original: itaraviśeṣaṇadvayaṃ tu tucche brahmaṇi ca bādhavāraṇāyādaraṇīyameva| pratyekaṃ vā vipratipattiḥ -- viyanmithyā na vā ? pṛthivī mithyā na veti| evaṃ viyadādeḥ pratyekaṃ pakṣatve'pi na ghaṭādau sandigdhānaikāntikatā| pakṣasamatvād ghaṭādeḥ| tathā hi -- pakṣe sādhyābhāvasandehasyānuguṇatvāt pakṣabhinna eva tasya dūṣaṇatvaṃ vācyam|
analyzed: itara viśeṣaṇa dvayam tu tucche brahmaṇi ca bādha vāraṇāya ādaraṇīyam eva pratyekam vā vipratipattiḥ viyat mithyā na vā pṛthivī mithyā na vā iti evam viyat ādeḥ pratyekam pakṣa tve api na ghaṭa ādau sandigdha anaikāntika tā pakṣa sama tvāt ghaṭa ādeḥ tathā hi pakṣe sādhya abhāva sandehasya anuguṇa tvāt pakṣa bhinne eva tasya dūṣaṇa tvam vācyam

original: ata evoktaṃ `sādhyābhāvaniścayavati hetusandehe eva sandigdhānaikāntikate' ti| pakṣatvaṃ tu sādhyasandehavattvam| sādhyagocarasādhakamānābhāvavattvaṃ vā| etacca ghaṭādisādhāraṇam| ata eva tatrāpi sandigdhānaikāntikatvaṃ na doṣaḥ| pakṣasamatvoktistu pratijñāviṣayatvābhāvamātreṇa| na ca tarhi pratijñāviṣayatvameva pakṣatvam| svārthānumāne tadabhāvāt|
analyzed: atas eva uktam sādhya abhāva niścayavati hetu sandehe eva sandigdha anaikāntika tā iti pakṣa tvam tu sādhya sandehavat tvam sādhya gocara sādhaka māna abhāvavat tvam vā etat ca ghaṭa ādi sādhāraṇam atas eva tatra api sandigdha anaikāntika tvam na doṣaḥ pakṣa samatva uktiḥ tu pratijñā viṣaya tva abhāva mātreṇa na ca tarhi pratijñā viṣaya tvam eva pakṣa tvam svārtha anumāne tad abhāvāt

original: evaṃ vipratipattau prācāṃ prayogāḥ -- vimataṃ mithyā dṛśyatvāt, jaḍatvāt, paricchinnatvāt, śuktirūpyavaditi| nāvayaveṣvāgrahaḥ| atra svaniyāmakaniyatayā vipratipattyā laghubhūtayā pakṣatāvacchedo na viruddhaḥ| samayabandhādinā vyavadhānāt| tasya anumānakālāsattve'pi upalakṣaṇatayā pakṣatāvacchedakatvam|
analyzed: evam vipratipattau prācām prayogāḥ vimatam mithyā dṛśya tvāt jaḍa tvāt paricchinna tvāt śukti rūpya vat iti na avayaveṣu āgrahaḥ atra sva niyāmaka niyatayā vipratipattyā laghu bhūtayā pakṣatā avacchedaḥ na viruddhaḥ samaya bandha ādinā vyavadhānāt tasya anumāna kāla asattve pi upalakṣaṇatayā pakṣatā avacchedaka tvam

original: yadvā vipratipattiviṣayatāvacchedakameva pakṣatāvacchedakam| prācāṃ prayogeṣvapi vimatamiti padaṃ vipratipattiviṣayatāvacchedakāvacchinnābhiprāyeṇetyadoṣaḥ|
analyzed: yat vā vipratipatti viṣaya tā avacchedakam eva pakṣatā avacchedakam prācām prayogeṣu api vimatam iti padam vipratipatti viṣaya tā avacchedaka avacchinna abhiprāyeṇa iti adoṣaḥ

original: nanu kimidaṃ mithyātvaṃ sādhyate ? na tāvat `mithyāśabdo'nirvacanīyatāvacanaḥ' iti pañcapādikāvacanāt sadasattvānadhikaraṇatvarūpamanirvācyatvam| taddhi kim asattvaviśiṣṭa sattvābhāvaḥ ? uta sattvātyantābhāvāsattvātyantābhāvarūpaṃ dharmadvayam ? āhosvit sattvātya ntābhāvavattve sati asattvātyantābhāvarūpaṃ viśiṣṭam ? nādyaḥ|
analyzed: nanu kim idam mithyātvam sādhyate na tāvat mithyā śabdaḥ nirvacanīya tā vacanaḥ iti pañcapādikā vacanāt sat asat tva anadhikaraṇa tva rūpam anirvācya tvam tat hi kim sattva abhāvaḥ uta sattva atyanta abhāva asattva atyanta abhāva rūpam dharma dvayam āhosvit sattva atyanta abhāvavat tve sati asattva atyanta abhāva rūpam viśiṣṭam na ādyaḥ

original: sattvaḥ mātrādhāre jagatyasattvaviśiṣṭasattvānabhyupagamāt| viśiṣṭābhāvasādhane siddhasādhanāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sattvāsattvayorekābhāve aparasattvāvaśyakatvena vyāghātāt| nirdharmakabrahmavatsattvarāhitye'pi sadrūpatvena amithyātvopapattyā arthāntarācca|
analyzed: sattvaḥ mātrādhāre jagati asattva viśiṣṭa sattva anabhyupagamāt viśiṣṭa abhāva sādhane siddhasādhanāt na dvitīyaḥ sattva asattvayoḥ eka abhāve apara sattva āvaśyaka tvena vyāghātāt nirdharmaka brahma vat sattva rāhitye api sat rūpa tvena amithyātva upapattyā artha antarāt ca

original: śuktirūpye abādhyatvarūpasattvavyatirekasya sattvena bādhyatvarūpāsattvasya vyatirekāsiddhyā sādhyavaikalyācca| ata eva na tṛtīyaḥ| pūrvavad vyāghātāt, arthāntarātsādhyavaikalyācceti cet, maivam| sattvātyantābhāvāsattvātyantābhāvarūpa dharmadvayavivakṣāyāṃ doṣābhāvāt| na ca vyāhatiḥ|
analyzed: śukti rūpye abādhya tva rūpa sattva vyatirekasya sattvena bādhya tva rūpa asattvasya vyatireka asiddhyā sādhya vaikalyāt ca atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ pūrvavat vyāghātāt artha antarāt sādhya vaikalyāt ca iti ced mā evam sattva atyanta abhāva asattva atyanta abhāva rūpa dharma dvaya vivakṣāyām doṣa abhāvāt na ca vyāhatiḥ

original: sā hi sattvāsattvayoḥ parasparaviraharūpatayā vā ? parasparavirahavyāpakatayā vā ? parasparavirahavyāpyatayā vā ? tatra nādyaḥ| tadanaṅgīkārāt| tathā hyatra trikālābādhyatvarūpasattvavyatireko nāsattvam| kiṃ tu kvacidapyupādhau sattvena pratīyamānatvānadhikaraṇatvam| tadvyatirekaśca sādhyatvena vivakṣitaḥ|
analyzed: sā hi sattva asattvayoḥ paraspara viraha rūpa tayā vā paraspara viraha vyāpaka tayā vā paraspara viraha vyāpya tayā vā tatra na ādyaḥ tad anaṅgīkārāt tathā hi atra tri kāla abādhya tva rūpa sattva vyatirekaḥ na asattvam kim tu kvacid api upādhau sattvena pratīyamāna tva anadhikaraṇa tvam tad vyatirekaḥ ca sādhya tvena vivakṣitaḥ

original: tathā ca trikālābādhyavilakṣaṇatve sati kvacidapyupādhau sattvena pratīyamānatvarūpaṃ sādhyaṃ paryavasitam| evaṃ ca sati na śuktirūpye sādhyavaikalyamapi| bādhyatvarūpāsattvavyatirekasya sādhyāpraveśāt| nāpi vyāghātaḥ, parasparaviraharūpatvābhāvāt| ata eva na dvitīyo'pi|
analyzed: tathā ca tri kāla abādhya vilakṣaṇa tve sati kvacid api upādhau sattvena pratīyamāna tva rūpam sādhyam paryavasitam evam ca sati na śukti rūpye sādhya vaikalyam api bādhya tva rūpa asattva vyatirekasya sādhya apraveśāt nā api vyāghātaḥ paraspara viraha rūpa tva abhāvāt atas eva na dvitīyaḥ api

original: sattvābhāvavati śuktirūpye vivakṣitāsattvavyatirekasya vidyamānatvena vyabhicārāt| nāpi tṛtīyaḥ| tasya vyāghātāprayojakatvāt| gotvāśvatvayoḥ parasparavirahavyāpyatve'pi tadabhāvayoruṣṭrādāvekatra sahopalambhād| yacca nirdharmakasya brahmaṇaḥ sattvarāhitye'pi sadrūpavatprapañcasya sadrūpatvenāmithyātvopapattyā arthāntaramuktam tanna|
analyzed: sattva abhāvavati śukti rūpye vivakṣita asattva vyatirekasya vidyamāna tvena vyabhicārāt na api tṛtīyaḥ tasya vyāghāta aprayojaka tvāt go tva aśva tvayoḥ paraspara viraha vyāpya tve api tad abhāvayoḥ uṣṭra ādau ekatra saha upalambhāt yat ca nirdharmakasya brahmaṇaḥ sattva rāhitye api sat rūpavat prapañcasya sat rūpa tvena amithyātva upapattyā artha antaram uktam tat na

original: ekenaiva sarvānugatena sarvatra satpratītyupapattau brahmavat pratyekaṃ prapañcasya satsvabhāvatākalpane mānābhāvāt| anugatavyavahārābhāvaprasaṅgācca| satpratiyogikāsatpratiyogikabhedadvayaṃ vā sādhyam| tathā cobhayātmakatve'nyatarātmakatve vā tādṛgbhedāsambhavena tābhyāmarthāntarānavakāśaḥ|
analyzed: ekena eva sarva anugatena sarvatra sat pratīti upapattau brahma vat pratyekam prapañcasya sat svabhāva tā kalpane māna abhāvāt anugata vyavahāra abhāva prasaṅgāt ca sat pratiyogika asat pratiyogika bheda dvayam vā sādhyam tathā ca ubhaya ātmaka tvena anyatara ātmaka tve vā tādṛś bheda asambhavena tābhyām artha antara anavakāśaḥ

original: na ca asattvavyatirekāṃśasyāsadbhedasya ca prapañce siddhatvenāṃśataḥ siddhasādhanamiti vācyam| `guṇādikaṃ guṇyādinā bhinnābhinnaṃ samānādhikṛtatvāt' iti bhedābhedavādiprayoge tārkikādyaṅgīkṛtasya bhinnatvasya siddhāvapi uddeśyapratītyasiddheryathā na siddhasādhanam tathā prakṛte'pi militapratīteruddeśyatvānna siddhasādhanam|
analyzed: na ca asattva vyatireka aṃśasya asat bhedasya ca prapañce siddhatvena aṃśataḥ siddhasādhanam iti vācyam guṇa ādikam guṇi ādinā bhinna abhinnam samāna adhikṛta tvāt iti bheda abheda vādi prayoge tārkika ādi aṅgīkṛtasya bhinna tvasya siddhau api uddeśya pratīti asiddheḥ yathā na siddhasādhanam tathā prakṛte api milita pratīteḥ uddeśya tvāt na siddhasādhanam

original: yathā tattvābhede ghaṭaḥ kumbha iti sāmānādhikaraṇyapratīteradarśanena militasiddhiruddeśyā tathā prakṛte'pi sattvarahite tucche dṛśyatvādarśanena militasya tatprayojakatayā militasiddhiruddeśyeti samānam|
analyzed: yathā tattva abhede ghaṭaḥ kumbhaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya pratīteḥ adarśanena milita siddhiḥ uddeśyā tathā prakṛte api sattva rahite tucche dṛśya tva adarśanena militasya tad prayojaka tayā milita siddhiḥ uddeśyā iti samānam

original: ata eva sattvātyantābhāvavattve satyasattvātyantābhāvarūpaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sādhyamityapi sādhu| na ca militasya viśiṣṭasya vā sādhyatve tasya kutrāpyaprasiddhyā aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvam| pratyekaṃ prasiddhyā militasya viśiṣṭasya vā sādhane śaśaśrṛṅgayoḥ pratyekaṃ prasiddhyā śaśīyaśrṛṅgasādhanamapi syāditi vācyam|
analyzed: atas eva sattva atyanta abhāvavat tve satya sattva atyanta abhāva rūpam viśiṣṭam sādhyam iti api sādhu na ca militasya viśiṣṭasya vā sādhya tve tasya kutra api aprasiddhyā aprasiddha viśeṣaṇa tvam pratyekam prasiddhyā militasya viśiṣṭasya vā sādhane śaśa śrṛṅgayoḥ pratyekam prasiddhyā śaśīya śrṛṅga sādhanam api syāt iti vācyam

original: tathāvidhaprasiddheḥ śuktirūpya evoktatvāt| na ca nirdharmakatvād brahmaṇaḥ sattvāsattvarūpadharmadvayaśūnyatvena tatrātivyāptiḥ| sadrūpatvena brahmaṇaḥ tadatyantābhāvānadhikaraṇatvāt| nirdharmakatvenaivābhāvarūpadharmānadhikaraṇatvācceti dik| iti sadasadvilakṣaṇatvarūpamithyātvavicāraḥ||1||

original: yadi punaḥ dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvapratiyogitvamivātyantābhāvapratiyogitvamākāśādau na syāt| sādhakamānābhāvasya tulyatvād| ihākāśo nāstīti pratyakṣapratītyasambhavād| anumāne cānukūlatarkābhāvāt| sāmānyato dṛṣṭamātreṇa dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvapratiyogitvasyāpi siddhiprasaṅgāt| tadvyatirekeṇa kasyacit kāryasyānupapatterabhāvācca|
analyzed: yadi punar dhvaṃsa prāgabhāva pratiyogi tvam iva atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvam ākāśa ādau na syāt sādhaka māna abhāvasya tulya tvāt iha ākāśaḥ na asti iti pratyakṣa pratīti asambhavāt anumāne ca anukūla tarka abhāvāt sāmānyatas dṛṣṭa mātreṇa dhvaṃsa prāgabhāva pratiyogi tvasya api siddhi prasaṅgāt tad vyatirekeṇa kasyacid kāryasya anupapatteḥ abhāvāt ca

analyzed: evam saṃyoga sambandhena ghaṭavati bhū tale samavāya sambandhena ghaṭa abhāva sattve māna abhāvāt lāghavena ghaṭa atyanta abhāva tvena eva ghaṭa sāmānādhikaraṇya virodhi tva kalpanāt sambandha viśeṣa praveśe ca gauravāt ghaṭa samavāya ādi abhāva mātra viṣayaka tayā pratīteḥ upapatteḥ ādhāra ādheya bhāvasya pratyakṣa siddhatvena ghaṭasya avṛtti tva śaṅkā anudayāt ukta yukteḥ ca na anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya anya

original: ghaṭāderatyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyam| evaṃ saṃyogatadabhāvayornaikādhikaraṇyam| agre vṛkṣaḥ kapisaṃyogī mūle ne 'ti pratīteragramūlayoreva saṃyogatadabhāvavattayopapatteḥ, tadā sanmātraniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvameva mithyātvaṃ mantavyam|
analyzed: ghaṭa ādeḥ atyanta abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyam evam saṃyoga tad abhāvayoḥ na aika adhikaraṇyam agre vṛkṣaḥ kapi saṃyogī mūle na i ti pratīteḥ agra mūlayoḥ eva saṃyoga tad abhāvavat tayā upapatteḥ tadā sat mātra niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam eva mithyātvam mantavyam

original: na caivaṃ sati bhāvābhāvayoravirodhāttajjñānayorbādhyabādhakabhāvo na syāditi vācyam| bhinnasattākayoravirodhe'pi samasattākayorvirodhāt| yatra bhūtale yasya ghaṭasyātyantābhāvo vyāvahārikaḥ tatra sa ghaṭo na vyāvahārika iti niyamāt|
analyzed: na ca evam sati bhāva abhāvayoḥ avirodhāt tad jñānayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ na syāt iti vācyam bhinna sattākayoḥ avirodhe pi sama sattākayoḥ virodhāt yatra bhū tale yasya ghaṭasya atyanta abhāvaḥ vyāvahārikaḥ tatra sa ghaṭaḥ na vyāvahārikaḥ iti niyamāt

original: na caivaṃ sati `śuktiriyaṃ na rajata' miti jñānaviṣayībhūtābhāvasya vyāvahārikatvena purovartipratītarajatasya vyāvahārikatvāpahāre'pi prātītikasattvānapahārād bādhottarakāle'pi `idaṃ rajata' miti pratītiḥ syāditi vācyam| tatra `iyaṃ śuktiḥ' rityaparokṣapramayā prātītikarajatopādānājñānanivṛttau prātītikasattvasyāpyapahārāt|
analyzed: na ca evam sati śuktiḥ iyam na rajatam iti jñāna viṣayībhūta abhāvasya vyāvahārika tvena purovarti pratīta rajatasya vyāvahārika tva apahāre pi prātītika sattva anapahārāt bādha uttara kāle pi idam rajatam iti pratītiḥ syāt iti vācyam tatra iyam śuktiḥ riti aparokṣa pramayā prātītika rajata upādāna ajñāna nivṛttau prātītika sattvasya api apahārāt

original: śuktyajñānasya prātītikarajatopādānatvena tadasattve prātītikarajatāsattvasyāvaśyakatvāt| ata eva yatra parokṣayā'dhiṣṭhānapramayā na bhramopādānājñānanivṛttiḥ,tatra vyāvahārikatvāpahāre'pi prātītikatvānapahārāt `tikto guḍaḥ' ityādipratītiranuvartata eva|
analyzed: śukti ajñānasya prātītika rajata upādāna tvena tad asattve prātītika rajata asattvasya āvaśyaka tvāt atas eva yatra parokṣayā adhiṣṭhāna pramayā na bhrama upādāna ajñāna nivṛttiḥ tatra vyāvahārika tva apahāre pi prātītika tva anapahārāt tiktaḥ guḍaḥ ityādi pratītiḥ anuvartate eva

original: ekamakhaṇḍabrahmasākṣātkārātpūrvaṃ parokṣabodhena prapañcasya vyāvahārikatvāpahāre'pi pratītiranuvartata eva| adhiṣṭhānājñānanivṛttau tu nānuvartiṣyate|
analyzed: ekam akhaṇḍa brahma sākṣātkārāt pūrvam parokṣa bodhena prapañcasya vyāvahārika tva apahāre pi pratītiḥ anuvartate eva adhiṣṭhāna ajñāna nivṛttau tu na anuvartiṣyate

original: etena upādhiśabdenādhikaraṇamātravivakṣāyāmarthāntaram| vāyvadhikaraṇakātyantā bhāvapratiyogitve'pi rūpasyāmithyātvād| adhiṣṭhānavivakṣāyāṃ tu bhramopādānājñāna viṣayasyādhiṣṭhānatvenānyonyāśrayatvam| jñānasya bhramatve viṣayasya mithyātvam, viṣayasya mithyātve ca jñānasya bhramatvamiti parāstam; uktarītyā adhikaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ doṣābhāvāt|
analyzed: etena upādhi śabdena adhikaraṇa mātra vivakṣāyām artha antaram vāyu adhikaraṇaka atyanta abhāva pratiyogitve pi rūpasya amithyātvāt adhiṣṭhāna vivakṣāyām tu bhrama upādāna ajñāna viṣayasya adhiṣṭhāna tvena anyonya āśraya tvam jñānasya bhrama tve viṣayasya mithyātvam viṣayasya mithyātve ca jñānasya bhrama tvam iti parāstam ukta rītyā adhikaraṇa vivakṣāyām doṣa abhāvāt

original: na ca `sa evādhastād' iti śrutyā pratipanno deśakālādyupādhau paramārthato brahmaṇo'bhāvāttatrātivyāptiriti vācyam| nirdharmake tasminnabhāvapratiyogitvarūpadharmābhāvāt| na caivaṃ -- satyatvamapi tatra na syāt, tathā ca `satyaṃ jñānamananta' mityādiśrutivyākopa iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca saḥ eva adhastāt iti śrutyā pratipannaḥ deśa kāla ādi upādhau paramārthataḥ brahmaṇaḥ bhāvāt tatra ativyāptiḥ iti vācyam nirdharmake tasmin abhāva pratiyogi tva rūpa dharma abhāvāt na ca evam satya tvam api tatra na syāt tathā ca satyam jñānam anantam ityādi śruti vyākopaḥ iti vācyam

original: adhikaraṇātiriktābhāvānabhyupagamenoktamithyātvābhāvarūpasatyatvasya brahma svarūpatvāvirodhāt| etena svaprakāśatvādyapi vyākhyātam| paraprakāśyatvābhāvo hi svaprakāśatvam, kālaparicchedābhāvo nityatvam, deśaparīcchedābhāvo vibhutvam, vastuparicchedābhāvaḥ pūrṇatvamityādi|
analyzed: adhikaraṇa atirikta abhāva anabhyupagamena ukta mithyātva abhāva rūpa satya tvasya brahma svarūpa tva avirodhāt etena sva prakāśa tva ādi api vyākhyātam para prakāśya tva abhāvaḥ hi sva prakāśa tvam kāla pariccheda abhāvaḥ nitya tvam deśa parīccheda abhāvaḥ vibhu tvam vastu pariccheda abhāvaḥ pūrṇa tvam ityādi

original: tathā ca bhāvarūpadharmānāśrayatve'pi brahmaṇaḥ sarvadharmābhāvarūpatayā na kā'pyanupapattiriti sarvamavadātam|
analyzed: tathā ca bhāva rūpa dharma anāśraya tve pi brahmaṇaḥ sarva dharma abhāva rūpa tayā na kā api anupapattiḥ iti sarvam avadātam

original: iti sadasadvilakṣaṇatvarūpadvitīyamithyātvavicāraḥ||
analyzed: iti sat asat vilakṣaṇa tva rūpa dvitīya mithyātva vicāraḥ

original: jñānanivartyatvaṃ vā mithyātvam| nanu -- uttarajñānanivartye pūrvajñāne ativyāptiḥ, mudgarapātādinivartye ca ghaṭādāvavyāptiḥ, jñānatvena jñānanivartyatvavivakṣāyāmapyayaṃ doṣaḥ, adhiṣṭhānasākṣātkāratvena nivartye śuktirajatādau ca jñānatvena jñānanivartyatvābhāvāt sādhyavikalatā|
analyzed: jñāna nivartya tvam vā mithyātvam nanu uttara jñāna nivartye pūrva jñāne ativyāptiḥ mudgara pāta ādi nivartye ca ghaṭa ādau avyāptiḥ jñāna tvena jñāna nivartya tva vivakṣāyām api ayam doṣaḥ adhiṣṭhāna sākṣātkāra tvena nivartye śukti rajata ādau ca jñāna tvena jñāna nivartya tva abhāvāt sādhya vikala tā

original: jñānatvavyāpyadharmeṇa jñānanivartyatvavikṣāyāṃ jñānatvavyāpyena smṛtitvena jñānanivartye saṃskāre ativyāptiriti cenna, jñānaprayuktāvasthitisāmānyavirahapratiyogitvaṃ hi jñānanivartyatvam| avasthitiśca dvedhā svarūpeṇa kāraṇātmanā ca; satkāryavādābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: jñāna tva vyāpya dharmeṇa jñāna nivartya tva vikṣāyām jñāna tva vyāpyena smṛti tvena jñāna nivartye saṃskāre ativyāptiḥ iti ced na jñāna prayukta avasthiti sāmānya viraha pratiyogi tvam hi jñāna nivartya tvam avasthitiḥ ca dvedhā svarūpeṇa kāraṇa ātmanā ca satkārya vāda abhyupagamāt

original: tathā ca mudgarapātena ghaṭasya svarūpeṇāvasthitivirahe'pi kāraṇātmanāvasthitivirahābhāvād, brahmajñānaprayukta eva sa iti nātītaghaṭādāvavyāptiḥ| ata evottarajñānanivartye pūrvajñāne na siddhasādhanam; na vā viyadādau brahmajñānanāśyatve'pi tadvadeva mithyātvāsiddhyā'rthāntaram;
analyzed: tathā ca mudgara pātena ghaṭasya svarūpeṇa avasthiti virahe api kāraṇa ātmanā avasthiti viraha abhāvāt brahma jñāna prayuktaḥ eva saḥ iti na atīta ghaṭa ādau avyāptiḥ atas eva uttara jñāna nivartye pūrva jñāne na siddhasādhanam na vā viyat ādau brahma jñāna nāśya tve pi tadvat eva mithyātva asiddhyā arthāntaram

original: uttarajñānena līnasya pūrvajñānasya svakāraṇātmanāvasthānādavasthitisāmānyavirahānupapatteḥ| śaśaviṣāṇādāvavasthitisāmānyavirahe'pi tasya jñānaprayuktatvābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ| śuktirajatā deścāparokṣapratītyanyathānupapattyā pratibhāsakāle avasthityaṅgīkārānna bādhakajñānaṃ vinā tadviraha iti na sādhyavikalatā|
analyzed: uttara jñānena līnasya pūrva jñānasya sva kāraṇa ātmanā avasthānāt avasthiti sāmānya viraha anupapatteḥ śaśaviṣāṇa ādau avasthiti sāmānya virahe pi tasya jñāna prayukta tva abhāvāt na ativyāptiḥ śukti rajatā ādeḥ ca aparokṣa pratīti anyathā anupapattyā pratibhāsa kāle avasthiti aṅgīkārāt na bādhaka jñānam vinā tad virahaḥ iti na sādhya vikala tā

original: ata evoktaṃ vivaraṇācāryaiḥ -- ajñānasya svakāryeṇa pravilīnena vartamānena vā saha jñānena nivṛttirbādha'iti| vārtikakṛdbhiścoktam --
analyzed: atas eva uktam vivaraṇa ācāryaiḥ ajñānasya sva kāryeṇa pravilīnena vartamānena vā saha jñānena nivṛttiḥ bādhā eti vārtika kṛdbhiḥ ca uktam

original: `tattvamasyādivākyotthasamyagdhījanmamātrataḥ|
analyzed: tattvam asi ādi vākya uttha samyak dhī janma mātrataḥ

original: avidyā saha kāryeṇa nāsīdasti bhaviṣyati|| iti|
analyzed: avidyā saha kāryeṇa na āsīt asti bhaviṣyati iti

original: `saha kāryeṇa nāsī' diti līnena kāryeṇa saha nivṛttyabhiprāyam, `saha kāryeṇa na bhaviṣyatī' ti tu bhāvikāryanivṛttyabhiprāyamityanyadetat| rūpyopādānamajñānaṃ svakāryeṇa vartamānena līnena vā sahādhiṣṭhānasākṣātkārānnivartate|
analyzed: saha kāryeṇa na āsīt iti līnena kāryeṇa saha nivṛtti abhiprāyam saha kāryeṇa na bhaviṣyati ti tu bhāvi kārya nivṛtti abhiprāyam iti anyat etat rūpya upādānam ajñānam sva kāryeṇa vartamānena līnena vā saha adhiṣṭhāna sākṣātkārāt nivartate

original: tattadbhramopādānānām ajñānānāṃ bhedābhyupagamāditi na dṛṣṭānte sādhyavaikalyam, mudgarapātāntaraṃ ghaṭo nāstīti pratītivadadhiṣṭhānajñānānantaraṃ śuktyajñānaṃ tadgatarūpyaṃ ca nāstīti pratīteḥ sarvasaṃmatatvāt| jñānatvavyāpyadharmeṇa jñānanivartyatvamityapi sādhu|
analyzed: tad tad bhrama upādānānām ajñānānām bheda abhyupagamāt iti na dṛṣṭānte sādhya vaikalyam mudgara pāta antaram ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratīti vat adhiṣṭhāna jñāna anantaram śukti ajñānam tad gata rūpyam ca na asti iti pratīteḥ sarva saṃmata tvāt jñāna tva vyāpya dharmeṇa jñāna nivartya tvam iti api sādhu

original: uttarajñānasya pūrvajñānanivartakatvaṃ ca na jñānatvavyāpyadharmeṇa ? kiṃtvicchādisādhāraṇenodīcyātmaviśeṣaguṇatvena udīcyatvena veti na siddhasādhanādi| nāpīcchādyanivartye smṛtitvena jñānanivartye saṃskāre ativyāptiḥ, smṛtitvena smṛteḥ saṃskāranivartakatve mānābhāvāt|
analyzed: uttara jñānasya pūrva jñāna nivartaka tvam ca na jñāna tva vyāpya dharmeṇa kiṃtu icchā ādi sādhāraṇena udīcya ātma viśeṣa guṇa tvena udīcya tvena vā iti na siddha sādhana ādi nā api icchā ādi anivartye smṛti tvena jñāna nivartye saṃskāre ativyāptiḥ smṛti tvena smṛteḥ saṃskāra nivartaka tve māna abhāvāt

original: smṛtau hi jātāyāṃ saṃskāro dṛḍho bhavatītyanubhavasiddham teṣāṃ dṛḍhatvaṃ ca samānaviṣayakasaṃskārānekatvamityadoṣaḥ| vastutastu sākṣātkāratvena jñānanivartyatvaṃ vivakṣitam; ato na pūrvektadoṣaḥ| nāpi niścayatvena jñānatvavyāpyadharmiṇa jñānanivartye saṃśaye ativyāptiriti sarvamavadātam|
analyzed: smṛtau hi jātāyām saṃskāraḥ dṛḍhaḥ bhavati iti anubhava siddham teṣām dṛḍha tvam ca samāna viṣayaka saṃskāra anekatvam iti adoṣaḥ vastutas tu sākṣātkāra tvena jñāna nivartya tvam vivakṣitam atas na pūrva īkta doṣaḥ na api niścaya tvena jñāna tva vyāpya dharmiṇa jñāna nivartye saṃśaye ativyāptiḥ iti sarvam avadātam

original: iti tṛtīyamithyātvavicāraḥ
analyzed: iti tṛtīya mithyātva vicāraḥ

original: svāśrayaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ vā mithyātvam| tacca svātyantābhāvādhikaraṇa eva pratīyamānatvam, ataḥ pūrvavailakṣaṇyam| dūṣaṇaparihāraśca pūrvavat|
analyzed: sva āśraya niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam vā mithyātvam tat ca sva atyanta abhāva adhikaraṇe eva pratīyamāna tvam atas pūrva vailakṣaṇyam dūṣaṇa parihāraḥ ca pūrvavat

original: na ca saṃyogini samavāyini vā deśe tadatyantābhāvāsambhavaḥ, sambhave tūpādānatvādyanupapattiriti vācyam, kāle sahasaṃbhavavad deśe'pi sahasambhavāvirodhāt, prāgabhāvasattvenopādānatvāvirodhācca| na ca atyantābhāvādhikaraṇe prāgabhāvasyāpyanupapattiriti vācyam| kāle vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: na ca saṃyogini samavāyini vā deśe tad atyanta abhāva asambhavaḥ sambhave tu upādāna tva ādi anupapattiḥ iti vācyam kāle saha saṃbhava vat deśe api saha sambhava avirodhāt prāgabhāva sattvena upādāna tva avirodhāt ca na ca atyanta abhāva adhikaraṇe prāgabhāvasya api anupapattiḥ iti vācyam kāle vyabhicārāt

original: na ca kāle prāgabhāvatyantābhāvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam idānīṃ ghaṭātyantābhāvaḥ, idānīṃ ghaṭaprāgabhāva iti pratītibalādaṅgīkṛtam, deśe tu tadubhayasāmānādhikaraṇye na kiñcidapi pramāṇamiti vācyam, mityātvānumiteḥ śrutyādeśca pramāṇatvāt| viṣamasattāka bhāvābhavayoravirodhaḥ pūrvamupapāditaḥ|
analyzed: na ca kāle prāgabhāva atyanta abhāvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam idānīm ghaṭa atyanta abhāvaḥ idānīm ghaṭa prāgabhāvaḥ iti pratīti balāt aṅgīkṛtam deśe tu tad ubhaya sāmānādhikaraṇye na kiñcid api pramāṇam iti vācyam mityātva anumiteḥ śruti ādeḥ ca pramāṇa tvāt viṣama sattāka bhāva abhavayoḥ avirodhaḥ pūrvam upapāditaḥ

original: na ca asatyativyāptiḥ, svātyantābhāvādhikaraṇa eva sattvena pratīyamānatvasya vivakṣitatvāt| na ca `taddhaika āhurasadevedamagra āsī' diti śrutyā asataḥ sattvapratītestatrātivyāptirduṣparihareti vācyam, `sadevedamagra āsī' dityasyārthasyābhāva eva nañā pratipādyate, na tvasataḥ sattvam, virodhātuḥ ato nātivyāptiḥ|
analyzed: na ca asati ativyāptiḥ sva atyanta abhāva adhikaraṇe eva sattvena pratīyamāna tvasya vivakṣita tvāt na ca tat ha eke āhuḥ asat eva idam agre āsīt iti śrutyā asataḥ sattva pratīteḥ tatra ativyāptiḥ duṣpariharā iti vācyam sat eva idam agre āsīt iti asya arthasya abhāvaḥ eva nañā pratipādyate na tu asataḥ sattvam virodhātuḥ atas nā ativyāptiḥ

original: sarvaṃ cānyat pūrvoktamevānusandheyamityuparamyate||
analyzed: sarvam ca anyat pūrva uktam eva anusandheyam iti uparamyate

original: iti caturthamithyātvavicāraḥ||
analyzed: iti caturtha mithyātva vicāraḥ

original: sadviviktatvaṃ vā mithyātvam| sattvaṃ ca pramāṇasiddhatvam| pramāṇatvaṃ ca doṣāsahakṛtajñānakaraṇatvam, tena svapnādivatpramāṇasiddhabhinnatvena mithyātvaṃ sidhyati| pramāṇasiddhatvaṃ cābādhyatvavyāpyamityanyat| atrāpyasati nirdharmake brahmaṇi cātivyāptivāraṇāya sattvena pratīyamānatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam|
analyzed: sat vivikta tvam vā mithyātvam sattvam ca pramāṇa siddha tvam pramāṇa tvam ca doṣa asahakṛta jñāna karaṇa tvam tena svapna ādi vat pramāṇa siddha bhinna tvena mithyātvam sidhyati pramāṇa siddha tvam ca abādhya tva vyāpyam iti anyat atra api asati nirdharmake brahmaṇi ca ativyāpti vāraṇāya sattvena pratīyamāna tvam viśeṣaṇam deyam

original: tayoḥ sattvaprakārakapratītiviṣayatvābhāvāt| ata eva sadviviktatvamityatra sattvaṃ sattājātyadhikaraṇatvaṃ vā ? abādhyatvaṃ vā ? brahmarūpatvaṃ vā ? ādye ghaṭādāvāvidyakajātestvayābhyupagamenāsambhavaḥ, dvitīye bādhyatvarūpamithyātva paryavasānam, tṛtīye siddhasādhanamiti nirastam, anabhyupagamādeva|
analyzed: tayoḥ sattva prakāraka pratīti viṣayatva abhāvāt atas eva sat viviktatvam iti atra sattvam sattā jāti adhikaraṇatvam vā abādhya tvam vā brahma rūpatvam vā ādye ghaṭa ādau āvidyaka jāteḥ tvayā abhyupagamena asambhavaḥ dvitīye bādhya tva rūpa mithyātva paryavasānam tṛtīye siddhasādhanam iti nirastam anabhyupagamāt eva

original: sadasadvilakṣaṇatvapakṣokta yuktayaścātrānusandheyāḥ| avaśiṣṭaṃ ca dṛṣṭāntasiddhau vakṣyāmaḥ||
analyzed: sat asat vilakṣaṇa tva pakṣa ukta yuktayaḥ ca atra anusandheyāḥ avaśiṣṭam ca dṛṣṭānta siddhau vakṣyāmaḥ

original: ityadvaitasiddhau pañcamamithyātvaniruktiḥ||
analyzed: iti advaitasiddhau pañcama mithyātva niruktiḥ

original: nanu -- uktamithyātvasya mithyātve prapañcasatyatvāpātaḥ, ekasmin dharmiṇi prasaktayoḥ virudvadharmayorekamithyātve aparasatyatvaniyamāt, mithyātvasatyatve ca tadvadeva prapañcasatyatvāpatteḥ| ubhayathāpyadvaitavyāghāta iti cenna; mithyātvamithyātve'pi prapañcasatyatvānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu ukta mithyātvasya mithyātve prapañca satya tva āpātaḥ ekasmin dharmiṇi prasaktayoḥ virudva dharmayoḥ eka mithyātve apara satya tva niyamāt mithyātva satyatve ca tadvat eva prapañca satya tva āpatteḥ ubhayathā api advaita vyāghātaḥ iti ced na mithyātva mithyātve pi prapañca satya tva anupapatteḥ

original: tatra hi viruddhayordharmayorekamithyātve aparasatyatvam‌, yatra mithyātvāvacchedakamubhayavṛtti na bhavet; yathā parasparaviraharūpayo rajatatvatadabhāvayoḥ śuktau, yathā vā parasparavirahavyāpakayo rajatabhinnatvarajatvayoḥ tatraiva; tatra niṣedhyatāvacchedakabhedaniyamāt| prakṛte tu niṣedhyatāvacchedakamekameva dṛśyatvādi|
analyzed: tatra hi viruddhayoḥ dharmayoḥ eka mithyātve apara satyatvam yatra mithyātva avacchedakam ubhaya vṛtti na bhavet yathā paraspara viraha rūpayoḥ rajata tva tad abhāvayoḥ śuktau yathā vā paraspara viraha vyāpakayoḥ rajata bhinna tva raja tvayoḥ tatra eva tatra niṣedhya tā avacchedaka bheda niyamāt prakṛte tu niṣedhya tā avacchedakam ekam eva dṛśya tva ādi

original: yathā gotvāśvatvayorekasmin gaje niṣedhe gajatvātyantābhāvavyāpyatvaṃ niṣedhyatācchedakamubhayostulyamiti naikataraniṣedhe anyatarasattvam, tadvat| yathā ca satyatvamithyātvayorna parasparaviraharūpatvam, na vā parasparavirahavyāpakatvam, tathopapāditamadhastāt|
analyzed: yathā go tva aśva tvayoḥ ekasmin gaje niṣedhe gaja tva atyanta abhāva vyāpya tvam niṣedhya tā ācchedakam ubhayoḥ tulyam iti na ekatara niṣedhe anyatara sattvam tadvat yathā ca satyatva mithyātvayoḥ na paraspara viraha rūpatvam na vā paraspara viraha vyāpaka tvam tathā upapāditam adhastāt

original: parasparaviraharūpatve'pi viṣamasattākayoravirodhāt, vyāvahārika mithyātvena vyāvahārikasatyatvāpahāre'pi kālpanikasatyatvānapahārāt, tārkikamatasiddha saṃyogatadabhāvavat satyatvamithyātvayoḥ samuccayābhyupagamācca| ekasya sādhakena aparasya bādhyatvaṃ viṣamasattākatve prayojakam,yathā śuktirūpyatadabhāvayoḥ|
analyzed: paraspara viraha rūpa tve api viṣama sattākayoḥ avirodhāt vyāvahārika mithyātvena vyāvahārika satyatva apahāre pi kālpanika satyatva anapahārāt tārkika mata siddha saṃyoga tad abhāva vat satyatva mithyātvayoḥ samuccaya abhyupagamāt ca ekasya sādhakena aparasya bādhya tvam viṣama sattāka tve prayojakam yathā śukti rūpya tad abhāvayoḥ

original: ekabādhakabādhyatvaṃ ca samasattākatve prayojakam, yathā śuktirūpyaśuktibhinnatvayoḥ asti ca prapañcatanmithyātva yorekabrahmajñānabādhyatvam| ataḥ samasattākatvānmithyātvabādhakena prapañcasyāpi bādhānnādvaitakṣati riti kṛtamadhikena|
analyzed: eka bādhaka bādhya tvam ca sama sattāka tve prayojakam yathā śukti rūpya śukti bhinna tvayoḥ asti ca prapañca tad mithyātva yoḥ eka brahma jñāna bādhya tvam atas sama sattāka tvāt mithyātva bādhakena prapañcasya api bādhāt na advaita kṣatiḥ iti kṛtam adhikena

original: iti mithyātvasāmānyopapattiḥ|
analyzed: iti mithyātva sāmānya upapattiḥ

original: nanu -- mithyātve sādhye hetūkṛtaṃ yad dṛśyatvaṃ tadapyupapādanīyam| tathā hi -- kimidaṃ dṛśyatvam ? vṛttivyāpyatvaṃ vā ? phalavyāpyatvaṃ vā ? sādhāraṇaṃ vā ? kadācit kathañcit cidviṣayatvaṃ vā ? svavyavahāre svātiriktasaṃvidantarāpekṣāniyatirvā ?asvaprakāśatvaṃ vā ? nādyaḥ, ātmano vedāntajanyavṛttivyāpyatvena tatra vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: nanu mithyātve sādhye hetūkṛtam yat dṛśya tvam tat api upapādanīyam tathā hi kim idam dṛśya tvam vṛtti vyāpya tvam vā phala vyāpya tvam vā sādhāraṇam vā kadācid kathañcid cit viṣayatvam vā sva vyavahāre sva atirikta saṃvid antara apekṣā niyatiḥ vā asvaprakāśa tvam vā na ādyaḥ ātmanaḥ vedānta janya vṛtti vyāpya tvena tatra vyabhicārāt

original: ata eva na tṛtīyo'pi| nāpi dvitīyaḥ nityātīndriye śuktirūpyādau ca tadabhāvena bhāgāsiddhi sādhanavaikalyayoḥ prasaṅgāt| nāpi caturthaḥ, brahma pūrvaṃ na jñātamidānīṃ vedāntena jñātamityanubhavena ātmani vyabhicārāt| nāpi pañcamaḥ, brahmaṇyapyadvitīyatvādiviśiṣṭavyavahāre saṃvidantarāpekṣāniyatidarśanena vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ api nā api dvitīyaḥ nitya atīndriye śukti rūpya ādau ca tad abhāvena bhāga asiddhi sādhana vaikalyayoḥ prasaṅgāt nā api caturthaḥ brahma pūrvam na jñātam idānīm vedāntena jñātam iti anubhavena ātmani vyabhicārāt nā api pañcamaḥ brahmaṇi api advitīya tva ādi viśiṣṭa vyavahāre saṃvid antara apekṣā niyati darśanena vyabhicārāt

original: nāpi ṣaṣṭhaḥ, sa hi avedyatve satyaparokṣavyavahārayogyatvābhāvarūpaḥ| tathā ca śuktirūpyāderapi aparokṣavyavahārayogyatvena sādhanavaikalyād -- iti cenmaivam, phalavyāpyatvavyatiriktasya sarvasyāpi pakṣasya kṣodakṣamatvāt|
analyzed: nā api ṣaṣṭhaḥ sa hi avedya tve sati aparokṣa vyavahāra yogya tva abhāva rūpaḥ tathā ca śukti rūpya ādeḥ api aparokṣa vyavahāra yogya tvena sādhana vaikalyāt iti ced mā evam phala vyāpya tva vyatiriktasya sarvasya api pakṣasya kṣoda kṣamatvāt

original: na ca vṛttivyāpyatvapakṣe brahmaṇi vyabhicāraḥ, anyathā brahmaparāṇāṃ vedāntānāṃ vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāditi vācyam, śuddhaṃ hi brahma na dṛśyam, `yattadadreśyam -- iti śruteḥ, kintūpahitameva, tacca mithyaiva, na hi vṛttidaśāyāṃ anupahitaṃ tadbhavati|
analyzed: na ca vṛtti vyāpya tva pakṣe brahmaṇi vyabhicāraḥ anyathā brahma parāṇām vedāntānām vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt iti vācyam śuddham hi brahma na dṛśyam yat tat adreśyam iti śruteḥ kintu upahitam eva tat ca mithyā eva na hi vṛtti daśāyām anupahitam tat bhavati

original: na ca `sarvapratyayavedye vā brahmarūpe vyavasthite' iti svavacanavirodha iti vācyam, tasyāpyupahitaparatvāt|
analyzed: na ca sarva pratyaya vedye vā brahma rūpe vyavasthite iti sva vacana virodhaḥ iti vācyam tasya api upahita para tvāt

original: na ca -- evaṃ sati śuddhasiddhirna syāditi -- vācyam, svata eva tasya prakāśatvena siddhatvāt| nanu -- ajñāte dharmiṇi kasyacit dharmasya vidhātuṃ niṣeddhuṃ vā aśakyatvena śuddhe dṛśyatvaṃ niṣedhatā śuddhasya jñeyatvamavaśyaṃ svīkaraṇīyam| na ca svaprakāśatvena svataḥ siddhe śuddhe śrutyā dṛśyatvaniṣedha iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca evam sati śuddha siddhiḥ na syāt iti vācyam svatas eva tasya prakāśa tvena siddha tvāt nanu ajñāte dharmiṇi kasyacid dharmasya vidhātum niṣeddhum vā aśakya tvena śuddhe dṛśya tvam niṣedhatā śuddhasya jñeya tvam avaśyam svīkaraṇīyam na ca sva prakāśa tvena svatas siddhe śuddhe śrutyā dṛśya tva niṣedhaḥ iti vācyam

original: śuddhaṃ svaprakāśamiti śabdajanyaviśiṣṭavṛttau śuddhāprakāśe tasya svaprakāśatvāsiddheḥ iti -- cet, na| vṛttikāle vṛttirūpeṇa dharmeṇa śuddhatvāsambhavāt śuddhasya vṛttiviṣayatvaṃ na sambhavati, ataḥ `śuddhaṃ svaprakāśam -- iti vākyasya lakṣaṇayā aśuddhatvamasvaprakāśatvavyāpakamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: śuddham sva prakāśam iti śabda janya viśiṣṭa vṛttau śuddha aprakāśe tasya sva prakāśa tva asiddheḥ iti ced na vṛtti kāle vṛtti rūpeṇa dharmeṇa śuddha tva asambhavāt śuddhasya vṛtti viṣaya tvam na sambhavati atas śuddham sva prakāśam iti vākyasya lakṣaṇayā aśuddha tvam asva prakāśa tva vyāpakam iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca aśuddhatvavyāvṛttyā śuddhe svaprakāśatā paryavasyati, yathā bhedaniṣedhena abhinnatvam| na ca śuddhapadena abhidhayā lakṣaṇayā vā śuddhāprakāśe tatprayogavaiyarthyamiti vācyam, paryavasitārthamādāya sārthakatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca aśuddha tva vyāvṛttyā śuddhe sva prakāśa tā paryavasyati yathā bheda niṣedhena abhinna tvam na ca śuddha padena abhidhayā lakṣaṇayā vā śuddha aprakāśe tad prayoga vaiyarthyam iti vācyam paryavasita artham ādāya sārthaka tva upapatteḥ

original: evaṃ ca `śuddhaṃ na dṛśyaṃ na mithyā' ityasyāpyaśuddhatvaṃ dṛśyatvamithyātvayorvyāpakamityetatparatvena śuddhe dṛśyatvamithyātvayorvyatirekaḥ paryavasyati| etena sphuraṇamātrameva mithyātve tantram, lāghavād; ataḥ `svataḥ sphuradapi brahma mithyaive' ti śūnyavādimatamapāstam;
analyzed: evam ca śuddham na dṛśyam na mithyā iti asya api aśuddha tvam dṛśya tva mithyātvayoḥ vyāpakam iti etad paratvena śuddhe dṛśya tva mithyātvayoḥ vyatirekaḥ paryavasyati etena sphuraṇa mātram eva mithyātve tantram lāghavāt atas svatas sphurat api brahma mithyā evā iti śūnyavādi matam apāstam

original: svataḥ sphuraṇarūpatāyāḥ śuktirūpyādāvabhāvāt, sphuraṇaviṣayatvasya brahmaṇyasiddheḥ|
analyzed: svatas sphuraṇa rūpa tāyāḥ śukti rūpya ādau abhāvāt sphuraṇa viṣaya tvasya brahmaṇi asiddheḥ

original: nanu -- viśiṣṭajñāne viśeṣyasyāpi bhāne śrutyā viśiṣṭasya dṛśyatvenaiva viśeṣyasyāpi dṛśyatvād vyabhicāraḥ, na ca `viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāye' tyādau viśiṣṭasya devatātvavad viśiṣṭasya viṣayatvam, agnīṣomayormilitayordevatātvavadvā militasya viṣayatvam, ato na viśeṣye viṣayatvamiti vācyam, tadvadeva viśeṣaṇasyāpyaviṣayatve bhāgāsiddhiprasaṅgād iti cenna,
analyzed: nanu viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣyasya api bhāne śrutyāḥ viśiṣṭasya dṛśya tvena eva viśeṣyasya api dṛśya tvāt vyabhicāraḥ na ca viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya ityādau viśiṣṭasya devatā tva vat viśiṣṭasya viṣaya tvam agnīṣomayoḥ militayoḥ devatā tva vat vā militasya viṣaya tvam atas na viśeṣye viṣaya tvam iti vācyam tadvat eva viśeṣaṇasya api aviṣaya tve bhāga asiddhi prasaṅgāt iti ced na

original: viśeṣyatāpannasya viṣayatve'pi kṣatyabhāvāt, tasya mithyātvābhyupagamāt| ata eva upahitaviṣayatve'pyupadheyaviṣayatvamakṣatameva iti apāstam, upahitātmanā tasyāpi mithyātvābhyupagamāt, jñānāntaraviṣayatvena viśeṣaṇe bhāgāsiddhyabhāvācca|
analyzed: viśeṣya tā āpannasya viṣaya tve pi kṣati abhāvāt tasya mithyātva abhyupagamāt atas eva upahita viṣaya tve pi upadheya viṣaya tvam akṣatam eva iti apāstam upahita ātmanā tasya api mithyātva abhyupagamāt jñāna antara viṣaya tvena viśeṣaṇe bhāga asiddhi abhāvāt ca

original: nanu vedāntajanyākhaṇḍavṛtterupahitaviṣayatve tadānīmupādhyantarābhāvena tasyā evopadhāyakatvāt svaviṣayatvāpattiḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| śābdabodhe śabdānupasthitābhānaniyamena vṛtteḥ śabdānupasthitāyā bhānānupapatteḥ| yathākathañcidupapattau vā na tato'jñānatatkāryayornivṛttiḥ syād| ajñānatatkāryāviṣayakajñānasyaiva tadubhayanivartakatvād|
analyzed: nanu vedānta janya akhaṇḍa vṛtteḥ upahita viṣayatve tadānīm upādhi antara abhāvena tasyāḥ eva upadhāyakatvāt sva viṣayatva āpattiḥ na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ śābdabodhe śabda anupasthita abhāna niyamena vṛtteḥ śabda anupasthitāyāḥ bhāna anupapatteḥ yathā kathañcid upapattau vā na tatas jñāna tad kāryayoḥ nivṛttiḥ syāt ajñāna tad kārya aviṣayaka jñānasya eva tad ubhaya nivartaka tvāt

original: anyathā `ahamajñaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa' ityādijñānānāmapyupahitaviṣayakatvena ajñānanivartakatvaprasaṅga iti cenna| vṛtteḥ śābdavṛttāvanavabhāsamānāyā evopadhāyakatvābhyupagamāt| taduktaṃ kalpatarukṛdbhiḥ `śuddhaṃ brahmeti viṣayīkurvāṇā vṛttiḥ svasvetaropādhinivṛttiheturudayate, svasyā api upādhitvāviśeṣāt| evaṃ ca nānupahitasya viṣayatā|
analyzed: anyathā aham ajñaḥ ayam ghaṭaḥ ityādi jñānānām api upahita viṣayaka tvena ajñāna nivartaka tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na vṛtteḥ śābda vṛttau anavabhāsamānāyāḥ eva upadhāyaka tva abhyupagamāt tat uktam kalpataru kṛdbhiḥ śuddham brahma iti viṣayīkurvāṇā vṛttiḥ sva sva itara upādhi nivṛtti hetuḥ udayate svasyāḥ api upādhi tva aviśeṣāt evam ca na anupahitasya viṣayatā

original: vṛttyuparāgo'tra sattayopayujyate;na tu bhāsyatayā viṣayakoṭipraveśene'ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- yathā ajñānopahitasya sākṣitve'pi nājñānaṃ sākṣikoṭau praviśati, jaḍatvāt| kiṃ tu sākṣyakoṭāveva| evaṃ vṛttyupahitasya viṣayatve'pi na vṛttiviṣayakoṭau praviśati; svasyāḥ svaviṣayatvānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: vṛtti uparāgaḥ utra sattayā upayujyate na tu bhāsya tayā viṣaya koṭi praveśena iayam abhiprāyaḥ yathā ajñāna upahitasya sākṣi tve pi na ajñānam sākṣi koṭau praviśati jaḍa tvāt kim tu sākṣya koṭau eva evam vṛtti upahitasya viṣaya tve pi na vṛtti viṣaya koṭau praviśati svasyāḥ sva viṣaya tva anupapatteḥ

original: kiṃ tu svayamaviṣayo'pi caitanyasya viṣayatāṃ sampādayatīti na kāpyanupapattiḥ| etena jñānājñānayorekaviṣayatvaṃ vyākhyātam; ajñānamapi hi svopadhānadaśāyāmeva brahma viṣayī karoti; svānupadhānadaśāyāṃ svasyaivābhāvāt| tathā ca jñānājñānayorubhayorapyupādhyaviṣayakatve satyupahitaviṣayakatvāt samānaviṣayatvamastyeva|
analyzed: kim tu svayam aviṣayaḥ api caitanyasya viṣayatām sampādayati iti na kā api anupapattiḥ etena jñāna ajñānayoḥ eka viṣaya tvam vyākhyātam ajñānam api hi sva upadhāna daśāyām eva brahma viṣayī karoti sva anupadhāna daśāyām svasya eva abhāvāt tathā ca jñāna ajñānayoḥ ubhayoḥ api upādhya viṣayaka tve sati upahita viṣayaka tvāt samāna viṣayatvam asti eva

original: etena upādhiviṣayajñānānāmajñānānivartakatvaṃ vyākhyātam; ajñānasyo pādhyaviṣayatvena samānaviṣayatvābhāvāt, samānaviṣayatvenaiva tayornivartyanivartakabhāvāt|

original: nanu -- `yadā aparokṣaṃ jñānaṃ tadārtha' iti vyāptyanabhyupagame `idaṃ rajata' mityaparokṣajñānānyathānupapattyā anirvacanīya rajatasiddhirnasyāt, arthaṃ vināpyaparokṣatvopapatteḥ -- iti cenna, `idaṃ rajatamahaṃ jānāmī' tyanusandhīyamānaṃ yat jñānaviṣayatvaṃ tasyāśrayāntarānupapattyā anirvacanīyarajata siddhervakṣyamāṇatvāt|

original: ata eva parokṣabhrame'pi anirvacanīyārthasiddhiḥ| janyāparokṣatvena vā arthavyāpyatā, ārṣajñānasyāparokṣatvānabhyupagamāt| tathā ca nānirvacanīyarajata siddhyunupapattiḥ| evaṃ sajñātṛkatvamapi kiṃ jñātṛjanyatvam ? jñātṛvyāpyatvam ? jñātṛsamavetatvaṃ vā ? ādye īśvarajñāne vyabhicāraḥ, jñānanityatvasya sādhayiṣyamāṇatvācca| dvitīye'pi aprayojakatā|
analyzed: atas eva parokṣa bhrame api anirvacanīya artha siddhiḥ janya aparokṣa tvena vā artha vyāpya tā ārṣa jñānasya aparokṣa tva anabhyupagamāt tathā ca na anirvacanīya rajata siddhi unupapattiḥ evam sajñātṛkatvam api kim jñātṛ janya tvam jñātṛ vyāpya tvam jñātṛ samaveta tvam vā ādye īśvara jñāne vyabhicāraḥ jñāna nitya tvasya sādhayiṣyamāṇa tvāt ca dvitīye api aprayojaka tā

original: na tṛtīyaḥ, jñānajanyatvavat jñānasamavetatvasyāpi sambhavāt, jñānasya guṇatvakriyātvayoranabhyupagamena dravyāśrayatvānumānāyogāt, kadācit jñātṛjñeyasambandhenaiva anubhavasya vivaraṇavākyasya ca upapatteḥ| `asti brahme ' ti ca lakāro na brahmasattāṃ prati brahmaṇaḥ kartṛtvamāha, nityatvena tadasambhavāt, kintu sādhutvārtha iti draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: na tṛtīyaḥ jñāna janya tva vat jñāna samaveta tvasya api sambhavāt jñānasya guṇa tva kriyā tvayoḥ anabhyupagamena dravya āśraya tva anumāna ayogāt kadācid jñātṛ jñeya sambandhena eva anubhavasya vivaraṇa vākyasya ca upapatteḥ asti brahma iti ca lakāraḥ na brahma sattām prati brahmaṇaḥ kartṛ tvam āha nitya tvena tad asambhavāt kintu sādhu tva arthaḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: nanu -- pramābhakramabhinnaṃ na jñānam, na cātmasvarūpaṃ jñānaṃ pramā, tadviṣayasyāvidyā destāttvikatvāpātāt| na ca apramā,doṣajanyatvāpād -- iti cenna;
analyzed: nanu pramā bha krama bhinnam na jñānam na ca ātma svarūpam jñānam pramā tad viṣayasya avidyā deḥ tāttvika tva āpātāt na ca apramā doṣa janya tva āpāt iti ced na

original: tārkikasiddheśvarajñānavad ghaṭādinirvikalpakavacca svabhāvata ubhayavailakṣaṇyenāpyupapatteḥ, tatrāpi īśvarajñānasya pramātve guṇajanyatvasya, bhramatve doṣajanyatvasya cāpatteḥ, niṣprakārake ca nirvikalpake tadvati tatprakārakatvasya tadabhāvavati tatprakārakatvasya cānupapatteḥ, janyasavikalpa katvena bhramapramānyataratvaniyame cāsmākaṃ
analyzed: tārkika siddha īśvara jñāna vat ghaṭa ādi nirvikalpaka vat ca svabhāvataḥ ubhaya vailakṣaṇyena api upapatteḥ tatra api īśvara jñānasya pramā tve guṇa janya tvasya bhrama tve doṣa janya tvasya ca āpatteḥ niṣprakārake ca nirvikalpake tadvati tad prakāraka tvasya tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka tvasya ca anupapatteḥ janya sa vikalpa ka tvena bhrama pramā anyatara tva niyame ca asmākam

original: kṣatyabhāvād,vilakṣaṇavṛttidvayoparāgeṇa ca svabhāvato bhramapramāvilakṣaṇasyāpyātmajñānasya tadubhayarūpeṇa vyavahāropapatteḥ| na ca -- jñānapadapācya bhinnatvavivakṣāyām upādherapi jñānapadavācyatvāttatrāsiddhiḥ, jñānapadalakṣyabhinnatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ghaṭāderapi jñānapadalakṣyatvāttatrāpyasiddhiriti -- vācyam;
analyzed: kṣati abhāvāt vilakṣaṇa vṛtti dvaya uparāgeṇa ca svabhāvataḥ bhrama pramā vilakṣaṇasya api ātma jñānasya tad ubhaya rūpeṇa vyavahāra upapatteḥ na ca jñāna pada pācya bhinnatva vivakṣāyām upādheḥ api jñāna pada vācya tvāt tatra asiddhiḥ jñāna pada lakṣya bhinnatva vivakṣāyām tu ghaṭa ādeḥ api jñāna pada lakṣya tvāt tatra api asiddhiḥ iti vācyam

original: jñānapadajanyapratītiviśeṣyabhinnatvaṃ vivakṣāyāmuktadoṣābhāvāt| evamānandabhinnatvarūpamanātmatvaṃ mupapādyam, vaiṣayikānandasyāpi brahmarūpatvāt, tadupādhimātrasyaivotpattivināśapratiyogitvāt| na ca -- jñānabhinnatvasyā nandabhinnatvasya ca kālpanikasya brahmaṇi sattvāt, tatra vyabhicāra iti -- vācyam; dharmisamānasattākatadbhedasya hetutvāt|
analyzed: jñāna pada janya pratīti viśeṣya bhinnatvam vivakṣāyām ukta doṣa abhāvāt evam ānanda bhinna tva rūpam anātma tvam vaiṣayika ānandasya api brahma rūpatvāt tad upādhi mātrasya eva utpatti vināśa pratiyogitvāt na ca jñāna bhinna tvasya ā nanda bhinna tvasya ca kālpanikasya brahmaṇi sattvāt tatra vyabhicāraḥ iti vācyam dharmi samāna sattāka tad bhedasya hetutvāt

original: anaupādhikatvena vā bhedo viśeṣaṇīyaḥ, tucche pañcamaprakārāvidyānivṛttau ca vyabhicāraparihāraḥ pūrvavat| evam -- asvaprakāśatvaṃ vā jaḍatvam, tacca pūrvamevopapāditamiti śivam|| ityadvaitasiddhau jaḍatvahetūpapattiḥ||
analyzed: anaupādhika tvena vā bhedaḥ viśeṣaṇīyaḥ tucche pañcama prakāra avidyā nivṛttau ca vyabhicāra parihāraḥ pūrvavat evam asvaprakāśa tvam vā jaḍa tvam tat ca pūrvam eva upapāditam iti śivam iti advaita siddhau jaḍa tva hetu upapattiḥ

original: paricchinnatvamapi hetuḥ| tacca deśataḥ kālato vastutaśceti trividham| tatra deśataḥ piracchinnatvam -- atyantābhāvapratiyogitvam| kālataḥ paricchinnatvam -- dhvaṃsapratiyogitvam| vastutaḥ paricchinnatvam -- anyo'nyābhāvapratiyogitvam| nanu samavāyasambandhenātyantābhāvapratiyogitvam ātmani vyabhicāri| tasyāpyākāśādivat kvāpyasamavetatvāt|
analyzed: paricchinna tvam api hetuḥ tat ca deśataḥ kālataḥ vastutaḥ ca iti trividham tatra deśataḥ piracchinna tvam atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvam kālataḥ paricchinna tvam dhvaṃsa pratiyogi tvam vastutaḥ paricchinna tvam anyonya abhāva pratiyogi tvam nanu samavāya sambandhena atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvam ātmani vyabhicāri tasya api ākāśa ādi vat kvāpi asamaveta tvāt

original: saṃyogasambandhenātyantābhāvapratiyogitvamākāśādāvasiddham| tasya yāvanmūrtasaṃyogitvaniyamāt| amūrtaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvābhiprāye tu ātmani vyabhicārastadavasthaḥ| sarvasambandhitvābhāva vivakṣāyāmapi sarvasambandhaśūnye paramātmani vyabhicāraḥ| ajñāne sarvasambandhinyasiddhiśca| dhvaṃsapratiyogitvamapi ākāśādāvasiddham|
analyzed: saṃyoga sambandhena atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam ākāśa ādau asiddham tasya yāvat mūrta saṃyogitva niyamāt amūrta niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitva abhiprāye tu ātmani vyabhicāraḥ tad avasthaḥ sarva sambandhi tva abhāva vivakṣāyām api sarva sambandha śūnye paramātmani vyabhicāraḥ ajñāne sarva sambandhini asiddhiḥ ca dhvaṃsa pratiyogitvam api ākāśa ādau asiddham

original: teṣāṃ parairnityatvābhyupagamāt| anyonyā bhāvapratiyogitvaṃ cātmani vyabhicāri| tasya jaḍaniṣṭhānyonyābhāvapratiyogitvād, anyathā jaḍatvāpatteḥ iti cenna| atyantābhāve anyonyābhāve ca pratiyogisamasattākatvaviśeṣaṇena ātmani vyabhicāraparihārāt| ajñānākāśādau ca svasamānasattākātyantā bhāvānyonyā bhāvapratiyogitvasattvena asiddhyabhāvāt|
analyzed: teṣām paraiḥ nitya tva abhyupagamāt anyonyā bhāva pratiyogitvam ca ātmani vyabhicāri tasya jaḍa niṣṭha anyonya abhāva pratiyogitvāt anyathā jaḍa tva āpatteḥ iti ced na atyanta abhāve anyonya abhāve ca pratiyogi sama sattāka tva viśeṣaṇena ātmani vyabhicāra parihārāt ajñāna ākāśa ādau ca sva samāna sattāka atyantā bhāva anyonyā bhāva pratiyogitva sattvena asiddhi abhāvāt

original: avidyākāśādervyāvahārikasya pāramārthikābhāvapakṣe `svānyūnasattāke'ti viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam| ata eva prātibhāsikaśuktirūpyādervyā vahārikābhāvapratiyogitve'pi na sādhanavaikalyam| niruktamithyātvaprakārāṇāmevaṃrūpatvābhāvāt na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā| dhvaṃsapratiyogitvaṃ cākāśādau nāsiddham|
analyzed: avidyā ākāśa ādeḥ vyāvahārikasya pāramārthika abhāva pakṣe sva anyūna sattāka iti viśeṣaṇam deyam atas eva prātibhāsika śukti rūpya ādeḥ vyāvahārika abhāva pratiyogi tve api na sādhana vaikalyam nirukta mithyātva prakārāṇām evaṃrūpa tva abhāvāt na sādhya aviśiṣṭatā dhvaṃsa pratiyogitvam ca ākāśa ādau na asiddham

original: `tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ' iti śrutisiddhajanyatvenānumitatvāt| `ākāśavatsarvagataśca nitya'ityatra cātmanidarśanatvaṃ svasamānakālīnasarvagatatvena, ābhūtasamplavāvasthāyitvena ceti draṣṭavyam| `ato'nyadārta'mitiśrutyā anātmamātrasyaiva vināśitvapratipādanāt|
analyzed: tasmāt vai etasmāt ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ iti śruti siddha janya tvena anumita tvāt ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca nityā eti atra ca ātmani darśana tvam sva samāna kālīna sarvagata tvena ābhūtasamplava avasthāyi tvena ca iti draṣṭavyam atonyat ārtam iti śrutyā anātma mātrasya eva vināśi tva pratipādanāt

original: ata eva ghaṭādayaḥ svānugatapratibhāse vastuni kalpitāḥ, vibhaktatvād, yathā sarpamālādikaṃ svānugatapratibhāse rajjvā idamaṃśe vibhajyate, `evaṃ brahmaṇyanugacchati ghaṭādikaṃ vibhajyate, san ghaṭaḥ, san paṭa'iti ānandabodhoktamapi sādhu|
analyzed: atas eva ghaṭa ādayaḥ sva anugata pratibhāse vastuni kalpitāḥ vibhakta tvāt yathā sarpa mālā ādikam sva anugata pratibhāse rajjvā idam aṃśe vibhajyate evam brahmaṇi anugacchati ghaṭa ādikam vibhajyate san ghaṭaḥ san paṭa eti ānanda bodha uktam api sādhu

original: vibhaktaśabdena svasamānasattākabhedapratiyogitvarūpavastuparicchedasya vivakṣitatvāt na brahmatucchayorvyabhicāraḥ| na ca -- `khaṇḍo gaurmuṇḍo gau' rityevamādisvānugatapratibhāse gotvādau vyaktīnāmakalpitvād vyabhicāra iti -- vācyam|
analyzed: vibhakta śabdena sva samāna sattāka bheda pratiyogitva rūpa vastu paricchedasya vivakṣita tvāt na brahma tucchayoḥ vyabhicāraḥ na ca khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ muṇḍaḥ gauḥ riti evamādi sva anugata pratibhāse go tva ādau vyaktīnām akalpi tvāt vyabhicāraḥ iti vācyam

original: satsāmānyātiriktagotvādisāmānyānabhyupagamāt, gotvādyabhyupagame'pi gotvādivyañjakatāvacchedakasāmānyānabhyupagamāt| vyaktiviśeṣāṇāmevānanugatānāṃ sāsnādimattvādyupādhyanugatānāṃ vā tadvyañjakatvavad vyaktiviśeṣaviśiṣṭatvena satsāmānyasyaiva tattadvyavahārajanakatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: sat sāmānya atirikta go tva ādi sāmānya anabhyupagamāt go tva ādi abhyupagame pi go tva ādi vyañjakatā avacchedaka sāmānya anabhyupagamāt vyakti viśeṣāṇām eva ananugatānām sāsnādimattva ādi upādhi anugatānām vā tad vyañjakatva vat vyakti viśeṣa viśiṣṭa tvena sat sāmānyasya eva tad tad vyavahāra janakatva upapatteḥ

original: ata eva -- `ghaṭādikaṃ, sadrūpe kalpitam, pratyekaṃ tadanuviddhatvena pratīyamānatvāt pratyekaṃ candrānuviddhajalataraṅgacandravat iti brahmasiddhikāroktamapi sādhu|
analyzed: atas eva ghaṭa ādikam sat rūpe kalpitam pratyekam tad anuviddha tvena pratīyamāna tvāt pratyekam candra anuviddha jala taraṅga candra vat iti brahmasiddhi kāra uktam api sādhu

original: nanu -- sadarthasya brahmaṇaḥ rūpādihīnasyā'saṃsāramajñānāvṛtasya śabdaikagamyasya kathaṃ ghaṭaḥ sannityādibuddhiviṣayatā syāt ?tathā ca `ghaṭo'nitya' ityanena ghaṭagatānityateva `ghaṭaḥ sa' nnityanenāpi ghaṭagatameva sattvaṃ gṛhyate| na ca -- svarūpeṇāpratyakṣasya rāhoścandrāvacchedeneva brahmaṇo'pi ghaṭādyavacchedenaiva pratyakṣateti -- vācyam|
analyzed: nanu sat arthasya brahmaṇaḥ rūpa ādi hīnasya asaṃsāram ajñāna āvṛtasya śabda eka gamyasya katham ghaṭaḥ san ityādi buddhi viṣayatā syāt tathā ca ghaṭaḥ nityaḥ iti anena ghaṭa gata anitya tā iva ghaṭaḥ san iti anena api ghaṭa gatam eva sattvam gṛhyate na ca svarūpeṇa apratyakṣasya rāhoḥ candra avacchedena iva brahmaṇaḥ api ghaṭa ādi avacchedena eva pratyakṣatā iti vācyam

original: śabdādyavacchinnasyāpi gaganādeḥ śrāvaṇatvādyāpātāt| rāhostu dūradoṣeṇājñātasya nīlasya yogyasya śuklabhāsvaracandra sambandhāccākṣuṣatā uktā -- iti cenna| yataḥ sadātmanā na brahmaṇo mūlājñānenāvṛtatvam| kintu ghaṭādyavacchinnaśaktyajñānenaiva|
analyzed: śabda ādi avacchinnasya api gagana ādeḥ śrāvaṇa tva ādi āpātāt rāhoḥ tu dūra doṣeṇa ajñātasya nīlasya yogyasya śukla bhāsvara candra sambandhāt cākṣuṣa tā uktā iti ced na yatas sat ātmanā na brahmaṇaḥ mūla ajñānena āvṛta tvam kintu ghaṭa ādi avacchinna śakti ajñānena eva

original: tathā ca cakṣurādijanyavṛttyā tadāvaraṇabhaṅge sati `sanghaṭa' ityatra brahmaṇaḥ sphuraṇe bādhakābhāvāt| na ca -- rūpādihīnatayā cākṣuṣatvādyanupapattiḥ bādhiketi -- vācyam| pratiniyatendriyagrāhyeṣveva rūpādyapekṣāniyamāt| sarvendriyagrāhyaṃ tu sadrūpaṃ brahma| nāto rūpādihīnatve'pi cākṣuṣatvādyanupapattiḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca cakṣuḥ ādi janya vṛttyā tad āvaraṇa bhaṅge sati san ghaṭaḥ iti atra brahmaṇaḥ sphuraṇe bādhaka abhāvāt na ca rūpa ādi hīna tayā cākṣuṣa tva ādi anupapattiḥ bādhikā iti vācyam pratiniyata indriya grāhyeṣu eva rūpa ādi apekṣā niyamāt sarva indriya grāhyam tu sat rūpam brahma na atas rūpa ādi hīna tve pi cākṣuṣa tva ādi anupapattiḥ

original: sattāyāḥ parairapi sarvendriyagrāhyatvābhyupagamācca| taduktaṃ vārtikakṛdbhiḥ --
analyzed: sattāyāḥ paraiḥ api sarva indriya grāhya tva abhyupagamāt ca tat uktam vārtika kṛdbhiḥ

original: `ato'nubhava evaiko viṣayo'jñātalakṣaṇaḥ|
analyzed: atas nubhavaḥ eva ekaḥ viṣayaḥ jñāta lakṣaṇaḥ

original: akṣādīnāṃ svataḥ siddho yatra teṣāṃ pramāṇatā||' iti|
analyzed: akṣa ādīnām svatas siddhaḥ yatra teṣām pramāṇa tā iti

original: kālasya ca rūpādihīnasya mīmāṃsakādibhiḥ sarvendriyagrāhyatvābhyupagamāt| naca -- śabdāvacchinnasyākāśasyāpi śrāvaṇatvaṃ syāditi -- vācyam; svabhāvato yogyasya hi kenacinnimittena pratiruddhayogyatākasyāvacchedakādinā yogyatā sampādyate, yathā dūradoṣeṇa pratiruddhayogyatākasya rāhoścandrasambandhena |
analyzed: kālasya ca rūpa ādi hīnasya mīmāṃsaka ādibhiḥ sarva indriya grāhya tva abhyupagamāt na ca śabda avacchinnasya ākāśasya api śrāvaṇa tvam syāt iti vācyam svabhāvataḥ yogyasya hi kenacid nimittena pratiruddha yogyatākasya avacchedaka ādinā yogyatā sampādyate yathā dūra doṣeṇa pratiruddha yogyatākasya rāhoḥ candra sambandhena

original: evaṃ cāvaraṇena pratiruddhayogyatākaṃ brahma ghaṭādyavacchedena yogyaṃ bhavati, nabhastu svabhāvāyogyameva, na pratiruddhayogyatākam, yena śabdāvacchedena yogyaṃ bhavet| yadvā -- dravyagrahe cakṣuṣo rūpāpekṣā, na tvanyagrahe| brahma tu na dravyam, `asthūlamanaṇvahrasvamadīrgha ' miti śrutyā caturvidhaparimāṇaniṣedhena dravyatva pratiṣedhāt|
analyzed: evam ca āvaraṇena pratiruddha yogyatākam brahma ghaṭa ādi avacchedena yogyam bhavati nabhaḥ tu svabhāva ayogyam eva na pratiruddha yogyatākam yena śabda avacchedena yogyam bhavet yat vā dravya grahe cakṣuṣaḥ rūpa apekṣā na tu anya grahe brahma tu na dravyam asthūlam anaṇu ahrasvam adīrgham iti śrutyā caturvidha parimāṇa niṣedhena dravya tva pratiṣedhāt

original: ato nānupapattiḥ| astu vā dravyam| tathāpyadhyastadravyatvavati guṇādau rūpānapekṣacākṣuṣatvadarśanena dharmyanyūnasattākadravyatvavatyeva cakṣū rūpamapekṣate| brahmaṇi ca dravyatvaṃ dharmyapekṣayā nyūnasattākamaveti na tadgrahe rūpādyapekṣā| kalpitatvaṃ ca svābhāvavati pratīyamānatvaṃ vā, svarūpajñānanivartyatvaṃ vetyanyadetat|
analyzed: atas nā anupapattiḥ astu vā dravyam tathā api adhyasta dravya tvavati guṇa ādau rūpa anapekṣa cākṣuṣa tva darśanena dharmya nyūna sattāka dravya tvavati eva cakṣuḥ rūpam apekṣate brahmaṇi ca dravya tvam dharmi apekṣayā nyūna sattākam aveti na tad grahe rūpa ādi apekṣā kalpita tvam ca svābhāvavati pratīyamāna tvam vā svarūpa jñāna nivartya tvam vā iti anyat etat

original: tasmāt paricchinnatvamapi bhavati heturiti siddham| iti paricchinnatvahetūpapattiḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt paricchinna tvam api bhavati hetuḥ iti siddham iti paricchinna tva hetu upapattiḥ

original: citsukhācāryaistu -- `ayaṃ paṭaḥ, etattantuniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogī, aṃśitvād, itarāṃ śivad ityuktam| tatra tantupadamupādānaparam| tena svopādānaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvalakṣaṇamityātvasiddhiḥ| na ca -- kāryasya kāraṇābhedena tadanāśritatvāt siddhasādhanam, anāśritatvenānyāśritatvena vā upapattyā arthāntaraṃ ca iti vācyam|
analyzed: citsukha ācāryaiḥ tu ayam paṭaḥ etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogī aṃśi tvāt itarām śi vat iti uktam tatra tantu padam upādāna param tena sva upādāna niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitva lakṣaṇam ityātva siddhiḥ na ca kāryasya kāraṇa abhedena tad anāśrita tvāt siddhasādhanam anāśrita tvena anya āśrita tvena vā upapattyā artha antaram ca iti vācyam

analyzed: abhede kārya kāraṇa bhāva vyāhatyā kathañcid api bhedasya avaśya abhyupeya tvāt na ca tad ananyatvam ārambhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ iti adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ upādāna vyatirekeṇa upādeyam na asti iti asya eva tad artha tvāt pakṣa viśeṣaṇāt vā na artha antaram na ca prakṛte api bādhaḥ tasya uddhariṣyamāṇa tvāt

original: na cātyantābhāvasya prāmāṇikatvāprāmāṇikatvavikalpāvakāśaḥ | tasya prāgeva nirastatvāt| na ca -- kasyacit paṭasya saṃyogavṛttyaitattantuṣu sattvena tatra vyabhicāra iti vācyam| tatsamavetasya tanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvamaṅgīkurvataḥ tatsaṃyoginastanniṣṭhā tyantābhāvapratiyogitvāṅgīkāreṇa pakṣasamatvāt| na cāvyāpyavṛttitve nārthāntaram|
analyzed: na ca atyantābhāvasya prāmāṇika tva aprāmāṇika tva vikalpa avakāśaḥ tasya prāk eva nirasta tvāt na ca kasyacid paṭasya saṃyoga vṛttyā etat tantuṣu sattvena tatra vyabhicāraḥ iti vācyam tad samavetasya tad niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam aṅgīkurvataḥ tad saṃyoginaḥ tad niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitva aṅgīkāreṇa pakṣasama tvāt na ca avyāpya vṛtti tve na artha antaram

original: paṭatadabhāvayorekādhikaraṇavṛttau virodhasya jagati dattajalāñjalitvaprasaṅgāt, saṃyogatadabhāvayorapyekādhikaraṇavṛttitvānabhyupagamāt| abhyupagame vā etattantutvāvacchinnavṛtti tvamatyantābhāvasya viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam, evametatkālīnatvamapi| tena kālāntarīyābhāvamādāya nārthāntaram| na ceha tantuṣu paṭa iti pratyakṣa bādhaḥ|
analyzed: paṭa tad abhāvayoḥ eka adhikaraṇa vṛttau virodhasya jagati datta jala añjali tva prasaṅgāt saṃyoga tad abhāvayoḥ api eka adhikaraṇa vṛtti tva anabhyupagamāt abhyupagame vā etat tantu tva avacchinna vṛtti tvam atyanta abhāvasya viśeṣaṇam deyam evam etad kālīna tvam api tena kāla antarīya abhāvam ādāya na artha antaram na ca iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti pratyakṣa bādhaḥ

original: tasya bhramasādhāraṇatayā candraprādeśikatvapratyakṣavadaprāmāṇyaśaṅkāskanditatvenābādhakatvāt| bādhoddhāre ca vistareṇai tadvakṣyāmaḥ| na ca -- anyāsamavetasyāṃśitvametattantu samavetatvaṃ vinā na yuktamiti viruddho heturiti -- vācyam| etattantuniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitve'pyetattantusamavetasya sattvenāṃśitvasya sādhyenāvirodhāt|
analyzed: tasya bhrama sādhāraṇa tayā candra prādeśika tva pratyakṣa vat aprāmāṇya śaṅkā āskandita tvena ābādhaka tvāt bādha uddhāre ca tat vakṣyāmaḥ na ca anya asamavetasya aṃśi tvam etat tantu samaveta tvam vinā na yuktam iti viruddhaḥ hetuḥ iti vācyam etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tve pi etad tantu samavetasya sattvena aṃśi tvasya sādhyena avirodhāt

original: etanniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogitvaṃ hi etatsamavetatve prayojakaṃ na bhavati, paramate kevalānvayidharmamātrasya etatsamavetatvāpatteḥ| kintvetanniṣṭhaprāgabhāvapratiyogitvādikam| taccaitanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitve'pi na viruddhamityupapāditamadhastāt| etatsamavetatvaṃ caitadupādānakatvam, na tu nityasambandhaśālitvam, tasyānabhyupagamāt|
analyzed: etad niṣṭha atyanta abhāva apratiyogitvam hi etad samaveta tve prayojakam na bhavati para mate kevala anvayi dharma mātrasya etad samaveta tva āpatteḥ kintu etad niṣṭha prāgabhāva pratiyogi tva ādikam tat ca etad niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tve pi na viruddham iti upapāditam adhastāt etad samaveta tvam ca etad upādānaka tvam na tu nitya sambandha śāli tvam tasya anabhyupagamāt

original: nanu -- ayaṃ paṭa etattantuniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogī na, etattantvārabdhatvād, vyatirekeṇa paṭāntaravaditi pratirodhaḥ| na cāprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvam| etanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ kiñcinniṣṭhātyantā bhāvapratiyogi, saṃsargābhāvapratiyogitvavyāpyatvāt, prāgabhāvapratiyogitvavaditi sāmānyatasta tprasiddheḥ|
analyzed: nanu ayam paṭaḥ etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogī na etad tantu ārabdha tvāt vyatirekeṇa paṭa antara vat iti pratirodhaḥ na ca aprasiddha viśeṣaṇa tvam etad niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvam kiñcid niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogi saṃsarga abhāva pratiyogi tva vyāpya tvāt prāgabhāva pratiyogi tva vat iti sāmānyatas tad prasiddheḥ

original: na ca -- ākāśātyantābhāvasya ghaṭādau saṃsargābhāvapratiyogitva vyāpyatvagrahāt tasya ca kevalānvayitvena kiñcinniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvābhāvāt yatra vyabhicāra iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca ākāśa atyanta abhāvasya ghaṭa ādau saṃsarga abhāva pratiyogitva vyāpyatva grahāt tasya ca kevala anvayi tvena kiñcid niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitva abhāvāt yatra vyabhicāraḥ iti vācyam

original: saṃsargābhāvapratiyogitvānadhikaraṇe kevalānvayini dharme sattvenākāśātyantābhāvasya saṃsargābhāvapratiyogitvāvyāpyatvena vyabhicārābhāvād iti cenna, yatraitattantuniṣṭhātyantā bhāvapratiyogitvam, tatraitattantvārabdhatvābhāva iti vyatirekavyāptāvetanniṣṭhaprāgabhāvāpratiyogitvasyopādhitvena pratirodhasya hīnabalatvād,
analyzed: saṃsarga abhāva pratiyogitva anadhikaraṇe kevala anvayini dharme sattvena ākāśa atyanta abhāvasya saṃsarga abhāva pratiyogitva avyāpya tvena vyabhicāra abhāvāt iti ced na yatra etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam tatra etad tantu ārabdha tva abhāvaḥ iti vyatireka vyāptau etad niṣṭha prāgabhāva apratiyogitvasya upādhi tvena pratirodhasya hīna bala tvāt

original: etattantvārabdhatvābhāvavyāpakasyaitattantu niṣṭhaprāgabhāvāpratiyogitvasya pakṣāvṛtteḥ pakṣavṛttitayā sandihyamānaitattantuniṣṭhātyantā bhāvapratiyogitvāvyāpakatvāt| dṛśyatvādyanupapattipratikūlatarkaparāhatervakṣyamāṇatvācca| ata eva etattantvanārabdhatvamapi nopādhiḥ| upādhivyatirekeṇa sādhyavyatireka sādhyamāne sopādhikatvasyoktatvāt|
analyzed: etad tantu ārabdha tva abhāva vyāpakasya etad tantu niṣṭha prāgabhāva apratiyogitvasya pakṣa āvṛtteḥ pakṣa vṛttitayā sandihyamāna etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitva avyāpaka tvāt dṛśya tva ādi anupapatti pratikūla tarka parāhateḥ vakṣyamāṇa tvāt ca atas eva etad tantu anārabdha tvam api na upādhiḥ upādhi vyatirekeṇa sādhya vyatireka sādhyamāne sopādhika tvasya uktatvāt

original: avyāpyavṛttisaṃyogābhyupagame tatra vyabhicārācca| ata eva yatraitattantuniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvam, tatraitattantvanārabdhatvamiti na sādhyavyāpakatāgraho'pi| tatraiva vyabhicārāditi sarvamanavadyam||
analyzed: avyāpya vṛtti saṃyoga abhyupagame tatra vyabhicārāt ca atas eva yatra etad tantu niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitvam tatra etad tantu anārabdha tvam iti na sādhya vyāpaka tā grahaḥ upi tatra eva vyabhicārāt iti sarvam anavadyam

original: evaṃ ca `vimataṃ jñānavyatirekeṇāsat, jñānavyatirekeṇānupalabhyamānatvāt, svapnādivadi' ti vidyāsāgaroktamapi sādhu| jñānavyatirekeṇāsattvamuktamithyātvānyatamatvaṃ cidābhāse sattyevopalabhyamānatvaṃ heturiti na kiñcidanupapannam| evamanyeṣāmapi prayogā yathāyogamupapādanīyā iti śivam| ityaṃśitvahetūpapattiḥ|
analyzed: evam ca vimatam jñāna vyatirekeṇa asat jñāna vyatirekeṇa anupalabhyamāna tvāt svapna ādi vat i ti vidyāsāgara uktam api sādhu jñāna vyatirekeṇa asattvam ukta mithyātva anyatamatvam cit ābhāse sattyā iva upalabhyamāna tvam hetuḥ iti na kiñcid anupapannam evam anyeṣām api prayogāḥ yathāyogam upapādanīyāḥ iti śivam iti aṃśi tva hetu upapattiḥ

original: nanu -- dṛśyatvādihetavaḥ sopādhikāḥ| tathāhi svabādhakābhimatābādhyadoṣaprayuktabhānatvaṃ svabādhakābādhyabādhakaṃ prati niṣedhyatvena viṣayatvaṃ vā vipakṣād vyāvṛttaṃ samavyāptam| ata eva vyatirekavyāptimadupādhiḥ iti cenna| brahmajñānamātrabādhye dehātmaikye mithyābhūte sādhyāvyāpakatvāt|
analyzed: nanu dṛśya tva ādi hetavaḥ sa upādhikāḥ tathā hi sva bādhaka abhimata abādhya doṣa prayukta bhāna tvam sva bādhaka abādhya bādhakam prati niṣedhya tvena viṣaya tvam vā vipakṣāt vyāvṛttam sama vyāptam atas eva vyatireka vyāptimat upādhiḥ iti ced na brahma jñāna mātra bādhye deha ātma aikye mithyā bhūte sādhya avyāpaka tvāt

original: parvatāvayavavṛttyanyatvādivat sādhanavatpakṣamātravyavartakaviśeṣaṇavattvena pakṣetaratvatulyatvācca| na ca bādhonnītatvāt so'pyupādhiḥ| bādhasyāgre nirasiṣyamāṇatvād| api ca yadvyatirekasya sādhyavyatirekasādhakatvaṃ tasyaiva sādhyavyāpakatvam, itarāṃśe anukūlatarkāprasarāt|
analyzed: parvata avayava vṛtti anya tva ādi vat sādhanavat pakṣa mātra vyavartaka viśeṣaṇavat tvena pakṣa itaratva tulya tvāt ca na ca bādha unnīta tvāt saḥ api upādhiḥ bādhasya agre nirasiṣyamāṇa tvāt api ca yad vyatirekasya sādhya vyatireka sādhaka tvam tasya eva sādhya vyāpaka tvam itara aṃśe anukūla tarka aprasarāt

original: tathā ca `kṣityādikaṃ na kartṛjanyam śarīrājanyatvā' dityatra yathā śarīraviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyānna śarīrajanyatvaṃ kartṛjanyatvavyāpakam, evaṃ `viyadādikaṃ na mithyā svabādhakābhimatābādhyadoṣa prayuktabhānatvarahitatvā ' diti sādhyavyatirekasādhane svabādhakābhimatābādhyabhāgasya vaiyarthyāt svabādhakābhimatābādhyadoṣaprayuktabhānatvaṃ na
analyzed: tathā ca kṣiti ādikam na kartṛ janyam śarīra ajanya tvāt iti atra yathā śarīra viśeṣaṇa vaiyarthyāt na śarīra janya tvam kartṛ janya tva vyāpakam evam viyat ādikam na mithyā sva bādhaka abhimata abādhya doṣa prayukta bhāna tva rahita tvāt iti sādhya vyatireka sādhane sva bādhaka abhimata abādhya bhāgasya vaiyarthyāt sva bādhaka abhimata abādhya doṣa prayukta bhāna tvam na asti

original: mithyātvavyāpakam| doṣaprayuktabhānatvaṃ tu bhavati sādhyavyāpakam| tacca sādhanavyāpakamapīti nopādhiḥ| dṛśyatvādinaiva mithyātvavattasyāpi sādhanāt| evaṃ dvitīyopādhāvapi `svabādhakābādhyabādhakaṃ pratī' ti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyatirekasādhane vyartham| viśeṣyabhāgastu sādhyasādhanayorvyāpaka iti nopādhiḥ|
analyzed: mithyātva vyāpakam doṣa prayukta bhāna tvam tu bhavati sādhya vyāpakam tat ca sādhana vyāpakam api iti na upādhiḥ dṛśya tva ādinā eva mithyātva vat tasya api sādhanāt evam dvitīya upādhau api sva bādhaka abādhya bādhakam prati iti viśeṣaṇam vyatireka sādhane vyartham viśeṣya bhāgaḥ tu sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāpakaḥ iti na upādhiḥ

original: ata evādhiṣṭhānatvābhimata samasattākadoṣavaddhetu janyajñānaviṣayatvamupādhiḥ| atra ca brahmaṇo'pi bauddhakalpitadoṣavaddhetujanyakṣaṇikatvādi jñānaviṣayatvāt, samavyāptisiddhyarthamadhiṣṭhāna samasattāketi viśeṣaṇam, na tu pakṣamātra vyāvṛttyartham, ato na pakṣetaratulyatetyapāstam|
analyzed: atas eva adhiṣṭhāna tva abhimata sama sattāka doṣavat hetu janya jñāna viṣayatvam upādhiḥ atra ca brahmaṇaḥ api bauddha kalpita doṣavat hetu janya kṣaṇikatva ādi jñāna viṣayatvāt sama vyāpti siddhi artham adhiṣṭhāna sama sattāka iti viśeṣaṇam na tu pakṣa mātra vyāvṛtti artham atas na pakṣa itara tulya tā iti apāstam

original: brahmaṇīva brahmaṇi kalpite kṣaṇikatvādāvapi mithyābhūte dharme adhiṣṭhānasamasattākadoṣavaddhetujanyajñānāviṣayatvādupādheḥ sādhyāvyāpteḥ| vyatirekasādhane vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvasyoktatvācca| nāpi śrutitātparyāviṣayatvamupādhiḥ| śrutitātparyaviṣayatvasya brahmamātraniṣṭhatayā tadabhāvasya sādhanavyāpakatvāt| nāpi prātibhāsikatvamupādhiḥ|

original: taddhi brahmajñānetarabādhyatvam| tasya ca dehātmaikye mithyābhūte'pya sattvena sādhyāvyāpteḥ| vyatireke vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvācca| nāpi pratibhāsamātraśarīratvamupādhiḥ| dṛṣṭisṛṣṭipakṣe sādhanavyāpakatvāt, pareṣāmasiddheśceti| iti dṛśyatvādīnāṃ sopādhitvabhaṅgaḥ||

original: nanu -- vimataṃ prātibhāsikam dṛśyatvāt, brahma mithyā vyavahāraviṣayatvād asadvilakṣaṇatvādvā śuktirūpyavadityādyābhāsasāmyam -- iti cenna| jagato vyāvahārikasattva bādhe vyavahārānupapattiḥ, brahmaṇo mithyātve śūnyavādāpattiśceti pratikūlatarkaparāghātena tayorasādhakatvāt| prakṛte ca pratikūlatarkasya nirasiṣyamāṇatvāt|
analyzed: nanu vimatam prātibhāsikam dṛśya tvāt brahma mithyā vyavahāra viṣaya tvāt asat vilakṣaṇa tvāt vā śukti rūpya vat iti ādi ābhāsa sāmyam iti ced na jagataḥ bādhe vyavahāra anupapattiḥ brahmaṇaḥ mithyātve śūnyavāda āpattiḥ ca iti pratikūla tarka parāghātena tayoḥ asādhaka tvāt prakṛte ca pratikūla tarkasya nirasiṣyamāṇa tvāt

original: kiñca pratibhāsikatvaṃ brahmajñānetarabādhyatvam ? pratibhāsamātraśarīratvaṃ vā ? ādye sādhye dehātmaikye vyabhicāraḥ, aprayojakatvaṃ ca| dvitīye dṛṣṭisṛṣṭimatena siddhasādhanam| evaṃ brahmaṇi mithyātve sādhye sopādhike siddhasādhanam| anupādhike vyavahāraviṣayatvarūpo heturasiddhaḥ| vedāntajanyavṛtti viṣayatvābhyupagame'pyaprayojakaḥ|
analyzed: kiñca pratibhāsikatvam brahma jñāna itara bādhyatvam pratibhāsa mātra śarīratvam vā ādye sādhye deha ātma aikye vyabhicāraḥ aprayojaka tvam ca dvitīye dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi matena siddhasādhanam evam brahmaṇi mithyātve sādhye sopādhike siddhasādhanam anupādhike vyavahāra viṣaya tva rūpaḥ hetuḥ asiddhaḥ vedānta janya vṛtti viṣayatva abhyupagame pi aprayojakaḥ

original: evamasadvilakṣaṇatvamapi brahmaṇyasiddhameva| kvacidapyupādhau sattvena pratītyanarhatvaṃ hyasattvam, sadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ ca kvacidapyupādhau satvena pratītyarhatvarūpam, tacca śuddhe brahmaṇi nāstyeva|

analyzed: na ca yat bhavatām ghaṭa ādi buddheḥ prātibhāsika buddhitaḥ vailakṣaṇyam viṣayasya vyāvahārika sattva sādhakam tat eva iha mama viṣayasya pāramārthika sattva sādhakam astu iti vācyam prātibhāsika buddhi vailakṣaṇyam hi ghaṭa ādi buddheḥ sa prakāraka jñāna abādhya viṣaya tva ādi rūpam tat na pāramārthika sattvam ghaṭa ādeḥ sādhayitum śaktam

original: dehātmaikyajñāne brahmajñānāvyavahitabhrame ca vyabhicārāt| nanu -- `ghaṭassan', `rūpyaṃ mithyā' iti pratītyoraviśeṣe kathaṃ `ghaṭo mithyā', rūpyamithyātvaṃ na mithyā' iti viśeṣaḥ ? na ca tadapi mithyaiva, rūpyatāttvikattvāpatteḥ iti cenna| mithyātvamithyātve'pi yathā na rūpyasya tāttvikatvaṃ tatropapatteruktatvāt|
analyzed: deha ātma aikya jñāne brahma jñāna avyavahita bhrame ca vyabhicārāt nanu ghaṭaḥ san rūpyam mithyā iti pratītyoḥ aviśeṣe katham ghaṭaḥ mithyā rūpya mithyātvam na mithyā iti viśeṣaḥ na ca tat api mithyā eva rūpya tāttvika ttva āpatteḥ iti ced na mithyātva mithyātve api yathā na rūpyasya tāttvika tvam tatra upapatteḥ ukta tvāt

original: na ca pāramārthikasattvasya pratyakṣāgocaratve tanniṣedhaśrutīnāṃ aprasaktapratiṣedhakatā syāditi vācyam| tāsāṃ cakṣurādiprasaktataniṣedhaparatvāt| pāramārthikatvena dvaitaniṣedhaparatve'pi nāprasaktaniṣedhakatvam| parokṣaprasakteḥ sambhavāt| `nāntarikṣe'gniścetavyaḥ ' ityādivadaprasaktapratiṣedhasyāpyupapatteśca|
analyzed: na ca pāramārthika sattvasya pratyakṣa agocara tve tad niṣedha śrutīnām aprasakta pratiṣedhaka tā syāt iti vācyam tāsām cakṣuḥ ādi prasakta tad niṣedha paratvāt pāramārthika tvena dvaita niṣedha paratve pi na aprasakta niṣedhaka tvam parokṣa prasakteḥ sambhavāt na antarikṣa igniḥ cetavyaḥ ityādi vat aprasakta pratiṣedhasya api upapatteḥ ca

analyzed: na ca atāttvika prapañce yadi tātvika tvam api adhyakṣeṇa na gṛhyate katham tarhi tasya a tattva āvedaka tvam na hi tat eva tattvena avedayat atāttvikam nāma dṛśyate ca sārvalaukikaḥ prapañce pāramārthika tva anubhavaḥ iti vācyam na hi asmākam tattva āvedaka tvam tadvati tad prakāraka tvam tad bhinna tvam atattva āvedaka tvam

original: kintvabādhitaviṣayakatvaṃ tattvāvedakatvam, bādhitaviṣayatvaṃ cātattvāvedakatvam| abādhitaviṣayatvaṃ tu śraute brahmajñāna eva, na tadbhinnajñāne| tātparyavadvedatvenaiva tattvāvabodhakatvāt| tathā ca prapañcapratyakṣasya tāttvikatvāgocaratve'pyatattvāvedakatvaṃ saṅgacchate|
analyzed: kintu abādhita viṣayaka tvam tattva avedaka tvam bādhita viṣaya tvam ca atattva avedaka tvam abādhita viṣaya tvam tu śraute brahma jñāne eva na tad bhinna jñāne tātparyavat veda tvena eva tattva avabodhaka tvāt tathā ca prapañca pratyakṣasya tāttvika tva agocara tve ipi atattva avedaka tvam saṅgacchate

analyzed: sārvalaukikī pāramārthika tva prasiddhiḥ tu jala gata pipāsā upaśamana sāmarthya prasiddhi vat parokṣa tayā api upapannā na aparokṣa tva paryavasāyinī

original: tasmādadhyakṣayogyasya sattvasyehāniruktitaḥ|
