original: `kiñcedaṃ rūpyaṃ' ityatra idamitivat `san ghaṭaḥ' ityatrāpi sadityadhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ brahmaiva bhāsate| na ca cākṣuṣādijñāne rūpādihīnasya brahmaṇaḥ kathaṃ sphuraṇamiti vācyam| rūpādihīnasyāpi kālādinyāyena sphuraṇasya prāgevopapāditatvāt| nanvevaṃ `nīlo ghaṭaḥ' `mithyā rūpyam' asannṛśrṛṅgam 'ityādāvapi `nīlaḥ' ityādiradhiṣṭhānānuvedha iti syāt|
analyzed: kiñca idam rūpyam iti atra idam iti vat san ghaṭaḥ iti atra api sat iti adhiṣṭhāna bhūtam brahma eva bhāsate na ca cākṣuṣa ādi jñāne rūpa ādi hīnasya brahmaṇaḥ katham sphuraṇam iti vācyam rūpa ādi hīnasya api kāla ādi nyāyena sphuraṇasya prāk eva upapādita tvāt nanu evam nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ mithyā rūpyam asat nṛśrṛṅgam ityādau api nīlaḥ ityādiḥ adhiṣṭhāna anuvedhaḥ iti syāt

original: na ca nailyaṃ ghaṭādiṣvasti, sattvaṃ tu neti vācyam| asyāropitatvasiddhyuttara kālīnatvenānyonyāśrayād, anyathā `satyaṃ jñānaṃ' ityatrāpi satyamityadhiṣṭhānānuvedha eva syāt iti cenna| sannityasya `ghaṭaḥ'ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bādhitvāt|
analyzed: na ca nailyam ghaṭa ādiṣu asti sattvam tu na iti vācyam asya āropita tva siddhi uttara kālīna tvena anyonya āśrayāt anyathā satyam jñānam iti atra api satyam iti adhiṣṭhāna anuvedhaḥ eva syāt iti ced na san ityasya ghaṭaḥ iti anena sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bādhitvāt

original: tathā hi -- sattājātisphuraṇanibandhanaṃ vā, svarūpasattvanibandhanaṃ vā, kālatrayābādhyatvanibandhanaṃ vā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt| na cābhāvādisādhāraṇasatpratītau sattājātisphuraṇaṃ sambhavati| abhāvādiṣu tvayāpi tadanaṅgīkārāt| na ca kvacitsākṣātsambandhena kvacit paramparāsambandhena saditi pratītyupapattiḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi sattā jāti sphuraṇa nibandhanam vā svarūpa sattva nibandhanam vā kāla traya abādhya tva nibandhanam vā sāmānādhikaraṇyam syāt na ca abhāva ādi sādhāraṇa sat pratītau sattā jāti sphuraṇam sambhavati abhāva ādiṣu tvayā api tad anaṅgīkārāt na ca kvacid sākṣāt sambandhena kvacid paramparā sambandhena sat iti pratīti upapattiḥ

original: vijātīyasambandhena sāmānākārapratītyanupapatteḥ| anyathā sambandhebheda eva na sidhyet| na ca svarūpasattvenābhāvādau tatpratītiḥ, ananugamāt| ananugatenāpi anugatapratītau jātimātrocchedaprasaṅgāt| ata eva na sarvatrāpi svarūpasattvenaiva sad‌vyavahāraḥ| ekenaiva sarvānugatena sarvatra satpratītyupapattau bahūnāṃ taddhetutvakalpane mānābhāvāt|
analyzed: vijātīya sambandhena sāmāna ākāra pratīti anupapatteḥ anyathā sambandhe bhedaḥ eva na sidhyet na ca svarūpa sattvena abhāva ādau tad pratītiḥ ananugamāt ananugatena api anugata pratītau jāti mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt atas eva na sarvatra api svarūpa sattvena eva sat vyavahāraḥ ekena eva sarva anugatena sarvatra sat pratīti upapattau bahūnām tad hetu tva kalpane māna abhāvāt

original: nāpi kālatrayābādhyatvanibandhanaṃ tat| tasya cakṣurādyagamyatvasyoktatvāt| `sadidaṃ rajatam' ityādibhrame abhāvācca| tasmādekaṃ sarvādhiṣṭhānameva saditi sarvatrānubhūyata iti yuktam| nīlādestu ghaṭādisāmānādhikaraṇye kimapi nāsti bādhakam| na vā nīlāderadhiṣṭhānatvaṃ sambhavati| prāgasattvāt| nīlapītādiprātisvikānantādhiṣṭhānakalpane gauravāt|
analyzed: nā api kāla traya abādhya tva nibandhanam tat tasya cakṣuḥ ādi agamya tvasya uktatvāt sat idam rajatam ityādi bhrame abhāvāt ca tasmāt ekam sarva adhiṣṭhānam eva sat iti sarvatra anubhūyate iti yuktam nīla ādeḥ tu ghaṭa ādi sāmānādhikaraṇye kim api nā asti bādhakam na vā nīla ādeḥ adhiṣṭhāna tvam sambhavati prāk asattvāt nīla pīta ādi prātisvika ananta adhiṣṭhāna kalpane gauravāt

original: adhiṣṭheyena tulyayogakṣematvācca| adhiṣṭheyaviṣamasattākameva hyadhiṣṭhānaṃ bhavati| `mithyā rūpyam asannṛśrṛṅgam' ityādau mithyātvāsattvayoradhiṣṭhānatvaśaṅkāpi nāsti| śūnyavādāpatteḥ| tatra cānupapattiruktā, vakṣyate ca| yattu `satyaṃ jñānamanantam'ityatrāpi tathā syād iti| tanna|
analyzed: adhiṣṭheyena tulya yogakṣema tvāt ca adhiṣṭheya viṣama sattākam eva hi adhiṣṭhānam bhavati mithyā rūpyam asat nṛśrṛṅgam ityādau mithyātva asattvayoḥ adhiṣṭhāna tva śaṅkā api nā asti śūnyavāda āpatteḥ tatra ca anupapattiḥ uktā vakṣyate ca yat tu satyam jñānam anantam iti atra api tathā syāt iti tat na

original: yato na tatra sattāsambandhena sattvam, kintu svarūpeṇaivetyuktadoṣānavakāśāt| na caivaṃ ghaṭādāvapi svarūpeṇaiva tathātvam| pūrvameva nirākṛtatvāt| iti sanghaṭa iti pratyakṣe'dhiṣṭhānānuvedhanirūpaṇam|
analyzed: yatas na tatra sattā sambandhena sattvam kintu sva rūpeṇa eva iti ukta doṣa anavakāśāt na ca evam ghaṭa ādau api sva rūpeṇa eva tathātvam pūrvam eva nirākṛta tvāt iti san ghaṭaḥ iti pratyakṣa idhi sthāna anuvedha nirūpaṇam

original: kiṃ ca niścitaprāmāṇyameva pratyakṣamitarabādhakaṃ bhavet, na cātra prāmāṇyaṃ niścitam; āgamavirodhād, anumānavirodhād, bhāvibādhābhāvānirṇayācca| nanu pratyakṣameva prabalamanumānāgamabādhakam| nānumānāgamau| pratyakṣāprāmaṇye tadvirodhābhāvenānumānāgamayoḥ prāmāṇyam, tayoḥ prāmāṇye ca tadvirodhāt pratyakṣāprāmāṇyamityanyonyāśrayāt|
analyzed: kim ca niścita prāmāṇyam eva pratyakṣam itara bādhakam bhavet na ca atra prāmāṇyam niścitam āgama virodhāt anumāna virodhāt bhāvi bādhā bhāva anirṇayāt ca nanu pratyakṣam eva prabalam anumāna āgama bādhakam na anumāna āgamau pratyakṣa aprāmaṇye tad virodha abhāvena anumāna āgamayoḥ prāmāṇyam tayoḥ prāmāṇye ca tad virodhāt pratyakṣa aprāmāṇyam iti anyonya āśrayāt

original: na hi pratyakṣasya prāmāṇye'pyevamanyonyāśrayaḥ| tasyānapekṣatvād iti cenna| candratārakādiparimāṇapratyakṣe anumānāgamavirodhena tasyāprāmāṇyadarśanāt, tenāpi svaprāmāṇyasiddhyarthamitarāvirodhasyāvaśyamapekṣaṇīyatvāt|
analyzed: na hi pratyakṣasya prāmāṇye pi evam anyonya āśrayaḥ tasya anapekṣa tvāt iti ced na candra tārakā ādi parimāṇa pratyakṣe anumāna āgama virodhena tasya aprāmāṇya darśanāt tena api sva prāmāṇya siddhi artham itara avirodhasya avaśyam apekṣaṇīya tvāt

original: tathā cānyo'nyāśrayatulyatvāt parasparavirodhena prāmāṇyasandehe satyanāptāpraṇītatvādinā pramājanakatvavyāptervedaprāmāṇyaniścaye jāte tena svatassambhāvitadoṣasya pratyakṣasya bādhāt asmanmate kvānyo'nyāśrayaḥ ? anyathā dehātmaikyapratyakṣabuddhyā bādhād dehabhinnatvamapyātmano nāgamānumānābhyāṃ siddhyet|
analyzed: tathā ca anyonya āśraya tulya tvāt paraspara virodhena prāmāṇya sandehe sati anāpta apraṇīta tva ādinā pramā janaka tva vyāpteḥ veda prāmāṇya niścaye jāte tena svatas sambhāvita doṣasya pratyakṣasya bādhāt asmad mate kva anyonyāśrayaḥ anyathā deha ātma aikya pratyakṣa buddhyā bādhāt deha bhinna tvam api ātmanaḥ na āgama anumānābhyām siddhyet

original: nanu pratyakṣamanumānādyapekṣayā jātyaiva prabalam| kathamanyathā auṣṇyapratyakṣeeṇa vahniśaityānumitipratibandhaḥ ? na ca tatropajīvyatvanibandhanaṃ pratyakṣasya bādhakatvam| dharmyādeścakṣurādinaiva siddhestvaco'nupajīvyatvāt|
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣam anumāna ādi apekṣayā jātyā eva prabalam katham anyathā auṣṇya pratyakṣeeṇa vahni śaitya anumiti pratibandhaḥ na ca tatra upajīvya tva nibandhanam pratyakṣasya bādhaka tvam dharmya ādeḥ cakṣuḥ ādinā eva siddheḥ tvacaḥ unupajīvya tvāt

original: kiñca pratyakṣasya prābalyamanumānādya gṛhītarekhoparekhādigrāhakatvādanumānādyanivartitadiṅmohādinivartakatvācca iti cenna| tvācapratyakṣasyāpyupajīvyatvenaiva śaityānumitipratibandhakatvasambhavāt| cakṣurādinā dharmyādi grahe'pi tvacaṃ vinā sādhyaprasiddherabhāvāt| tathā ca na jātyā prābalye mānamasti|
analyzed: kiñca pratyakṣasya prābalyam anumāna ādya gṛhīta rekhā uparekhā ādi grāhaka tvāt anumāna ādi anivartita diś moha ādi nivartaka tvāt ca iti ced na tvāca pratyakṣasya api upajīvya tvena eva śaitya anumiti pratibandhaka tva sambhavāt cakṣuḥ ādinā dharmya ādi grahe api tvacam vinā sādhya prasiddheḥ abhāvāt tathā ca na jātyā prābalye mānam asti

original: tadagṛhītagrāhitvamapi na prābalye prayojakam| pratyakṣāgṛhītadharmādigrāhakatvena parokṣapramāṇasyaiva prābalyāpatteḥ| nāpyanumānādyanivartitadiṅmohādinivartakatvena prābalyam| etāvatā hi vaidharmyamātraṃ siddham| na ca tāvatetarapramāṇāpekṣayā prābalyaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tad agṛhīta grāhi tvam api na prābalye prayojakam pratyakṣa agṛhīta dharma ādi grāhaka tvena parokṣa pramāṇasya eva prābalya āpatteḥ nā api anumāna ādi anivartita diś moha ādi nivartaka tvena prābalyam etāvatā hi vaidharmya mātram siddham na ca tāvatā itara pramāṇa apekṣayā prābalyam bhavati

original: anyathā tvācapratyakṣānivartitavaṃśoragabhramanivartakatvāccakṣuṣo'pi tvagapekṣayā prābalyaṃ syāt| tataśca citranimnonnatajñānasya cākṣuṣasya tadvirodhitvācajñānād bādho na syāt| pratyutāgamasyaiva sarvataḥ prābalyaṃ smāryate -- `prābalyamāgamasyaiva jātyā teṣu triṣu smṛtam' iti| na ca tadvaidikārthaviṣayamiti vācyam| advaitasyāpi vaidikārthatvāt|
analyzed: anyathā tvāca pratyakṣa anivartita vaṃśa uraga bhrama nivartaka tvāt cakṣuṣaḥ api tvac apekṣayā prābalyam syāt tatas ca citra nimna unnata jñānasya cākṣuṣasya tad virodhi tvāt cajñānāt bādhaḥ na syāt pratyuta āgamasya eva sarvatas prābalyam smāryate prābalyam āgamasya eva jātyā teṣu triṣu smṛtam iti na ca tat vaidika artha viṣayam iti vācyam advaitasya api vaidika artha tvāt

original: `kva ca pratyakṣataḥ' prāptamanumāgamabādhitam iti tu parīkṣitaprāmāṇ‌yapratyakṣaviṣayam| nanu -- pratyakṣasyāsañjāta virodhitvādupakramamanyāyenaiva prābalyam| uktaṃ hi -- `asañjātavirodhitvādarthavādo yathāśrutaḥ| āstheyastadviruddhasya vidhyuddeśasya lakṣaṇā' iti cenna|
analyzed: kva ca pratyakṣataḥ prāptam anumā āgama bādhitam iti tu parīkṣita prāmāṇya pratyakṣa viṣayam nanu pratyakṣasya asañjāta virodhi tvāt upakramam anyāyena eva prābalyam uktam hi asañjāta virodhi tvāt arthavādaḥ yathāśrutaḥ āstheyaḥ tad viruddhasya vidhi uddeśasya lakṣaṇā iti ced na

original: yata ekavākyasthaparasparasāpekṣapadatvena ubhayoḥ sāmye satyupakramasthavedapadānurodhenopasaṃhārasthargādipadānāṃ mantramātravācināṃ kṛtsnavedaparatve nirṇīte'pi na prakṛte tannyāyaḥ sambhavati| ubhayoḥ sāmyābhāvād| gṛhītapramāṇabhāvaśrutyapekṣayā bhramavilakṣaṇatvenāniścitasya pratyakṣasya nyūnabalatvāt|
analyzed: yatas eka vākya stha paraspara sāpekṣa padatvena ubhayoḥ sāmye sati upakrama stha veda pada anurodhena upasaṃhāra stha ṛga ādi padānām mantra mātra vācinām kṛtsna veda paratve nirṇīte api na prakṛte tad nyāyaḥ sambhavati ubhayoḥ sāmya abhāvāt gṛhīta pramāṇa bhāva śruti apekṣayā bhrama vilakṣaṇa tvena aniścitasya pratyakṣasya nyūna bala tvāt

original: anyathā `idaṃ rajataṃ' iti bhramo'pi `iyaṃ śuktiḥ' iti āptopadeśāpekṣayā prabalaḥ syāt| etena liṅgāt śruteriva śīghragāmitvāt pratyakṣasya prābalyam| taduktam -- `pratyakṣe cānumāne ca yathā loke balābalam| śrīghramantharagāmitvāttathaiva śrutiliṅgayoḥ' ityapāstam; parīkṣitasya mantharagāmino'pi prābalyāt|
analyzed: anyathā idam rajatam iti bhramaḥ api iyam śuktiḥ iti āpta upadeśa apekṣayā prabalaḥ syāt etena liṅgāt śruteḥ iva śīghra gāmi tvāt pratyakṣasya prābalyam tat uktam pratyakṣe ca anumāne ca yathā loke balābalam śrīghra manthara gāmi tvāt tathā eva śruti liṅgayoḥ iti apāstam parīkṣitasya manthara gāminaḥ api prābalyāt

original: na ca `yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityasmāt `pade juhoti' ityasya viśeṣaviṣayatvena prābalyavad ghaṭaviṣayasattvāgrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya sāmānyato dvaitaniṣedhakaśrutyapekṣayā prābalyamiti vācyam| sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyasya niścitapramāṇabhāvobhayaviṣayatvāt| anyathā `ayaṃ gauraśvaḥ' ityāderapi gauraśvo na bhavatītyāditaḥ prābalyaṃ bhavet|
analyzed: na ca yadā āhavanīye juhoti ityasmāt pade juhoti ityasya viśeṣa viṣaya tvena prābalya vat ghaṭa viṣaya sattva agrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya sāmānyatas dvaita niṣedhaka śruti apekṣayā prābalyam iti vācyam sāmānya viśeṣa nyāyasya niścita pramāṇa bhāva ubhaya viṣaya tvāt anyathā ayam gauḥ aśvaḥ ityādeḥ api gauḥ aśvaḥ na bhavati ityāditaḥ prābalyam bhavet

original: na ca yathā `yatkiñcitprācīnamagnīṣomīyāttenopāṃśu caranti' ityatratyasya yatkiñcicchabdasya yatkiñcitprakṛtavācitvena sāmānyāviṣayatve'pi dīkṣaṇīyāvyatirikte sāvakāśatvād `yāvatyā vācā kāmayīta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyāt ' ityanena niravakāśena saṅkocastathā pratyakṣeṇa niravakāśena vṛttyantareṇānekārthatvena vā viṣayāntaraparatvena
analyzed: na ca yathā yat kiñcid prācīnam agnīṣomīyāt tena upāṃśu caranti iti atratyasya yat kiñcid śabdasya yat kiñcid prakṛta vāci tvena sāmānya aviṣaya tve api dīkṣaṇīyā vyatirikte sa avakāśa tvāt yāvatyā vācā kāmayīta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyām anubrūyāt iti anena niravakāśena saṅkocaḥ tathā pratyakṣeṇa niravakāśena vṛtti antareṇa aneka arthatvena vā viṣaya antara paratvena

original: sāvakāśāyāḥ śruteḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ na syāditi vācyam| tātparyaliṅgairupakramādibhirdvaitaniṣedhaparatve avadhṛte advaitaśruterapi niravakāśatvāt| pratyakṣasyāpi vyāvahārikadvaitaviṣayatayā sāvakāśatvād|

original: viruddhayośca dvayoḥ `ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ' ityādipratyakṣa `ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ 'ityādiśrutyoriva tāttvikaprāmāṇyānupapattyā kasyacid vyāvahārikaṃ kasyacittātvikaṃ prāmāṇyamabhyupeyam| atyantāprāmāṇyasyānyāyyatvāt| tatrādvaitaśrutervyāvahārikaprāmāṇyasambhave dvaitagrāhipratyakṣā destāttvikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ bhavet|
analyzed: viruddhayoḥ ca dvayoḥ aham manuṣyaḥ ityādi pratyakṣaḥ ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca nityaḥ ityādi śrutyoḥ iva tāttvika prāmāṇya anupapattyā kasyacid vyāvahārikam kasyacid tātvikam prāmāṇyam abhyupeyam atyanta aprāmāṇyasya anyāyya tvāt tatra advaita śruteḥ vyāvahārika prāmāṇya sambhave dvaita grāhi pratyakṣa ādeḥ tāttvikam prāmāṇyam bhavet

original: tadasambhave tu balādevādvaitaśrutestāttvikaṃ prāmāṇyamiti pratyakṣādervyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ paryavasyatīti kṛtabuddhayo vidāṅkurvantu|
analyzed: tad asambhave tu balāt evā advaita śruteḥ tāttvikam prāmāṇyam iti pratyakṣa ādeḥ vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam paryavasyati iti kṛtabuddhayaḥ

original: nanu pañcadaśarātre prathame'hanyagniṣṭunnāmake nāmātideśena ekāhāgniṣṭuddharmabhūtā subrahmaṇyāgneyī prāptā| tasyā alpaviṣayāyāścaturdaśāhassu codakena prāptayā aindryā subrahmaṇyayā bahuviṣayayā yathā bādhaḥ, bahubādhasyānyāyyatvāt tathā dvaitagrāhipratyakṣatadupajīvyanumānakarmakāṇḍa saguṇopāsanāvākyādirūpa bahupramāṇābādhāyādvaitavākyasya
analyzed: nanu pañcadaśa rātre prathamehani agniṣṭut nāmake nāma atideśena ekāha agniṣṭut dharma bhūtā subrahmaṇyā āgneyī prāptā tasyāḥ alpa viṣayāyāḥ caturdaśa ahaḥsu ca udakena prāptayā aindryā subrahmaṇyayā bahu viṣayayā yathā bādhaḥ bahu bādhasya anyāyya tvāt tathā dvaita grāhi pratyakṣa tad upajīvi anumāna karmakāṇḍa sa guṇa upāsanā vākya ādi rūpa bahu pramāṇa abādhāya advaita vākyasya

original: pratītārthabādhaḥ kiṃ na syāt ? taduktam -- `bahupramāṇavirodhe caikasyāprāmāṇyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śuktirajatādijñāne ' iti cenna| dṛṣṭānte bahuviṣayayā bādho'tra bahubhiriti vaiṣamyāt|
analyzed: pratīta artha bādhaḥ kim na syāt tat uktam bahu pramāṇa virodhe ca ekasya aprāmāṇyam dṛṣṭam śukti rajata ādi jñāne iti ced na dṛṣṭānte bahu viṣayayā bādhaḥ utra bahubhiḥ iti vaiṣamyāt

original: dehātmaikye pratyakṣānumānaśabdābhāsādisattve'pi dehātmabhedabodhakasyānanya paratvenaprābalyavadatrāpi ananyaparatvenādvaitaśruteḥ prābalyād, vidyāvidyābhedena vidvadavidvatpuruṣabhedena ca virodhābhāvāditi| || pratyakṣasya jātyupakrama nyāyādibhiḥ prābalyanirākaraṇam||
analyzed: deha ātma aikye pratyakṣa anumāna śabda ābhāsa ādi sattve pi deha ātma bheda bodhakasya ananya paratvena prābalya vat atra api ananya paratvena advaita śruteḥ prābalyāt vidyā avidyā bhedena vidvat avidvat puruṣa bhedena ca virodha abhāvāt iti pratyakṣasya jāti upakrama nyāya ādibhiḥ prābalya nirākaraṇam

original: nanu -- uktanyāyaiḥ pratyakṣasya jātyā prābalyābhāve'pi upajīvyatvena prābalyam| upajīvyatvaṃ cānumānāgamāpekṣitāśeṣārthagrāhakatayā| sā ca kvacit sākṣāt kvacitparamparayā dṛṣṭaṃ cāpekṣitaikadeśagrāhiṇāmapyupajīvyatvam, tadviruddhagrahaṇe tena bādhaśca|
analyzed: nanu ukta nyāyaiḥ pratyakṣasya jātyā prābalya abhāve api upajīvya tvena prābalyam upajīvya tvam ca anumāna āgama apekṣita aśeṣa artha grāhaka tayā sā ca kvacid sākṣāt kvacid paramparayā dṛṣṭam ca apekṣita eka deśa grāhiṇām api upajīvya tvam tad viruddha grahaṇe tena bādhaḥ ca

original: yathā ghaṭavibhutvānumāne pakṣagrāhiṇā akṣṇā, naraśiraśśucitvānumāne sādhyagrāhakeṇāgamena, manovaibhavānumāne jñānāsamavāyyādhāratvahetugrāhakeṇānumānena| kimu vaktavyamapekṣitāśeṣagrāhiṇā svaviruddhagrāhakasya bādhaḥ ? cakṣurādeśca śabdatajjanyajñānaprāmāṇyādyagrāhitve'pi tad‌grāhiśrotrasākṣyādisajātīya tvādupajīvyatvam|
analyzed: yathā ghaṭa vibhu tva anumāne pakṣa grāhiṇā akṣṇā nara śiraḥ śuci tva anumāne sādhya grāhakeṇa āgamena manaḥ vaibhava anumāne jñāna asamavāyi ādhāra tva hetu grāhakeṇa anumānena kimu vaktavyam apekṣita aśeṣa grāhiṇā sva viruddha grāhakasya bādhaḥ cakṣuḥ ādeḥ ca śabda tad janya jñāna prāmāṇya ādi agrāhi tve api tad grāhi śrotra sākṣya ādi sajātīya tvāt upajīvya tvam

original: dṛṣṭaṃ ca naraśiraḥ kapālāśucitvabodhakāgamasya tacchucitvānumānopa jīvyaśucitvāgamasajātīyatvena tadanumānāt prābalyam| na cendriyamapi svajñānārtha manumānamupajīvatīti sama evopajīvyopajīvakabhāvaḥ| ajñātakaraṇatayā jñānajananārtha manumānānapekṣaṇāt| anumānāgamādinā tu jñānajananārthameva tadapekṣaṇāditi viśeṣād iti cenna| upajīvyāvirodhāt|
analyzed: dṛṣṭam ca nara śiraḥ kapāla aśuci tva bodhaka āgamasya tad śuci tva anumāna upa jīvya śuci tva āgama sajātīya tvena tad anumānāt prābalyam na ca indriyam api sva jñāna artha m anumānam upajīvati iti samaḥ eva upajīvya upajīvaka bhāvaḥ ajñāta karaṇa tayā jñāna janana artha m anumāna anapekṣaṇāt anumāna āgama ādinā tu jñāna janana artham eva tad apekṣaṇāt iti viśeṣāt iti ced na upajīvya avirodhāt

original: tathā hi -- yatsvarūpamupajīvyate tanna bādhyate| bādhyate ca tāttvikatvākāraḥ| sa ca nopajīvyate| kāraṇatve tasyāpraveśāt| taduktam --
analyzed: tathā hi yat svarūpam upajīvyate tat na bādhyate bādhyate ca tāttvika tva ākāraḥ sa ca nā upajīvyate kāraṇa tve tasya apraveśāt tat uktam

original: `pūrvasambandhaniyame hetutve tulya eva nau|
analyzed: pūrva sambandha niyame hetu tve tulyaḥ eva nau

original: hetutatvabahirbhūtasattvāsattvakathā vṛthā||' iti

kiñcāpekṣitagrāhitvamātreṇa cedupajīvyatā, tayā ca bādhakatvam, tadā'pekṣitapratiyogigrāhakatvena `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhramasya bādhopajīvyatvāt kathaṃ `nedaṃ rajatam' iti bādhabuddhistadviruddhodiyāt ? atha niṣedhyārthasamarpakatayā pratiyogijñānatvena tasyopajīvyatve'pi tatprāmāṇyaṃ nopajīvyam|
analyzed: kiñca apekṣita grāhi tva mātreṇa ced upajīvyatā tayā ca bādhaka tvam tad apekṣita pratiyogi grāhaka tvena idam rajatam iti bhramasya bādha upajīvya tvāt katham na idam rajatam iti bādha buddhiḥ tad viruddhā udiyāt atha niṣedhya artha samarpaka tayā pratiyogi jñāna tvena tasya upajīvya tve api tad prāmāṇyam na upajīvyam

original: na hi pratiyogipramātvenābhāvajñānajanakatā, gauravāt| pratiyogibhramādapyabhāvajñānadarśanācca| kintu tajjñānatvenaiva, lāghavāt| atastadviruddhaviṣayakaṃ jñānamudiyādeveti brūṣe, tulyamidaṃ prakṛte'pi, pakṣajñānatvādinā kāraṇatā, na tu tatpramātvādināpīti|
analyzed: na hi pratiyogi pramā tvena abhāva jñāna janakatā gauravāt pratiyogi bhramāt api abhāva jñāna darśanāt ca kintu tad jñāna tvena eva lāghavāt atas tad viruddha viṣayakam jñānam udiyāt eva iti brūṣe tulyam idam prakṛte api pakṣa jñāna tva ādinā kāraṇatā na tu tad pramā tva ādinā api iti

original: atha yatprāmāṇyaṃ svarūpasiddhyarthamapavādanirāsārthaṃ ca yatprāmāṇyamupajīvati tattasyopajīvyam, yathā smṛteranubhavaḥ| na ca rajatabhramastathā iti cet, tarhi vyāptidhiyo'pi nānumityupajīvyatvaṃ syāt| liṅgābhāsādapi vahnimati vahnipramādarśanāt| nanu yena vinā yasyotthānaṃ nāsti tattasyopajīvyamityeva vaktavyam|
analyzed: atha yat prāmāṇyam svarūpa siddhi artham apavāda nirāsa artham ca yat prāmāṇyam upajīvati tat tasya upajīvyam yathā smṛteḥ anubhavaḥ na ca rajata bhramaḥ tathā iti ced tarhi vyāpti dhiyaḥ api na anumiti upajīvya tvam syāt liṅga ābhāsāt api vahnimati vahni pramā darśanāt nanu yena vinā yasya utthānam na asti tat tasya upajīvyam iti eva vaktavyam

original: tathā ca rajatabhramasyopajīvyatvamastyeva, na tu prābalyam| na hyupajīvyatvamātreṇa prābalyam| kintu parīkṣitatayā| parīkṣā ca sajātīyavijātīyasaṃvādavisaṃvādābhāvau| na ca tau rajatabhrame staḥ| prakṛte cākṣasya parīkṣitatvena prābalyam| asti hi `san ghaṭaḥ' iti viśeṣadarśanajanyajñānāntaraṃ ghaṭārthakriyāpratyakṣe klṛptadūrādidoṣābhāvaśca|
analyzed: tathā ca rajata bhramasya upajīvya tvam asti eva na tu prābalyam na hi upajīvya tva mātreṇa prābalyam kintu parīkṣita tayā parīkṣā ca sajātīya vijātīya saṃvāda visaṃvāda abhāvau na ca tau rajata bhrame staḥ prakṛte ca akṣasya parīkṣita tvena prābalyam asti hi san ghaṭaḥ iti viśeṣa darśana janya jñāna antaram ghaṭa arthakriyā pratyakṣe klṛpta dūra ādi doṣa abhāvaḥ ca

original: evameva jīveśābhedaśrutau niṣedhyārpakabhedaśrutiḥ sākṣipratyakṣaṃ cādoṣatvāt parīkṣitamiti| tadapi na bādhyam| evameva ca doṣābhāvādijñānarūpaparīkṣāyāmapi anāśvāse vede pauruṣeyatvābhāvajñāne, tvaduktānumāne ca yogyānupalabdhyādinā hetvābhāsādirāhityajñāne, brahmamīmāṃsāyāṃ pratyadhikaraṇaṃ siddhāntyabhipretārrtha, upakramādyānugupyajñāne
analyzed: evam eva jīva īśa abheda śrutau niṣedhya arpaka bheda śrutiḥ sākṣi pratyakṣam ca adoṣa tvāt parīkṣitam iti tat api na bādhyam evam eva ca doṣa abhāva ādi jñāna rūpa parīkṣāyām api anāśvāse vede pauruṣeya tva abhāva jñāne tvad ukta anumāne ca yogya anupalabdhi ādinā hetvābhāsa ādi rāhitya jñāne brahmamīmāṃsāyām pratyadhikaraṇam siddhānti abhipreta arrthaḥ upakrama ādya anugupya jñāne

original: cānāśvāsaḥ syāditi pramāṇatadābhāsavyavasthā na syāt iti cenna| parīkṣā hi pravṛttisaṃvādavisaṃvādābhāvadoṣābhāvādirūpā| tayā ca svasamānadeśakālīnaviṣayābādhyatvaṃ prāmāṇyasya vyavasthāpyate, dhūmena svasamānadeśa kālīnavahniriva|
analyzed: ca anāśvāsaḥ syāt iti pramāṇa tad ābhāsa vyavasthā na syāt iti ced na parīkṣā hi pravṛtti saṃvāda visaṃvāda abhāva doṣa abhāva ādi rūpā tayā ca sva samāna deśa kālīna viṣaya abādhya tvam prāmāṇyasya vyavasthāpyate dhūmena sva samāna deśa kālīna vahniḥ iva

original: tathā ca vyavahāradaśāmātrābādhyatvaṃ dehātmaikyasādhāraṇaṃ parīkṣitapramāṇe vyavasthitamiti kathamatyantābādhyatvābhāvagrāhakāgamānumānayoḥ pravṛttirna syāt ? tasmādviśvāsa -- pramāṇatadābhāsavyavasthā jīveśabhedādikaṃ ca vyāvahārikamityupapannameva sarvaṃ jaganmithyeti|
analyzed: tathā ca vyavahāra daśā mātra abādhya tvam deha ātma aikya sādhāraṇam parīkṣita pramāṇe vyavasthitam iti katham atyanta abādhya tva abhāva grāhaka āgama anumānayoḥ pravṛttiḥ na syāt tasmāt viśvāsa pramāṇa tad ābhāsa vyavasthā jīva īśa bheda ādikam ca vyāvahārikam iti upapannam eva sarvam jagat mithyā iti

original: nanu -- pratyakṣāprāmāṇye tatsiddhasya vyāptyaderbādhenānumeyāderanumityādiprāmāṇyasya ca bādhaḥ| anumeyādervyāptyādinā anumitiprāmāṇyādinā ca samānayogakṣematvāt|
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣa aprāmāṇye tad siddhasya vyāpti adeḥ bādhena anumeya ādeḥ anumiti ādi prāmāṇyasya ca bādhaḥ anumeya ādeḥ vyāpti ādinā anumiti prāmāṇya ādinā ca samāna yogakṣema tvāt

original: anyathā prātibhāsikavyāptyādimatā bāṣpādhyastadhūmena tātviko vyāvahāriko vāgnirvyāva hārikavyāptyādimatā dhūmena tātviko'gnirvyāvahārikeṇābādhena viruddhadharmādhikaraṇatvena ca viśvasya jīveśabhedasya ca tātvikaṃ sattvaṃ sidhyet -- iti cenna| etāvatā hi vyāptyādisamānasattākamanumeyaṃ siddhyatvityāpatteḥ phalito'rthaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā prātibhāsika vyāpti ādimatā bāṣpa adhyasta dhūmena tātvikaḥ vyāvahārikaḥ vā agniḥ vyāva hārika vyāpti ādimatā dhūmena tātvikaḥ agniḥ vyāvahārikeṇa ābādhena viruddha dharma adhikaraṇa tvena ca viśvasya jīva īśa bhedasya ca tātvikam sattvam sidhyet iti ced na etāvatā hi vyāpti ādi samāna sattākam anumeyam siddhyatu iti āpatteḥ phalitaḥ ṛthaḥ

original: kiñca vipakṣabādhakasacivamanumānamapi pratyakṣabādhakam| nanu -- evamapi `audumbarīṃ spṛṣṭvā udgāyet', `aindryā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate', `śaramayaṃ barhirbhavati' iti śrutitrayagrāhi pratyakṣaṃ yathākramaṃ `audumbarī sarvā veṣṭayitavyā' iti smṛtirūpeṇa sarvaveṣṭanaśrutyanumānena, `kadācana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe' iti
analyzed: kiñca vipakṣa bādhaka sacivam anumānam api pratyakṣa bādhakam nanu evam api audumbarīm spṛṣṭvā udgāyet aindryā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate śara mayam barhiḥ bhavati iti śruti traya grāhi pratyakṣam yathākramam audumbarī sarvā veṣṭayitavyā iti smṛti rūpeṇa sarva veṣṭana śruti anumānena kadācana starīḥ asi na indra saścasi dāśuṣe iti

original: mantrasāmarthyalakṣaṇenendraśeṣatvaśrutyanumānena codanāliṅgarūpeṇa kuśaśrutyanumānena ca bādhyeteti sarvamīmāṃsonmūlinā syāditi -- cenna| vaiṣamyāt|

original: tathā hi -- kimidamāpādyate, śrutitrayagrāhipratyakṣamanumānairbādhyeteti vā, pratyakṣaviṣayībhūtaśrutitrayamiti vā ? nādyaḥ, virodhābhāvena tadbādhyabādhakabhāvasya śāstrārthatvābhāvāt, asmābhigaranabhyupagamācca| anuktopālambhamātratve niranuyojyānu yogāpatteḥ| ataeva na dvitīyaḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi kim idam āpādyate śruti traya grāhi pratyakṣam anumānaiḥ bādhyeta iti vā pratyakṣa viṣayībhūta śruti trayam iti vā na ādyaḥ virodha abhāvena tad bādhya bādhaka bhāvasya śāstra artha tva abhāvāt asmābhiḥ gar anabhyupagamāt ca anukta upālambha mātra tve niranuyojya anu yoga āpatteḥ ataeva na dvitīyaḥ

original: pratyakṣaviṣayībhūtaśrutitrayasya liṅgabādhakatvapare'pi śāstre pratyakṣasya liṅgabādhyatve virodhābhāvāt| nahi śabdapratyakṣayoraikyamasti| śabdasyaca sarvapramāṇāpekṣayā balavattvamavocāma| tasmānmauḍhyamātrametanmīmāṃsāvirodhodbhāvanam|
analyzed: pratyakṣa viṣayībhūta śruti trayasya liṅga bādhaka tva pare api śāstre pratyakṣasya liṅga bādhya tve virodha abhāvāt nahi śabda pratyakṣayoḥ aikyam asti śabdasya ca sarva pramāṇa apekṣayā balavat tvam avocāma tasmāt mauḍhya mātram etat mīmāṃsā virodha udbhāvanam

original: nanu pratyakṣasya liṅgabādhyatve bahnyauṣṇyapratyakṣaṃ śaityānumānasya ātmasthāyitvapratyabhijñānaṃ ca kṣaṇikatvānumānasya bādhakaṃ na syāt, pratyutānumānameva tayorbādhakaṃ syāt ithi cenna| arthakriyāsaṃvādena śrutyanugraheṇa ca tatra pratyakṣayoḥ prābalyenānumānabādhakatvāt|
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣasya liṅga bādhya tve bahni auṣṇya pratyakṣam śaitya anumānasya ātma sthāyi tva pratyabhijñānam ca kṣaṇikatva anumānasya bādhakam na syāt pratyuta anumānam eva tayoḥ bādhakam syāt ced na arthakriyā saṃvādena śruti anugraheṇa ca tatra pratyakṣayoḥ prābalyena anumāna bādhaka tvāt

original: aparīkṣitapratyakṣaṃ hi parīkṣitānumānāpekṣayā durbalaṃ, `nīlaṃ nabhaḥ' iti pratyakṣamiva nabho nīrūpatvānumānāpekṣayā| ato na sāmānyato dṛṣṭamātreṇa sarvasaṅkarāpattiḥ| nanvevaṃ paśutvena śrṛṅgānumānamapi syāt| lāghavāt paśutvameva śrṛṅgitve tantraṃ, na tu tadviśeṣagotvādikam;
analyzed: aparīkṣita pratyakṣam hi parīkṣita anumāna apekṣayā durbalam nīlam nabhaḥ iti pratyakṣam iva nabhaḥ nīrūpa tva anumāna apekṣayā atas na sāmānyatas dṛṣṭa mātreṇa sarva saṅkara āpattiḥ nanu evam paśu tvena śrṛṅga anumānam api syāt lāghavāt paśu tvam eva śrṛṅgi tve tantram na tu tad viśeṣa go tva ādikam

original: ananugatatvena gauravādityetattarkasadhrīcīnatvena pratyakṣāpekṣayā prābalyāt| anukūlatarkasācivyameva hi anumāne balam| evaṃ ca yena kenacit sāmān‌yadharmeṇa sarvatra yatkiñcidanumeyam, lāghavatarkasācivyasya sattvāt| tāvataiva ca pratyakṣabādhakatvāditi vyāvahārikyapi vyavasthā na syāt| na hyatra pratyakṣabādhādanyo doṣo'sti iti cenna|
analyzed: ananugata tvena gauravāt iti etad tarka sadhrīcīna tvena pratyakṣa apekṣayā prābalyāt anukūla tarka sācivyam eva hi anumāne balam evam ca yena kenacid sāmānya dharmeṇa sarvatra yat kiñcid anumeyam lāghava tarka sācivyasya sattvāt tāvatā eva ca pratyakṣa bādhaka tvāt iti vyāvahārikī api vyavasthā na syāt na hi atra pratyakṣa bādhāt anyaḥ doṣaḥ asti iti ced na

original: ayogyaśrṛṅgādisādhane pratyakṣabādhasyāsambhavena tatra vyāptigrāhakatarkeṣvābhāsatvasya tvayā'pi vaktavyatvena vyavasthāyā ubhayasamādheyatvāt| na hi tarkābhāsasadhrīcīnamanumānaṃ pramāṇamiti kenāpyupeyate| ata upapannaṃ sattarkasacivamanumānaṃ pratyakṣasya bādhakamiti| iti pratyakṣasyānumānabādhyatvasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: ayogya śrṛṅga ādi sādhane pratyakṣa bādhasya asambhavena tatra vyāpti grāhaka tarkeṣu ābhāsa tvasya tvayā api vaktavya tvena vyavasthāyāḥ ubhaya samādheya tvāt na hi tarka ābhāsa sadhrīcīnam anumānam pramāṇam iti kena api upeyate atas upapannam sat tarka sacivam anumānam pratyakṣasya bādhakam iti iti pratyakṣasya anumāna bādhya tva siddhiḥ

original: kiṃ ca parīkṣitapramāṇabhāvaśabdabādhyamapi pratyakṣam| nanu -- pratyakṣaṃ yadi śabdabādhyaṃ syāttadā jaimininā `tasmāddhūma evāgnerdivā dadṛśe nārciḥ' ityādyarthavādasya `aditirdyauḥ' ityādimantrasya ca dṛṣṭavirodhenāprāmāṇye prāpte `guṇavādastu' `guṇādavipratiṣedhaḥ syāt' ityādinā gauṇārthatā nocyeta|
analyzed: kim ca parīkṣita pramāṇa bhāva śabda bādhyam api pratyakṣam nanu pratyakṣam yadi śabda bādhyam syāt tadā jaimininā tasmāt dhūmaḥ eva agneḥ divā dadṛśe na arciḥ ityādi artha vādasya aditiḥ dyauḥ ityādi mantrasya ca dṛṣṭa virodhena aprāmāṇye prāpte guṇa vādaḥ tu guṇāt avipratiṣedhaḥ syāt ityādinā gauṇa arthatā na ucyeta

original: `tatsiddhijātisārūpyapraśaṃsābhūmaliṅgasamavāyād' -- iti tatsiddhipeṭikāyāṃ `yajamānaḥ prastara' ityādegauṇārthatā ca nocyeta| tvayā'pi pratyakṣāvirodhāya tattvampadayorlakṣaṇā nocyetā| śrutivirodhe pratyakṣasyaivāprāmāṇyasambhavāt| na ca -- tātparyaliṅgānāmupakramādīnāmatra sattvānnādvaitaśrutīnāmamukhyārthatvamiti vācyam|
analyzed: tad siddhi jāti sārūpya praśaṃsā bhūma liṅga samavāyāt iti tad siddhi peṭikāyām yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ iti āde gauṇa arthatā ca nā ucyeta tvayā api pratyakṣa avirodhāya tattvam padayoḥ lakṣaṇā nā ucyeta ā śruti virodhe pratyakṣasya eva aprāmāṇya sambhavāt na ca tātparya liṅgānām upakrama ādīnām atra sattvāt na advaita śrutīnām amukhya arthatvam iti vācyam

original: `yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādāvapyapūrvatvādyekaikaliṅgasya tātparyagrāhakasya vidyamānatvāt| ekaikaliṅgasya tātparyanirṇāyakatve liṅgāntaramanuvādakameva| tvanmate pratyakṣasiddhe bhede śrutiriva| kiṃ bāhulyena iti cenna|
analyzed: yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ ityādau api apūrva tva ādi eka eka liṅgasya tātparya grāhakasya vidyamāna tvāt ekaika liṅgasya tātparya nirṇāyaka tve liṅga antaram anuvādakam eva tvad mate pratyakṣa siddhe bhede śrutiḥ iva kim bāhulyena iti ced na

original: vākyaśeṣapramāṇāntarasaṃvādārthakriyādirūpaparīkṣāparīkṣitasya pratyakṣasya prābalyena vyavahāradaśāyāmeva etadviruddhārthagrāhiṇo `dhūma evāgnerdivā dadṛśe', `aditirdyauḥ' `jayamānaḥ prastara' ityādestadvirodhenāmukhyārthatve'pyadvaitāgamasya parīkṣitapramāṇavirodhābhāvena mukhyārthatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: vākya śeṣa pramāṇa antara saṃvāda arthakriyā ādi rūpa parīkṣā parīkṣitasya pratyakṣasya prābalyena vyavahāra daśāyām eva etad viruddha artha grāhiṇaḥ dhūmaḥ eva agneḥ divā dadṛśe aditiḥ dyauḥ jayamānaḥ prastaraḥ ityādeḥ tad virodhena amukhya artha tve pi advaita āgamasya parīkṣita pramāṇa virodha abhāvena mukhya artha tva upapatteḥ

original: pratyakṣāderhi parīkṣayā vyāvahārikaprāmāṇyamātraṃ siddham| tacca nādvaitāgamena bādhyate| bādhyate tu tātvikaṃ prāmāṇyam| tattu parīkṣayā na siddhameva| ato na varodhaḥ| `dhūma evāgneḥ' ityādestu mukhyārthatve pratyakṣādervyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vyāhanyeta| ato virodhāttatrāmukhyārthatvamiti vivekaḥ|
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādeḥ hi parīkṣayā vyāvahārika prāmāṇya mātram siddham tat ca na advaita āgamena bādhyate bādhyate tu tātvikam prāmāṇyam tat tu parīkṣayā na siddham eva atas na varodhaḥ dhūmaḥ eva agneḥ ityādeḥ tu mukhya artha tve pratyakṣa ādeḥ vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam vyāhanyeta atas virodhāt tatra amukhya artha tvam iti vivekaḥ

original: yattu -- pratyakṣāvirodhāya tattvampadayorlakṣaṇā nāśrīyeteti tanna| ṣaḍvidhaliṅgairgatisāmānyena cākhaṇḍa evāvadhāryamāṇasya tātparyasyānupapatterjīveśagatasarvajñatvakiñcijjñatvādīnā maikyānvayānupapatteśca| tātparyaviṣayībhūtākhaṇḍapratītinirvāhāya lakṣaṇāṅgīkaraṇasyaivocitatvāt|
analyzed: yat tu pratyakṣa avirodhāya tattvam padayoḥ lakṣaṇā na āśrīyeta iti tat na ṣaḍvidha liṅgaiḥ gati sāmānyena ca akhaṇḍe eva avadhāryamāṇasya tātparyasya anupapatteḥ jīva īśa gata sarvajñatva kiñcijjñatva ādīnām maikya anvaya anupapatteḥ ca tātparya viṣayībhūta akhaṇḍa pratīti nirvāhāya lakṣaṇa aṅgīkaraṇasya eva ucitatvāt

original: anvayānupapattestātparyānupapattervā lakṣaṇābījasya vidhyavidhisādhāraṇatvācca| śābaraṃ tu vacanamarthavādamukhyātvāya vidhau na lakṣaṇetyevamparam| tasmānna pratyakṣaṃ śabdabādhyam iti cenna| bhāvānavabodhāt| tātparyaviṣayībhūtārthabodhakatvaṃ hi mukhyārthatvam| na śakyārthamātrabodhakatvam| anyārthatātparyakatvāccamukhyārthatvam|
analyzed: anvaya anupapatteḥ tātparya anupapatteḥ vā lakṣaṇā bījasya vidhi avidhi sādhāraṇa tvāt ca śābaram tu vacanam arthavāda mukhyā tvāya vidhau na lakṣaṇā iti evamparam tasmāt na pratyakṣam śabda bādhyam iti ced na bhāva anavabodhāt tātparya viṣayībhūta artha bodhaka tvam hi mukhya artha tvam na śakya artha mātra bodhaka tvam anya artha tātparyaka tvāt ca mukhya artha tvam

original: na lākṣaṇikatvamātram| tathā cādvaitāgamasya svatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthabodhakatvanirvāhāya lakṣaṇāśrayaṇe'pi mukhyārthatvamupapannamityavocāma| evaṃ ca `somena yajeta' ityādi viśiṣṭavidherviśeṣaṇe tātparyābhāvānmatvarthalakṣaṇāyāmapi svārthāparityāgācca nāmukhyārthatvam|
analyzed: na lākṣaṇikatva mātram tathā ca advaita āgamasya sva tātparya viṣayībhūta artha bodhaka tva nirvāhāya lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇe api mukhya ārthatvam upapannam iti avocāma evam ca somena yajeta ityādi viśiṣṭa vidheḥ viśeṣaṇe tātparya abhāvāt matu artha lakṣaṇāyām api svārtha aparityāgāt ca na amukhya ārthatvam

original: jijñāsāpade tu jñādhātuneṣyamāṇajñānalakṣaṇāṅgīkārānaṅgīkāramatabhede'pi satpratyayasya vicāre jahallakṣaṇābhyupagamasyobhayatra tulyatvāt, śakyārthaparityāge'pi vidhitātparyanirvāhāt nāmukhyārthatvam| nahi vākyārthapratītyanyathānupapattyā padamātre lakṣaṇāyāmapi vākyasyāmukhyārthatvam| pratītasyārthasyānanyaśeṣatvena mukhyatvāt|
analyzed: jijñāsā pade tu jñā dhātunā iṣyamāṇa jñāna lakṣaṇa aṅgīkāra anaṅgīkāra mata bhede pi sat pratyayasya vicāre jahat lakṣaṇa abhyupagamasya ubhayatra tulya tvāt śakya artha parityāge pi vidhi tātparya nirvāhāt na amukhya artha tvam nahi vākya artha pratīti anyathā anupapattyā pada mātre lakṣaṇāyām api vākyasya amukhya artha tvam pratītasya arthasya ananyaśeṣatvena mukhya tvāt

original: yatra punaḥ pratīta eva vākyārtho'nyaśeṣatvena kalpyate, tatra vākyasyāmukhyārthatvameva| anyaddhi padatātparyamanyacca vākyatātparyam| `saundhavamānaya' `gaṅgāyāṃ vasanti' ityādau vākyatātparyaikye'pi padatātparyabhedāt| `viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva' ityādau padatātparyābhede'pi vākyatātparyabhedāt|
analyzed: yatra punar pratītaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ nya śeṣa tvena kalpyate tatra vākyasya amukhya artha tvam eva anyat hi pada tātparyam anyat ca vākya tātparyam saundhavam ānaya gaṅgāyām vasanti ityādau vākya tātparya aikye pi pada tātparya bhedāt viṣam bhuṅkṣva ityādau pada tātparya abhede pi vākya tātparya bhedāt

original: ata eva `iyaṃ gauḥ krayyā bahukṣīrā' ityādivākyārthasyāvaśyaṃ kretavyeti vidhiśeṣatvena tatprāśastyalakṣakatvāt, `so'rodhīt' ityādi vākyārthasya ca `barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā ' iti vidhiśeṣatvena rajatanindādvārā tatprāśastyalakṣakatvāt|
analyzed: atas eva iyam gauḥ krayyā bahu kṣīrā ityādi vākya arthasya avaśyam kretavyā iti vidhi śeṣa tvena tad prāśastya lakṣaka tvāt sorodhīt ityādi vākya arthasya ca barhiṣi rajatam na deyam hiraṇyam dakṣiṇā iti vidhi śeṣa tvena rajata nindā dvārā tad prāśastya lakṣaka tvāt

original: `sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalān' iti vākyārthasya `śāntaupāsīta' iti śamavidhiśeṣatvenātyanāyāsasiddhatvarūpatatprāśastyalakṣakatvādamukhyatvameva| ataeva mānāntara virodha eva lakṣaṇetyapāstam| `iyaṃ gauḥ krayyā bahukṣīrā' ityādinā prāśastyalakṣaṇāyāṃ vyabhicārāt| kiṃ tu paramatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthapratītinirvāhāyaiva sarvārthavādeṣu lakṣaṇā|
analyzed: sarvam khalu idam brahma tat jalān iti vākya arthasya śāntyā upāsīta iti śama vidhi śeṣatvena ati anāyāsa siddha tva rūpa tad prāśastya lakṣaka tvāt amukhya tvam eva ataeva māna antara virodhaḥ eva lakṣaṇā iti apāstam iyam gauḥ krayyā bahu kṣīrā ityādinā prāśastya lakṣaṇāyām vyabhicārāt kim tu parama tātparya viṣayībhūta artha pratīti nirvāhāya eva sarva artha vādeṣu lakṣaṇā

original: etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- vidhiprāśastye lakṣaṇātaḥ prāgarthavādavākyārthajñānam| tasyapramāṇāntaravirodhe bādha eva, yathā `prajāpatirātmano vapāmudakhidat' ityādau| ataeva tatra guṇavādamātram| pramāṇān‌taraprāptau tvanuvādamātram `agnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ' ityādau| ataeva tadubhayatrābādhitājñātajñāpakatvarūpaprāmāṇyaśarīrānirvāhādaprāmāṇyam|
analyzed: etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ vidhi prāśastye lakṣaṇātaḥ prāk arthavāda vākya artha jñānam tasya pramāṇa antara virodhe bādhaḥ eva yathā prajāpatiḥ ātmanaḥ vapām udakhidat ityādau ataeva tatra guṇavāda mātram pramāṇa antara prāptau tu anuvāda mātram agniḥ himasya bheṣajam ityādau ataeva tad ubhayatra abādhita ajñāta jñāpaka tva rūpa prāmāṇya śarīra anirvāhāt aprāmāṇyam

original: yatra punaḥ pramāṇāntaraprāptivirodhau na stastatra prāmāṇyaśarīranirvāhād bhūtārthavādatvam‌ -- yathā `indro vṛtrāya vajramudayacchat' ityādau ayameva devatādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ| nanu tarhi `ādityo yūpaḥ' ityādau vākyārthapratītyarthameva lakṣaṇāṅgīkārādamukhyārthatvaṃ na syāt| na syādyadyādityasadṛśo yūpa iti vākyārthaparyavasānaṃ syāt|
analyzed: yatra punar pramāṇa antara prāpti virodhau na staḥ tatra prāmāṇya śarīra nirvāhāt bhūtārthavādatvam yathā indraḥ vṛtrāya vajram udayacchat ityādau ayam eva devatā adhikaraṇa nyāyaḥ nanu tarhi ādityaḥ yūpaḥ ityādau vākya artha pratīti artham eva lakṣaṇa aṅgīkārāt amukhya artha tvam na syāt na syāt yadi āditya sadṛśaḥ yūpaḥ iti vākya artha paryavasānam syāt

original: kiṃ tu guṇavṛttyā pratītasyāpi vākyārthasya yūpe paśuṃ badhnātīti vidhiśeṣatvena tatprāśastyalakṣakatvamastyeva, tenaivāmukhyatvam, na tvādityapadagauṇatayeti tatsiddhipeṭikāyāṃ sarvodāharaṇeṣvapyavāntaravākyārthapratītaye guṇavṛttiprakārāḥ pradarśitā iti draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: kim tu guṇa vṛttyā pratītasya api vākya arthasya yūpe paśum badhnāti iti vidhi śeṣa tvena tad prāśastya lakṣaka tvam asti eva tena eva amukhya tvam na tu āditya pada gauṇa tayā iti tad siddhipeṭikāyām sarva udāharaṇeṣu api avāntaravākya artha pratītaye guṇa vṛtti prakārāḥ pradarśitāḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: karmaprāśastyalakṣaṇā tu sarvārthavādasādhāraṇī tatrāstyeveti nāmukhyārthatvānupapattiḥ| ata upapannaṃ prastarādivākyavaiṣamyam advaitavākyasya| yaccoktam arthavādamukhyārthatvāya vidhau na lakṣaṇetyevamparaṃ śabarasvāmivacanamiti, tanna|
analyzed: karma prāśastya lakṣaṇā tu sarva arthavāda sādhāraṇī tatra asti eva iti na amukhya arthatva anupapattiḥ atas upapannam prastara ādi vākya vaiṣamyam advaita vākyasya yat ca uktam arthavāda mukhya artha tvāya vidhau na lakṣaṇā iti evamparam śabarasvāmi vacanam iti tat na

original: aśvapratigraheṣṭau `pratigṛhṇīyāt' iti vidhau pratigrāhayediti vyavadhāraṇakalpanayā arthavādānu sāreṇa prayojakavyāpāralakṣaṇāyā aṅgīkāraṇāt| tasmādvidhau tātparyavati vākye pratīyamānavākyārthātirikto'nyaḥ śeṣī nāstītyevamparameva tadvacanam| ataḥ siddhamadvaitāgamasya lākṣaṇikatve'pi mukhyārthatvāt pratyakṣabādhakatvamiti śivam||
analyzed: aśva pratigraha iṣṭau pratigṛhṇīyāt iti vidhau pratigrāhayet iti vyavadhāraṇa kalpanayā arthavāda anu sāreṇa prayojaka vyāpāra lakṣaṇāyāḥ aṅgīkāraṇāt tasmāt vidhau tātparyavati vākye pratīyamāna vākya artha atiriktaḥ nyaḥ śeṣī na asti iti evamparam eva tat vacanam atas siddham advaita āgamasya lākṣaṇika tve pi mukhya artha tvāt pratyakṣa bādhaka tvam iti śivam

original: iti pratyakṣasyāgamabādhyatvam||
analyzed: iti pratyakṣasya āgama bādhya tvam

original: kiṃ cāpacchedanyāyenāpyāgamasya prābalyam| yathā hi `paurvāparye pūrvadaurbalyaṃ prakṛtivat' ityadhikaraṇe udgātrapacchedanimittakādakṣiṇayāgena pareṇa pratihartrapacchedanimittaka sarvasvadakṣiṇayāgasya pūrvasiddhanimittasya bādha iti sthitaṃ, tathehāpi udīcyāgamena pūrvasya pratyakṣasya bādhaḥ|
analyzed: kim ca apaccheda nyāyena api āgamasya prābalyam yathā hi paurvāparye pūrva daurbalyam prakṛti vat iti adhikaraṇe udgātṛ apaccheda nimittaka adakṣiṇa yāgena pareṇa pratihartṛ apaccheda nimittaka sarvasva dakṣiṇa yāgasya pūrva siddha nimittasya bādhaḥ iti sthitam tathā iha api udīcya āgamena pūrvasya pratyakṣasya bādhaḥ

original: nanu pratihartrapacchedanimittakasarvasvadakṣiṇayāgasya pratihartṛmātrāpacchede, yugapadapacchede, krameṇāpacchede'pi pratihartrapacchedasya paścāttve cāvakāśa iti yuktaḥ udgātrapacchedanimittakādakṣiṇayāgena bādhaḥ| anyathā `yadi pratihartā apacchidyeta sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt' iti śāstramaprāmāṇaṃ syāt|
analyzed: nanu pratihartṛ apaccheda nimittaka sarva sva dakṣiṇa yāgasya pratihartṛ mātra apacchede yugapad apacchede krameṇa apacchede api pratihartṛ apacchedasya paścāttve ca avakāśaḥ iti yuktaḥ udgātṛ apaccheda nimittaka adakṣiṇa yāgena bādhaḥ anyathā yadi pratihartā apacchidyeta sarvavedasam dadyāt iti śāstram aprāmāṇam syāt

original: ata eva `vipratiṣedhādvikalpaḥ syāt' ityadhikaraṇe dvayoryugapadapacchede vikalpa uktaḥ| kiṃ ca `yadyudgātā jaghanyaḥ syātpunaryajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyādyathetarasmin' ityadhikaraṇe udgātrapacchedasya pratihartrapacchedātparatve udgātrapacchedanimittaṃ pūrvaṃ prayogaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ sampādya kartavyajyotiṣṭomasya dvitīyaprayoge `taddadyādyatpūrvasmin
analyzed: atas eva vipratiṣedhāt vikalpaḥ syāt iti adhikaraṇe dvayoḥ yugapad apacchede vikalpaḥ uktaḥ kim ca yadi udgātā jaghanyaḥ syāt punar yajñe sarvavedasam dadyāt yathā itarasmin iti adhikaraṇe udgātṛ apacchedasya pratihartṛ apacchedāt paratve udgātṛ apaccheda nimittam pūrvam prayogam dakṣiṇā hīnam sampādya kartavya jyotiṣṭomasya dvitīya prayoge tat dadyāt yat pūrvasmin

original: dāsyan syāt' iti śrutyuktā yā dakṣiṇā sā pūrvabhāvipratihartrapaccheda nimittakapūrvaprayogasthasarvasvaditsāyā abādhena sarvasvarūpaiva, na tu yā jyotiṣṭome nityā dvādaśaśatarūpā| tasmānna pratihartrapacchedasya sarvathā bādhaḥ| kiṃ tu prayogāntare nikṣepa ityuktam| uktaṃ hi ṭipṭīkāyām -- `tasya prayogāntare nikṣepaḥ' iti|
analyzed: dāsyan syāt iti śruti uktā yā dakṣiṇā sā pūrva bhāvi pratihartṛ apaccheda nimittaka pūrva prayoga stha sarvasva ditsāyāḥ abādhena sarva sva rūpā eva na tu yā jyotiṣṭome nityā dvādaśa śata rūpā tasmāt na pratihartṛ apacchedasya sarvathā bādhaḥ kim tu prayoga antare nikṣepaḥ iti uktam uktam hi ṭipṭīkāyām tasya prayoga antare nikṣepaḥ iti

original: api ca kramikanimittadvayena krameṇādakṣiṇasarvasvadakṣiṇayoḥ prayogayoḥ sambhavena virodha eva nāsti, yathā badaraphale kramikanimittavattoḥ śyāmaraktarūpayoḥ| uktaṃ hyapacchedādhikaraṇe -- `naimittakaśāstrasya hyayamarthaḥ -- nimittopajananāt prāganyathākartavyo'pi kraturnimitte satyevaṃ kartavyaḥ' iti| tasmādapacchedanyāyaḥ sāvakāśaviṣayaḥ|
analyzed: api ca kramika nimitta dvayena krameṇa adakṣiṇa sarva sva dakṣiṇayoḥ prayogayoḥ sambhavena virodhaḥ eva nā asti yathā badara phale kramika nimittavattoḥ śyāma rakta rūpayoḥ uktam hi apaccheda adhikaraṇe naimittaka śāstrasya hi ayam arthaḥ nimitta upajananāt prāk anyathā kartavyaḥ api kratuḥ nimitte sati evam kartavyaḥ iti tasmāt apaccheda nyāyaḥ sa avakāśa viṣayaḥ

original: advaitāgamena pratyakṣabādhe tu na pratyakṣapramāṇyasyāvakāśo'sti iti cenna| udgātrapacchedābhāve yugapadubhayāpacchede pratihartrapacchedasya udgātrapacchede paścāttve ca jyotiṣṭomadvitīyaprayoge pratihartrapacchedanimittaka sarvasvadakṣiṇayāgapratipādakaśāstrasya sāvakāśatvavadvyāvahārikaprāmāṇye pratyakṣasyāpi sāvakāśatvāt|

original: tatraikaprayoge virodhavadatrāpi tāttvikatvāṃśe virodhāt| ata eva saguṇasaprapañcaśrutyornirguṇaniṣprapañcaśrutibhyāmapacchedanyāyena bādha iti suṣṭhūktam| taduktamānandabodhācāryauḥ -- `tatparatvātparatvācca nirdoṣatvācca vaidikam| pūrvasya bādhakaṃ nāyaṃ sarpa ityādivākyavat||' iti|

analyzed: kim ca parīkṣita tvena eva prābalyam na upajīvya tva ādinā anumāna śabda bādhya tvasya pratyakṣe api darśanāt tathā hi idam rajatam iti pratyakṣasya anumāna āpta vacanābhyām nabhaḥ nailya pratyakṣasya nīrūpa tva grāhaka anumānena gauraḥ ham ityasya aham iha eva asmi sadane jānānaḥ ityasya candra prādeśika tva pratyakṣasya ca anumāna āgamābhyām pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ tiktaḥ guḍaḥ

original: ityādeścānumānāptavacanābhyāṃ bādho dṛśyate| nanu sākṣātkāribhrame sākṣātkāriviśeṣadarśanameva virodhītyabhyupeyam; anyathā parokṣapramāyā aparokṣabhramanivartakatvopapattau vedāntavākyānāmaparokṣa jñānajanakatvavyutpādanaprayāse vyarthaḥ syād iti cenna|
analyzed: ityādeḥ ca anumāna āpta vacanābhyām bādhaḥ dṛśyate nanu sākṣātkāri bhrame sākṣātkāri viśeṣa darśanam eva virodhi iti abhyupeyam anyathā parokṣa pramāyāḥ aparokṣa bhrama nivartaka tva upapattau vedānta vākyānām aparokṣa jñāna janaka tva vyutpādana prayāse vyarthaḥ syāt iti ced na

original: `nāyaṃ sarpaḥ' ityādivākyādinā savilāsājñānanivṛttyabhāve'pi bhramagatāpramāṇatvajñāpanena bhramapramāṇatvabuddhestadviṣayasatyatābuddheśca nivartanāt| tāvatā ca bhramanivartakatvavyapadeśāt| bhrame prāmāṇyavibhramasya tadviṣaye satyatāvibhramasya ca parokṣatvenāparokṣabādhānapekṣatvāt|
analyzed: na ayam sarpaḥ ityādi vākya ādinā savilāsa ajñāna nivṛtti abhāve pi bhrama gata apramāṇa tva jñāpanena bhrama pramāṇa tva buddheḥ tad viṣaya satyatā buddheḥ ca nivartanāt tāvatā ca bhrama nivartaka tva vyapadeśāt bhrame prāmāṇya vibhramasya tad viṣaye satyatā vibhramasya ca parokṣa tvena aparokṣa bādhā anapekṣa tvāt

original: na hi duṣṭakaraṇājanyatvamabādhitaviṣayatvaṃ vā prāmāṇyaṃ kasyacit pratyakṣam| na vā sarvadeśasarvakālasarvapuruṣābādhyatvarūpaṃ viṣayasatyatvam| atastayoḥ parokṣapramābādhyatvamucitameva| tayośca bādhitayoḥ rajatādibhramaḥ svarūpeṇa sannapi svakāryākṣamatvādasanniveti bādhita ityucyata ityanavadyam|
analyzed: na hi duṣṭa karaṇa ajanya tvam abādhita viṣaya tvam vā prāmāṇyam kasyacid pratyakṣam na vā sarva deśa sarva kāla sarva puruṣa abādhya tva rūpam viṣaya satya tvam atas tayoḥ parokṣa pramā bādhya tvam ucitam eva tayoḥ ca bādhitayoḥ rajata ādi bhramaḥ svarūpeṇa san api sva kārya akṣama tvāt asan iva iti bādhitaḥ iti ucyate iti anavadyam

original: nanu -- `idaṃ rajatam' ityatra sayuktikaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhakaṃ, na yuktimātram| `gauro'ham' ityatrāpi `mama śarīram' iti balavat pratyakṣameva bādhakam| `ahamihaivāsmi sadane jānāna' iti tu pramāṇameva, jīvasyāṇutvād iti cenna| rajatābhedaśarīrābhedapratyakṣayorjāgratoḥ yuktyā pratibandhākṣamatve tadviṣayapratyakṣotpatte ravonavakāśāt|
analyzed: nanu idam rajatam iti atra sayuktikam pratyakṣam bādhakam na yukti mātram gauḥ ūham iti atra api mama śarīram iti balavat pratyakṣam eva bādhakam aham iha eva asmi sadane jānānaḥ iti tu pramāṇam eva jīvasya aṇu tvāt iti ced na rajata abheda śarīra abheda pratyakṣayoḥ jāgratoḥ yuktyā pratibandha akṣama tve tad viṣaya pratyakṣa utpatteḥ ravaḥ navakāśāt

original: na ca tatra paramparāsambandhena kardamalipte vastre `nīlaṃ vastram' itivad `gauro'ham' iti gauṇam; kardamavastrayoriva śarīrātmanorbhedānadhyavasāyena dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt| tathā cātraikyādhyāsa evocitaḥ| evaṃ ca `uṣṇaṃ jalam' ityatrāpi yadi kardamavastrayoriva toyatejasorbhedagrahaḥ, tadā gauṇataiva|
analyzed: na ca tatra paramparā sambandhena kardama lipte vastre nīlam vastram iti vat gauḥ ūham iti gauṇam kardama vastrayoḥ iva śarīra ātmanoḥ bheda anadhyavasāyena dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ vaiṣamyāt tathā ca atra aikya adhyāsaḥ eva ucitaḥ evam ca uṣṇam jalam iti atra api yadi kardama vastrayoḥ iva toya tejasoḥ bheda grahaḥ tadā gauṇa tā eva

original: yadica śarīrātmavad bhedānadhyavasāyastadā'dhyāsa eva| tathā ca yuktibādhyameveti tadapyudāharaṇam| yattvahamihaiveti pramāṇamityuktam, tanna| ātmanaḥ `ākāśavat sarvagataśca' iti sarvagatatvena ihaiveti vyavacchedasyāpramāṇikatvāt| na ca jīvo'ṇuḥ, yugapadeva pādaśiro'vacchedena sukhaduḥkhānubhavāt|
analyzed: yadi ca śarīra ātma vat bheda anadhyavasāyaḥ tadā adhyāsaḥ eva tathā ca yukti bādhyam eva iti tat api udāharaṇam yat tu aham iha eva iti pramāṇam iti uktam tat na ātmanaḥ ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca iti sarva gata tvena iha eva iti vyavacchedasya apramāṇika tvāt na ca jīva ūṇuḥ yugapad eva pāda śiraḥ vacchedena sukha duḥkha anubhavāt

original: na hyoko'ṇurekadā vyavahitadeśadvayāvacchinno bhavati| naca yugapatpratītirbhramaḥ, utsargasiddhaprāmāṇyaparityāge bījābhāvāt| vistareṇa caitadagre vakṣyāmaḥ|
analyzed: na hi oka uṇuḥ ekadā vyavahita deśa dvaya avacchinnaḥ bhavati na ca yugapad pratītiḥ bhramaḥ utsarga siddha prāmāṇya parityāge bīja abhāvāt vistareṇa ca etat agre vakṣyāmaḥ

original: nanu -- nabhonailyapratyakṣasya nīrūpatvagrāhakānumānena na bādhaḥ, liṅgābhāvāt| na ca paramamahattvadravyānārambhakatbāderliṅgatvam, tvanmate asiddheḥ| niḥsparśatvaṃ tu tamasi vyabhicāri| pṛthivyāditrayetarabhūtatvādi cāprayojakam|
analyzed: nanu nabhaḥ nailya pratyakṣasya nīrūpa tva grāhaka anumānena na bādhaḥ liṅga abhāvāt na ca parama mahat tva dravya anārambhaka tva ādeḥ liṅga tvam tvanmate asiddheḥ niḥsparśa tvam tu tamasi vyabhicāri pṛthivī ādi traya itara bhūta tva ādi ca aprayojakam

original: tathā ca nīrūpatvagrāhakasākṣipratyakṣameva tadbādhakaṃ vācyam, na ca rūpagrahaṇāsamarthasya sākṣiṇaḥ kathaṃ nīrūpatvagrāhakatvamiti vācyam|
analyzed: tathā ca nīrūpatva grāhaka sākṣi pratyakṣam eva tat bādhakam vācyam na ca rūpa grahaṇa asamarthasya sākṣiṇaḥ katham nīrūpatva grāhaka tvam iti vācyam

original: piśācāgrāhakasyāpi cakṣuṣastadabhāvagrāhakatvavadupapatteḥ, pareṇāpi sākṣiṇo'pi rūpavattamogrāhakatvābhyupagamācca acākṣuṣe'pi nabhasi vāyāviva cakṣuṣaiva rūpābhāvagrahaṇasambhavena cākṣuṣapratyakṣabādhād iti cenna| `nīlaṃ nabhaḥ' it pratyakṣe jāgrati rūpābhāvagrahaṇasya cakṣuṣā sākṣiṇā cāsambhavāt| tathā ca balavatī yuktireva tadbādhikā|
analyzed: piśāca agrāhakasya api cakṣuṣaḥ tad abhāva grāhaka tva vat upapatteḥ pareṇa api sākṣiṇaḥ api rūpavat tamaḥ grāhaka tva abhyupagamāt ca acākṣuṣe api nabhasi vāyau iva cakṣuṣā eva rūpa abhāva grahaṇa sambhavena cākṣuṣa pratyakṣa bādhāt iti ced na nīlam nabhaḥ pratyakṣe jāgrati rūpa abhāva grahaṇasya cakṣuṣā sākṣiṇā ca asambhavāt tathā ca balavatī yuktiḥ eva tad bādhikā

original: na ca liṅgābhāvaḥ, cakṣuranvayavyatirekānuvidhāyirūpāviśeṣitapratītiviṣayatvādrūpavaditi liṅgasambhavāt| na cāprayojakatvam, nabho yadi sarūpaṃ syāttadā cakṣuranvayavyatirekānu vidhāyipratītau rūpāsambandhitayā viṣayo na syāditi tarkopapatteḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, savidhe rūpāsambandhitayā nabhasaḥ siddheḥ sarvajanasammatatvāt|
analyzed: na ca liṅga abhāvaḥ cakṣuḥ anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi rūpa a viśeṣita pratīti viṣaya tvāt rūpa vat iti liṅga sambhavāt na ca aprayojaka tvam nabhaḥ yadi sarūpam syāt tadā cakṣuḥ anvaya vyatireka anu vidhāyi pratītau rūpa asambandhi tayā viṣayaḥ na syāt iti tarka upapatteḥ na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ savidhe rūpa asambandhi tayā nabhasaḥ siddheḥ sarva jana sammata tvāt

original: nabhasaḥ sākṣivedyatāyāmapi cakṣuranvayavyatirekānuvidhānamavarjanīyameva| anyathā'ndhasyāpi tadgrahaṇaṃ syāt| na ca pañcīkaraṇādrūpavadārabdhatvena nabhaso nīrūpatvaṃ bādhitamiti vācyam| trivṛtkaraṇapakṣe'sya dūṣaṇasyānavakāśāt|
analyzed: nabhasaḥ sākṣi vedya tāyām api cakṣuḥ anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam avarjanīyam eva anyathā andhasya api tat grahaṇam syāt na ca pañcīkaraṇāt rūpavat ārabdha tvena nabhasaḥ nīrūpa tvam bādhitam iti vācyam trivṛtkaraṇa pakṣe isya dūṣaṇasya anavakāśāt

original: pañcīkaraṇapakṣe'pi apañcīkaraṇadaśāyāṃ yasmin bhūte yo guṇaḥ sa pañcīkaraṇādvyavahārayogyo bhavatītyetāvanmātrābhyupagamānnākāśe rūpārambhaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca `nāyaṃ sarpaḥ' ityukto'pi, `kimevaṃ vadasi param ? api punaḥ parāmṛśya paśyasi ?' iti prativacanadarśanānna śabdamātraṃ rajjusarpādibhramanivarttakam, kiṃ tu pratyakṣameveti vācyam|
analyzed: pañcīkaraṇa pakṣe api apañcīkaraṇa daśāyām yasmin bhūte yaḥ guṇaḥ sa pañcīkaraṇāt vyavahāra yogyaḥ bhavati iti etāvat mātra abhyupagamāt na ākāśe rūpa ārambha prasaṅgaḥ na ca na ayam sarpaḥ iti uktaḥ api kim evam vadasi param api punar parāmṛśya paśyasi iti prativacana darśanāt na śabda mātram rajju sarpa ādi bhrama nivarttakam kim tu pratyakṣam eva iti vācyam

original: prativacanasthale bhramapramādādiśaṅkākrāntatvena `nāyaṃ sarpaḥ' ityāderdurbalatayā na bhramanivartakatvam| yatra tu tādṛkśaṅkānākrāntatvaṃ tatra bhramanivartakataiva| ata eva tādṛkśaṅkānākrāntapitrādivacasi nedṛkprativacanaṃ, kintu siddhavatpravṛttyādikameva| jvālaikyapratyakṣamapyevameva yuktibādhyam|
analyzed: prativacana sthale bhrama pramāda ādi śaṅkā ākrānta tvena na ayam sarpaḥ ityādeḥ durbala tayā na bhrama nivartaka tvam yatra tu tādṛś śaṅkā anākrānta tvam tatra bhrama nivartaka tā eva atas eva tādṛś śaṅkā anākrānta pitṛ ādi vacasi na īdṛś prativacanam kintu siddha vat pravṛtti ādikam eva jvālā aikya pratyakṣam api evam eva yukti bādhyam

original: na ca nirvāpitāropitasthale spaṣṭatarabhedapratyakṣabādhitaṃ tadityantatrāpi dīrgheyaṃ na hrasveti bhedapratyakṣameva tadbādhakamiti vācyam| nirvāpitāropitātiriktasthale tāvadayaṃ vicāraḥ| tatra ca dīrgheyaṃ na hrasveti bhedapratyakṣaṃ vaktumaśakyam| yaiva hrasvā saivedānīṃ dīrgheti hrasvatvadīrghatvābhyāmupasthitayorabhedasya sākṣātkriyamāṇatvāt|
analyzed: na ca nirvāpita āropita sthale spaṣṭatara bheda pratyakṣa bādhitam tat iti antatra api dīrghā iyam na hrasvā iti bheda pratyakṣam eva tad bādhakam iti vācyam nirvāpita āropita atirikta sthale tāvat ayam vicāraḥ tatra ca dīrghā iyam na hrasvā iti bheda pratyakṣam vaktum aśakyam yā eva hrasvā sā eva idānīm dīrghā iti hrasva tva dīrgha tvābhyām upasthitayoḥ abhedasya sākṣātkriyamāṇa tvāt

original: tathā ca jvālāpratyabhijñā yuktibādhyaiva| sarvadā pittadūṣitanetrasya `ṣītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ' it pratyakṣe candraprādeśatvapratyakṣe ca parokṣātiriktasya bādhakasya śaṅkitumapyaśakyatvād yuktyādibādhyataiva vaktavyā|
analyzed: tathā ca jvālā pratyabhijñā yukti bādhyā eva sarvadā pitta dūṣita netrasya ṣītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pratyakṣe candra prādeśa tva pratyakṣe ca parokṣa atiriktasya bādhakasya śaṅkitum api aśakya tvāt yukti ādi bādhya tā eva vaktavyā

original: nanu sarvatraivātra prakārāntareṇāsātkalpe pratyakṣe mānāntarapravṛttiḥ| tathā hi -- dvividhaṃ jñānam| dvikoṭikamekakoṭikaṃ ca| antyamapi dvividhaṃ aprāmāṇyaśaṅkākalaṅkitaṃ tadakalaṅkitaṃ ca| tatrādyau sarvapramāṇāvakāśadau| arthāparicchedakatvādaprāmāṇya śaṅkākalaṅkitatvācca| aprāmāṇyadhīkalaṅkitatvaṃ ca dvedhā bhavati|
analyzed: nanu sarvatra eva atra prakāra antareṇa āsāt kalpe pratyakṣe māna antara pravṛttiḥ tathā hi dvividham jñānam dvi koṭikam eka koṭikam ca antyam api dvividham aprāmāṇya śaṅkā kalaṅkitam tad akalaṅkitam ca tatra ādyau sarva pramāṇa avakāśa dau artha aparicchedaka tvāt aprāmāṇya śaṅkā kalaṅkita tvāt ca aprāmāṇya dhī kalaṅkita tvam ca dvedhā bhavati

original: duṣṭakaraṇakatva niścayādarthābhāvaniścayācca| tathā śailāgrasthitaviṭapināṃ prādeśikatvapratītirdūradoṣanibandhanā dṛṣṭeti dūratasthasya candramasaḥ prādeśikatvapratyayo doṣanibandhana eveti nirṇīyate| evamākāśe samīpe nīrupatvaniścayād dūre rūpavattvadhīrdūradoṣajanyeti prāgeva niściyate|
analyzed: duṣṭa karaṇaka tva niścayāt artha abhāva niścayāt ca tathā śaila agra sthita viṭapinām prādeśika tva pratītiḥ dūra doṣa nibandhanā dṛṣṭā iti dūratasthasya candramasaḥ prādeśika tva pratyayaḥ doṣa nibandhanaḥ eva iti nirṇīyate evam ākāśe samīpe nīrupa tva niścayāt dūre rūpavat tva dhīḥ dūra doṣa janyā iti prāk eva niściyate

original: `pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ' ityādi pratyakṣaṃ tu prāthamikaparīkṣitapratyakṣeṇa `śaṅkho na pītaḥ' ityarthābhāva niścayādaprāmāṇyajñānāskanditamevotpadyate| evaṃ savitṛsuṣirādipratyakṣamapi |
analyzed: pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ ityādi pratyakṣam tu prāthamika parīkṣita pratyakṣeṇa śaṅkhaḥ na pītaḥ iti artha abhāva niścayāt aprāmāṇya jñāna āskanditam eva utpadyate evam savitṛ suṣira ādi pratyakṣam api

original: tathā ca candrādiprādeśikatvapratyakṣaṃ dūrādidoṣaniścayāt, `pītaḥ saṅkhaḥ' ityadipratyakṣaṃ prāthamikārthābhāvaniścayādeva bādhitamiti paścādanumānāgamādiprasara iti na tābhyāṃ tadvādhaḥ| yena hi yasya bhramatvaṃ jñāyateḥ, tattasya bādhakamityucyate| na ca candraprādeśikatvādipratyakṣasyāgamādinā bhramatvaṃ jñāyate|
analyzed: tathā ca candra ādi prādeśika tva pratyakṣam dūra ādi doṣa niścayāt pītaḥ saṅkhaḥ iti ādi pratyakṣam prāthamika artha abhāva niścayāt eva bādhitam iti paścāt anumāna āgama ādi prasaraḥ iti na tābhyām tad vādhaḥ yena hi yasya bhrama tvam jñāyateḥ tat tasya bādhakam iti ucyate na ca candra prādeśika tva ādi pratyakṣasya āgama ādinā bhrama tvam jñāyate

original: bhramatvajñānottarakālameva tatpravṛtteḥ| apramāṇyajñānākalaṅkitaṃ tu svārthaparicchedakaṃ niḥśaṅkapravṛttijananayogyam| yathā `vahniruṣṇa eva',`prastaro yajamānabhinna eva', `ghaṭaḥ sanneva ityādi tannānyasyāvakāśadaṃ nānyena bādhyam| na hyatra prāgeva dūrādidoṣadhīrvā arthābhāvaniścayo vā koṭyantarālambitvaṃ vā'sti|
analyzed: bhrama tva jñāna uttara kālam eva tad pravṛtteḥ apramāṇya jñāna akalaṅkitam tu svārtha paricchedakam niḥśaṅka pravṛtti janana yogyam yathā vahniḥ uṣṇaḥ eva prastaraḥ yajamāna bhinnaḥ eva ghaṭaḥ san eva ityādi tat na anyasya avakāśa dam na anyena bādhyam na hi atra prāk eva dūra ādi doṣa dhīḥ vā artha abhāva niścayaḥ vā koṭi antara ālambi tvam vā asti

original: kiṃ ca kvacit pratyakṣaṃ pratyakṣāntaragauravādyuktibādhyaṃ bhavatu, kvacicca liṅgādikaṃ śrutigauravāt śrutyanusāriprakaraṇādibādhyaṃ bhavatu, rājāmātya iva rājagauraveṇa rājabhṛtyabādhyaḥ, tathāpi na yuktimātrasya prakaraṇamātrasya vā pratyakṣaliṅgādibādhakatvam| pratyakṣādyanusāritvasya sarvatrābhāvāt|
analyzed: kim ca kvacid pratyakṣam pratyakṣa antara gauravāt yukti bādhyam bhavatu kvacid ca liṅga ādikam śruti gauravāt śruti anusāri prakaraṇa ādi bādhyam bhavatu rāja amātyaḥ iva rāja gauraveṇa rāja bhṛtya bādhyaḥ tathā api na yukti mātrasya prakaraṇa mātrasya vā pratyakṣa liṅga ādi bādhaka tvam pratyakṣa ādi anusāri tvasya sarvatra abhāvāt

original: na hi pradhānabhūtācamanādipadārthaviṣayayā `ācāmedupavīti dakṣiṇācāraḥ' ityādismṛtyā padārthadharmabhūtakramādiviṣayā `vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti' iti śrutirvedakaraṇānantaraṃ kṣutanimittakācamanopanipāte bādhyata ityanyatrāpi tathā bhavitavyāmiti cet, maivam|yato yuktirevaiṣā|

original: parasparaviruddhayordvayostāttvikatvāyogād, vastuni ca vikalpāsambhavāt, tāttvika vyāvahārikaprāmāṇyabhedena ca vyavasthopapatteḥ, atatparatvenāvadhāritasya viśvasatyatvavākyasyai vānyathā vyākhyātumucitatvāt|
analyzed: paraspara viruddhayoḥ dvayoḥ tāttvika tva ayogāt vastuni ca vikalpa asambhavāt tāttvika vyāvahārika prāmāṇya bhedena ca vyavasthā upapatteḥ atatpara tvena avadhāritasya viśva satya tva vākyasyai vā anyathā vyākhyātum ucita tvāt

original: tathā hi -- caturdhā hi sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌ -- adhyāse `idaṃ rajata' mityādau, bādhāyāṃ `sthāṇuḥ pramāni' tyevamādau, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena `nīlamutpalamityādau' abhedena `tattvamasī'tyevamādau| atra ca bādhāyāmadhyāse vā sāmānādhikaraṇyopapatterna satyatvabodhakaśruteḥ ṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgopetādvaitaśrutibādhakatvam|
analyzed: tathā hi caturdhā hi sāmānādhikaraṇyam adhyāse idam rajatam mityādau bādhāyām sthāṇuḥ pramāni tyevamādau viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvena nīlam utpalam ityādau abhedena tat tvam asi iti evamādau atra ca bādhāyām adhyāse vā sāmānādhikaraṇya upapatteḥ na satya tva bodhaka śruteḥ ṣaḍvidha tātparya liṅga upeta advaita śruti bādhaka tvam

original: nanu ātmana ānandatvabodhikā śrutirapi `sukhaṃ supto'smī' ti sākṣipratyakṣasiddhānandānuvādinā sattvaśrutivadbhavet iti cenna, sākṣiṇa upahitānandaviṣayatvena śruteśca nirupādhikānandaviṣayatvena bhinnaviṣayatvādanuvādatvāyogāt| tadā hi svarūpānando gṛhyate| svarūpaṃ cājñānopahitameva sākṣiviṣayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ātmanaḥ ānanda tva bodhikā śrutiḥ api sukham suptaḥ asmi iti sākṣi pratyakṣa siddha ānanda anuvādinā sattva śruti vat bhavet iti ced na sākṣiṇaḥ upahita ānanda viṣaya tvena śruteḥ ca nirupādhika ānanda viṣaya tvena bhinna viṣayatvāt anuvāda tva ayogāt tadā hi svarūpa ānandaḥ gṛhyate sva rūpam ca ajñāna upahitam eva sākṣi viṣayaḥ

original: nanu -- `tattvamasī' tyādau navakṛtvo'bhyāsavat, pipāsitasya jalagocarapramāṇasamplavavat, aikye ṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgavat, bhāvarūpājñāne pratyakṣasiddhe `tamaāsī' dityādiśrutivat, sattvaśrutirdārḍhyārthā -- iti cenna| aśeṣaviśeṣagrāhipratyakṣaprāpte dārḍhyārthamanyānapekṣaṇāt|
analyzed: nanu tat tvam asi tyādau nava kṛtvas bhyāsa vat pipāsitasya jala gocara pramāṇa samplava vat aikye ṣaḍvidha tātparya liṅga vat bhāva rūpa ajñāne pratyakṣa siddhe tamaḥ asī dityādi śruti vat sattva śrutiḥ dārḍhya arthā iti ced na aśeṣa viśeṣa grāhi pratyakṣa prāpte dārḍhya artham anya anapekṣaṇāt

original: pipāsitasya śabdaliṅganantaraṃ jale pratyakṣamapekṣitam, na tu pratyakṣānantaraṃ śabdaliṅgeḥ na ca tarhi `tama āsī' dityādeḥ na kiñcidavediṣamiti pratyakṣasiddhājñānadārḍhyārthatvaṃ na syāditi -- vācyam, `tama āsī' dityasya sṛṣṭipūrvakālasambandhitvenājñānagrāhitayā suṣuptikālasambandhitvenājñānagrāhakaṃ pratyakṣamapekṣya bhinnaviṣayatvenaiva
analyzed: pipāsitasya śabda liṅga nantaram jale pratyakṣam apekṣitam na tu pratyakṣa anantaram śabda liṅgeḥ na ca tarhi tamaḥ āsīt ityādeḥ na kiñcid avediṣam iti pratyakṣa siddha ajñāna dārḍhya arthatvam na syāt iti vācyam tamaḥ āsīt ityasya sṛṣṭi pūrva kāla sambandhi tvena ajñāna grāhitayā suṣupti kāla sambandhi tvena ajñāna grāhakam pratyakṣam apekṣya bhinna viṣaya tvena eva

original: prāmāṇyasambhavāt|
analyzed: prāmāṇya sambhavāt

original: nanu -- `ṣaḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkraya' iti mantrasyāśvamedhe codakaprāptasya `catustriṃśadvājino devabandho' riti vaiśeṣikamantreṇāpoditasya ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāditi vacanavat pratyakṣaprāptajagatsattvasya mithyātvaśrutyāpātato'poditasya pratiprasavārthaṃ sattvaśrutiḥ iti cenna, mithyātvaśruteḥ pratyakṣabādhakatvābhyupagame tasyāḥ balavattvena
analyzed: nanu ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ asya vaṅkrayaḥ iti mantrasya aśvamedhe ca udaka prāptasya catustriṃśat vājinaḥ deva bandhoḥ iti vaiśeṣika mantreṇa apoditasya ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ iti eva brūyāt iti vacana vat pratyakṣa prāpta jagat sattvasya mithyātva śruti āpātatā upoditasya pratiprasava artham sattva śrutiḥ iti ced na mithyātva śruteḥ pratyakṣa bādhaka tva abhyupagame tasyāḥ balavat tvena

original: tadvirodhāt satyatvaśruteranyaparatvād devatādhikaraṇanyāyāsambhavācca pratiprasavārthatvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt|
analyzed: tad virodhāt satyatva śruteḥ anya paratvāt devatā adhikaraṇa nyāya asambhavāt ca pratiprasava arthatvasya vaktum aśakya tvāt

original: nanu sattvapratyakṣaprāmāṇye tenaiva mithyātvaśrutyanumānādibādhaḥ, tadaprāmāṇye na tena sattvaśruteranuvādakatvam -- iti cenna, pratyakṣāprāmāṇye'pi tatsiddhabodhakasyānuvādakatvasambhavāt| na hi pramitapramāpakatvamanuvādakatvam,kintu paścādvādakatvamātram| paścātvaṃ ca pramāṇāvadhikamapramāṇāvadhikaṃ ceti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sattva pratyakṣa prāmāṇye tena eva mithyātva śruti anumāna ādi bādhaḥ tad aprāmāṇye na tena sattva śruteḥ anuvādaka tvam iti ced na pratyakṣa aprāmāṇye api tad siddha bodhakasya anuvādaka tva sambhavāt na hi pramita pramāpaka tvam anuvādaka tvam kintu paścādvādaka tva mātram paścātvam ca pramāṇa avadhikam apramāṇa avadhikam ca iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ

original: na ca śruteḥ sarvasiddhapramāṇabhāvāyāḥ sadarthatvāyānanuvādakatvāya ca pratyakṣāprāptatāttvikasattvaviṣayatvamavaśyaṃ vaktavyam| tathā cāpramāṇena pratyakṣeṇa kathaṃ śruteranuvādakatvamiti -- vācyam;
analyzed: na ca śruteḥ sarva siddha pramāṇa bhāvāyāḥ sat artha tvāya ananuvādaka tvāya ca pratyakṣa aprāpta tāttvika sattva viṣayatvam avaśyam vaktavyam tathā ca apramāṇena pratyakṣeṇa katham śruteḥ anuvādaka tvam iti vācyam

original: sattvāṃśasya pratyakṣasiddhatve'pi vākyārthasya kriyādisamabhivyāhārasiddhasyāpūrvatvena tadviṣayatayaivānuvādakatvopapattāvadvaita śrutiviruddhatāttvikasattvakalpanāyāstadarthamayogāt| paramārthasadviṣayatā tu sarvaśrutīnāṃ śuddhabrahmatātparyakatvenaiva,avāntaratātparyamādāya vyāvahārikasadviṣayateti karmakāṇḍaprāmāṇyopa pādane vakṣyate|
analyzed: sattva aṃśasya pratyakṣa siddha tve pi vākya arthasya kriyā ādi samabhivyāhāra siddhasya apūrva tvena tad viṣayatayā eva anuvādaka tva upapattau advaita śruti viruddha tāttvika sattva kalpanāyāḥ tad artham ayogāt paramārtha sat viṣayatā tu sarva śrutīnām śuddhabrahma tātparyaka tvena eva avāntara tātparyam ādāya vyāvahārika sat viṣayatā iti karmakāṇḍa prāmāṇya upa pādane vakṣyate

original: na ca pratyakṣaṃ svaprāmāṇyanirṇanārthaṃ śrutisaṃvādamapekṣata iti na tena śruteranuvādakatvam| anyathā `satyaṃ jñānam' `neha nāne' tyādiśrutirapyanuvādinī syāt, brahmasattvasya lokato bhramādhiṣṭānatvena liṅgena ca mithyātvasya dṛśyatvādyanumānenā vedamūlapravāhānādivijñānavādādinā ca prāpteriti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca pratyakṣam sva prāmāṇya nirṇana artham śruti saṃvādam apekṣate iti na tena śruteḥ anuvādaka tvam anyathā satyam jñānam na iha nānā tyādi śrutiḥ api anuvādinī syāt brahma sattvasya lokataḥ bhrama adhiṣṭāna tvena liṅgena ca mithyātvasya dṛśya tva ādi anumānena ā veda mūla pravāha anādi vijñāna vāda ādinā ca prāpteḥ iti vācyam

original: yadi hi dṛṣṭe'pyarthe pratyakṣaṃ svaprāmāṇyanirṇayāya śrutisaṃvādamapekṣeta tadā śrutisaṃvādavirahiṇi dṛṣṭe kutrāpi niśśaṅkapravṛttiḥ na syāt| na syāccaiva `magnirhimasya bheṣajamityādyapi anuvādakam| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, mānāntaragṛhītapramāṇabhāvapratyakṣanirṇīte mānāntarasyānanuvādakatve jagatyanuvādakatvakathoccheda prasaṅgāt|
analyzed: yadi hi dṛṣṭe api arthe pratyakṣam sva prāmāṇya nirṇayāya śruti saṃvādam apekṣeta tadā śruti saṃvāda virahiṇi dṛṣṭe kutra api niśśaṅka pravṛttiḥ na syāt na syāt ca eva magniḥ himasya bheṣajam ityādi api anuvādakam na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ māna antara gṛhīta pramāṇa bhāva pratyakṣa nirṇīte māna antarasya ananuvādaka tve jagati anuvādaka tva kathā uccheda prasaṅgāt

original: na ca `satyaṃ jñānam' `neha nāne' tyāderapyanuvādakatāpattiḥ| anuvādakatā hi na tāvat pratyakṣeṇa| brahmatvasāmānādhikaraṇye sattvādikaṃ hyanena pratipādanīyam| prāgeva nirākṛtatvāt| nāpi pravāhānādivijñānavādimatena| tasyāpauruṣeyaśrutyavadhika pūrvatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca satyam jñānam na iha nānā tyādeḥ api anuvādaka tā āpattiḥ anuvādaka tā hi na tāvat pratyakṣeṇa brahmatva sāmānādhikaraṇye sattva ādikam hi anena pratipādanīyam prāk eva nirākṛta tvāt nā api pravāha anādi vijñāna vādi matena tasya apauruṣeya śruti avadhika pūrva tva abhāvāt

original: na ca -- sattvaśruteḥ sattvapratyakṣānapekṣatvāt na sāpekṣānuvādakatvam| nirapekṣānuvādakatvaṃ tu dhārāvahanavannāprāmāṇyahetuḥ, uktaṃ hi nayaviveke -- `sāpekṣānuvāde hi na pramitiḥ, na tu daivādanuvāde, dhārāvahanavaditi ' iti -- vācyam| yato lāghavādanuvādakatvamevāprāmāṇye prayojakam| na tu sāpekṣānuvādakatvam|
analyzed: na ca sattva śruteḥ sattva pratyakṣa anapekṣa tvāt na sāpekṣa anuvādaka tvam nirapekṣa anuvādaka tvam tu dhārāvahana vat na aprāmāṇya hetuḥ uktam hi nayaviveke sāpekṣa anuvāde hi na pramitiḥ na tu daivāt anuvāde dhārāvahana vat iti iti vācyam yatas lāghavāt anuvādaka tvam eva aprāmāṇye prayojakam na tu sāpekṣa anuvādaka tvam

original: anadhigatārthabīdhakatvasya prāmāṇyaghaṭakatvasya tāvataiva gatārthatvāt| na ca tarhi dhārāvahanabuddhāvaprāmāṇyam, tasyaḥ vartamānārthagrāhakatvena tattatkṣaṇaviśiṣṭagrāhakatayā anuvādakatvābhāvāt| kiṃ ca śruteratatparatve prāptatvamātrameva prayojakam| anyathā vaiphalyena svādhyāyavidhigrahaṇānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: anadhigata artha bīdhaka tvasya prāmāṇya ghaṭaka tvasya tāvatā eva gatārtha tvāt na ca tarhi dhārā vahana buddhau aprāmāṇyam tasyāḥ vartamāna artha grāhaka tvena tad tad kṣaṇa viśiṣṭa grāhaka tayā anuvādaka tva abhāvāt kim ca śruteḥ atatpara tve prāptatva mātram eva prayojakam anyathā vaiphalyena svādhyāya vidhi grahaṇa anupapatteḥ

original: api ceyaṃ sattvaśrutirapi sattvapratyakṣasāpekṣatvāt sāpekṣānuvādinyeva| na hi sattvapratyakṣaṃ vinā tanmūlaśaktyādigrahamūlakaśabdapravṛttisambhavaḥ| ata eva "yatra tu pramāṇāntarasaṃvādastatra pramāṇāntarādivārthavādādapi so'rthaḥ prasidhyati, dvayoḥ parasparānapekṣayoḥ pratyakṣānumāna yorivaikārthe pravṛtteḥ, pramātrapekṣayā tvanuvādakatvam|
analyzed: api ca iyam sattva śrutiḥ api sattva pratyakṣa sāpekṣa tvāt sāpekṣa anuvādinī eva na hi sattva pratyakṣam vinā tad mūla śakti ādi graha mūlaka śabda pravṛtti sambhavaḥ atas eva yatra tu pramāṇa antara saṃvādaḥ tatra pramāṇa antarāt iva artha vādāt api saḥ ṛthaḥ prasidhyati dvayoḥ paraspara anapekṣayoḥ pratyakṣa anumāna yoḥ iva ekārthe pravṛtteḥ pramātṛ apekṣayā tu anuvādaka tvam

original: pramātā hyavyutpannaḥ prathamaṃ pratyakṣādibhyo yathā'rthamavagacchati, na tathā''mnāyataḥ, tatra vyutpattyapekṣatvāt" iti vācaspatyuktamapyetamarthaṃ saṃvadati| tenāmnāyasya vyutpatyapekṣatvena pratyakṣasāpekṣatvasyaivokteḥ| na ca vādivipratipattinirāsaprayojanavatvena na niṣprayojanānuvādakatvam|
analyzed: pramātā hi avyutpannaḥ prathamam pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ yathārtham avagacchati na tathā āmnāyataḥ tatra vyutpatti apekṣa tvāt iti vācaspati uktam api etam artham saṃvadati tena āmnāyasya vyutpati apekṣa tvena pratyakṣa sāpekṣa tvasya eva ukteḥ na ca vādi vipratipatti nirāsa prayojanavatvena na niṣprayojana anuvādaka tvam

original: saprayojanānuvādakatvaṃ tu na svārthaparatvavirodhi| vidvadvākye samudāyadvitvāpādanarūpaprayojanavattvenānuvādyasvārthaparatāyā dṛṣṭatvāt| ata eva tatra vākyaikavākyatoktā| anyathā arthavādavat padaikavākyataiva syāditi vācyam|
analyzed: sa prayojana anuvādaka tvam tu na svārtha paratva virodhi vidvat vākye samudāya dvi tva āpādana rūpa prayojanavat tvena anuvādya svārtha paratāyāḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt atas eva tatra vākya ekavākyatā uktā anyathā arthavāda vat pada ekavākyatā eva syāt iti vācyam

original: pratyakṣasiddhe vādivipratipattinirāsarūpaprayojanavattvena pramāṇāntarasya saprayojanatayā svārthaparatvoktau `agnirhimasya bheṣaja' mityādyapi tenaiva prayājanena saprayojanaṃ svārthaparaṃ ca syāt| tathā ca na pratyakṣasiddhe vādivipratipattinirāsārthamanyāpekṣā|
analyzed: pratyakṣa siddhe vādi vipratipatti nirāsa rūpa prayojanavat tvena pramāṇa antarasya sa prayojana tayā svārtha paratva uktau agniḥ himasya bheṣajam ityādi api tena eva prayājanena sa prayojanam svārtha param ca syāt tathā ca na pratyakṣa siddhe vādi vipratipatti nirāsa artham anya apekṣā

original: dṛṣṭānte tu samudāyānuvādena dvitvasampādanasyoddeśyasyānyato labdhumaśakyatayā tena prayojanena svārthaparatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| etadabhiprāyaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ nayavivekavākyam| na ca anuvādatve'pi naiṣphalyamātram, na tvaprāmāṇyam, yāthārthyameva prāmāṇyaṃ, na tvanadhigatārthatve sati yāthārthyamiti vācyam|
analyzed: dṛṣṭānte tu samudāya anuvādena dvi tva sampādanasya uddeśyasya anyatas labdhum aśakya tayā tena prayojanena svārtha paratvasya vaktum śakya tvāt etad abhiprāyam ca pūrvoktam nayaviveka vākyam na ca anuvāda tve pi naiṣphalya mātram na tu aprāmāṇyam yāthārthyam eva prāmāṇyam na tu anadhigata artha tve sati yāthārthyam iti vācyam

original: tātparyaviṣaye śabdaḥ pramāṇam `yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha' ityabhiyuktābhyupagamāt| anyathā svādhyāyavidhigrahaṇānupapatteruktatvācca| na hyanyataḥ siddhe'rthe śāstratātparyam, ato na tatra prāmāṇyam, yadāhurbhaṭṭācāryāḥ `aprāpte śāstramarthava ' diti|
analyzed: tātparya viṣaye śabdaḥ pramāṇam yad paraḥ śabdaḥ sa śabda arthaḥ iti abhiyukta abhyupagamāt anyathā svādhyāya vidhi grahaṇa anupapatteḥ ukta tvāt ca na hi anyatas siddhi ṛthe śāstra tātparyam atas na tatra prāmāṇyam yat āhuḥ bhaṭṭa ācāryāḥ aprāpte śāstram arthavat iti

original: nanu ayamanuvādo na `vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devate' tyādivat stutyarthaḥ| na vā
analyzed: nanu ayam anuvādaḥ na vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā iti ādi vat stuti arthaḥ na vā

original: `dadhnā juhotī' tyādivadanyavidhānārthaḥ| anuvādyatve'pi anyavidhānāya pramāṇānūditasya tāttvikatvaniyamāt| nahi `vrīhīn prokṣatī' tyādāvāropitavrīhyāderdhīḥ, anuvādyasyāsattve hyāśrayāsiddhau dharmadharmisaṃsargarūpānumitivedya ivānuvādyavidheyasaṃsargarūpavākyārtho bādhitaḥ syād iti cenna| asyānuvādasyāprāptānyaprāptyarthatvāt|

analyzed: nanu vyāvahārika tvam sādhakatāyām atantram ajñāna ādi sādhake paramārtha sati sākṣiṇi tad abhāvāt iti ced na brahma jñāna itara abādhyatvasya atyanta abādhye api sattvasya uktatvāt traividya vibhāge pāramārthika vyāvṛtta vyāvahārika tva niruktau api janakatāyām tad sādhāraṇye pi adoṣāt vastutas tu sākṣī api ajñāna upahitaḥ eva ajñāna ādi sādhakaḥ sa ca vyāvahārikaḥ eva

original: anupahitena paramārthasadākāreṇa tasyāsādhakatvāt| evaṃ ca vyāvahārikasattvameva sarvatra sādhakatāyāṃ prayojakamiti sthitam| yathā cājñānopahitasya sākṣitve'pi nātmāśrayādidoṣaḥ tathoktaṃ dṛśyatvahetūpapādane prāk| agre ca vakṣyate| yatra ca yatsādhakaṃ vyāvahārikam tatra tad vyāvahārikam|
analyzed: anupahitena paramārtha sat ākāreṇa tasya asādhaka tvāt evam ca vyāvahārika sattvam eva sarvatra sādhakatāyām prayojakam iti sthitam yathā ca ajñāna upahitasya sākṣi tve pi na ātma āśraya ādi doṣaḥ tathā uktam dṛśyatva hetu upapādane prāk agre ca vakṣyate yatra ca yad sādhakam vyāvahārikam tatra tat vyāvahārikam

original: yatra tu sādhakaṃ prātītikaṃ, tatra phalamapi tathaiva, na tu vyāvahārikamiti sarvavidhipratiṣedhādivyavahārāsaṅkaraḥ| ata eva lokasyāpi vyatikrame vicārasya yādṛcchikavāṅmātratāpattirityudayanoktamapi nirastam, vyāvahārikasattvena lokamaryādā natikramāt|
analyzed: yatra tu sādhakam prātītikam tatra phalam api tathā eva na tu vyāvahārikam iti sarva vidhi pratiṣedha ādi vyavahāra asaṅkaraḥ atas eva lokasya api vyatikrame vicārasya yādṛcchika vāc mātra tā āpattiḥ iti udayana uktam api nirastam vyāvahārika sattvena loka maryādāḥ natikramāt

original: bhaṭṭācāryavacanāni viruddhatvena bhāsamānāni sattvatraividhyanirūpaṇāyāmavirodhena vyākhyāsyante| tasmāt pakṣādisarvamithyātvasādhane'pi na vyāhatiḥ|| ityadvaitasiddhau asataḥ sādhakatvopapattiḥ|
analyzed: bhaṭṭa ācārya vacanāni viruddha tvena bhāsamānāni sattva traividhya nirūpaṇāyām avirodhena vyākhyāsyante tasmāt pakṣa ādi sarva mithyātva sādhane api na vyāhatiḥ iti advaita siddhau asataḥ sādhaka tva upapattiḥ

original: nanu sattvāpekṣayā tucchavilakṣaṇatvādergauravataratvena sādhakatve kathaṃ tantratvamiti cenna| trikālabādhaviraharūpasya sattvasya laghutvābhāvāt| jātyādirūpasya tasya mithyātvāvirodhitvād| ubhayasiddhe sadvivikte sādhakatvadarśanena pāramārthikasattvasya sādhakatvāprayojakatvācca| tathā hi -- pratibimbe bimbasādhakatvaṃ tāvadasti|
analyzed: nanu sattva apekṣayā tuccha vilakṣaṇa tva ādeḥ gauravatara tvena sādhaka tve katham tantra tvam iti ced na trikāla bādha viraha rūpasya sattvasya laghu tva abhāvāt jāti ādi rūpasya tasya mithyātva avirodhi tvāt ubhaya siddhe sat vivikte sādhaka tva darśanena pāramārthika sattvasya sādhaka tva aprayojaka tvāt ca tathā hi pratibimbe bimba sādhaka tvam tāvat asti

original: tasya bimbātmanā sattve'pi pratibimbākāreṇāsattvāt paramārthasattvaṃ na sādhakatve prayojakam| evaṃ svāpnārthasyāsato'pi bhāviśubhāśubhasūcakatvam| yadyapi tatratyadarśanasyaiva sūcakatvam| `puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇadantaṃ paśyati' ityādiśrutibalāt| tathāpi darśanamātrasyātiprasaktatvena viṣayo'pyavaśyamapekṣaṇīya eva|

original: evaṃ sphaṭikalauhityasya upādhisannidhānasādhakatvaṃ ca| na ca lauhityaṃ sphaṭike na mithyā, kintu dharmamātrapratibimba iti na pṛthagudāharaṇamiti vācyam| dharmibhūtamukhādinairapekṣyeṇa taddharmabhūtarūpādipratibimbādarśanāt| pratibimbasyā vyāpyavṛttitvaniyamena lauhityasya sphaṭike vyāpyavṛttitvapratītyayogācca|
analyzed: evam sphaṭika lauhityasya upādhi sannidhāna sādhaka tvam ca na ca lauhityam sphaṭike na mithyā kintu dharma mātra pratibimbaḥ iti na pṛthak udāharaṇam iti vācyam dharmi bhūta mukha ādi nairapekṣyeṇa tad dharma bhūta rūpa ādi pratibimba adarśanāt pratibimbasya vyāpya vṛtti tva niyamena lauhityasya sphaṭike vyāpya vṛtti tva pratīti ayogāt ca

original: lauhitye sphaṭikasya tvārope tasya pratibimbatvam, sphaṭike lauhityārope tu tasya mithyātvamiti vivekaḥ| "sphaṭikamaṇerivopadhānanimitto lohitimā" iti lohitimano mithyātvaṃ darśitaṃ pratibimbasatyatvavādibhiḥ pañcapādikākṛdbhiḥ| evaṃ rekhātādātmyenāropitānāṃ varṇānāmartha sādhakatvam| na ca -- rekhāsmāritā varṇā evārthasādhakā iti -- vācyam|
analyzed: lauhitye sphaṭikasya tu ārope tasya pratibimba tvam sphaṭike lauhitya ārope tu tasya mithyātvam iti vivekaḥ sphaṭika maṇeḥ iva upadhāna nimittaḥ lohitimāḥ iti lohitimanaḥ mithyātvam darśitam pratibimba satya tva vādibhiḥ pañcapādikā kṛdbhiḥ evam rekhā tādātmyena āropitānām varṇānām artha sādhaka tvam na ca rekhā smāritāḥ varṇāḥ eva artha sādhakāḥ iti vācyam

original: āśaiśavamayaṃ kakāro'yaṃ gakāra ityanubhavād, abhedenaiva smaraṇād| viveke satyapi dṛḍhatarasaṃskāravaśāt nāropanivṛttiḥ| ata eva kakāraṃ paṭhati likhati ceti sārvalaukiko vyavahāraḥ| varṇāropitadīrghahrasvatvādīdāṃ ca nago nāga ityādāvarthaviśeṣapratyāyakatvam|

analyzed: na ca varṇeṣu anāropita dhvani sāhityam tad abhivyakta tva rūpam vā dairdhyam pratyāyakam evam hrasva tva ādikam api iti vācyam dhvanīnām asphuraṇe api dīrghaḥ varṇaḥ ityādi pratyayāt

original: anābhāsatvagrahaśca tatra bahulordhvatādigrahaṇavadvyāptigrahaṇārthamevāpekṣitaḥ| taduktaṃ vācaspatimiśraiḥ -- `yathā satyatvaviśeṣe'pi cakṣuṣā rūpameva jñāpyate na rasaḥ tathaivāsattvāviśeṣe'pi varṇadairghyādinā satyaṃ jñāpyate, na tu dhūmābāsādinā' iti|

original: dṛṣṭaṃ hi māyākalpitahastyādeḥ rajjusarpādeśca bhayādihetutvaṃ, savitṛsuṣirasya ca maraṇasūcakatvaṃ, śaṅkāviṣasya ca maraṇahetutvam| `nanu tatra śaṅkaiva bhayamutpādya dhātuvyākulatāmutpādayatīti saiva maraṇahetuḥ, na tu śaṅkitaṃ viṣamapi| evaṃ savitṛsuṣiramāyākalpitagajādīnāmapi jñānameva tattadarthakriyākāri, na tvartho'pi|

original: tathā ca sarvatrodāhṛtasthaleṣu jñānameva hetuḥ| tacca svarūpataḥ satyameva| anvayavyatirekāvapi jñānasyaiva kāraṇatāṃ grāhayataḥ| na hi sannihitaṃ sarpamajānāno bibheti| na ca arthānavacchinnasya jñānasya hetutve'tiprasaṅgādarthāvacchinnameva jñānaṃ hetuḥ|
