original: ata eva dharmyantarasambandhamanapekṣya vilakṣaṇamutyuktānumānaṃ bādhitaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ vyabhicāri ca| tathā hi -- ghaṭasaṃyogaḥ, paṭasaṃyogānna jātyā bhidyate, tadavṛttijātyanadhikaraṇatvāt, kintu ghaṭarūpopādhinaiveti dharmyantarasambandhamapekṣyaiva vilakṣaṇe ghaṭasaṃyogatvāvacchinne sādhyābhāvavati uktahetusattvād vyabhicāraḥ, aprayojakatvam|
analyzed: atas eva dharmi antara sambandham an apekṣya vilakṣaṇam uti ukta anumānam bādhitam draṣṭavyam vyabhicāri ca tathā hi ghaṭa saṃyogaḥ paṭa saṃyogāt na jātyā bhidyate tad avṛtti jāti anadhikaraṇa tvāt kintu ghaṭa rūpa upādhinā eva iti dharmi antara sambandham apekṣya eva vilakṣaṇe ghaṭa saṃyoga tva avacchinne sādhya abhāvavati ukta hetu sattvāt vyabhicāraḥ aprayojaka tvam

original: na ca upalakṣaṇībhūtacaitrasambandhenāpi kalamāṅkurādervyāvṛttatāpattiḥ, vipakṣabādhāyāmiṣṭāpatteḥ| na hi jātervyāvartakatve upādhiravyāvartako bhavati| evaṃ śiloddharaṇamāṣoddharaṇakṛtyoḥ parasparaṃ jātyā vyāvṛttāvapi viṣayarūpopādhinā'pi vyāvṛttiraviruddhā|
analyzed: na ca upalakṣaṇībhūta caitra sambandhena api kalama aṅkura ādeḥ vyāvṛtta tā āpattiḥ vipakṣa bādhāyām iṣṭa āpatteḥ na hi jāteḥ vyāvartaka tve upādhiḥ avyāvartakaḥ bhavati evam śilā uddharaṇa māṣa uddharaṇa kṛtyoḥ parasparam jātyāḥ vyāvṛttau api viṣaya rūpa upādhinā api vyāvṛttiḥ aviruddhā

original: śiloddharaṇo ca jātiviśeṣaviśiṣṭāyāḥ kṛterjanakatvena tadrahitāyā māṣoddharaṇakṛtestadaniṣpattiradoṣaḥ| vyāvṛtteranyato'pi siddhisambhave kāryakāraṇabhāvādinirvāhāya jātiviśeṣasyāpi kalpanāt| atītāsaddhiṣayakajñānavyavahārādau cātītāsatoreva vyāvartakatvam| na hi vyāvṛttidhījanakatvaṃ tat, yena sattvābhāve prāksattvaśarīratayā na syāt|
analyzed: ca jāti viśeṣa viśiṣṭāyāḥ kṛteḥ janaka tvena tad rahitāyāḥ māṣa uddharaṇa kṛteḥ tad aniṣpattiḥ adoṣaḥ vyāvṛtteḥ anyatas api siddhi sambhave kārya kāraṇa bhāva ādi nirvāhāya jāti viśeṣasya api kalpanāt atīta asat dhiṣayaka jñāna vyavahāra ādau ca atīta asatoḥ eva vyāvartaka tvam na hi vyāvṛtti dhī janaka tvam tat yena sattva abhāve prāk sattva śarīra tayā na syāt

original: kiṃ tu vyāvṛttidhījanaka dhīviṣayatvamityuktam| taccātītādau sulabhameva| ata evābhāvādinidarśanamapi nirastam| uktarūpavyāvartakatvasyātyantāsatyapi sambhavena kadācit sati sambhavasya kaimutikanyāyasiddha| nanu viṣayasya vyāvartakatve'pi sarvatra viśeṣaṇatvāsambhavād upalakṣaṇatvameva vācyam|
analyzed: kim tu vyāvṛtti dhī janaka dhī viṣayatvam iti uktam tat ca atīta ādau sulabham eva atas eva abhāva ādini darśanam api nirastam ukta rūpa vyāvartaka tvasya atyanta asati api sambhavena kadācid sati sambhavasya nanu viṣayasya vyāvartaka tve api sarvatra viśeṣaṇa tva asambhavāt upalakṣaṇa tvam eva vācyam

original: upalakṣaṇena copalakṣyagatasvasambandhavyatiriktaḥ kaściddharma evopasthāpyate, kākeneva gṛhasambandhinā tadgatasaṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ| tathā ca sa eva vyāvartaka iti viṣayasambandhamanapekṣya svagatenaiva dharmeṇa jñānasya vyāvṛttisiddhiriti cenna| viṣayasya viśeṣaṇatvavadupa lakṣaṇatvasyāpyanamyupagamāt|
analyzed: upalakṣaṇena ca upalakṣya gata sva sambandha vyatiriktaḥ kaścid dharmaḥ eva upasthāpyate kākena iva gṛha sambandhinā tad gata saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ tathā ca saḥ eva vyāvartakaḥ iti viṣaya sambandham an apekṣya svagatena eva dharmeṇa jñānasya vyāvṛtti siddhiḥ iti ced na viṣayasya viśeṣaṇa tva vat upa lakṣaṇa tvasya api anami upagamāt

original: yena hi svoparāgādviśeṣye vyāvṛttibuddhirjanyate tadviśeṣaṇaṃ vyāvṛttibuddhikāle viśeṣyoparañjakamityarthaḥ, yathā gotvādi| yena ca svoparāgamudāsīnaṃ kurvatā viśeṣyagatavyāvartakadharmopasthāpanena vyāvṛttibuddhirjanyate tadupalakṣaṇam, yathā kākādi| yattu -- viśeṣye noparañjakam, na vā dharmāntaropasthāpakam, atha ca vyāvartakaṃ tadupādhiḥ|
analyzed: yena hi sva uparāgāt viśeṣye vyāvṛtti buddhiḥ janyate tat viśeṣaṇam vyāvṛtti buddhi kāle viśeṣya uparañjakam iti arthaḥ yathā go tva ādi yena ca sva uparāgam udāsīnam kurvatā viśeṣya gata vyāvartaka dharma upasthāpanena vyāvṛtti buddhiḥ janyate tat upalakṣaṇam yathā kāka ādi yat tu viśeṣye na uparañjakam na vā dharma antara upasthāpakam atha ca vyāvartakam tat upādhiḥ

original: yathā paṅkajaśabdaprayoge padmatvam, yathā vodbhidādiśabdaprayoge yāgatvāvāntarajātiviśeṣaḥ| atra hi padmatvayāgatvāvāntaradharmau paṅkajanikartari phalodbhedanakartari ca na dharmāntaramupasthāpayataḥ, apratīteḥ| na vā svoparaktāṃ buddhiṃ janayataḥ,samudāye śaktyantarānabhyupagamād| atha ca kumudajyotiṣṭomādibhyo vyāvartakāvityupādhī eva|
analyzed: yathā paṅkaja śabda prayoge padma tvam yathā vā udbhida ādi śabda prayoge yāga tva avāntara jāti viśeṣaḥ atra hi padma tva yāga tva avāntara dharmau paṅkaja nikartari phala udbhedana kartari ca na dharma antaram upasthāpayataḥ apratīteḥ na vā sva uparaktām buddhim janayataḥ samudāye śakti antara anabhyupagamāt atha ca kumuda jyotiṣṭoma ādibhyaḥ vyāvartakau iti upādhī eva

original: idaṃ ca prābhākarāṇāṃ bhāṭṭānāṃ ca saṃmatamudāharaṇayugalam| tārkikāṇāṃ tvākāśaśabdaprayoge śabdāśrayatvamudāharaṇam| ata evāvidyādikaṃ sākṣitvādāvupādhiriti siddhānto vedāntinām| ato yatra viṣayasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na sambhavati, tatkālāsattvāt, tatropādhitvābhyumagamānnopalakṣaṇatvanibandhana doṣāvakāśaḥ|
analyzed: idam ca prābhākarāṇām bhāṭṭānām ca saṃmatam udāharaṇa yugalam tārkikāṇām tu ākāśa śabda prayoge śabda āśraya tvam udāharaṇam atas eva avidyā ādikam sākṣi tva ādau upādhiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ vedāntinām atas yatra viṣayasya viśeṣaṇa tvam na sambhavati tad kāla asattvāt tatra upādhi tva abhyumagamāt na upalakṣaṇa tva nibandhana doṣa avakāśaḥ

original: sandehe tu viśeṣaṇatvamevābhyarhi tatvādupeyate| tasmādviṣaya eva sarvatra jñāne vyāvartakaḥ| ekaviṣayakasmṛtyanubhavayoḥ parokṣāparokṣayośca viṣayamanapekṣya jātyā parasparavyāvṛttidarśanāt| sarvatra viṣayanirapekṣā jātireva vyāvartiketi na yuktam bhinnaviṣayake samānajātīye tadasambhavāt| na ca tatrāpi cātirasti kṣīrādimādhuryavaditi vācyam|
analyzed: sandehe tu viśeṣaṇa tvam eva abhyarhita tvāt upeyate tasmāt viṣayaḥ eva sarvatra jñāne vyāvartakaḥ eka viṣayaka smṛti anubhavayoḥ parokṣa aparokṣayoḥ ca viṣayam an apekṣya jātyā paraspara vyāvṛtti darśanāt sarvatra viṣaya nirapekṣā jātiḥ eva vyāvartikā iti na yuktam bhinna viṣayake samāna jātīye tad asambhavāt na ca tatra api cātiḥ asti kṣīra ādi mādhurya vat iti vācyam

original: cākṣuṣatvādinā saṅkarasyoktatvāt| na ca tava mate tattad‌vṛttestattadākāratvena caitanyasya tatpratibimbitatvena tadabhivyaktatvena vā mama tu tattajjñānasya tattadīyasvabhāvatvena tattadvyavahārajananaśaktatvena vā svata eva vailakṣaṇyamiti vācyam|
analyzed: cākṣuṣa tva ādinā saṅkarasya ukta tvāt na ca tava mate tad tad vṛtteḥ tad tad ākāra tvena caitanyasya tad pratibimbita tvena tad abhivyakta tvena vā mama tu tad tad jñānasya tad tadīya svabhāva tvena tad tad vyavahāra janana śakta tvena vā svatas eva vailakṣaṇyam iti vācyam

original: viṣayasyaivākārasamarpakatvena svabhāvavyavahārayoḥ paricāyakatvena ca tannairapekṣyeṇa vyāvartakatāyā vaktumaśakyatvād| asmābhiśca tucche janakatvasyānuktatvāt| viśeṣaṇatvopādhitvayoḥ sambhave ca nopalakṣaṇatvamityuktam|
analyzed: viṣayasya eva ākāra samarpaka tvena svabhāva vyavahārayoḥ paricāyaka tvena ca tad nairapekṣyeṇa vyāvartaka tāyāḥ vaktum aśakya tvāt asmābhiḥ ca tucche janaka tvasya anukta tvāt viśeṣaṇa tva upādhi tvayoḥ sambhave ca na upalakṣaṇa tvam iti uktam

original: na ca `kathamasataḥ sajjāyeta' iti śrutyā `nāsato'dṛṣṭatvāt' iti sūtreṇa `śaśaviṣāṇādibhyaḥ sadutpattyadarśanād' -- ityādibhāṣyeṇa ca virodhaḥ| teṣāṃ tucche janakatvaniṣedhaparatvād| asmābhiśca tucche janakatvasyānuktatvāt| tasmāt sadviviktatvaṃ sādhanamiti siddham|| ityadvaitasiddhau asataḥ sādhakatvābhāve bādhakam||
analyzed: na ca katham asataḥ sat jāyeta iti śrutyā na asataḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt iti sūtreṇa śaśaviṣāṇa ādibhyaḥ sat utpatti adarśanāt ityādi bhāṣyeṇa ca virodhaḥ teṣām tucche janakatva niṣedha paratvāt asmābhiḥ ca tucche janakatvasya anuktatvāt tasmāt sat vivikta tvam sādhanam iti siddham iti advaita siddhau asataḥ sādhakatva abhāve bādhakam

original: nanu mithyātvānumānamaprayojakam, satyatve'pi dṛśyatvopapatteriti cenna| dṛgdṛśyasambandhānupapatteḥ| na hi jñānaṃ jñeyāsambaddhameva prakāśakam, atiprasaṅgāt| nāpi sambaddham, ātmasvarūpasya tadaguṇasya vā jñānasya jñeyena saṃyogasamavāyayorabhāvāt| anyasya cānādhyāsikasya sambandhasyābhāvāt|naca viṣayaviṣayibhāvaḥ saḥ|
analyzed: nanu mithyātva anumānam aprayojakam satya tve api dṛśya tva upapatteḥ iti ced na dṛś dṛśya sambandha anupapatteḥ na hi jñānam jñeya asambaddham eva prakāśakam atiprasaṅgāt nā api sambaddham ātma svarūpasya tad aguṇasya vā jñānasya jñeyena saṃyoga samavāyayoḥ abhāvāt anyasya ca anādhyāsikasya sambandhasya abhāvāt na ca viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ saḥ

original: tasya viṣayatvaviṣayitvarūpasya ekaikamātraniṣṭhatvena dviṣṭhasambandhātmakatvāsambhavād| durnirūpatvācca| tathā hi viṣayatvaṃ kiṃ jñānajanyaphalādhāratvam ? kiṃ vā jñānajanyahānādibuddhigocaratvam ? uta jñānakarmatvam ? jñānākārārpakatvaṃ vā ?dṛśyamānatve sati tattvaṃ va ? jñānajanyavyavahārayogyatvaṃ vā ? yatsannikṛṣṭakaraṇena yajjñānamutpādyate
analyzed: tasya viṣaya tva viṣayi tva rūpasya ekaika mātra niṣṭhatvena dviṣṭha sambandha ātmaka tva asambhavāt durnirūpa tvāt ca tathā hi viṣaya tvam kim jñāna janya phala ādhāra tvam kim vā jñāna janya hāna ādi buddhi gocaratvam uta jñāna karma tvam jñāna ākāra arpaka tvam vā dṛśyamāna tve sati tattvam jñāna janya vyavahāra yogyatvam vā yat sat nikṛṣṭa karaṇena yat jñānam utpādyate

original: tattvaṃ vā ? yasyāṃ saṃvidi yo'rtho'vabhāsate sa tasyā viṣayaḥ, tathā ca saṃvidi bhāsamānatvamiti vā ? sambandhāntaramantarā jñānāvacchedakatvaṃ vā ? ādye phalaṃ na tāvat jñātatā, anaṅgīkārād, atītādāvabhāvācca| nāpi hānādiḥ| gaganādau tadabhāvāt| kaladhautamalāderapi tajjñānaviṣayatvaprasaṅgācca|
analyzed: tattvam vā yasyām saṃvidi yaḥ ṛthaḥ uvabhāsate sa tasyāḥ viṣayaḥ tathā ca saṃvidi bhāsamāna tvam iti vā sambandha antaram antarā jñāna avacchedaka tvam vā ādye phalam na tāvat jñātatā anaṅgīkārāt atīta ādau abhāvāt ca nā api hāna ādiḥ gagana ādau tad abhāvāt kaladhauta mala ādeḥ api tad jñāna viṣaya tva prasaṅgāt ca

original: nāpyabhijñābhilapane, tayorjñeyāvṛttitvāt|naca viṣayaviṣayibhāvena te tatra sya iti vācyam| tasyaiva vicāryamāṇatvāt| ata eva na dvitīyo'pi| na tṛtīyaḥ| īśvarajñānasyātītādijñānasya ca karmakārakājanyatvena nirviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt|nacaturthaḥ| jñānatadākārayorabhedena sarveṣāṃ jñānahetunāṃ viṣayatvāpātād| anumityādiviṣaye tadabhāvāpātācca|
analyzed: nā api abhijñā abhilapane tayoḥ jñeya āvṛtti tvāt na ca viṣaya viṣayi bhāvena te tatra syaḥ iti vācyam tasya eva vicāryamāṇa tvāt atas eva na dvitīyaḥ api na tṛtīyaḥ īśvara jñānasya atīta ādi jñānasya ca karma kāraka ajanya tvena nirviṣaya tva prasaṅgāt na caturthaḥ jñāna tad ākārayoḥ abhedena sarveṣām jñāna hetunām viṣaya tva āpātāt anumiti ādi viṣaye tad abhāva āpātāt ca

original: na pañcamaḥ| dṛśyamānatvasya viṣayatvaghaṭitatvenātmāśrayāt| na ṣaṣṭhaḥ| yogyātāyāṃ yogyatāntarābhāvāt|naca yogyatā yogyatāṃ vinaiva yogyā, yathā dṛśyatvaṃ dṛśyatvāntaraṃ vinaiva dṛśyamiti vācyam| avacchedakarūpāpiracaye yogyatāyā eva grahītumaśakyatvāt|naca jñānaviṣayatvaṃ tadavacchedakam, ātmāśrayāt| na saptamaḥ|
analyzed: na pañcamaḥ dṛśyamāna tvasya viṣayatva ghaṭita tvena ātma āśrayāt na ṣaṣṭhaḥ yogyātāyām yogyatā antara abhāvāt na ca yogyatā yogyatām vinā eva yogyā yathā dṛśya tvam dṛśya tva antaram vinā eva dṛśyam iti vācyam avacchedaka rūpa apiracaye yogyatāyāḥ eva grahītum aśakya tvāt na ca jñāna viṣaya tvam tad avacchedakam ātma āśrayāt na saptamaḥ

original: nityeśvarajñānasya nirviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt| nāṣṭamaḥ, saṃviditi na tāvadadhikaraṇasaptamī| jñānasya jñeyānadhikaraṇatvāt| nāpi viṣayasaptamī, tasyaiva nirūpyamāṇatvāt| saṃvido viṣayatvaṃ saṃvedyasya ca viṣayitvamiti vaiparītyāpātācca| nāpi sati saptamī| bhāsamānatvasya viṣayatāghaṭitatvenā'tmāśrayāt| nāpi navamaḥ|
analyzed: nitya īśvara jñānasya nirviṣaya tva prasaṅgāt na aṣṭamaḥ saṃvid iti na tāvat adhikaraṇa saptamī jñānasya jñeya anadhikaraṇa tvāt nā api viṣaya saptamī tasya eva nirūpyamāṇa tvāt saṃvidaḥ viṣaya tvam saṃvedyasya ca viṣayi tvam iti vaiparītya āpātāt ca nā api sati saptamī bhāsamāna tvasya viṣaya tā ghaṭita tvena ātma āśrayāt nā api navamaḥ

original: matsamavetaṃ rūpajñānamityatra rūpajñānasamavāyasya sambandhāntaraṃ vinaiva rūpajñānāvacchedakasya `idaṃ rūpam' iti jñāne'pi viṣayatvāpātāt| nanu jñānaviṣaya ityabhiyuktaprayoga eva jñānaviṣayayoḥ sambandhaḥ| yathā abhiyuktasya mantra iti prayogaviṣayatvameva mantralakṣaṇam|nacānyonyāśrayaḥ, pūrvapūrvaprayogamapekṣyottarottaraprayogāditi -- cenna|
analyzed: mad samavetam rūpa jñānam iti atra rūpa jñāna samavāyasya sambandha antaram vinā eva rūpa jñāna avacchedakasya idam rūpam iti jñāne api viṣaya tva āpātāt nanu jñāna viṣayaḥ iti abhiyukta prayogaḥ eva jñāna viṣayayoḥ sambandhaḥ yathā abhiyuktasya mantraḥ iti prayoga viṣaya tvam eva mantra lakṣaṇam na ca anyonya āśrayaḥ pūrva pūrva prayogam apekṣya uttara uttara prayogāt iti ced na

original: etāvatā hi jñeyatvamātraṃ sāmānyataḥ syāt, na tvetajjñānaviṣayatvam|nacāsmin sādau pūrvaprayogamapekṣya uttarottaraprayogo vaktuṃ śakyate| tasyānādimātraviśrāntatvāt| kiṃ ca prayogo'pi svaviṣaye sambandha ityātmāśrayo'pi |
analyzed: etāvatā hi jñeya tva mātram sāmānyataḥ syāt na tu etat jñāna viṣayatvam na ca asmin sa ādau pūrva prayogam apekṣya uttara uttara prayogaḥ vaktum śakyate tasya anādi mātra viśrānta tvāt kim ca prayogaḥ api sva viṣaye sambandhaḥ iti ātma āśrayaḥ api

original: nanu yajjñānaṃ yadabhilapanarūpavyavahārakāraṇaṃ sa tasya viṣayaḥ| karaṇapāṭavādyabhāvena vyavahārānudaye'pi sahakārivirahaprayuktakāryābhāvavattvarūpaṃ kāraṇatvamastyeva|naca nirvikalpakaviṣaye avyāptiḥ| tasyānaṅgīkārāt|naca yattadbhyāmananugamo doṣaḥ|
analyzed: nanu yat jñānam yat abhilapana rūpa vyavahāra kāraṇam sa tasya viṣayaḥ karaṇa pāṭava ādi abhāvena vyavahāra anudaye pi sahakāri viraha prayukta kārya abhāvavat tva rūpam kāraṇatvam asti eva na ca nirvikalpaka viṣaye avyāptiḥ tasya anaṅgīkārāt na ca yat tadbhyām ananugamaḥ doṣaḥ

original: kasya ko viṣaya iti ananugatasyaiva praśnaviṣayatvena tasyādoṣatvāt|naca ghaṭajñānānantaraṃ pramādādyatra paṭa iti vyavahārastatra ghaṭajñānasya paṭābhilapanarūpavyavahārajanakatvena paṭaviṣayatvāpattiḥ| samānaviṣayābhilāpaṃ pratyeva jñānasya janakatayā ghaṭajñānasya bhinnaviṣayatayā tatrājanakatvāditi cenna|
analyzed: kasya kaḥ viṣayaḥ iti ananugatasya eva praśna viṣaya tvena tasya adoṣa tvāt na ca ghaṭa jñāna anantaram pramādāt yatra paṭaḥ iti vyavahāraḥ tatra ghaṭa jñānasya paṭa abhilapana rūpa vyavahāra janaka tvena paṭa viṣaya tva āpattiḥ samāna viṣaya abhilāpam prati eva jñānasya janaka tayā ghaṭa jñānasya bhinna viṣaya tayā tatra ajanaka tvāt iti ced na

original: abhilapanarūpavyavahārajananayogyatvaṃ na prātisvikarūpeṇa nirṇeyam| avacchedakatvasya phalanirṇeyatvāt| pratisvaṃ ca phalādarśanād| ajanitaphale prātisvikayogyatāyāṃ mānābhāvāt, kintu tatra tatrānugatatattadvṛttiviṣayatvena, tathā ca ātmāśrayaḥ| ata eva jñānakarmatvaṃ viṣayatvam| karmatvaṃ ca na kārakaviśeṣaḥ, yenātītādau tadabhāvo bhavet|
analyzed: abhilapana rūpa vyavahāra janana yogya tvam na prātisvika rūpeṇa nirṇeyam avacchedaka tvasya phala nirṇeya tvāt pratisvam ca phala adarśanāt ajanita phale prātisvika yogyatāyām māna abhāvāt kintu tatra tatra anugata tad tad vṛtti viṣayatvena tathā ca ātmā āśrayaḥ atas eva jñāna karmatvam viṣaya tvam karmatvam ca na kāraka viśeṣaḥ yena atīta ādau tad abhāvaḥ bhavet

original: kintu kriyādhīnavyavahārayogyatvarūpātiśayavattvam| anyathā ghaṭaṃ karotītyādāvasiddhaṃ ghaṭādi na janakaṃ, siddhaṃ ca na kṛtikarmeti dvitīyāvibhaktiranarthikā syāditi nirastam| vyavahārayogyatvaṃ na vyavahārarūpaphalopahitatvam| kutracit pratiruddhe vyavahāre avyāpteḥ| nāpi tatsvarūpayogyatvam| viṣayatvādanyasya tasyāsambhavāditi pūrvoktadoṣāt|
analyzed: kintu kriyā adhīna vyavahāra yogya tva rūpa atiśayavat tvam anyathā ghaṭam karoti ityādau asiddham ghaṭa ādi na janakam siddham ca na kṛti karma iti dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ anarthikā syāt iti nirastam vyavahāra yogya tvam na vyavahāra rūpa phala upahita tvam kutracid pratiruddhe vyavahāre avyāpteḥ nā api tad svarūpa yogya tvam viṣaya tvāt anyasya tasya asambhavāt iti pūrva ukta doṣāt

original: naca avacchedakād bhinnaṃ sahakārivirahaprayuktakāryābhāvavattvaṃ taditi vācyam| anugatāvacchedakadharmaṃ vinā tasyāpi grahītumaśakyatvāt| ghaṭaṃ karotītyatra siddhasyaiva kapālādeḥ kṛtikarmatā| (vyāpāryatayā'siddhasyaiva kṛtikarmatāṅgīkārāt| ata eva niṣpādanāvācidhātusamabhivyāhṛtakarmapade śakyāvayave nirūḍhalakṣaṇāmāhurasatkāryavādinaḥ|
analyzed: naca avacchedakāt bhinnam sahakāri viraha prayukta kārya abhāvavat tvam tat iti vācyam anugata avacchedaka dharmam vinā tasya api grahītum aśakya tvāt ghaṭam karoti iti atra siddhasya eva kapāla ādeḥ kṛti karmatā vyāpārya tayā asiddhasya eva kṛti karmatā aṅgīkārāt atas eva niṣpādana avāci dhātu samabhivyāhṛta karma pade śakya avayave nirūḍha lakṣaṇām āhuḥ asatkārya vādinaḥ

original: satkāryavādināṃ tu pūrve sato'pyabhivyañjanīyatayā na kārakatvakṛtikarmatvayoranupapattiḥ| etena -- `yasyāṃ saṃvidi' ityādi pūrvokte'pi na doṣaḥ| saṃviditi sati saptamī| bhāsamānatvaṃ ca vyavahārayogyatvam| tacca sati kāraṇāntare vyavahārāvaśyambhāva ityetadapi nirastam|
analyzed: satkārya vādinām tu pūrve sataḥ api abhivyañjanīya tayā na kāraka tva kṛti karma tvayoḥ anupapattiḥ etena yasyām saṃvidi ityādi pūrva ukte api na doṣaḥ saṃvid iti sati saptamī bhāsamāna tvam ca vyavahāra yogya tvam tat ca sati kāraṇa antare vyavahāra avaśyambhāvaḥ iti etat api nirastam

original: nanu yaḥ sambandhāntaramanapekṣya yajjñānāvacchedako yajjñānānavacchinnasvabhāvaśca sa tasya viṣayaḥ| yadyapyātmā svaviṣayajñānasamavāyavān, tathāpi na tasya jñānāvacchede samavāyāpekṣā| jñānāsamavāyino'pi ghaṭādestadavacchedakatvadarśanāt|
analyzed: nanu yaḥ sambandha antaram an apekṣya yad jñāna avacchedakaḥ yad jñāna anavacchinna svabhāvaḥ ca sa tasya viṣayaḥ yadi api ātmā sva viṣaya jñāna samavāyavān tathā api na tasya jñāna avacchede samavāya apekṣā jñāna asamavāyinaḥ api ghaṭa ādeḥ tad avacchedaka tva darśanāt

original: yadyapi ca rūpajñānaṃ matsamavetaṃ, dhvastamiṣṭamityādau rūpajñānāviṣayā apyātmasamavāyecchādhvaṃsādayaḥ sambandhāntaramanapekṣya jñānāvacchedakāḥ, tathāpi samaveteṣyamāṇapratiyogyātmakarūpajñānāvacchinnasvabhāvā eva, sambandhecchādīnāṃ sambandhīṣyamāṇādyavacchinnasvabhāvatvāditi nātivyāptiḥ| jñānaviṣayastu na jñānāvacchinnasvabhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yadi api ca rūpa jñānam mad samavetam dhvastam iṣṭam ityādau rūpa jñāna aviṣayāḥ api ātma samavāya icchā dhvaṃsa ādayaḥ sambandha antaram an apekṣya jñāna avacchedakāḥ tathā api samaveta iṣyamāṇa pratiyogi ātmaka rūpa jñāna avacchinna svabhāvāḥ eva sambandha icchā ādīnām sambandhi iṣyamāṇa ādi avacchinna svabhāva tvāt iti na ativyāptiḥ jñāna viṣayaḥ tu na jñāna avacchinna svabhāvaḥ

original: jñānasya ghaṭādyavacchinnasvabhāvatvavad ghaṭāderjñānāvacchinna svabhāvatvādarśanāt| yadyapi svagrāhakajñānaviṣayībhūtaṃ jñānaviṣayakānumityanuvyavasāyādikaṃ (jñānaṃ)jñānāvacchinnasvabhāvam, tathāpi svayaṃ yajjñānaṃ prati viṣayastadavacchinnasvābhāvaṃ neti nāvyāptiriti cenna|
analyzed: jñānasya ghaṭa ādi avacchinna svabhāva tva vat ghaṭa ādeḥ jñāna avacchinna svabhāva tva adarśanāt yadi api sva grāhaka jñāna viṣayībhūtam jñāna viṣayaka anumiti anuvyavasāya ādikam jñānam jñāna avacchinna svabhāvam tathā api svayam yat jñānam prati viṣayaḥ tad avacchinna sva abhāvam na iti na avyāptiḥ iti ced na

original: matsamavetaṃ rūpajñānamityākārakajñānasyātma samavāyaviṣa katvābhāvaprasaṅgād| ātmasamavāyasya sambandhatvena sambandhibhūtasvajñānāvacchinnatvād| ghaṭasya jñānamiti pratītyā ghaṭāvacchinnasvabhāvatvaṃ yathā jñānasya tathā jñāto ghaṭa iti pratītyā ghaṭasyāpi jñānāvacchinnasvabhāvatvenāsambhavācca|
analyzed: mad samavetam rūpa jñānam iti ākāraka jñānasya ātma samavāya viṣa ka tva abhāva prasaṅgāt ātma samavāyasya sambandha tvena sambandhi bhūta sva jñāna avacchinna tvāt ghaṭasya jñānam iti pratītyā ghaṭa avacchinna svabhāva tvam yathā jñānasya tathā jñātaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pratītyā ghaṭasya api jñāna avacchinna svabhāva tvena asambhavāt ca

original: atha yajjñānaṃ yadīyasvabhāvaṃ sa tasya viṣayaḥ| matsamavetaṃ rūpajñānamityatra tu samavāya eva rūpajñānāvacchinnasvabhāvo na tu rūpajñānaṃ tadavacchinnasvabhāvam| idaṃ ca jñānasyaiva viṣayatvamuktam, na tvicchādisādhāraṇamiti nāvyāptiriti cenna| yadīyasvābhāvamiti taddhitasya yadviṣayakatvārthakatve ātmāśrayād|
analyzed: atha yat jñānam yadīya svabhāvam sa tasya viṣayaḥ mad samavetam rūpa jñānam iti atra tu samavāyaḥ eva rūpa jñāna avacchinna svabhāvaḥ na tu rūpa jñānam tad avacchinna svabhāvam idam ca jñānasya eva viṣaya tvam uktam na tu icchā ādi sādhāraṇam iti na avyāptiḥ iti ced na yadīya sva abhāvam iti taddhitasya yad viṣayaka tva arthaka tve ātma āśrayāt

original: arthāntarasya ca nirūpayitumaśakyatvād| rūpajñānābhāvābhāvasya rūpajñānarūpatvena rūpajñānasyāpyabhāvīyatayā tadviṣayatvāpatteḥ| nanu jñānajanakakaraṇasannikarṣāśrayatvaṃ tadviṣayatvam|naca rūpajñānakaraṇamanassannikarṣāśrayasyātmanastadviṣayatvāpattiḥ| karaṇapadenāsādhāraṇajñānakaraṇasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt|
analyzed: artha antarasya ca nirūpayitum aśakya tvāt rūpa jñāna abhāva abhāvasya rūpa jñāna rūpa tvena rūpa jñānasya api abhāvīyatayā tad viṣaya tva āpatteḥ nanu jñāna janaka karaṇa sannikarṣa āśraya tvam tad viṣaya tvam na ca rūpa jñāna karaṇa manaḥ sannikarṣa āśrayasya ātmanaḥ tad viṣaya tva āpattiḥ karaṇa padena asādhāraṇa jñāna karaṇasya eva vivakṣita tvāt

original: sannikarṣapadenāpyasādhāraṇajñānajanakasannikarṣasyaivoktatvāditi cenna| cakṣurmanassaṃyogasyāpi cākṣuṣajñānāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvena manaso'pi cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvāpatteḥ| parokṣaviṣaye avyāpteśca|naca tatra liṅgajñānaṃ karaṇam| tatra ca liṅginaḥ tadvyāptatvaṃ sambandho'stīti vācyam|
analyzed: sannikarṣa padena api asādhāraṇa jñāna janaka sannikarṣasya eva uktatvāt iti ced na cakṣuḥ manaḥ saṃyogasya api cākṣuṣa jñāna asādhāraṇa kāraṇa tvena manasaḥ api cākṣuṣa jñāna viṣaya tva āpatteḥ parokṣa viṣaye avyāpteḥ cana ca tatra liṅga jñānam karaṇam tatra ca liṅginaḥ tad vyāpta tvam sambandhaḥ usti iti vācyam

original: liṅgasyāpi svajñānasambandhitvenānumitiviṣayatvāpatteḥ|nacānumitau tadvyāptatārūpasambandha eva viṣayatāniyāmakaḥ| vyāpakatāvacchedakavyāpaka sambandhādīnāmaviṣayatvāpatteḥ|naca jñānakaraṇasannikarṣasamānādhikaraṇo jñānāvacchedakatva sākṣādvyāpyadharmo viṣayatvam, idaṃ ca nityaparokṣasādhāraṇamiti vācyam| vastutvādikameva viṣayatvamityāpatteḥ|
analyzed: liṅgasya api sva jñāna sambandhi tvena anumiti viṣayatva āpatteḥ naca anumitau tad vyāpta tā rūpa sambandhaḥ eva viṣayatā niyāmakaḥ vyāpaka tā avacchedaka vyāpaka sambandha ādīnām aviṣaya tva āpatteḥ naca jñāna karaṇa sannikarṣa samāna adhikaraṇaḥ jñāna avacchedaka tva sākṣāt vyāpya dharmaḥ viṣayatvam idam ca nitya parokṣa sādhāraṇam iti vācyam vastu tva ādikam eva viṣayatvam iti āpatteḥ

original: jñānāvacchedakatvasya eva viṣayatvamiti vācyam, asiddheḥ| tathā hi -- svarūpasambandha ityasya svarūpaṃ sambandha ityarthatve saṃyogādāvativyāptiḥ|naca tadubhayānyatvaṃ viśeṣaṇam| himavadvindhyayorapi svarūpasambandhāpatteḥ| sambandhāntaramantareṇa viśiṣṭapratītijananayogyatvaṃ svarūpasambandhaṃ iti cenna| ātmānaṃ jānāmītyatrāvyāpteḥ|
analyzed: jñāna avacchedaka tvasya eva viṣayatvam iti vācyam asiddheḥ tathā hi svarūpa sambandhaḥ iti asya sva rūpam sambandhaḥ iti artha tve saṃyoga ādau ativyāptiḥ na ca tad ubhaya anya tvam viśeṣaṇam himavat vindhyayoḥ api svarūpa sambandha āpatteḥ sambandha antaram antareṇa viśiṣṭa pratīti janana yogya tvam svarūpa sambandham iti ced na ātmānam jānāmi iti atra avyāpteḥ

original: tatra sambandhāntarasya samavāyasyaiva sattvād| atīndriyābhāvādāvavyāpteśca| nahi tasya viśiṣṭapratītijananayogyatve mānamasti| anyathā tena viśiṣṭapratyayajananāpatteḥ| kiṃ ca viśiṣṭapratītijananayogyatvaṃ dharmo vā sambandhaḥ ? tādṛśaṃ svarūpadvayameva vā ? ādye svarūpasya sambandhatvavyāghātaḥ|
analyzed: tatra sambandha antarasya samavāyasya eva sattvāt atīndriya abhāva ādau avyāpteḥ ca nahi tasya viśiṣṭa pratīti janana yogya tve mānam asti anyathā tena viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana āpatteḥ kim ca viśiṣṭa pratīti janana yogya tvam dharmaḥ vā sambandhaḥ tādṛśam svarūpa dvayam eva vā ādye sva rūpasya sambandha tva vyāghātaḥ

original: pratītighaṭitasyāsya cākṣuṣādijñānāgocaratvaprasaṅgaśca| na dvitīyaḥ, ananugamāt| kiṃ caivamabhāvabhramānupapattiḥ| tatrāpi viśiṣṭapratītisambhave svarūpasambandhasya sattvāt|naca pramātvaghaṭitaṃ tallakṣaṇam| vāstavasambandhasattve pramātvasyāpyāpādyatvāt| anyathā tatra tasyāpramātve sambandhābhāvaḥ, tasmiṃśca tasyāpramātvamityanyonyāśrayāt|
analyzed: pratīti ghaṭitasya asya cākṣuṣa ādi jñāna agocara tva prasaṅgaḥ ca na dvitīyaḥ ananugamāt kim ca evam abhāva bhrama anupapattiḥ tatra api viśiṣṭa pratīti sambhave svarūpa sambandhasya sattvāt na ca pramā tva ghaṭitam tat lakṣaṇam vāstava sambandha sattve pramā tvasya api āpādya tvāt anyathā tatra tasya apramā tve sambandha abhāvaḥ tasmin ca tasya apramā tvam iti anyonya āśrayāt

original: nanu sambandhāntaramantareṇa viśiṣṭapratītijananayogyatāvacchedakāvacchinnasvarūpasya sambandhatvaṃ saṃyogatvāvacchinnasya daṇḍītyādau sambandhatvavad, viśiṣṭabuddhiścāvacchedakā viṣayiṇyevāvacchedyaviṣayā|
analyzed: nanu sambandha antaram antareṇa viśiṣṭa pratīti janana yogyatā avacchedaka avacchinna svarūpasya sambandha tvam saṃyoga tva avacchinnasya daṇḍī ityādau sambandha tva vat viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ ca avacchedakā viṣayiṇī eva avacchedya viṣayā

original: ato na svarūpasambandhagocaraviśiṣṭabuddheścākṣuṣatvavirodhaḥ|naca tarhyabhāvapramābhramayoḥ svarūpadvayamātraviṣayatvāviśeṣāt pramābhramavyavasthānupapattiriti vācyam| ghaṭābhāvavati ghaṭābhāvajñānatvena tadbhinnajñānatvenaca vyavasthopapatteḥ|
analyzed: atas na sva rūpa sambandha gocara viśiṣṭa buddheḥ cākṣuṣa tva virodhaḥ na ca tarhi abhāva pramā bhramayoḥ sva rūpa dvaya mātra viṣaya tva aviśeṣāt pramā bhrama vyavasthā anupapattiḥ iti vācyam ghaṭa abhāvavati ghaṭa abhāva jñāna tvena tad bhinna jñāna tvena ca vyavasthā upapatteḥ

original: nanu atiriktāviṣayatve tasyaivānupapattiḥ na hi bhavadrītyā tasyobhayātmakatvena tadubhayasattvena vyadhikaraṇaprakāratva rūpabhramatvasyaivābhāve bhramatadanyatvābhyāṃ vyavasthā sambhavatīti cenna| ghaṭābhāvābhāvasya ghaṭatvena tadvati ghaṭābhāvajñānasya vyadhikaraṇaprakārakatvasambhavāt| kiṃ ca bhramasya vastugatyā yad ghaṭavat sa viṣayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu atirikta aviṣaya tve tasya eva anupapattiḥ na hi bhavat rītyā tasya ubhaya ātmaka tvena tad ubhaya sattvena vyadhikaraṇa prakāra tva rūpa bhrama tvasya eva abhāve bhrama tad anya tvābhyām vyavasthā sambhavati iti ced na ghaṭa abhāva abhāvasya ghaṭa tvena tadvati ghaṭa abhāva jñānasya vyadhikaraṇa prakāraka tva sambhavāt kim ca bhramasya vastugatyā yat ghaṭa vat sa viṣayaḥ

original: na tu pramāyā ityatiriktaviṣayatvamastyeva|nacātīndriyābhāve avyāptiḥ| atyantābhāve pratiyogideśānyadeśatvaṃ, prāgabhāvādau pratiyogideśatve sati pratiyogikālānyakālatvam, anyonyābhāve pratiyogitāvacchedakadeśānyadeśatvaṃ viśiṣṭapratyaya jananayogyatāvacchedakam| tadavacchinnatvaṃ ca viśiṣṭapratītyajanake'pyatīndriyābhāve sulabham|
analyzed: na tu pramāyāḥ iti atirikta viṣayatvam asti eva na ca atīndriya abhāve avyāptiḥ atyantābhāve pratiyogi deśa anya deśa tvam prāgabhāva ādau pratiyogi deśa tve sati pratiyogi kāla anya kāla tvam anyonya abhāve pratiyogitā avacchedaka deśa anya deśa tvam viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana yogyatā avacchedakam tad avacchinna tvam ca viśiṣṭa pratīti ajanake ipi atīndriya abhāve sulabham

original: na hyaraṇyastho daṇḍo na ghaṭanananayogyatāvacchedakāvacchinna iti cet, nityasyātīndriyasyākāśā tyantābhāvāderviśiṣṭapratītijananayogyatāvacchedakāvacchinnatve avaśyaṃ viśiṣṭapratyayajanakatva prasaṅgāt| nityasya svarūpayogyasya sahakārisamavadhānaniyamāt|

analyzed: śuddha caitanyasya āsaṃsāram āvṛta tvena jagat āndhya prasaṅgāt iti ced na mūlāvidyā nivṛtti abhāvena sarvatas āvaraṇa abhibhava abhāve api ghaṭa ādi avacchedena āndhya viraha upapatteḥ nanu tarhi idānīm api brahma sphuraṇe carama vṛtti vaiyarthyam adhika bhāne pi tasya sphuraṇāt

original: na hyakhaṇḍārthavedāntajanyāyāṃ vṛttau bhāvo abhāvo vā viśeṣaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ vā prakāraḥ prakāśata iti cenna| upādhyaviṣayakabrahmasphuraṇasya caramapravṛttiprayuktatvena tasyāḥ sāphalyāt| prakārāsphuraṇaṃ tu tasyāḥ bhūṣaṇameva| idānīntanasphuraṇasya saprakārakatvenopādhiviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: na hi akhaṇḍa artha vedānta janyāyām vṛttau bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā viśeṣaṇam upalakṣaṇam vā prakāraḥ prakāśate iti ced na upādhya viṣayaka brahma sphuraṇasya carama pravṛtti prayukta tvena tasyāḥ sāphalyāt prakāra asphuraṇam tu tasyāḥ bhūṣaṇam eva idānīntana sphuraṇasya sa prakāraka tvena upādhi viṣaya tvāt

original: `ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyam' ityādiśrutibalāt svasamānaviṣayajñānādeva cājñānanivṛtterakhaṇḍacinmātrajñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvāvadhāraṇāt| na ca antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnacaitanyasya jīvatve suṣuptidaśāyāṃ tadabhāvena kṛtahānyādyāpattiriti vācyam| tadā'pyasya kāraṇātmanā'vasthānāt| sthūlasūkṣmasādhāraṇasyāntaḥkaraṇasyopādhitvāt|
analyzed: ekadhā eva anudraṣṭavyam ityādi śruti balāt sva samāna viṣaya jñānāt eva ca ajñāna nivṛtteḥ akhaṇḍa cit mātra jñānasya eva mokṣa hetutva avadhāraṇāt na ca antaḥkaraṇa avacchinna caitanyasya jīva tve suṣupti daśāyām tad abhāvena kṛta hāni ādi āpattiḥ iti vācyam tadā api asya kāraṇa ātmanā avasthānāt sthūla sūkṣma sādhāraṇasya antaḥkaraṇasya upādhi tvāt

original: `tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāt' ityasmin sūtre cāyamarthaḥ spaṣṭataraḥ| na ca vṛttyuparaktatvaṃcaitanyasya na tatpratibimbitatvam| darpaṇe mukhasyevānud‌bhūtarūpe'ntaḥkaraṇe śabdānyapratibimbanopādhitāyā acākṣuṣacaitanyasya pratibimbanāyāścāyogāditi vācyam| ud‌bhūtarūpavattvaṃ na pratibimbanopādhitāprayojakam| asvacche'pi loṣṭādau pratibimbāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tad apīteḥ saṃsāra vyapadeśāt iti asmin sūtre ca ayam arthaḥ spaṣṭataraḥ na ca vṛtti uparakta tvam caitanyasya na tad pratibimbita tvam darpaṇe mukhasya iva anudbhūta rūpe ntaḥkaraṇe śabda anya pratibimbana upādhi tāyāḥ acākṣuṣa caitanyasya pratibimbanāyāḥ ca ayogāt iti vācyam udbhūta rūpavat tvam na pratibimbana upādhi tā prayojakam asvacche api loṣṭa ādau pratibimba āpatteḥ

original: kintu svacchatvam| tacca prakāśasvabhāvatvena manasastatpariṇāmabhūtāyā vṛtteścāstyeva, triguṇātmakasyāpyajñānasya svacchasattvātmakatāyā api sattvena tatrāpi pratibimbanopādhitāyāḥ sattvāt| nāpi cākṣuṣatvaṃ pratibimbitatvaprayojakam| acākṣuṣasyāpyākāśādeḥ pratibimbitatvadarśanāt|
analyzed: kintu svaccha tvam tat ca prakāśa svabhāva tvena manasaḥ tad pariṇāma bhūtāyāḥ vṛtteḥ ca asti eva triguṇa ātmakasya api ajñānasya svaccha sattva ātmaka tāyāḥ api sattvena tatra api pratibimbana upādhi tāyāḥ sattvāt nā api cākṣuṣa tvam pratibimbita tva prayojakam acākṣuṣasya api ākāśa ādeḥ pratibimbita tva darśanāt

original: nanu -- cākṣuṣavṛttyupārūḍhacitaḥ kathaṃ rūpamātraprakāśakatvam? na ca prabhāvanniyamaḥ, vaiṣamyāt| tathā hi -- prabhāyāṃ tamovirodhitvaṃ rūpaṃ pratīva gandhādīn pratyapi samam| na hi sā gandhadeśasthaṃ tamo na nivartayati| na ca ajñānavirodhitvalakṣaṇaṃ prakāśakatvaṃ rūpaṃ pratyeva, na tu rasādīn pratīti vācyam|
analyzed: nanu cākṣuṣa vṛtti upārūḍha citaḥ katham rūpa mātra prakāśakatvam na ca prabhā vat niyamaḥ vaiṣamyāt tathā hi prabhāyām tamaḥ virodhi tvam rūpam prati iva gandha ādīn prati api samam na hi sā gandha deśa stham tamaḥ na nivartayati na ca ajñāna virodhi tva lakṣaṇam prakāśakatvam rūpam prati eva na tu rasa ādīn prati iti vācyam

original: ajñānanivartakatvasya vṛttibhinne'naṅgīkārāt| prabhāyā rūpagrāhakacakṣuḥsahakāritvavat gandhādigrāhighrāṇādisahakāritvābhāve'pi cito grāhakāntarāsadṛkāritvena tadvatsahakārivilambena vilambasya vaktumaśakyatvāt|
analyzed: ajñāna nivartaka tvasya vṛtti bhinnena aṅgīkārāt prabhāyāḥ rūpa grāhaka cakṣuḥ sahakāri tva vat gandha ādi grāhi ghrāṇa ādi sahakāri tva abhāve pi citaḥ grāhaka antara asadṛkāri tvena tadvat sahakāri vilambena vilambasya vaktum aśakya tvāt

original: tathā ca citaḥ sarvagatatvena sarvasambandhādrūpādivad gurutvāderapyāśrayadvārā sākṣādvā sambandhitvāt prakāśāpattiḥ, vṛttyuparaktacitsambandhasyaiva prakāśakatvāt| `asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ' iti śrutistu (īśvarasya) tatkṛtalepābhāvaparā, na tu sambandhaniṣedhikā|
analyzed: tathā ca citaḥ sarvagata tvena sarva sambandhāt rūpa ādi vat guru tva ādeḥ api āśraya dvārā sākṣāt vā sambandhi tvāt prakāśa āpattiḥ vṛtti uparakta cit sambandhasya eva prakāśaka tvāt asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti śrutiḥ tu īśvarasya tad kṛta lepa abhāva parā na tu sambandha niṣedhikā

original: `sa yattatra yatkiñcitpaśyatyananvāgatastena bhavati' iti pūrvavākyāt, `yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān' ityādismṛteśceti cenna|
analyzed: sa yat tatra yat kiñcid paśyati an anvāgataḥ tena bhavati iti pūrva vākyāt yathā ākāśa sthitaḥ nityam vāyuḥ sarvatragaḥ mahān ityādi smṛteḥ ca iti ced na

original: prabhāyā rūparasādideśagatatamonāśakatvaṃ tatsambandhādyujyate, caitanyasya tu svabhāvato'sambaddhatvāt tadākāravṛttyā tadekasambandhasyopādānāt kathamanyāvabhāsakatvaprasaṅgaḥ? svabhāvato hyasaṅgatve `asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ' iti śrutiḥ pramāṇam| na caiṣā lepābhāvaparā| akartṛtvapratipādanāya sambandhābhāvaparatvāt| yathā caitattathā vyaktamākare|
analyzed: prabhāyāḥ rūpa rasa ādi deśa gata tamaḥ nāśaka tvam tad sambandhāt yujyate caitanyasya tu svabhāvataḥ usambaddha tvāt tad ākāra vṛttyā tad eka sambandhasya upādānāt katham anya avabhāsaka tva prasaṅgaḥ svabhāvataḥ hi asaṅga tve asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti śrutiḥ pramāṇam na ca eṣā lepa abhāva parā akartṛ tva pratipādanāya sambandha abhāva paratvāt yathā ca etat tathā vyaktam ākare

original: evaṃ smṛtirapyetat śrutyanurodhena neyā| ataḥ sarvaiḥ saha sambandhābhāvāt| na sarvāvabhāsaḥ, kiṃtu yadākārā vṛttistasyaiva| ata eva `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhrame idamākāravṛttyavacchinnacaitanyena rajatabhānānupapatteḥ rajatākārā'pyavidyāvṛttirabhyupeyate| svataścidvimbāgrāhake caitanyasya tadākāratvāyogāt|
analyzed: evam smṛtiḥ api etat śruti anurodhena neyā atas sarvaiḥ saha sambandha abhāvāt na sarva avabhāsaḥ kiṃtu yad ākārā vṛttiḥ tasya eva atas eva idam rajatam iti bhrame idam ākāra vṛtti avacchinna caitanyena rajata bhāna anupapatteḥ rajata ākārā api avidyā vṛttiḥ abhyupeyate svatas cit vimba agrāhake caitanyasya tad ākāra tva ayogāt

original: svataścidvimbagrāhake tvantaḥkaraṇavṛttyādau na vṛttyapekṣeti nānavasthā| na ca āśrayasambandhāviśeṣe'pi rūpākārā vṛttirna gandhādyākāreti kuta iti vācyam| yathā tava cākṣuṣajñāne āśrayasambandhāviśeṣe'pi na gandho viṣayaḥ| tathā'smākamapi cakṣurdvārakavṛttau na gandhādyākāratvam| indriyaviṣayasambandhānāṃ svabhāvasya niyāmakasya samānatvāt|
analyzed: svatas cit vimba grāhake tu antaḥkaraṇa vṛtti ādau na vṛtti apekṣā iti na anavasthā na ca āśraya sambandha aviśeṣe pi rūpa ākārā vṛttiḥ na gandha ādi ākārā iti kutas iti vācyam yathā tava cākṣuṣa jñāne āśraya sambandha aviśeṣe pi na gandhaḥ viṣayaḥ tathā asmākam api cakṣuḥ dvāraka vṛttau na gandha ādi ākāra tvam indriya viṣaya sambandhānām svabhāvasya niyāmakasya samāna tvāt

original: nanu ādhyāsikasambandho vṛtteḥ pūrvamapyastyeva| anyastūparāgo na dṛśyatve tantramiti kiṃ tadarthayā vṛttyeti cenna| jīvacaitanyasyādhiṣṭhānacaitanyasya vā'bhedābhivyaktyarthatvād vṛtteḥ| anyathā mayedaṃ viditamiti sambandhāvabhāso na syāt|
analyzed: nanu ādhyāsika sambandhaḥ vṛtteḥ pūrvam api asti eva anyaḥ tu uparāgaḥ na dṛśya tve tantram iti kim tad arthayā vṛttyā iti ced na jīva caitanyasya adhiṣṭhāna caitanyasya vā abheda abhivyakti arthatvāt vṛtteḥ anyathā mayā idam viditam iti sambandha avabhāsaḥ na syāt

original: nanu jīvacaitanyasyāsaṅgatve brahmacaitanyaṃ sutirāmasaṅgam| tathā ca māyopādhikaviṣayoparāgatvāt svataḥ sārvajñyaṃ na syāt| na ca brahma sarvopādānatvādupādhiṃ vinaiva svasvarūpavatsvābhinnaṃ jagadavabhāsayatīti vācyam| upādānatvaṃ na tāvadviśiṣṭaniṣṭhaṃ pariṇāmitvam| ādhyāsikasambandhasyātantratāpatteḥ| anādyavidyādikaṃ prati tadabhāvācca|
analyzed: nanu jīva caitanyasya asaṅga tve brahma caitanyam tathā ca māyā upādhika viṣaya uparāga tvāt svatas sārvajñyam na syāt na ca brahma sarva upādāna tvāt upādhim vinā eva sva svarūpavat sva abhinnam jagat avabhāsayati iti vācyam upādāna tvam na tāvat viśiṣṭa niṣṭham pariṇāmi tvam ādhyāsika sambandhasya atantra tā āpatteḥ anādyavidyā ādikam prati tad abhāvāt ca

original: nāpi śuddhaniṣṭhamadhiṣṭhānatvam| śuddhasya sarvajñatvasarvaśaktitvāderabhāvāditi cenna| brahmaṇo'saṅgatve'pi sarveṣāṃ tatrādhyāsena māyopādhiṃ vinaiva tasya sarvaprakāśakatayā sārvajñyopapatteḥ| na ca śuddhaniṣṭhamadhiṣṭhānatvaṃ nopādānatvam sārvajñyābhāvādityuktamiti vācyam| avidyākalpitānāṃ sarvajñatvādīnāṃ śuddhe sattvāt|
analyzed: nā api śuddha niṣṭham adhiṣṭhāna tvam śuddhasya sarvajñatva sarva śaktitva ādeḥ abhāvāt iti ced na brahmaṇaḥ sarva prakāśakatayā sārvajñya upapatteḥ na ca śuddha niṣṭham adhiṣṭhāna tvam na upādāna tvam sārvajñya abhāvāt iti uktam iti vācyam avidyā kalpitānām sarvajñatva ādīnām śuddhe sattvāt

original: anyathā teṣāṃ taṭasthalakṣaṇatvamapi na syāt| nanu āvaraṇābhibhavārthatvapakṣo na yuktaḥ| vivartādhiṣṭhānasya cinmātrasyājñānādisākṣitvena sadā prakāśanāt| anyasyājñānakalpitasyāvaraṇasyābhāvāditi cenna| ajñānādisākṣitvena svaprakāśe'pyaśanāyādyatītatvādinā prakāśābhāvādāvaraṇasyāvaśyatvāt|
analyzed: anyathā teṣām taṭastha lakṣaṇa tvam api na syāt nanu āvaraṇa abhibhava artha tva pakṣaḥ na yuktaḥ vivarta adhiṣṭhānasya cit mātrasya ajñāna ādi sākṣi tvena sadā prakāśanāt anyasya ajñāna kalpitasya āvaraṇasya abhāvāt iti ced na ajñāna ādi sākṣi tvena sva prakāśe pi aśanāya ādi atīta tva ādinā prakāśa abhāvāt āvaraṇasya avaśyatvāt

original: nanu ajñānasya nayanapaṭalavat puṅgatatve caitrasyājñānanāśe'pi maitrasya tadanāśād aprakāśo yuktaḥ| viṣayagatatve tu caitrārjitayā vṛttyā ajñāne dīpena tamasīva nāśite maitrasyāpi prakāśaḥ syāditi cenna| caitrāvaraṇaśakterevājñānagatāyāścaitrārjitavṛttyā nāśitatvena sa paśyati, na maitraḥ tatpratiyogikāvaraṇaśakteranāśād|
analyzed: nanu ajñānasya nayana paṭala vat caitrasya ajñāna nāśe pi maitrasya tad anāśāt aprakāśaḥ yuktaḥ viṣaya gata tve tu caitra arjitayā vṛttyā ajñāne dīpena tamasi iva nāśite maitrasya api prakāśaḥ syāt iti ced na caitra āvaraṇa śakteḥ eva ajñāna gatāyāḥ caitra arjita vṛttyā nāśita tvena sa paśyati na maitraḥ tad pratiyogika āvaraṇa śakteḥ anāśāt

original: āvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ draṣṭṛviṣayabhedābhyāṃ bhinnatvāt| tamastu na tathetyekānītapradīpenāpyanyāt prati prakāśo yujyate| etena -- ekājñānapakṣe śuktijñānena tadajñānanivṛttau sadya eva mokṣāpātaḥ| anivṛttau rūpyādeḥ savilāsāvidyānivṛttirūpabādhāyoga iti nirastam|
analyzed: āvaraṇa śaktīnām draṣṭṛ viṣaya bhedābhyām bhinna tvāt tamaḥ tu na tathā iti eka ānīta pradīpena api anyāt prati prakāśaḥ yujyate etena eka ajñāna pakṣe śukti jñānena tad ajñāna nivṛttau sadyas eva mokṣa āpātaḥ anivṛttau rūpya ādeḥ savilāsa avidyā nivṛtti rūpa bādhā yogaḥ iti nirastam

original: āvaraṇaśaktināśe'pi mūlājñānanāśābhāvena sadyo mokṣābhāvasya rūpyādau savilāsaśaktimadavidyānivṛttirūpabādhasya copapatteḥ|
analyzed: āvaraṇa śakti nāśe api mūla ajñāna nāśa abhāvena sadyas mokṣa abhāvasya rūpya ādau savilāsa śaktimat avidyā nivṛtti rūpa bādhasya ca upapatteḥ

original: nanu ekājñānapakṣe rūpyādeḥ śuktijñānena svakāraṇe pravilayamātraṃ kriyate| mud‌garaprahāreṇeva ghaṭasya| na tvajñānaṃ nivartyata iti te mataṃ na yuktam| yato jñānamajñānasyaiva nivartakamiti vyāptibalāt jñānasyājñānanivṛttidvāraivānyavirodhitvenājñānamanivartya rūpyādinivartakatvāyogāt|
analyzed: nanu eka ajñāna pakṣe rūpya ādeḥ śukti jñānena sva kāraṇe pravilaya mātram kriyate mudgara prahāreṇa iva ghaṭasya na tu ajñānam nivartyate iti te matam na yuktam yatas jñānam ajñānasya eva nivartakam iti vyāpti balāt jñānasya ajñāna nivṛtti dvārā eva anya virodhi tvena ajñānam a nivartya rūpya ādi nivartaka tva ayogāt

original: śuktijñānenājñānānivṛttāvabhivyaktacaitanyasambandhābhāvena bhrāntāviva bādhe'pi śukteraprakāśāpatteśceti cenna| yato jñānamajñānanivartakamiti vyāpterucchedaviṣayatvāt| svakāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthāne tadanaṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: śukti jñānena ajñāna anivṛttau abhivyakta caitanya sambandha abhāvena bhrāntau iva bādhaḥ api śukteḥ aprakāśa āpatteḥ ca iti ced na yatas jñānam ajñāna nivartakam iti vyāpteḥ uccheda viṣaya tvāt sva kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avasthāne tad anaṅgīkārāt

original: śuktijñānasya cānavacchinnacaitanyāvaraṇarūpamūlājñānānivartakatve'pi avacchinnacaitanyāvaraṇarūpatūlājñānanivartakatvenābhivyaktacaitanyasambandhāt bādhadaśāyāṃ rūpyanivṛttiśuktiprakāśayorapyupapatteḥ| na ca upādeyabhūtayā vṛttyopādānabhūtāvidyābhibhavo na ghaṭate| upādeyenopādānābhibhavādarśanāditi vācyam|
analyzed: śukti jñānasya ca anavacchinna caitanya āvaraṇa rūpa mūla ajñāna anivartaka tve pi avacchinna caitanya āvaraṇa rūpa tūla ajñāna nivartaka tvena abhivyakta caitanya sambandhāt bādha daśāyām rūpya nivṛtti śukti prakāśayoḥ api upapatteḥ na ca upādeya bhūtayā vṛttyā upādāna bhūta avidyā abhibhavaḥ na ghaṭate upādeyena upādāna abhibhava adarśanāt iti vācyam

original: vṛścikādinā gomayāderupādānasyāpyabhibhavadarśanāt| ārambhavādānabhyupagamācca na gomayāvayavānāmupādānatvaśaṅkā|
analyzed: vṛścika ādinā gomaya ādeḥ upādānasya api abhibhava darśanāt ārambha vāda anabhyupagamāt ca na gomaya avayavānām upādāna tva śaṅkā

original: nanu cakṣurādijanyaśuktyādivṛtteḥ saprakārikāyāḥ niṣprakārakaśuddhacaitanyāviṣayatayā tadāvaraṇarūpamūlājñānābhibhavābhāve'pyavacchinnaviṣayayā tayā avacchinnacaitanyāvaraṇarūpatūlājñānābhibhavo yujyata iti te matamayuktam| avacchinne avidyākalpite aprasaktaprakāśe mūlāvidyāyā iva tadāvaraṇaśakterayogāt| tvayānabhyupagatatvācca|
analyzed: nanu cakṣuḥ ādi janya śukti ādi vṛtteḥ saprakārikāyāḥ niṣprakāraka śuddha caitanya aviṣayatayā tad āvaraṇa rūpa mūla ajñāna abhibhava abhāve pi avacchinna viṣayayā tayā avacchinna caitanya āvaraṇa rūpa tūla ajñāna abhibhavaḥ yujyate iti te matam ayuktam avacchinne avidyā kalpite aprasakta prakāśe mūla avidyāyāḥ iva tad āvaraṇa śakteḥ ayogāt tvayā anabhyupagata tvāt ca

original: jaḍaviśiṣṭātmānaṃ prati tadabhyugame ca viśeṣaṇānāvarakaviśiṣṭāvarakaśaktyabhibhavasya viśeṣyāvarakaśaktyabhibhavaṃ vinā'yogena śuktyākāravṛttyaiva śuddhātmaprakāśāpātāditi cenna| anavabodhāt| na hyavidyākalpite'vacchinne asmābhiravidyā vā tacchaktirvābhyupeyate|
analyzed: jaḍa viśiṣṭa ātmānam prati tad abhyugame ca viśeṣaṇa anāvaraka viśiṣṭa āvaraka śakti abhibhavasya viśeṣya āvaraka śakti abhibhavam vinā ayogena śukti ākāra vṛttyā eva śuddha ātma prakāśa āpātāt iti ced na anavabodhāt na hi avidyā kalpitā iva chinne asmābhiḥ avidyā vā tad śaktiḥ vā abhyupeyate

original: kiṃ tu caitanyamātra na hyavidyākalpite'vacchinne asmābhiravidyā vā tatchaktirvābhyupeyate| kiṃ tu caitanyamātra eva| tasmiṃstu sarvaṃ jaḍamadhyastamastītyekāśrayāśritatvasambandhāt jaḍāvacchinnacaitanyamāvṛtamiti vyapadeśaḥ|
analyzed: kim tu caitanya mātra na hi avidyā kalpita iva chinne asmābhiḥ avidyā vā tad śaktiḥ vā abhyupeyate kim tu caitanya mātre eva tasmin tu sarvam jaḍam adhyastam asti iti ekāśraya āśrita tva sambandhāt jaḍa avacchinna caitanyam āvṛtam iti vyapadeśaḥ

original: ghaṭādyākāravṛttyā tu tadadhiṣṭhānacaitanyābhivyaktau tadavacchedenaiva tanniṣṭhāvaraṇābhibhavo jāyata iti na śuddhātmaprakāśāpattiḥ| taduktaṃ saṃkṣepaśārīrake --
analyzed: ghaṭa ādi ākāra vṛttyā tu tad adhiṣṭhāna caitanya abhivyaktau tad avacchedena eva tad niṣṭha āvaraṇa abhibhavaḥ jāyate iti na śuddha ātma prakāśa āpattiḥ tat uktam saṃkṣepaśārīrake

original: āśrayatvaviṣayatvabhāginī nirvibhāgacitireva kevalā|
analyzed: āśraya tva viṣaya tva bhāginī nirvibhāga citiḥ eva kevalā

original: pūrvasiddhatamaso hi paścimo nāśrayo bhavati nāpi gocaraḥ||
analyzed: pūrva siddha tamasaḥ hi paścimaḥ nā āśrayaḥ bhavati nā api gocaraḥ

original: bahu nigadya kimatra vadāmyahaṃ śṛṇuta saṅagrahamadvayaśāsane|
analyzed: bahu nigadya kim atra vadāmi aham śṛṇuta saṅagraham advaya śāsane

original: sakalavāṅmanasātigatā citiḥ sakalavāṅmanasavyavahārabhāk||

iti ca| tasmādavidyāyāṃ satyāmapi śaktyabhibhavādvā, tūlājñānanāśādvā, avasthāviśeṣapracyavādvā, ekadeśanāśādvā, bhīrubhaṭavadapasaraṇādvā, kaṭavat saṃveṣṭanādvā, āvaraṇabhaṅgānirmokṣabādhānāmupapattiḥ|
analyzed: iti ca tasmāt avidyāyām satyām api śakti abhibhavāt vā tūla ajñāna nāśāt vā avasthā viśeṣa pracyavāt vā eka deśa nāśāt vā bhīru bhaṭa vat apasaraṇāt vā kaṭa vat saṃveṣṭanāt vā āvaraṇa bhaṅga anirmokṣa bādhānām upapattiḥ

original: nanu avasthāviśeṣāṇāmajñānābhinnatve ekājñānapakṣakṣatiḥ| ajñānabhinnatve ca sākṣāt jñānena nivṛttiḥ bhramādyupādānatvaṃ ca na syāt| teṣāmiva rūpyasyaivopādānanāśaṃ vinā nāśaprasaṅgaśca| śuktyajñānaṃ naṣṭamityanubhavavirodhaśceti cenna| yato'vasthā tāvadavasthāvato'bhinnaiva| ajñānaikyaṃ tu sarvāvasthānusyūtaikākāramādāya|
analyzed: nanu avasthā viśeṣāṇām ajñāna abhinna tve eka ajñāna pakṣa kṣatiḥ ajñāna bhinna tve ca sākṣāt jñānena nivṛttiḥ bhrama ādi upādāna tvam ca na syāt teṣām iva rūpyasya eva upādāna nāśam vinā nāśa prasaṅgaḥ ca śukti ajñānam naṣṭam iti anubhava virodhaḥ ca iti ced na yatas vasthā tāvat avasthāvataḥ bhinnā eva ajñāna aikyam tu sarva avasthā anusyūta eka ākāram ādāya

original: evaṃ cājñānāvasthāyā ajñānatvena na jñānasākṣānnivartyatvādyanupapattiḥ| yattvavasthāviśeṣāṇāmiva rūpyasyaivopādānanivṛttiṃ vinā nivṛttyāpādanaṃ tadayuktam| ajñāna eva jñānasya sākṣādvirodhāvadhāraṇenājñānāvasthāyāstadabhinnāyā jñānasākṣānnivartyatvārhatvāt| na tu rūpyādīnām, anīdṛktvāt| anekājñānapakṣe tu śaṅkāpi nodeti|
analyzed: evam ca ajñāna avasthāyāḥ ajñāna tvena na jñāna sākṣāt nivartya tva ādi anupapattiḥ yat tu avasthā viśeṣāṇām iva rūpyasya eva upādāna nivṛttim vinā nivṛtti āpādanam tat ayuktam ajñāne eva jñānasya sākṣāt virodha avadhāraṇena ajñāna avasthāyāḥ tad abhinnāyāḥ jñāna sākṣāt nivartya tva arha tvāt na tu rūpya ādīnām anīdṛktvāt aneka ajñāna pakṣe tu śaṅkā api nā udeti

original: nanvasminpakṣe ekayā vṛttyā sarvatadajñānasya nivṛttiḥ? uta ekatadajñānasya? ādye punaḥ śukteḥ kadā'pyaprakāśo na syāt| antye vṛttikāle'pi prakāśo na syāt| ekasyāvaraṇasya nivṛttāvapyāvaraṇāntarānivṛtteriti cenna| ekayā vṛttyā ekājñānanāśe'pi tayaivāvaraṇāntarāṇāṃ pratiruddhatvād| yāvat sā tiṣṭhati tāvatprakāśaḥ|
analyzed: nanu asmin pakṣe ekayā vṛttyā sarva tad ajñānasya nivṛttiḥ uta eka tad ajñānasya ādye punar śukteḥ kadāpi aprakāśaḥ na syāt antye vṛtti kāle api prakāśaḥ na syāt ekasya āvaraṇasya nivṛttau api āvaraṇa antara anivṛtteḥ iti ced na ekayā vṛttyā eka ajñāna nāśe pi tayā eva āvaraṇa antarāṇām pratiruddha tvāt yāvat sā tiṣṭhati tāvat prakāśaḥ

original: tasyāmapagatāyāṃ punaraprakāśaścopapadyate| ajñānasya jñānaprāgabhāvasthānīyatvāt| yathā tava ekaṃ jñānamekameva prāgabhāvaṃ nāśayati, tannāśarūpeṇodayāt prāgabhāvāntaranibandhanamajñātatvādivyavahāraṃ ca pratibaghnāti tathā mamāpyekaṃ jñānamekamevājñānaṃ nivartayati, ajñānāntaranibandhanaṃ ca prayojanaṃ pratibaghnātī ti kimanupapannam? atra ca
analyzed: tasyām apagatāyām punar aprakāśaḥ ca upapadyate ajñānasya jñāna prāgabhāva sthānīya tvāt yathā tavaḥ ekam jñānam ekam eva prāgabhāvam nāśayati tad nāśa rūpeṇa udayāt prāgabhāva antara nibandhanam ajñāta tva ādi vyavahāram ca pratibaghnāti tathā mama api ekam jñānam ekam eva ajñānam nivartayati ajñāna antara nibandhanam ca prayojanam pratibaghnāti iti kim anupapannam atra ca

original: pratibandhapadena kāryānutpattiprayojakatvaṃ kāraṇābhāvapratibandhakasādhāraṇamabhihitam| evamavasthāviśeṣapakṣe'pi prakāśāprakāśāvupapādanīyau| evamamūrtasyājñānasya yadyapi daṇḍādinā gavādīnāmivāpasāraṇaṃ karādinā kaṭādīnāmiva saṃveṣṭanaṃ ca na sambhavati, tathāpi kāryākṣamatvasāmyenāpasāraṇasaṃveṣṭanapakṣau yojanīyau|
analyzed: pratibandha padena kārya anutpatti prayojaka tvam kāraṇa abhāva pratibandhaka sādhāraṇam abhihitam evam avasthā viśeṣa pakṣe api prakāśa aprakāśau upapādanīyau evam amūrtasya ajñānasya yadi api daṇḍa ādinā gavādīnām iva apasāraṇam kara ādinā kaṭa ādīnām iva saṃveṣṭanam ca na sambhavati tathā api kārya akṣama tva sāmyena apasāraṇa saṃveṣṭana pakṣau yojanīyau

original: yathā hi uttejakābhāvasahakṛtasya maṇeḥ pratibandhakatāyāmuttejakasattve pratibandhakakāryākṣamatvaṃ, tathā vṛttyabhāvasahakṛtasyājñānasya pratibandhakatāyāṃ vṛttau satyāṃ tatkāryānudaya iti draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: yathā hi uttejaka abhāva sahakṛtasya maṇeḥ pratibandhaka tāyām uttejaka sattve pratibandhaka kārya akṣamatvam tathā vṛtti abhāva sahakṛtasya ajñānasya pratibandhaka tāyām vṛttau satyām tad kārya anudayaḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: nanu caitanyasya niravayavatvāt tasyaikadeśena prakāśo na yujyate| athākāśa iva tattadarthāvacchinnatvamekadeśaśabdārthaḥ, tarhi nāgantukapadārthāvacchinnaṃ caitanyamanādyajñānasya viṣayaḥ| nirviṣayasyāvaraṇasyāyogāt| prāganavacchinnāvaraṇamevedānīmavacchinnāvaraṇaṃ jātamityapi na| avacchinnacaitanyajñānenaivānavacchinnāvaraṇanāśāpatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu caitanyasya niravayava tvāt tasya eka deśena prakāśaḥ na yujyate atha ākāśe iva tad tad artha avacchinna tvam eka deśa śabda arthaḥ tarhi na āgantuka padārtha avacchinnam caitanyam anādi ajñānasya viṣayaḥ nirviṣayasya āvaraṇasya ayogāt prāk anavacchinna āvaraṇam eva idānīm avacchinna āvaraṇam jātam iti api na avacchinna caitanya jñānena eva anavacchinna āvaraṇa nāśa āpatteḥ

original: etena vyaktitaḥ pūrvaṃ jātiriva viṣayātpūrvamajñānamastīti nirastamiti cenna| anādyajñānaviṣaye anādicaitanye tattadāgantukapadārthāvacchedābhyupagamād| `āśrayatvaviṣayatvabhāginī nirvibhāgacitireva kevalā' ityuktatvāt| yadavacchinnagocarā ca vṛttistadavacchedenaivāvaraṇāpasāraṇāt nānavacchinnacaitanyāvaraṇabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: etena vyaktitaḥ pūrvam jātiḥ iva viṣayāt pūrvam ajñānam asti iti nirastam iti ced na anādi ajñāna viṣaye anādi caitanye tad tad āgantuka padārtha avaccheda abhyupagamāt āśraya tva viṣaya tva bhāginī nirvibhāga citiḥ eva kevalā iti ukta tvāt yad avacchinna gocarā ca vṛttiḥ tad avacchedena eva āvaraṇa apasāraṇāt na anavacchinna caitanya āvaraṇa bhaṅga prasaṅgaḥ

original: ata eva vṛttiviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyāt prāgajñānamastītyabhiprāyeṇa viṣayātprāgajñānamastīti sādhūktam| tasmādadhiṣṭhānacaitanyaṃ svādhyastaṃ bhāsayatīti siddham|
analyzed: atas eva vṛtti viṣaya avacchinna caitanyāt prāk ajñānam asti iti abhiprāyeṇa viṣayāt prāk ajñānam asti iti sādhu uktam tasmāt adhiṣṭhāna caitanyam sva adhyastam bhāsayati iti siddham

original: tadayamatra niṣkarṣaḥ -- yadyapi viṣayaprakāśakaṃ viṣayādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ prameyacaitanyam| antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnacaitanyaṃ tu tasya pramātṛ| antaḥkaraṇavṛttyavacchinnacaitanyaṃ tu pramāṇam|
analyzed: tat ayam atra niṣkarṣaḥ yadi api viṣaya prakāśakam viṣaya adhiṣṭhāna bhūtam prameya caitanyam antaḥkaraṇa avacchinna caitanyam tu tasya pramātṛ antaḥkaraṇa vṛtti avacchinna caitanyam tu pramāṇam

original: tathāpi yadīyāntaḥkaraṇavṛttyā viṣayaparyantaṃ cakṣurādidvārā nissṛtayā yatprakāśakaṃ caitanyaṃ yatpramātṛcaitanyābhedenābhivyajyate tameva sa eva jānāti nānyaṃ nānyo vā| ata evaikavṛttyupārūḍhatvalakṣaṇaikalolībhāvāpannaṃ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyacaitanyaṃ bhavati| tatastadavacchedenājñānanivṛttyā bhāsamānaṃ prameyacaitanyamaparokṣaṃ phalamityucyate|
analyzed: tathā api yadīya antaḥkaraṇa vṛttyā viṣaya paryantam cakṣuḥ ādi dvārā nissṛtayā yat prakāśakam caitanyam yat pramātṛ caitanya abhedena abhivyajyate tam eva saḥ eva jānāti na anyam na anyaḥ vā atas eva eka vṛtti upārūḍha tva lakṣaṇa eka lolībhāva āpannam pramātṛ pramāṇa prameya caitanyam bhavati tatas tad avacchedena ajñāna nivṛttyā bhāsamānam prameya caitanyam aparokṣam phalam iti ucyate

original: tat svayaṃ bhāsamānaṃ sat svādhyastaṃ ghaṭādyapi bhāsayatīti tat phalavyāpyamityupeyate| yanniṣṭhā ca yadākārā vṛttirbhavati tanniṣṭhaṃ tadākāramajñānaṃ sā nāśayatīti niyamāt pramātṛprameyobhayavyāpinyaparokṣavṛttiḥ svāvacchedenāvaraṇamapasārayati| prakāśasya svāvacchedenāvaraṇāpasārakatvadarśanāt|
analyzed: tat svayam bhāsamānam sat svādhyastam ghaṭa ādi api bhāsayati iti tat phala vyāpyam iti upeyate yad niṣṭhā ca yad ākārā vṛttiḥ bhavati tad niṣṭham tad ākāram ajñānam sā nāśayati iti niyamāt pramātṛ prameya ubhaya vyāpinī aparokṣa vṛttiḥ sva avacchedena āvaraṇam apasārayati prakāśasya sva avacchedena āvaraṇa apasāraka tva darśanāt

original: ataḥ pramātravacchinnasyāsattvāvaraṇasya prameyāvacchinnasyābhānāvaraṇasya cāpasāraṇād ghaṭo'yaṃ me sphuratītyādyaparokṣavyavahāraḥ|
analyzed: atas pramātṛ avacchinnasya asattva āvaraṇasya prameya avacchinnasya abhā anāvaraṇasya ca apasāraṇāt ghaṭaḥ yam me sphurati ityādi aparokṣa vyavahāraḥ

original: parokṣasthale tu indriyasannikarṣalakṣaṇadvārābhāvādantaḥ -- karaṇanissaraṇābhāvena viṣayaparyantaṃ vṛtteragamanādviṣayāvacchinnaprameyacaitanyena saha pramātṛcaitanyasyaikavṛttyupārūḍhatvābhāvenāparokṣatayā'bhivyaktyabhāve'pi pramātṛpramāṇacaitanyayorekalolī bhāvāpattyā pramātravacchinnamasatatvāvaraṇamātraṃ nivartate|
analyzed: parokṣa sthale tu indriya sannikarṣa lakṣaṇa dvāra abhāvāt antar karaṇa nissaraṇa abhāvena viṣaya paryantam vṛtteḥ agamanāt viṣaya avacchinna prameya caitanyena saha pramātṛ caitanyasya eka vṛtti upārūḍha tva abhāvena aparokṣa tayā abhivyakti abhāve api pramātṛ pramāṇa caitanyayoḥ eka lolī bhāva āpattyā pramātṛ avacchinnam asata tva āvaraṇa mātram nivartate

original: tāvanmātrasya vṛttyavacchinnatvāt| idameva suṣuptivyāvṛttiśabdena vivaraṇācāryairvyākhyātam| viṣayāvacchinnābhānāvaraṇatatkāryasadbhāve'pi pramātravacchinnāsattvāvaraṇanivṛttyā anumānādau vyavahāropapattiḥ| ata eva jānāmyahaṃ parvate vahnisstīti, sa tu kīdṛśa iti me na bhātītyādivyavahāraḥ|
analyzed: tāvanmātrasya vṛtti avacchinna tvāt idam eva suṣupti vyāvṛtti śabdena vivaraṇa ācāryaiḥ vyākhyātam viṣaya avacchinna ābhāna āvaraṇa tad kārya sadbhāve pi pramātṛ avacchinna asattva āvaraṇa nivṛttyā anumāna ādau vyavahāra upapattiḥ atas eva jānāmi aham parvate vahniḥ sti iti sa tu kīdṛśaḥ iti me na bhāti ityādi vyavahāraḥ

original: trayāṇāmekalolībhāve aparokṣatvam, dvayorekalolībhāve tu parokṣatvamiti na saṅkaraḥ| vṛtteśca viṣayeṇa samaṃ sākṣādevāparokṣasthale sambandhaḥ | parokṣasthale tvanumiteranumeyena tadvyāpyajñānajanyatvam| śābdyāḥ saṃsargeṇa saha tadāśrayavācakapadajanyatvam| smṛteḥ smartavyena saha tadviṣayānubhavajanyatvam|
analyzed: trayāṇām eka lolībhāve aparokṣa tvam dvayoḥ eka lolībhāve tu parokṣa tvam iti na saṅkaraḥ vṛtteḥ ca viṣayeṇa samam sākṣāt eva aparokṣa sthale sambandhaḥ parokṣa sthale tu anumiteḥ anumeyena tad vyāpya jñāna janya tvam śābdyāḥ saṃsargeṇa saha tad āśraya vācaka pada janya tvam smṛteḥ smartavyena saha tad viṣaya anubhava janya tvam

original: evamanyatrāpi paramparāsambandha eveti parokṣāparokṣavibhāgaḥ| vistareṇa vyutpāditā'smābhiriyaṃ prakriyā siddhāntabindau| tasmādviṣayasya mithyātve'pi pratikarmavyavasthopapatteriti dik|
analyzed: evam anyatra api paramparā sambandhaḥ evā iti parokṣa aparokṣa vibhāgaḥ vistareṇa vyutpāditā asmābhiḥ iyam prakriyā siddhāntabindau tasmāt viṣayasya mithyātve api prati karma vyavasthā upapatteḥ iti diś

original: ityadvaitasiddhau pratikarmavyavasthopapattiḥ||
analyzed: iti advaita siddhau prati karma vyavasthā upapattiḥ

original: nanu -- mithyātvānumānaṃ pratikūlatarkaparāhatam| tathā hi -- viśvaṃ yadi kalpitaṃ syāt, sādhiṣṭhānaṃ syāt| na caivam, sāmānyato jñātatve satyajñātaviśeṣavattvasyādhiṣṭhānatvaprayojakasya nirviśeṣe nissāmānye ca brahmaṇyasambhavāditi cenna| svarūpeṇa jñātatve sati viśeṣeṇājñātatvasyādhiṣṭhānatvaprayojakatvenājñātaviśeṣavattvasyāprayojakatvāt|
analyzed: nanu mithyātva anumānam pratikūla tarka parāhatam tathā hi viśvam yadi kalpitam syāt sa adhiṣṭhānam syāt na ca evam sāmānyataḥ jñāta tve sati ajñāta viśeṣavat tvasya adhiṣṭhāna tva prayojakasya nirviśeṣe nissāmānye ca brahmaṇi asambhavāt iti ced na svarūpeṇa jñāta tve sati viśeṣeṇa ajñāta tvasya adhiṣṭhāna tva prayojaka tvena ajñāta viśeṣavat tvasya aprayojaka tvāt

original: tathā ca nissāmānye nirviśeṣe ca brahmaṇi svaprakāśatvena jñānāt paripūrṇatvānandatvādinā cājñānādadhiṣṭhānatvamupapannam| vastutastu -- kalpitasāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ brahmaṇyapi sulabhaveva| akalpitasāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ cāprasiddham| na ca tatkalpane anyonyāśrayaḥ| kalpitasāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ pravāhānāditvāt|
analyzed: tathā ca nissāmānye nirviśeṣe ca brahmaṇi sva prakāśa tvena jñānāt paripūrṇa tva ānanda tva ādinā ca ajñānāt adhiṣṭhāna tvam upapannam vastutas tu kalpita sāmānya viśeṣavat tvam brahmaṇi api akalpita sāmānya viśeṣavat tvam ca aprasiddham na ca tad kalpane anyonya āśrayaḥ kalpita sāmānya viśeṣāṇām pravāha anādi tvāt

original: sattvānandatvādīnāmeva kalpitavyaktibhedena sāmānyatvāt| paripūrṇānandatvādīnāṃ ca viśeṣatvāt| ata eva sāmānyākārajñānaṃ vinā saṃskāranudbodhāt kathamadhyāsa iti na vācyam| sadātmanā svarūpajñānasyaiva sāmānyajñānatvāt| na hyadhyasanīyaṃ sadātmanā na bhāti| etāvāneva viśeṣaḥ -- yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ svata eva tadātmanā bhāti|
analyzed: sattva ānanda tva ādīnām eva kalpita vyakti bhedena sāmānya tvāt paripūrṇa ānanda tva ādīnām ca viśeṣa tvāt atas eva sāmānya ākāra jñānam vinā saṃskāra an udbodhāt katham adhyāsaḥ iti na vācyam sat ātmanā svarūpa jñānasya eva sāmānya jñāna tvāt na hi adhyasanīyam sat ātmanā na bhāti etāvān eva viśeṣaḥ yat adhiṣṭhānam svatas eva tat ātmanā bhāti

original: adhyasanīyaṃ tu tatsambandhāt| nanu -- adhiṣṭhānatirodhānaṃ vinā bhramāsambhavaḥ| prakāśarūpatirodhāne tu tadadhyastāvidyādeḥ prakāśānupapattiriti cet, na| ekasyaivānandādyātmanā tirohitasya sadātmanā prakāśasambhavāt| taduktaṃ vārtikakārapādaiḥ --
analyzed: adhyasanīyam tu tad sambandhāt nanu adhiṣṭhāna tirodhānam vinā bhrama asambhavaḥ prakāśa rūpa tirodhāne tu tad adhyasta avidyā ādeḥ prakāśa anupapattiḥ iti ced na ekasya eva ānanda ādi ātmanā tirohitasya sat ātmanā prakāśa sambhavāt tat uktam vārtikakāra pādaiḥ

original: yatprasādādavidyādi sidhyatīva divāniśam|
analyzed: yad prasādāt avidyā ādi sidhyati iva divāniśam

original: tamapyapahnute'vidyā nājñānasyāsti duṣkaram|| iti|
analyzed: tam api apahnute vidyā na ajñānasya asti duṣkaram iti

original: na ca bādhakāle'pi sadviśeṣājñānamastīti -- vācyam| paripūrṇānandatvādeḥ sata eva viśeṣatvena tadā tadajñānābhāvāt| dharmatvamātrasyaiva kalpitatvāt| yadvā, bhramavirodhijñānābhāva eva tantram| na tu viśeṣājñānam| viśvopādānagocarājñānasya śravaṇādijanyamātmamātraviṣayakaṃ vṛttirūpaṃ jñānaṃ virodhi, na tu cidrūpaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ jñānam|
analyzed: na ca bādha kāle api sat viśeṣa ajñānam asti iti vācyam paripūrṇa ānanda tva ādeḥ sataḥ eva viśeṣa tvena tadā tad ajñāna abhāvāt dharma tva mātrasya eva kalpita tvāt yat vā bhrama virodhi jñāna abhāvaḥ eva tantram na tu viśeṣa ajñānam viśva upādāna gocara ajñānasya śravaṇa ādi janyam ātma mātra viṣayakam vṛtti rūpam jñānam virodhi na tu cit rūpam svatas siddham jñānam

original: bhramavirodhinaśca vṛttirūpasya jñānasyedānīmabhāvo'styeva| nanu -- ātmānātmanordṛgdṛśyatvātmānātmatvādinā bhedajñānāt kathamadhyastādhiṣṭhānabhāva iti cenna| idamanidaṃ na bhavatīti purovarttyapurovartinorbhedagrahe'pīdaṃ rajatamityadhyāsavat san ghaṭa ityādyadhyāso bhaviṣyati| na hi rūpāntareṇa bhedagraho rūpāntareṇādhyāsavirodhī|
analyzed: bhrama virodhinaḥ ca vṛtti rūpasya jñānasya idānīm abhāvaḥ usti eva nanu ātma anātmanoḥ dṛś dṛśya tva ātma anātma tva ādinā bheda jñānāt katham adhyasta adhiṣṭhāna bhāvaḥ iti ced na idam anidam na bhavati iti purovarttya purovartinoḥ bheda grahe pi idam rajatam iti adhyāsa vat san ghaṭaḥ ityādi adhyāsaḥ bhaviṣyati na hi rūpa antareṇa bheda grahaḥ rūpa antareṇa adhyāsa virodhī

original: san ghaṭa ityādipratyaye ca sadrūpasyātmano ghaṭādyanuviddhatayā bhānānna tasya ghaṭādyadhyāsādhiṣṭhānatānupapattiḥ| sadrūpeṇa ca sarvajñānaviṣayatopapatterna rūpādihīnasyāpyātmanaḥ kālasyeva cākṣuṣatvādyanupapattiḥ|
analyzed: san ghaṭaḥ ityādi pratyaye ca sat rūpasya ātmanaḥ ghaṭa ādi anuviddha tayā bhānāt na tasya ghaṭa ādi adhyāsa adhiṣṭhāna tā anupapattiḥ sat rūpeṇa ca sarva jñāna viṣaya tā upapatteḥ na rūpa ādi hīnasya api ātmanaḥ kālasya iva cākṣuṣa tva ādi anupapattiḥ

original: nanu -- viśvaṃ yadi kalpitaṃ syāttadā sapradhānaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ, tasmāt na kalpitamiti cenna| atrāpi pradhānasya sajātīyasya sattvāt| pūrvaprapañcasajātīyasyaivottaraprapañcasyādhyasanāt| adhyāso hi svakāraṇatayā saṃskāramapekṣate| na tu saṃskāraviṣayasya satyatām, anupayogāt| na ca -- pramājanya eva saṃskāro bhramahetuḥ|
analyzed: nanu viśvam yadi kalpitam syāt tadā sapradhānam syāt na ca evam tasmāt na kalpitam iti ced na atra api pradhānasya sajātīyasya sattvāt pūrva prapañca sajātīyasya eva uttara prapañcasya adhyasanāt adhyāsaḥ hi sva kāraṇatayā saṃskāram apekṣate na tu saṃskāra viṣayasya satyatām anupayogāt na ca pramā janyaḥ eva saṃskāraḥ bhrama hetuḥ

original: ato viṣayasatyatvamāvaśyakamiti vācyam| mānābhāvād, viparīte lāghavācca| ata eva -- adhyastasajātīyaṃ pūrvamadhyastāpekṣayā'dhikasattākamapekṣaṇīyamityapi nirastam| satyatāvadadhikasattāyā apyanupayogāt| pūrvaṃ tajjñānamātramapekṣyate, taccāstyeva|
analyzed: atas viṣaya satya tvam āvaśyakam iti vācyam māna abhāvāt viparīte lāghavāt ca atas eva adhyasta sajātīyam pūrvam adhyasta apekṣayā adhika sattākam apekṣaṇīyam iti api nirastam satyatāvat adhika sattāyāḥ api anupayogāt pūrvam tad jñāna mātram apekṣyate tat ca asti eva

original: nanu -- evamadhiṣṭhānasyāpi jñānamātrameva hetuḥ, na tu taditi na sadadhiṣṭhānāpekṣā syāditi śūnyavādāpattiriti cenna| adhiṣṭhānasya jñānadvārā bhramāhetutve'pyajñānadvārā bhramahetutvena sattvaniyamāt| bhramopādānājñānaviṣayo hyadhiṣṭhānamityucyate| tacca satyameva| asatyasya sarvasyāpyajñānakalpitatvenājñānaviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: nanu evam adhiṣṭhānasya api jñāna mātram eva hetuḥ na tu tat iti na sat adhiṣṭhāna apekṣā syāt iti śūnyavāda āpattiḥ iti ced na adhiṣṭhānasya jñāna dvārā bhrama ahetu tve pi ajñāna dvārā bhrama hetu tvena sattva niyamāt bhrama upādāna ajñāna viṣayaḥ hi adhiṣṭhānam iti ucyate tat ca satyam eva asatyasya sarvasya api ajñāna kalpita tvena ajñāna viṣaya tvāt

original: tadasatyatve tajjñānasya bhramābādhakatvaprasaṅgāt| jagati bhramabādhavyavasthā ca na syāt| bādhena hi kiñcidviruddhaṃ tattvamupadarśayatā āropitamatattvaṃ bādhanīyam| ubhayādhyāse tu kiṃ kena bādhyeta? ata eva bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa -- "satyānṛte mithunīkṛtya" ityuktam|
analyzed: tad asatya tve tad jñānasya bhrama ābādhaka tva prasaṅgāt jagati bhrama bādha vyavasthā ca na syāt bādhena hi kiñcid viruddham tattvam upadarśayatā āropitam atattvam bādhanīyam ubhaya adhyāse tu kim kena bādhyeta atas eva bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa satya anṛte mithunīkṛtya iti uktam

original: nanu etatprapañcāsādhyārthakriyākāriṇaḥ prapañcāntarasyābhāvena svocitārthakriyākāriṇo'sya na mithyātvamiti cenna, svāpnamāyādau vyabhicārāt| svocitārthakriyākāritvasya pāramārthikasattvāprayojakatvāt| nāpi śrutyādisiddhotpattyādimattvaṃ sattve tantram| svapnaprapañce vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: nanu etad prapañca asādhya arthakriyā kāriṇaḥ prapañca antarasya abhāvena svocita arthakriyā kāriṇaḥ asya na mithyātvam iti ced na svāpna māyā ādau vyabhicārāt svocita arthakriyā kāri tvasya pāramārthika sattva aprayojaka tvāt nā api śruti ādi siddha utpatti ādimattvam sattve tantram svapna prapañce vyabhicārāt

original: tasyāpi "na tatra rathā na rathayogā na panthāno bhavantyatha rathān rathayogān pathassṛjate" ityādiśrutyotpattyādipratipādanāt| na ca kalpādyabhramāyogaḥ| kalpāntarīyasaṃskārasya tatra hetutvāt| na ca janmāntarīyasaṃskārasya kāryajanakatve'tiprasaṅgaḥ| adṛṣṭādivaśena kvacidudbodhe'pyanyatrānudbodhopapatteḥ|
analyzed: tasya api na tatra rathāḥ na ratha yogāḥ na panthānaḥ bhavanti atha rathān ratha yogān pathaḥ sṛjate ityādi śrutyā utpatti ādi pratipādanāt na ca kalpa ādi abhrama ayogaḥ kalpa antarīya saṃskārasya tatra hetu tvāt na ca janma antarīya saṃskārasya kārya janaka tva iti prasaṅgaḥ adṛṣṭa ādi vaśena kvacid udbodhe pi anyatra anudbodha upapatteḥ

original: kāryonneyadharmāṇāṃ yathākāryamunnayanāt| anyathā jātasya stanyapānādau pravṛttirna syāt| nanu -- caitreṇa maitre saṃskārādhyāse'pi maitrasya bhramādarśanāt jagadbhramahetusaṃskārasya sattvaṃ durvāram| na ca svenādhyastātsaṃskārādbhramaḥ| bhramāt pūrvaṃ svasya kāryānumeyasaṃskārādhyāsaniyamābhāvāditi cenna|
analyzed: kārya unneya dharmāṇām yathākāryam unnayanāt anyathā jātasya stanya pāna ādau pravṛttiḥ na syāt nanu caitreṇa maitre saṃskāra adhyāse api maitrasya bhrama adarśanāt jagat bhrama hetu saṃskārasya sattvam durvāram na ca svena adhyastāt saṃskārāt bhramaḥ bhramāt pūrvam svasya kārya anumeya saṃskāra adhyāsa niyama abhāvāt iti ced na

original: śuktirūpyasya kuṇḍalājanakatvavaccaitrādhyastasaṃskārasya maitrabhramājanakatve'pi vaṇigvīthīstharūpyasya kuṇḍalajanakatvavat svenādhyastasya saṃskārasya viyadādyadhyāsajanakatvopapatteḥ| tatpratītyabhāve'pi tadadhyāsasya pūrvaṃ sattvāt kṛtsnasyāpi vyāvahārikapadārthasyājñātasattvābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: śukti rūpyasya kuṇḍala ajanaka tva vat caitra adhyasta saṃskārasya maitra bhrama ajanaka tve pi vaṇij vīthī stha rūpyasya kuṇḍala janaka tva vat svena adhyastasya saṃskārasya viyat ādi adhyāsa janaka tva upapatteḥ tad pratīti abhāve pi tad adhyāsasya pūrvam sattvāt kṛtsnasya api vyāvahārika padārthasya ajñāta sattva abhyupagamāt

original: nanu -- prātibhāsikarūpye traikālikaniṣedhasya tvanmate vyāvahārikarūpyaviṣayatvavad vyāhārikaprapañce'pi `neha nānā' iti traikālikaniṣedhasya pāramārthikaprapañcāntaraviṣayatā'vaśyaṃ vācyeti cenna| bhramabādhavaiyadhikaraṇyāpātenāsya pakṣasyānaṅgīkāraparāhatatvāt| aṅgīkāre'pi vyāvahārikaniṣedhe pāramārthikaviṣayatvaṃ na sambhavati|
analyzed: nanu prātibhāsika rūpye traikālika niṣedhasya tvad mate vyāvahārika rūpya viṣayatva vat vyāhārika prapañce pi na iha nānā iti traikālika niṣedhasya pāramārthika prapañca antara viṣayatā avaśyam vācyā iti ced na bhrama bādha vaiyadhikaraṇya āpātena asya pakṣasya anaṅgīkāra parāhata tvāt aṅgīkāre api vyāvahārika niṣedhe pāramārthika viṣayatvam na sambhavati

original: apratītasya niṣedhāyogāt| pratītyā sahādhyāsātiriktasambandhābhāvena pāramārthike pratītatvābhāvāt| nanu -- pradhānādhiṣṭhānayoḥ sādṛśyābhāvātkathamadhyāsaḥ? atha nirguṇayorapi guṇayoḥ sādṛśyavadatrāpi kiñcitsādṛśyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, tanna| nirdharmake brahmaṇi tasyāpyadhyāsādhīnatvenānyonyāśrayāt|
analyzed: apratītasya niṣedha ayogāt pratītyā saha adhyāsa atirikta sambandha abhāvena pāramārthike pratīta tva abhāvāt nanu pradhāna adhiṣṭhānayoḥ sādṛśya abhāvāt katham adhyāsaḥ atha nirguṇayoḥ api guṇayoḥ sādṛśya vat atra api kiñcid sādṛśyam bhaviṣyati iti tat na nirdharmake brahmaṇi tasya api adhyāsa adhīna tvena anyonya āśrayāt

original: yadyapi sādṛśyaṃ sopādhikādhyāse na kāraṇaṃ, vyabhicārāt| tathāpi nirupādhikādhyāse'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tasyāvaśyamapekṣaṇīyatvāt| sopādhike'pi `raktaḥ sphaṭikaḥ' dravyatvādinā sādṛśyānapekṣatvād| antaḥkaraṇādhyāse tvavidyāsambandhitvasyaiva sādṛśyasya vidyamānatvāt| vastutastuna bhrame sādṛśyāpekṣāniyamaḥ|
analyzed: yadi api sādṛśyam sopādhika adhyāse na kāraṇam vyabhicārāt tathā api nirupādhika adhyāsa invaya vyatirekābhyām tasya avaśyam apekṣaṇīya tvāt sopādhike api raktaḥ sphaṭikaḥ dravya tva ādinā sādṛśya anapekṣa tvāt antaḥkaraṇa adhyāse tu avidyā sambandhi tvasya eva sādṛśyasya vidyamāna tvāt vastutas tu na bhrame sādṛśya apekṣā niyamaḥ

original: nirupādhike'pi `pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ' ityādau vyabhicārāt| `raktaḥ sphaṭikaḥ' ityādāvapi dravyatvādinā sādṛśyamastītyapi na| pradhānamātravṛttitayā prāgavagatamadhyāsasamaye cādhiṣṭhānavṛttitayā gṛhītaṃ yat tadeva hi sādṛśyaṃ viparyayaprayojakamiti tvayāpi vācyam| na tu prāgeva pradhānādhiṣṭhānobhayavṛttitayā gṛhītam| tasya saṃśāyakatvāt|
analyzed: nirupādhike api pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ ityādau vyabhicārāt raktaḥ sphaṭikaḥ ityādau api dravya tva ādinā sādṛśyam asti iti api na pradhāna mātra vṛttitayā prāk avagatam adhyāsa samaye ca adhiṣṭhāna vṛttitayā gṛhītam yat tat eva hi sādṛśyam viparyaya prayojakam iti tvayā api vācyam na tu prāk eva pradhāna adhiṣṭhāna ubhaya vṛttitayā gṛhītam tasya saṃśāyaka tvāt

original: dravyatvādi ca lohitālohitavṛttitayā prāggṛhītamiti na viparyayaprayojakam| kiṃ ca sādṛśyaṃ na svato bhramakāraṇaṃ, mānābhāvāt| kiṃ tu saṃskārodbodhena sāmagrīsaṃpādakatayā| saṃskārodbodhaśca na sādṛśyaikaniyataḥ| adṛṣṭādinā'pi kiṃ tu saṃskārodbodhena sāmagrīsampādakatayā| saṃskārodbodhaśca na sādṛśyaikaniyataḥ| adṛṣṭādinā'pi tatsambhavāt|
analyzed: dravya tva ādi ca lohita alohita vṛtti tayā prāk gṛhītam iti na viparyaya prayojakam kim ca sādṛśyam na svatas bhrama kāraṇam māna abhāvāt kim tu saṃskāra udbodhena sāmagrī saṃpādaka tayā saṃskāra udbodhaḥ ca na sādṛśya eka niyataḥ adṛṣṭa ādinā api kim tu saṃskāra udbodhena sāmagrī sampādaka tayā saṃskāra udbodhaḥ ca na sādṛśya eka niyataḥ adṛṣṭa ādinā api tad sambhavāt

original: taduktam -- `sadṛśādṛṣṭacintādyāḥ smṛtibījasya bodhakāḥ' iti| cintādikaṃ ca praṇidhānasūtre vyākhyātam| tathā cānyataḥ saṃskārodvodhe sati sādṛśyamanupayogi| taduktaṃ vivaraṇe `nirupādhikabhramakāryadarśanameva guṇāvayavasāmānyābhāve'pi ketakīgandhasadṛśaḥ sarpagandha itivat sādṛśyāntaraṃ vā, śaṅkhapītimādāviva kāraṇāntaraṃ vā kalpayati' iti|
analyzed: tat uktam sadṛśa adṛṣṭa cintā ādyāḥ smṛti bījasya bodhakāḥ iti cintā ādikam ca praṇidhāna sūtre vyākhyātam tathā ca anyatas saṃskāra udvodhe sati sādṛśyam anupayogi tat uktam vivaraṇe nirupādhika bhrama kārya darśanam eva guṇa avayava sāmānya abhāve pi ketakī gandha sadṛśaḥ sarpa gandhaḥ iti vat sādṛśya antaram vā śaṅkha pītima ādau iva kāraṇa antaram vā kalpayati iti

original: nanu -- doṣaṃ vinā bhramasvīkāre tadaprāmāṇyasya svatastvāpattiḥ, doṣajanyatvasvīkāre tu doṣasyāpyadhyasanīyatvenānavasthāpattiriti -- cenna| anādyavidyādhyāsasya doṣānapekṣatvāt| sādyadhyāsasya cāvidyādoṣajanyatvāt nāprāmāṇyasya svatastvam| nāpyanavasthā| anyathā tārkikāṇāmapyanādipramā guṇaṃ vinā'pīti prāmāṇyaparatastvaṃ bhajyeta|
analyzed: nanu doṣam vinā bhrama svīkāre tad aprāmāṇyasya svatastva āpattiḥ doṣa janya tva svīkāre tu doṣasya api adhyasanīya tvena anavasthā āpattiḥ iti ced na anādya vidyā adhyāsasya doṣa anapekṣa tvāt sādi adhyāsasya ca avidyā doṣa janya tvāt na aprāmāṇyasya svatastvam na api anavasthā anyathā tārkikāṇām api anādi pramā guṇam vinā api iti prāmāṇya paratastvam bhajyeta

original: janyapramāmātrasya guṇajanyatvaṃ tu janyādhyāsamātrasya doṣajanyatvena samam| nanu -- lāghavena prathamopasthitatvena ca pravṛttimātraṃ prati saṃsargadhiya iva dhūmamātraṃ prati vahneriva cādhyāsamātraṃ prati doṣādīnāṃ janakatvādavidyādyāso'pi kathaṃ klṛptakāraṇena vinā bhavatu? anyathā saṃsargadhīrapi pravṛttiviśeṣe, vahnirapi dhūmaviśeṣe

analyzed: iti prācām vacanena bauddham prati pratyabhijñāna ādinā viśvasya sthāyi tva pratipādakena ca sūtra bhāṣya vārtika vivaraṇa ādi granthena virodhaḥ iti ced na anādi atirikte sṛṣṭi viṣaye eva dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi svīkārāt kāraṇa ātmanā sthāyi tva svīkārāt ca tāvatā eva bauddha abhimata kṣaṇikatva nirākaraṇa upapatteḥ na ākara virodhaḥ pratyuta ākareṣu bahuśas dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭiḥ upapāditā eva

analyzed: nanu evam pratīti mātra śarīra tvena niyata kāraṇa ajanya tve śrutiṣu svarga ādi artham jyotiṣṭoma ādi vidheḥ brahma sākṣātkāra artham śravaṇa ādi vidheḥ ākāśa ādeḥ vāyu ādi hetutvasya ca uktiḥ ayuktā iti ced na svāpna kārya kāraṇa bhāva bodhaka vat upapatteḥ na ca evam vedānta vākyasya tad mīmāṃsāyāḥ ca svapna vākya tad mīmāṃsā tulya tā āpattiḥ viṣaya bādhā bādhābhyām viśeṣa upapatteḥ

original: ata eva tṛptyarthaṃ bhojane parapratyayanārthaṃ śabdādau ca pravṛtterayogena svakriyāvyāghāta iti nirastam| svāpnavyavaharavadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: atas eva tṛpti artham bhojane para pratyayana artham śabda ādau ca pravṛtteḥ ayogena sva kriyā vyāghātaḥ iti nirastam svāpna vyavahara vat upapatteḥ

analyzed: atha evam ghaṭa ādeḥ sva jñānāt pūrvam asattvena prati karma vyavasthā anupapattiḥ adhiṣṭhānasya api śukti dam aṃśasya rūpya ādi vat idam rajatam iti jñānāt prāk asattvena saṃprayoga ādi hetu traya janya tva rūpa adhyāsa taṭastha lakṣaṇasya satyasya vastunaḥ mithyā vastu sambheda abhāvaḥ iti asya svarūpa lakṣaṇasya ca ayogaḥ iti ced na

original: pratikarmavyavasthāyāḥ saṃprayogādihetutraya janyatvarūpādhyāsataṭasthalakṣaṇasya ca mandādhikāriviṣayatvāt| satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāsa iti svarūpalakṣaṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭisṛṣṭipakṣepyaviruddham| na hi idamaṃśā vacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ na vastu, na vā mithyārūpyasya tena saha na sambhedāvabhāsaḥ|
analyzed: prati karma vyavasthāyāḥ saṃprayoga ādi hetu traya janya tva rūpa adhyāsa taṭastha lakṣaṇasya ca manda adhikāri viṣaya tvāt satyasya vastunaḥ mithyā vastu sambheda avabhāsaḥ iti svarūpa lakṣaṇam tu dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi pakṣepya viruddham na hi idam aṃśa avacchinnam caitanyam na vastu na vā mithyārūpyasya tena saha na sambheda avabhāsaḥ

original: na ca -- `idaṃ rūpyam' iti jñānakāle śuktitvāderabhāvenādhyāsasya tadajñānakāryatvādiprakriyāvirodha iti -- vācyam| `idaṃ rūpyam' iti jñānakāle śuktitvasyābhāve'pi tadajñānasthityavirodhāt| na hi sattākāla iva sattāvirahakāle'pi ajñānaṃ virudhyate|

original: na ca -- `idaṃ rūpyaṃ nedaṃ rūpyam' iti jñānayorbhinnaviṣayatvena bādhyabādhakabhāvānupapattiriti -- vācyam| bhinnaviṣayatve'pi viṣayayoḥ sārūpyāt svapnabādhyabādhakayoriva bādhyabādhakabhāvopapatteḥ| na ca -- rūpyādibādhasyāpi dṛṣṭisṛṣṭitve tena rūpyādermithyātvāsiddhiriti -- vācyam|
analyzed: na ca idam rūpyam na idam rūpyam iti jñānayoḥ bhinna viṣaya tvena bādhya bādhaka bhāva anupapattiḥ iti vācyam bhinna viṣaya tve pi viṣayayoḥ sārūpyāt svapna bādhya bādhakayoḥ iva bādhya bādhaka bhāva upapatteḥ na ca rūpya ādi bādhasya api dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi tve tena rūpya ādeḥ mithyātva asiddhiḥ iti vācyam

original: bādhyānyūnasattākatvameva bādhakatve prayojakam, na tvadhikasattākatvamityasyopapāditatvena vyāvahārikeṇa vyāvahārikabādhavat prātibhāsikena prātibhāsikabādhāvirodhāt|

original: na ca -- suṣuptipralayādau jīvabrahmavibhāgasyāpratītatvenāvidyamānatayā pratisuṣupti pratipralayaṃ ca muktasya punarāvṛttyāpattiriti -- vācyam, jīvabrahmavibhāgāderanāditvena dṛṣṭisṛṣṭitvānubhyupagamasyoktatvāt| na ca suptaṃ prati saṃskārāderapyabhāvena tasya punaḥ prabodhāyogaḥ, kāraṇātmanā saṃskārādeḥ sattvāt|
analyzed: na ca suṣupti pralaya ādau jīva brahma vibhāgasya apratīta tvena avidyamānatayā pratisuṣupti pratipralayam ca muktasya punarāvṛtti āpattiḥ iti vācyam jīva brahma vibhāga ādeḥ anādi tvena dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi tva anubhyupagamasya ukta tvāt na ca suptam prati saṃskāra ādeḥ api abhāvena tasya punar prabodha ayogaḥ kāraṇa ātmanā saṃskāra ādeḥ sattvāt

original: na ca mokṣasya dṛganyatvena svāpnamokṣavad dṛṣṭisṛṣṭyāpattiḥ| mokṣasya brahmasvarūpatvena dṛgbhinnatvāsiddheḥ| na ca -- caitanyamātrarūpā dṛṣṭirna sṛṣṭiḥ kintu vṛttiviśiṣṭacaitanyarūpā vā, vṛttirūpā vā dṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭiriti vācyam| tathā ca tasyā api dṛṣṭyantaraṃ sṛṣṭirityanavastheti -- vācyam|

original: caitanyamātrasya dṛṣṭitve yadyapi tatsamānasattākatayā ghaṭādeḥ sadātanatvāpattiḥ,tathāpi vṛttyupahitacaitanyameva dṛṣṭiśabdārthaḥ| vṛttāvapi vṛttireva svasvarūpā caitanyopādhiriti nānavasthā| ata eva -- doṣājñānadraṣṭṛdehendriyādīnāmabhāve na bhrama iti teṣāmapi dṛṣṭisṛṣṭitve anavastheti -- nirastam|
analyzed: caitanya mātrasya dṛṣṭi tve yadi api tad samāna sattāka tayā ghaṭa ādeḥ sadātana tva āpattiḥ tathā api vṛtti upahita caitanyam eva dṛṣṭi śabda arthaḥ vṛttau api vṛttiḥ eva sva svarūpā caitanya upādhiḥ iti nā anavasthā atas eva doṣa ajñāna draṣṭṛ deha indriya ādīnām abhāve na bhramaḥ iti teṣām api dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi tve anavasthā iti nirastam

original: dṛṣṭisṛṣṭau ca `evamevāsmādātmanaḥ sarve prāṇāḥ sarve lokāḥ sarve vedāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni sarva eta ātmāno vyuccaranti' iti śrutiḥ suptotathitajīvāt prāmādisṛṣṭiṃ pratipādayantī pramāṇam| na ca suṣuptau prāṇādiprapañcasya sattvātkimarthaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭiriti vācyam|

original: svāpnaśarīre `ayaṃ sukhī, ayaṃ duḥkhī' ityeva yatra buddhirna tvahaṃ sukhītyādi, tattu nirjīvam| yatra tvahamityādi tat sajīvam| jāgraccharīrāntare ahamiti pratītyavacchedake sajīvatoktirna dvitīyena jīvena sajīvatvamityabhipretya| tatra mānābhāvāt| bandhamokṣādivyavasthānupapattistatra mānamiti cenna|

original: etena -- mama kalpakatve tava mokṣārthaṃ pravṛttyayogaḥ| tava kalpakatve tvatkalpitāsmadādibodhārthaṃ tava śabdaprayogādyanupapattiḥ| na ca svapnavat paryanuyogāyogaḥ| evamaparyanuyojyatve nirmaryādatayā kathānadhikāraprasaṅgāditi nirastam| caitramaitrādisarvābhimānino jīvasya kalpakatvena tava mametyādivikalpānupapatteḥ| nāpi svakriyādivirodhaḥ|

original: svakriyāyāḥ kalpitatvādiniścayavirahakālīnatvena paryanuyogāyogāt| atha brahmaṇa eva jīvatvena tasyaiva bandhamokṣāviti tasya nityamuktatvādiśrutivirodhaḥ| na| mukteḥ svasvarūpatvena bandhasya cā'vidyakatvena tadavirodhaḥ| na hi mṛgatṛṣṇikākalpitodakena svabhāvaśuṣkā'pi marubhūmirārdrībhavati|

original: etena kalpitasya jīvasya kalpakaṃ prati pratyaktvāyogaḥ| tena kalpakena pratyaktvenājñānāt| anyasyānubhaviturabhāvāt| tathā'nubhavāpalāpe ekajīvādvaitaśrutyāderapyasiddhiriti nirastam| anekaśarīraikajīvavādasyāṅgīkārāt| na ca tarhi tameva prati pratyaktvaparāktvayorayogaḥ|

original: yad yadupādānakaṃ, tat tadanuviddhatayaiva pratīyata iti vyāptyasiddheḥ| na hi ghaṭopādānakaṃ rūpaṃ ghaṭa iti pratīyate| prakṛtidvyaṇukādyanuviddhatayā pratīteḥ parairapyanabhyupagamāt| kenaciddharmeṇa tadanuvedhastu prakṛte'pīṣṭa eva| na ca yāvanti jñānāni tāvantyajñānānīti pakṣe bhramāpūrvakapramānivartye'jñāne avyāptiḥ|

original: bhramopādānatāyogyatvasya vivakṣitatvāt| sahakārivaikalyāt kāryānudaye'pi yogyatānapāyāt| atha yogyatāvacchedakarūpāparicaye kathaṃ tadgrahaṇam? prathamalakṣaṇasyaiva yogyatāvacchedakatvāt| ekamevājñānamiti pakṣe tu tatra bhramopādānatvamakṣatameva| na caivaṃ śuktijñānenaivājñānanāśe mokṣāpattiḥ| tasyāvasthāviśeṣanāśakatvāṅgīkārāt|

original: || ityadvaitasiddhāvavidyālakṣaṇopapattiḥ||

original: tatra cājñāne sāmanyataḥ `ahamajño māmanyaṃ ca na jānāti' iti pratyakṣaṃ, `tvaduktamarthaṃ na jānāmi' iti viśeṣataḥ pratyakṣam, `etāvantaṃ kālaṃ sukhamahamasvāpyasaṃ na kiñcidavediṣam' iti parāmarśasiddhaṃ sauṣuptapratyakṣaṃ ca pramāṇam| na ca -- ahamarthasyājñānānāśrayatvena kathamayaṃ pratyayo bhāvarūpājñānapakṣe upapadyata iti -- vācyam|
analyzed: tatra ca ajñāne sāmanyataḥ aham ajñaḥ mām anyam ca na jānāti iti pratyakṣam tvad uktam artham na jānāmi iti viśeṣataḥ pratyakṣam etāvantam kālam sukham aham asvāpī asam na kiñcid avediṣam iti parāmarśa siddham sauṣupta pratyakṣam ca pramāṇam na ca ahamarthasya ajñāna anāśraya tvena katham ayam pratyayaḥ bhāva rūpa ajñāna pakṣe upapadyate iti vācyam

original: ajñānāśrayībhūtacaitanye antaḥkaraṇatādātmyādhyāsena ekāśrayatvasaṃbandhenopapatteḥ| ata eva -- jaḍe āvaraṇakṛtyābhāvāt `ghaṭaṃ na jānāmi' ityādipratīterjñānābhāvaviṣayatve prakṛte'pi tathā'stviti -- nirastam| tattadavacchinnacaitanyasyaivājñānāśrayatvena tatrāpi tad‌vyavahāropapatteḥ|
analyzed: ajñāna āśrayībhūta caitanye antaḥkaraṇa tādātmya adhyāsena eka āśraya tva saṃbandhena upapatteḥ atas eva jaḍe āvaraṇa kṛtya abhāvāt ghaṭam na jānāmi ityādi pratīteḥ jñāna abhāva viṣaya tve prakṛte api tathā astu iti nirastam tad tad avacchinna caitanyasya eva ajñāna āśraya tvena tatra api tad vyavahāra upapatteḥ

original: na ca -- sākṣivedye sukhaduḥkhājñānādau prātibhāsike ca bhāvarūpājñānābhāvena tatra na jānāmīti pratītiḥ kathamupapadyata iti -- vācyam| svasminvidyamāne sākṣivedye sukhādau svabhramasiddhe rūpyādau ca `na jānāmi' iti vyavahārāsambhavāt, parasukhādau `na jānāmi' iti vyavahārasya parokṣajñānanivartyena pramātṛgatājñānenaivopapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca sākṣi vedye sukha duḥkha ajñāna ādau prātibhāsike ca bhāva rūpa ajñāna abhāvena tatra na jānāmi iti pratītiḥ katham upapadyate iti vācyam svasmin vidyamāne sākṣi vedye sukha ādau sva bhrama siddhe rūpya ādau ca na jānāmi iti vyavahāra asambhavāt para sukha ādau na jānāmi iti vyavahārasya parokṣa jñāna nivartyena pramātṛ gata ajñānena eva upapatteḥ
