original: nanu -- bhāvarūpājñānaviṣayatvenābhimatasya `ahamajñaḥ' iti pratyapasya `mayi jñānaṃ nāsti' iti jñānābhāvaviṣayāt pratyayāt `aghaṭaṃ bhūtalam' iti pratyayasya `ghaṭo nāsti' iti pratyayādiva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsaṃ vinā icchādveṣābhāvajñānayoriva viṣayabhedāpratītiriti -- cet, satyam|
analyzed: nanu bhāva rūpa ajñāna viṣaya tvena abhimatasya aham ajñaḥ iti mayi jñānam na asti iti jñāna abhāva viṣayāt pratyayāt aghaṭam bhū talam iti pratyayasya ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratyayāt iva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva vyatyāsam vinā icchā dveṣa abhāva jñānayoḥ iva viṣaya bheda apratītiḥ iti ced satyam

original: dharmipratiyogijñānājñānājñānābhyāṃ jñānasāmānyābhāvajñānasya vyāhatatvena `mayi jñānaṃ nāsti' ityasyāpi bhāvarūpājñānaviṣayatvena viṣayabhedāpratīteryuktatvāt| tathā hi -- `mayi jñānaṃ nāsti' iti pratītiḥ `vāyau rūpaṃ nāsti' iti pratītivadyāvadviśeṣābhāvānyasāmānyābhāvaviṣayā, sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākayāvadviśeṣābhāvaviṣayā vā abhyupeyā|
analyzed: dharmi pratiyogi jñāna ajñāna ajñānābhyām jñāna sāmānya abhāva jñānasya vyāhata tvena mayi jñānam na asti iti asya api bhāva rūpa ajñāna viṣaya tvena viṣaya bheda apratīteḥ yukta tvāt tathā hi mayi jñānam na asti iti pratītiḥ vāyau rūpam na asti iti pratīti vat yāvat viśeṣa abhāva anya sāmānya abhāva viṣayā sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka yāvat viśeṣa abhāva viṣayā vā abhyupeyā

original: tathā ca tatkāraṇībhūtadharmipratiyogijñānājñānābhyāṃ kathaṃ na vyāghātaḥ? yatkiñcidviśeṣābhāvasya sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvābhāvād| abhāvajñāne pratiyogyaṃśe prakārībhūtadharmasyaiva pratiyogitāvacchedakatvāt| anyathā sāmānyābhāvasiddharna syāt| yāvadviśeṣābhāvānyasāmānyābhāvānabhyupagame'pyayaṃ doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca tad kāraṇībhūta dharmi pratiyogi jñāna ajñānābhyām katham na vyāghātaḥ yat kiñcid viśeṣa abhāvasya sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tva abhāvāt abhāva jñāne pratiyogi aṃśe prakārībhūta dharmasya eva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tvāt anyathā sāmānya abhāva siddhaḥ na syāt yāvat viśeṣa abhāva anya sāmānya abhāva anabhyupagame pi ayam doṣaḥ

original: yatkiñcidviśeṣābhāvasya sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatve ghaṭavatyapi bhūtale `nirghaṭaṃ bhūtalam' iti pratītiḥ syāt| `vāyau rūpaṃ nāsti' `puro deśe rajataṃ nāsti' ityādyāptavākyajanyapratītyanantaramapi tattatsaṃśayanivṛttirna syāt| ekaviśeṣābhāvabodhane'pi viśeṣāntaramādāya saṃśayopapatteḥ|
analyzed: yat kiñcid viśeṣa abhāvasya sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tve ghaṭavati api bhū tale nirghaṭam bhū talam iti pratītiḥ syāt vāyau rūpam na asti puras deśe rajatam na asti ityādi āpta vākya janya pratīti anantaram api tad tad saṃśaya nivṛttiḥ na syāt eka viśeṣa abhāva bodhane pi viśeṣa antaram ādāya saṃśaya upapatteḥ

original: atha -- abhāvabodhe prakārībhūtadharmasyāvacchedakatvaṃ pūrvānupasthitamapi saṃsargamaryādayā śabdābodhe anyatra ca bhāsate| na hvavacchedakatvasya svarūpasaṃbandhaviśeṣasya grahe anyā sāmagrī klṛptā|
analyzed: atha abhāva bodhe prakārībhūta dharmasya avacchedaka tvam pūrva anupasthitam api saṃsarga maryādayā śabda ābodhe anyatra ca bhāsate na hu avacchedaka tvasya svarūpa saṃbandha viśeṣasya grahe anyā sāmagrī klṛptā

original: tathā ca tattadviśeṣābhāvānāṃ tattadviśeṣāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvāt, sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ yāvadviśeṣābhāvakūṭe vā vyāsajyavṛttitadatiriktasāmānyābhāve vā pratyekaviśrāntamiti tādṛgabhāvapratīteyoryāvadviśeṣapratītivirodhitvāt kuto viśeṣasaṃśayādiriti cet, satyam|
analyzed: tathā ca tad tad viśeṣa abhāvānām tad tad viśeṣa avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvāt sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam yāvat viśeṣa abhāva kūṭe vā vyāsajya vṛtti tad atirikta sāmānya abhāve vā pratyeka viśrāntam iti tādṛś abhāva pratīteyoḥ yāvat viśeṣa pratīti virodhi tvāt kutas viśeṣa saṃśaya ādiḥ iti ced satyam

original: prakṛte'pi jñānatvasāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvapratītiryāvajjñānaviśeṣavirodhinīti kathaṃ tattatkāraṇatvābhimatajñānaviśeṣe sati sā na vyāhanyate? tathā ca klṛptābhāvapratītivailakṣaṇye'vaśyakalpye lāghavādviṣayasyaivābhāvavailakṣaṇyaṃ kalpayitumucitam| viṣayāvailakṣaṇye pratītivailakṣaṇyāyogāt|
analyzed: prakṛte api jñāna tva sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāva pratītiḥ yāvat jñāna viśeṣa virodhinī iti katham tad tad kāraṇatva abhimata jñāna viśeṣe sati sā na vyāhanyate tathā ca klṛpta abhāva pratīti vailakṣaṇya avaśya kalpye lāghavāt viṣayasya eva abhāva vailakṣaṇyam kalpayitum ucitam viṣaya availakṣaṇye pratīti vailakṣaṇya ayogāt

original: viṣayajñānamanubhūya ca puruṣastannivṛttyarthaṃ vicāre pravartata iti sarvānubhavasiddham| yadyapi jñānaviśeṣābhāvo `na jānāmī'ti pratīterviṣayaḥ, tadā jñāte'pi tathā pratītyāpātaḥ| tadvicārārthaṃ ca pravṛttiḥ syāt| sāmānyābhāve ca bādhakamuktameva| tasmādabhāvavilakṣaṇamevājñānaṃ `mayi jñānaṃ nāstyahamajñaḥ' ityādi -- dhīviṣaya iti siddham|
analyzed: viṣaya jñānam anubhūya ca puruṣaḥ tad nivṛtti artham vicāre pravartate iti sarva anubhava siddham yadi api jñāna viśeṣa abhāvaḥ na jānāmi iti pratīteḥ viṣayaḥ tadā jñāte api tathā pratīti āpātaḥ tad vicāra artham ca pravṛttiḥ syāt sāmānya abhāve ca bādhakam uktam eva tasmāt abhāva vilakṣaṇam eva ajñānam mayi jñānam na asti aham ajñaḥ ityādi dhī viṣayaḥ iti siddham

original: nanu abhāvavilakṣaṇamapyajñānaṃ `na jānāmi' iti jñānavirodhitvenaiva bhāsate| mohādipade'pi pralayādipadavattadanullekhamātram| uktaṃ ca vivaraṇe -- `ajñānamiti dvayasāpekṣajñānaparyudāsenābhidhānād' iti| anyathā jñānasyājñānavirodhitvamaprāmāṇikaṃ syāt|
analyzed: nanu abhāva vilakṣaṇam api ajñānam na jānāmi iti jñāna virodhi tvena eva bhāsate moha ādi pade pi pralaya ādi pada vat tad anullekha mātram uktam ca vivaraṇe ajñānam iti dvaya sāpekṣa jñāna paryudāsena abhidhānāt iti anyathā jñānasya ajñāna virodhi tvam aprāmāṇikam syāt

original: tathā ca virodhanirūpakajñānasya jñānājñānābhyāṃ tavāpi kathaṃ na vyāghātaḥ? evaṃ nirviṣayājñānāpratīterviṣayajñānājñānayorapi vyāghāta āpadanīyaḥ| tathā ca

analyzed: iti nyāyena ubhaya pariharaṇīyasya vyāghātasya jñāna abhāva pakṣe eva āpādanam anucitam iti ced na pramāṇa vṛtti nivartyasya api bhāva rūpa ajñānasya sākṣi vedyasya virodha nirūpaka jñāna tad vyāvartaka viṣaya grāhakeṇa sākṣiṇā tad sādhakena tad anāśāt vyāhati anupapatteḥ ajñāna grahe viṣaya gocara pramā apekṣāyām vyāhatiḥ syāt eva sā ca na asti

original: taduktaṃ vivaraṇe -- `sarvaṃ vastu jñātatayā'jñātatayā vā sākṣicaitanyasya viṣaya eva'iti| na caivaṃ jñānābhāvapakṣe'pi viṣayādijñānaṃ sākṣirūpam| `na jānāmi' iti dhīstu pramāṇavṛttyabhāvaviṣayeti na vyāhatiriti -- vācyam|
analyzed: tat uktam vivaraṇe sarvam vastu jñāta tayā ajñāta tayā vā sākṣi caitanyasya viṣayaḥ eva eti na ca evam jñāna abhāva pakṣe pi viṣaya ādi jñānam sākṣi rūpam na jānāmi iti dhīḥ tu pramāṇa vṛtti abhāva viṣayā iti na vyāhatiḥ iti vācyam

original: bhāvarūpājñānasya sākṣāt sākṣivedyatvena tadavacchedakaviṣayādestad‌dvārā sākṣivedyatvasambhave'pi abhāvasyānupalabdhigamyatvena sākṣāt sākṣivedyatvābhāvāt na tad‌dvārā tadavacchedakaviṣayādeḥ sākṣivedyatvamiti vaiṣamyāt|

original: yadyapi jñānaṃ sākṣivedyaṃ, tad‌dvārā tadavacchedako viṣayaśca sākṣivedyaḥ, tathāpi jñānābhāvo na sākṣivedyaḥ, tasyānupalabdhatvāt| utpannaṃ ca jñānaṃ sākṣāt sākṣivedyam| tasmiṃścotpanne tadviṣayo'pi sphuratīti kuto jñānābhāvo'pi? ajñānaviśeṣaṇatayā tu anutpannamapi jñānaṃ sākṣivedyamiti na doṣasāmyam|

original: na ca -- avacchedakasya viṣayādeḥ prāgajñāne kathaṃ tadviśiṣṭājñānajñānam? viśeṣaṇajñānādhīnatvādviśiṣṭajñānasyeti -- vācyam| viśeṣaṇajñānasya viśiṣṭajñānajanakatve mānābhāvāt| pratiyogitvābhāvatvayoḥ pūrvānupasthitayorapi tārkikairabhāvabodhe prakārībhūya bhānābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: na ca avacchedakasya viṣaya ādeḥ prāk ajñāne katham tad viśiṣṭa ajñāna jñānam viśeṣaṇa jñāna adhīna tvāt viśiṣṭa jñānasya iti vācyam viśeṣaṇa jñānasya viśiṣṭa jñāna janaka tve māna abhāvāt pratiyogi tva abhāva tvayoḥ pūrva anupasthitayoḥ api tārkikaiḥ abhāva bodhe prakārībhūya bhāna abhyupagamāt

original: tathāpi -- viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānaṃ vinā kathaṃ viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭabuddhiriti -- cenna| viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyabuddhitvena viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānatvena ca kāryakāraṇabhāve mānābhāvāt| pratyakṣatvādirūpeṇa pṛthak pṛthak klṛptakāryakāraṇabhāvenaivopapatteḥ viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyabuddhitvasyārthasamājasiddhatvāt|
analyzed: tathā api viśeṣaṇa tā avacchedaka prakāraka jñānam vinā katham viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭa buddhiḥ iti ced na viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya buddhi tvena viśeṣaṇa tā avacchedaka prakāraka jñāna tvena ca kārya kāraṇa bhāve māna abhāvāt pratyakṣa tva ādi rūpeṇa pṛthak pṛthak klṛpta kārya kāraṇa bhāvena eva upapatteḥ viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya buddhi tvasya artha samāja siddha tvāt

original: iha ca sāmagrītulyatvena `viśeṣye viśeṣaṇaṃ tatra ca viśeṣaṇāntaram' iti nyāyena viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyajñānasambhavāt| anyathā tārkikāṇāmapīśvarasya bhrāntijñatvaṃ na syāt| bhramaviṣayasya svātantryeṇa grahe bhrāntatvāpattyā bhramāvacchedakatayaiva tad‌grahaṇaṃ vācyam|
analyzed: iha ca sāmagrī tulya tvena viśeṣye viśeṣaṇam tatra ca viśeṣaṇa antaram iti nyāyena viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñāna sambhavāt anyathā tārkikāṇām api īśvarasya bhrāntijñatvam na syāt bhrama viṣayasya svātantryeṇa grahe bhrānta tva āpattyā bhrama avacchedaka tayā eva tad grahaṇam vācyam

original: nanvevaṃ -- `na jānāmi' iti dhiyo jñānābhāvaviṣayatve'pi na pratiyogijñānādinā vyāhatiḥ| sāmānyato viṣayapratiyogijñāne'pi viśeṣatastadabhāvasambhavāt| anyathā prāgabhāvadhīrna syāt| tatpratiyogiviśeṣasya sāmānyadharmaṃ vinā viśeṣato jñātumaśakyatvāditi -- cenna|

original: viśeṣajñānābhāve hi viśeṣajñānatvāvacchinnaṃ pratiyogīti tasya jñāne sa viśeṣo'pi jñāta eveti viśeṣajñānābhāvavyāghātāt| yatkiñcidviśeṣābhāvaśca na sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitāka ityuktam| pratiyogitāvacchedakaprakārakajñānābhāvena prāgabhāvapratītirasiddhaiva| nanu -- pratiyogitāvacchedakaprakārakajñānaṃ nābhāvajñāne kāraṇam|

original: kiṃtvabhāvajñāne bhāsamānapratiyogivṛttidharmaprakārakaṃ jñānam| sāmānyalakṣaṇapratyāsattyabhyupagame tu pratiyogiviṣayatvamapi tasyādhikam| itarathā tu tadeva iṣṭavṛttisāmānyadharmaprakārakajñānamivāsiddhavyaktiviṣayecchākṛtyoḥ| na ca -- pratiyogitānavacchedakadharmeṇa kathaṃ pratiyogitā gṛhyatāmiti -- vācyam|
analyzed: kiṃtu abhāva jñāne bhāsamāna pratiyogi vṛtti dharma prakārakam jñānam sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratyāsatti abhyupagame tu pratiyogi viṣaya tvam api tasya adhikam itarathā tu tat eva iṣṭa vṛtti sāmānya dharma prakāraka jñānam iva asiddha vyakti viṣaya icchā kṛtyoḥ na ca pratiyogitā anavacchedaka dharmeṇa katham pratiyogitā gṛhyatām iti vācyam

original: viśeṣāvacchinnāyā vyāpteriva sāmānyena grahaṇasambhavāt| tathā hi -- `idamabhidheyavat, prameyāt' ityanumāne `yatra prameyaṃ tatrābhidheyam' iti vyāptigrahaṇasamaye vṛttimatprameyatvāvacchedenaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyarūpavyāptisattve'pi tasyāḥ prameyatvarūpeṇaiva grahaṇaṃ, na tu vṛttimatprameyatvena, gauravāt|
analyzed: viśeṣa avacchinnāyāḥ vyāpteḥ iva sāmānyena grahaṇa sambhavāt tathā hi idam abhidheya vat prameyāt iti anumāne yatra prameyam tatra abhidheyam iti vyāpti grahaṇa samaye vṛttimat prameya tva avacchedena eva sāmānādhikaraṇya rūpa vyāpti sattve pi tasyāḥ prameya tva rūpeṇa eva grahaṇam na tu vṛttimat prameya tvena gauravāt

original: vṛttimattvaviśeṣaṇasya vyabhicārāvārakatvena vaiyarthyācca| avṛttiṣu sādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyarūpavyāptyabhāvavat sādhyābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyarūpavyabhicārasyāpyabhāvāt| vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvarahitatve sati vyabhicārivyāvṛttatvamātreṇaiva vyāpyatāvacchedakatvasambhavācca|
analyzed: vṛttimat tva viśeṣaṇasya vyabhicāra āvāraka tvena vaiyarthyāt ca avṛttiṣu sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇya rūpa vyāpti abhāva vat sādhya abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇya rūpa vyabhicārasya api abhāvāt vyartha viśeṣaṇa tva rahita tve sati vyabhicāri vyāvṛtta tva mātreṇa eva vyāpya tā avacchedaka tva sambhavāt ca

original: tathā ca yathā vṛttimatprameyagatāpi vyāptiḥ prameyatvenaiva gṛhyate, tathā tattannīlādivyaktigatā pratiyogitā nīlatvādirūpeṇa gṛhyata iti na kācidanupapattiḥ| evaṃ ca `ihedānīṃ' ghaṭo nāsti' iti pratītiriva ghaṭopādānagatatatprāgabhāvaviṣayā `mayi jñānaṃ nāsti' iti pratītirapi pramātṛgatatatprāgabhāvaviṣaye'ti na kāpyanupapattiriti -- cenna|
analyzed: tathā ca yathā vṛttimat prameya gatā api vyāptiḥ prameya tvena eva gṛhyate tathā tat tat nīla ādi vyakti gatā pratiyogitā nīla tva ādi rūpeṇa gṛhyate iti na kācid anupapattiḥ evam ca iha idānīm ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratītiḥ iva ghaṭa upādāna gata tad prāgabhāva viṣayā mayi jñānam na asti iti pratītiḥ api pramātṛ gata tad prāgabhāva viṣayā iti na kā api anupapattiḥ iti ced na

original: abhāvajñāne pratiyogyaṃśe bhāsamānasya dharmasyaiva pratiyogitāvacchedakatayā yatkiñcidviśeṣābhāvasya sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatve ghaṭavatyapi bhūtale `nirghaṭa bhūtalam' iti, ghaṭajñānavatyapi svasmin `mayi ghaṭajñānaṃ nāsti' iti ca pratīterāpatteḥ pūrvoktadoṣāt|
analyzed: abhāva jñāne pratiyogi aṃśe bhāsamānasya dharmasya eva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tayā yat kiñcid viśeṣa abhāvasya sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tve ghaṭavati api bhū tale nirghaṭa bhū talam iti ghaṭa jñānavati api svasmin mayi ghaṭa jñānam na asti iti ca pratīteḥ āpatteḥ pūrva ukta doṣāt

original: yatkiñcid‌ghaṭajñanaṃ ghaṭābhāvajñāne pratibandhakamiti tu jñānajñāne'pi tulyam| udāhṛtavyāptigrahaṇe tu bādhakābhāvāt sāmānyāvacchede'pi na doṣaḥ|
analyzed: yat kiñcid ghaṭa jñanam ghaṭa abhāva jñāne pratibandhakam iti tu jñāna jñāne api tulyam udāhṛta vyāpti grahaṇe tu bādhaka abhāvāt sāmānya avacchede api na doṣaḥ

original: athaivaṃ prāgabhāvapratītireva na syāt| na syādeva| `ghaṭo bhaviṣyati' iti pratīteḥ dhātvarthabhaviṣyattāviṣayatvena prāgabhāvāviṣayatvāt| anyathā dināntarotpatsyamānaghaṭe etaddinavṛttiprāgabhāvapratiyogitvena `adya ghaṭo bhaviṣyati' iti dhīprasaṅgaḥ| bhaviṣyattvaṃ ca pratiyogitad‌dhvaṃsānādhārakālasambandhitvam|
analyzed: atha evam prāgabhāva pratītiḥ eva na syāt na syāt eva ghaṭaḥ bhaviṣyati iti pratīteḥ dhātvartha bhaviṣyat tā viṣaya tvena prāgabhāva aviṣaya tvāt anyathā dina antara utpatsyamāna ghaṭe etad dina vṛtti prāgabhāva pratiyogi tvena adya ghaṭaḥ bhaviṣyati iti dhī prasaṅgaḥ bhaviṣyat tvam ca pratiyogi tad dhvaṃsa anādhāra kāla sambandhi tvam

original: dhvaṃsatvaṃ ca prāgabhāvānaṅgīkartṛmate kādācitkābhāvatvameva| tadaṅgīkartṛmate'pi pratiyogyajanakakādācitkābhāvatvam| janakatvaṃ ca svarūpasambandhaviśeṣo na prāgabhāvaghaṭitaḥ| prāgabhāvasyājanakatvāpatteḥ| anyathātmāśrayāt| ataḥ prāgabhāvamaṅgīkurvato'pi tatpratyakṣatvaṃ durlabham| tamanaṅgīkurvatastu na kā'pi hāniḥ|
analyzed: dhvaṃsa tvam ca prāgabhāva anaṅgīkartṛ mate kādācitka abhāva tvam eva tad aṅgīkartṛ mate pi pratiyogi ajanaka kādācitka abhāva tvam janaka tvam ca svarūpa sambandha viśeṣaḥ na prāgabhāva ghaṭitaḥ prāgabhāvasya ajanaka tva āpatteḥ anyathā ātma āśrayāt atas prāgabhāvam aṅgīkurvataḥ api tad pratyakṣa tvam durlabham tam anaṅgīkurvataḥ tu na kā api hāniḥ

original: `ihedānīṃ ghaṭo nāsti' iti pratītistu sāmānyadharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākatatkālāvacchinnayāvadviśeṣabhāvaviṣayā, samayaviśeṣasyāpyabhāvavācchedakatvāt| anyathā `ādyakṣaṇe ghaṭo nīrūpaḥ' ityādipratītirna syāt|
analyzed: iha idānīm ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratītiḥ tu sāmānya dharma avacchinna pratiyogitāka tad kāla avacchinna yāvat viśeṣa bhāva viṣayā samaya viśeṣasya api abhāvavān chedaka tvāt anyathā ādi akṣaṇe ghaṭaḥ nīrūpaḥ ityādi pratītiḥ na syāt

original: atha -- asminpakṣe sāmānyābhāvo na sidhyediti -- cet, prāgabhāvābhyupagame'pi tulyametat| sāmānyābhāvaprāgabhāvayoḥ sundopasundayoriva parasparaparāhatatvāt| tathā hi -- prāgabhāvasiddhau viśeṣābhāvasyāpi sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvāt na tāvanmātrapramāṇakasāmānyābhāvasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: atha asmin pakṣe sāmānya abhāvaḥ na sidhyet iti ced prāgabhāva abhyupagame api tulyam etat sāmānya abhāva prāgabhāvayoḥ sunda upasundayoḥ iva paraspara parāhata tvāt tathā hi prāgabhāva siddhau viśeṣa abhāvasya api sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvāt na tāvat mātra pramāṇaka sāmānya abhāva siddhiḥ

original: sāmānyābhāvasiddhau ca viśeṣābhāvasya sāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvābhāvāt kādācitkābhāvasya ca sāmānyābhāvatvāyogāt na sāmānyadharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākaviśeṣapratītimātraśaraṇaprāgabhāvasiddhiriti na tadubhayamapi vipaścitāṃ cetasi camatkāramāvahati|
analyzed: sāmānya abhāva siddhau ca viśeṣa abhāvasya sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitāka tva abhāvāt kādācitka abhāvasya ca sāmānya abhāva tva ayogāt na sāmānya dharma avacchinna pratiyogitāka viśeṣa pratīti mātra śaraṇa prāgabhāva siddhiḥ iti na tat ubhayam api vipaścitām cetasi camatkāram āvahati

original: nanu -- yāvadviśeṣābhāvaniścaye'pi `rūpaṃ vāyuvṛtti na vā', `vāyū rūpavānna vā' iti rūpābhāvasandehāt niścite ca saṃśayāyogādyāvadviśeṣābhāvānyasāmānyābhāvasiddhiḥ| ata etāvantyeva rūpāṇīti niścayadaśāyāmetādṛśasaṃśayasyānanubhūyamānatvena tadaniścayadaśāyāmevaitādṛśaḥ saṃśayo vācya|
analyzed: nanu yāvat viśeṣa abhāva niścaye api rūpam vāyu vṛtti na vā vāyuḥ rūpavān na vā iti rūpa abhāva sandehāt niścite ca saṃśaya ayogāt yāvat viśeṣa abhāva anya sāmānya abhāva siddhiḥ atas etāvanti eva rūpāṇi iti niścaya daśāyām etādṛśa saṃśayasya ananubhūyamāna tvena tad aniścaya daśāyām eva etādṛśaḥ saṃśayaḥ vācyaḥ

original: tathā ca `rūpatvaṃ pārthivāpyataijasarūpannitayātiriktavṛtti bhaviṣyati' ityadhikasaṃbhāvanayā aniściteṣveva saṃśayaḥ| uktasambhāvanāvirahasahakṛtaniścayasyaiva pratibandhakatvāditi -- cenna| evaṃ pratibandhakakalpane mānābhāvād| uktasambhavanāvirahadaśāyā mapyetādṛśasaṃśayadarśanācca|
analyzed: tathā ca rūpa tvam bhaviṣyati iti adhika saṃbhāvanayā aniściteṣu eva saṃśayaḥ ukta sambhāvanā viraha sahakṛta niścayasya eva pratibandhaka tvāt iti ced na evam pratibandhaka kalpane māna abhāvāt ukta sambhavanā viraha daśāyām api etādṛśa saṃśaya darśanāt ca

original: nanu -- yathā yāvadviśeṣābhāvebhyo'tiriktaḥ sāmānyābhāvo rūpasya saṃśayakoṭiḥ, tathā rūpasāmānyamapi yāvadviśeṣebhyo'tiriktaṃ saṃśayakoṭirnābhyupagantuṃ śakyate| tathā ca kathaṃ rūpasya saṃśayakoṭitvam? sarvarūpābhāvaniścayāt|
analyzed: nanu yathā yāvat viśeṣa abhāvebhyaḥ utiriktaḥ sāmānya abhāvaḥ rūpasya saṃśaya koṭiḥ tathā rūpa sāmānyam api yāvat viśeṣebhyaḥ utiriktam saṃśaya koṭiḥ na abhyupagantum śakyate tathā ca katham rūpasya saṃśaya koṭi tvam sarva rūpa abhāva niścayāt

original: yadi tu nīlapītādyabhāvatvena niścaye'pi rūpābhāvatvenāniścayādrūpasaṃśaya iti brūṣe, tadā kiṃ sāmānyābhāvena? rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvatvena saṃśayasambhavāt| dharmikalpanāto dharmakalpanāyā laghutvena yāvadviśeṣābhāvānāmeva rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvakalpanād|
analyzed: yadi tu nīla pīta ādi abhāva tvena niścaye pi rūpa abhāva tvena aniścayāt rūpa saṃśayaḥ iti brūṣe tadā kim sāmānya abhāvena rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāva tvena saṃśaya sambhavāt dharmi kalpanātaḥ dharma kalpanāyāḥ laghu tvena yāvat viśeṣa abhāvānām eva rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tva kalpanāt

original: ato na yatkiñcidabhāvamādāya `ghaṭo nīrūpaḥ' iti pratitiprasaṅga iti -- cenna| yāvadviśeṣābhāveṣu yadrūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ, tat pratyekaviśrāntaṃ, vyāsajyavṛtti vā? ādye yatkiñcidabhāvamādāya `ghaṭo nīrūpaḥ' iti pratītiprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: atas na yat kiñcid abhāvam ādāya ghaṭaḥ nīrūpaḥ iti pratiti prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na yāvat viśeṣa abhāveṣu yat rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam tat pratyeka viśrāntam vyāsajya vṛtti vā ādye yat kiñcid abhāvam ādāya ghaṭaḥ nīrūpaḥ iti pratīti prasaṅgaḥ

original: dvitīye, tattadrūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvasyāvyāsajyavṛttisvabhāvatvena tadvyatiriktaṃ rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ vyāsajyavṛtti kalpanīyam| tadvaraṃ rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitāka eka evābhāvaḥ kalpyate| mamaiko'bhāvaḥ rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ ceti vastudvayaṃ kalpyam|
analyzed: dvitīye tad tad rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvasya avyāsajya vṛtti svabhāva tvena tad vyatiriktam rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam vyāsajya vṛtti kalpanīyam tat varam rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitākaḥ ekaḥ eva abhāvaḥ kalpyate mama ekaḥ bhāvaḥ rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam ca iti vastu dvayam kalpyam

original: tava tu rūpatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ tasya ca vyāsajyavṛttitvena bahuṣvabhāveṣu pratyekaṃ saṃbandhā iti bahu kalpyam| `dharmikalpanāto dharmakalpanāyā laghutvam' iti nyāyastu kalpanīyādhikyāpekṣaḥ| kiṃ ca ghaṭadvaye yāvadviśeṣābhāvasattve'pi rūpasāmānyābhāvabuddhyanudayād aikādhikaraṇyāvacchedenāpyabhāvā viśeṣaṇīyāḥ| tathā cātigauravam|
analyzed: tava tu rūpa tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam tasya ca vyāsajya vṛtti tvena bahuṣu abhāveṣu pratyekam saṃbandhāḥ iti bahu kalpyam dharmi kalpanātaḥ dharma kalpanāyāḥ laghu tvam iti nyāyaḥ tu kalpanīya ādhikya apekṣaḥ kim ca ghaṭa dvaye yāvat viśeṣa abhāva sattve pi rūpa sāmānya abhāva buddhi anudayāt aika adhikaraṇya avacchedena api abhāvāḥ viśeṣaṇīyāḥ tathā ca ati gauravam

original: api ca vyāsajyavṛttidharmagrahe yāvadāśrayagrahastadbhedagrahaśca hetuḥ| agṛhīteṣvabhinnatayā vā gṛhīteṣu vastrādiṣu dvitvādibuddhyanudayāt| tathā ca yāvadabhāvatadbhedāgrahe prathamata eva nīrūpa iti dhīrna syāt| vyāsajyavṛttisāmānyapratiyogitākatvasyāgrahaṇāt|
analyzed: api ca vyāsajya vṛtti dharma grahe yāvat āśraya grahaḥ tad bheda grahaḥ ca hetuḥ agṛhīteṣu abhinna tayā vā gṛhīteṣu vastra ādiṣu dvi tva ādi buddhi anudayāt tathā ca yāvat abhāva tad bheda agrahe prathamatas eva nīrūpaḥ iti dhīḥ na syāt vyāsajya vṛtti sāmānya pratiyogitāka tvasya agrahaṇāt

original: ataḥ sāmānyābhāvasya prāmāṇikatvāt kathaṃ tatparāhatiriti -- cet, atra brūmaḥ -- evaṃ tarhi sāmānyaprakāreṇa viśeṣābhāvāpratīterjñānaviśeṣaprāgabhāvo na jānāmīti dhiyo jñānatvāvacchinnapratiyogitāko na viṣaya iti siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam| na hi prāgābhāvo'pi kaścitsāmānyābhāvo'sti|
analyzed: atas sāmānya abhāvasya prāmāṇika tvāt katham tad parāhatiḥ iti ced atra brūmaḥ evam tarhi sāmānya prakāreṇa viśeṣa abhāva apratīteḥ jñāna viśeṣa prāgabhāvaḥ na jānāmi iti dhiyaḥ jñāna tva avacchinna pratiyogitākaḥ na viṣayaḥ iti siddham naḥ samīhitam na hi prāgābhāvaḥ api kaścid sāmānya abhāvaḥ asti

original: yena tatpratiyogitā sāmānyadharmeṇāvacchidyeta, viśeṣābhāvapratiyogitā tu tattad‌ghaṭatvādinā viśeṣeṇāvacchidyate| na ca tena tena rūpeṇa bhaviṣyaddhaṭādi jñātuṃ śakyam| tajjanmāntaraṃ tu tattadrūpeṇa tajjñānasambhave'pi na prāgabhāvadhīḥ pratyakṣā syāt| tadānīṃ prāgabhāvāsattvāt| pratyakṣasya viṣayajanyatvāt|
analyzed: yena tad pratiyogitā sāmānya dharmeṇa avacchidyeta viśeṣa abhāva pratiyogitā tu tat tat ghaṭa tva ādinā viśeṣeṇa avacchidyate na ca tena tena rūpeṇa bhaviṣyat dhaṭa ādi jñātum śakyam tad janma antaram tu tad tad rūpeṇa tad jñāna sambhave pi na prāgabhāva dhīḥ pratyakṣā syāt tadānīm prāgabhāva asattvāt pratyakṣasya viṣaya janya tvāt

original: evaṃ cāvṛttīnāṃ gaganādīnāṃ samaniyatānāṃ cā'nyeṣāṃ dharmāṇāmeka evātyantābhāvaḥ, yugapadvinaṣṭānāmutpannānāṃ vā samānadeśānāmasati bādhake eka eva dhvaṃsaḥ prāgabhāvo vā, vyadhikaraṇadharmāvacchinnapratiyogitāko'pi cedabhāvaḥ prāmāṇikaḥ tadā tasyaikasyaiva pratiyogitāḥ savairaiva vyadhikaraṇaiḥ sarvaiśca samānādhikaraṇaiḥ

original: ata eva vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ svābhyupagatakālapadārthasyaiva sarvavyavahārahetutvopapattau na padārthāntarasiddhirityadvaitavādino vadanti| tadevaṃ `ahamajñaḥ' iti jñānasyābhāvajñānasāmagrīvilakṣaṇasāmagrījanyatvādabhāvavilakṣaṇaviṣayatvaṃ siddham|

analyzed: evam tvad uktam artham na jānāmi iti pratyakṣasya api nanu sākṣāt tvad ukta artha viṣayam pramāṇa jñānam mayi na asti iti etad viṣayakam udāhṛta jñānam tat ca na sākṣāt artha viṣayam pramāṇa jñāna avacchedaka tayā arthasya bhānāt atas na vyāghātaḥ iti ced na sākṣāt tvad ukta artham avetya hi tad abhāvaḥ grāhyaḥ tad jñānam ca na sākṣiṇā

original: asya jñānasya jñāne viśeṣye viśeṣaprakarakatvaprakārakatvāt| yatrāpi `tvaduktaviśeṣaṃ na jānāmi' ityabhilāpaḥ, tatrāpyevameva vyāhatyabhāvaḥ kathaṃcidunneyaḥ| na ca yatroktapratiyogyaprasiddhiḥ tatra kathamabhāvapratītiriti -- vācyam|

original: samavetavācyatvaṃ nāstītyatreva viśeṣye viśeṣaṇābhāvaviṣayatvena vyadhikaraṇadharmāvacchinna pratiyogitākābhāvaviṣayatvena vopapatteriti -- cenna| anubhavavirodhād| viśeṣajñānābhāvasya tvaduktārthajñānābhāvasya vā'nabhyupagame tadviṣayajñānasattvena tadvyavahārāpatteśca| na caivaṃ dṛśyate|

original: avinaśyatā tu tena svayameva tatkāryasya janayituṃ śakyatvāt kimiti saṃskāro janyeta? na hi saṃskāro'pi pratyakṣaḥ| yena kāryānyathānupapattimantareṇāpi abhyupeyeta|
analyzed: avinaśyatā tu tena svayam eva tat kāryasya janayitum śakya tvāt kim iti saṃskāraḥ janyeta na hi saṃskāraḥ api pratyakṣaḥ yena kārya anyathā anupapattim antareṇa api abhyupeyeta

original: jñānasāmagrīvirahaśca jñānābhāvānumeyatvenānyonyāśrayagrastaḥ| na cedānīntanenendriyaprasādena pūrvakālīnaṃ taduparamamanumāya sāmagrīvirahānumānam| indriyaprasādasya sukhānubhavahetukasya taduparamahetukatvāsiddheḥ| niyamenāsmaryamāṇatvaṃ ca yathāśrutaṃ vā suṣuptikālāvacchedeneti vā? ādye asiddhiḥ| dvitīye tūpekṣaṇīyajñānābhāvo na sidhyet|

analyzed: na ca suṣupti kāle jñāna abhāva anumāna artham bhāva rūpa ajñānam iva rāga abhāva anumā artham dveṣaḥ api svīkaraṇīyaḥ tad virodhi padārtha anubhavam vinā tad abhāva anumāna ayogāt iti vācyam bhāva rūpa ajñānena jñāna abhāvena vā rāga abhāva anumāna sambhavāt tasya api tad virodhi tvāt atha aparokṣataḥ jñāte tu ajñāna abhāvāt katham parokṣa jñāna abhāva anumānam sāmagrī viraha ādinā iti gṛhāṇa

original: na cātrāpyanyonyāśrayaḥ| śabdādīnāṃ yogyānāṃ yogyanupalabdhyā abhāvaniścayena parokṣajñānavirahajñānaṃ vinaiva sāmagrīvirahaniścayāt| suṣuptikāle cendriyādighaṭitasāmagrīvirahasya phalābhāvaṃ vinā jñātumaśakyatvenānyonyāśrayokteḥ| na ca smaraṇapakṣe saṃskārānupapattiḥ| ajñānasyājñānavṛttipratibimbitasākṣibhāsyatvena vṛttināśādeva saṃskāropapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca atra api anyonya āśrayaḥ śabda ādīnām yogyānām yogi anupalabdhyāḥ abhāva niścayena parokṣa jñāna viraha jñānam vinā eva sāmagrī viraha niścayāt suṣupti kāle ca indriya ādi ghaṭita sāmagrī virahasya phala abhāvam vinā jñātum aśakya tvena anyonya āśraya ukteḥ na ca smaraṇa pakṣe saṃskāra anupapattiḥ ajñānasya ajñāna vṛtti pratibimbita sākṣi bhāsya tvena vṛtti nāśāt eva saṃskāra upapatteḥ

original: ajñānavṛttipratibimbitacaitanyasyaiva sākṣipadārthatvāt| na ca -- jāgare'pyajñānasya vṛttivedyatve vṛttyabhāvadaśāyāṃ saṃśayādyāpattiriti -- vācyam| ajñānaviṣayājñānābhāvena tadayogāt| saṃśayādestatkāraṇībhūtājñānasamānaviṣayatvaniyamāt| bhāvatvādinā saṃśaye tviṣṭāpattireva| bhāvatvādeḥ sākṣivedyatvābhāvenājñānaviṣayatvād|
analyzed: ajñāna vṛtti pratibimbita caitanyasya eva sākṣi padārtha tvāt na ca jāgare pi ajñānasya vṛtti vedya tve vṛtti abhāva daśāyām saṃśaya ādi āpattiḥ iti vācyam ajñāna viṣaya ajñāna abhāvena tad ayogāt saṃśaya ādeḥ tad kāraṇībhūta ajñāna samāna viṣayatva niyamāt bhāva tva ādinā saṃśaye tu iṣṭa āpattiḥ eva bhāva tva ādeḥ sākṣi vedya tva abhāvena ajñāna viṣayatvāt

original: ajñānasya svarūpeṇaiva sākṣivedyatvāt| nanu -- tadā jñānābhāvo'pi svarūpeṇaiva bhāsatām| sapratiyogikatvenābhāvajñāna eva pratiyogijñānasya hetutvād| anyathā `prameyam' iti jñāne'pyabhāvo na bhāseteticenna| sākṣiṇā tāvanna svarūpeṇābhāvāvagāhanam| tasya sākṣātsākṣyavedyatvāt| nāpi śabdādinā| tadānīṃ teṣāmabhāvāt| nāpyanupalabdhyā|
analyzed: ajñānasya sva rūpeṇa eva sākṣi vedya tvāt nanu tadā jñāna abhāvaḥ api sva rūpeṇa eva bhāsatām sapratiyogika tvena abhāva jñāne eva pratiyogi jñānasya hetu tvāt anyathā prameyam iti jñāne pi abhāvaḥ na bhāseta iti ced na sākṣiṇā tāvat na sva rūpeṇa abhāva avagāhanam tasya sākṣāt sākṣya vedya tvāt nā api śabda ādinā tadānīm teṣām abhāvāt nā api anupalabdhyā

original: tasyāḥ pratiyogijñānanirapekṣāyā ajanakatvāt| na ca -- dṛṣṭābhāvāntaravilakṣaṇasvabhāva evāyamabhāva iti svarūpeṇa sākṣivedyo'stviti -- vācyam| nirvikalpakabuddhivedyatve bhāvatvasyaivaucityād| anyathā paribhāṣāmātrāpatteḥ| nanu jñānavirodhitvādestadā'nanubhavena `nāvediṣam' iti tenākāreṇa kathaṃ parāmarśaḥ? na|

original: draṣṭaryantaḥkaraṇatādātmyenāhamullekhasyeva jñānavirodhitvāderapi tadaivānubhūyamānatvena tadaṃśe parāmarśatvānabhyupagamāt| suṣuptikālīnasya draṣṭureva marāmṛṣṭatvāt|

original: anumānamapi tatra vivaraṇoktaṃ pramāṇam -- `vivādapadaṃ pramāṇajñānam, svaprāgabhāvavyatiriktasvaviṣayāvaraṇasvanivartyasvadeśagatavastvantarapūrvakam, aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvād, andhakāre prathamotpannapradīpaprabhāvaditi| atra pramāṇapadaṃ pramāṇavṛttereva pakṣatvena sukhādipramāyāṃ sākṣicaitanyarūpāyāmajñānānivartikāyāṃ bādhavāraṇāya|

analyzed: hetau ca prakāśaka tvam prakāśaka pada vācya tvam aprakāśa virodhi tvam vā jñāna ālokayoḥ sādhāraṇam yadi api prakāśaka pada vācya tvam nāma karaṇa vaśāt kasmiṃścid puruṣe pi asti tathā api prakāśaka śabdena śāstre sarva deśa kālayoḥ vā vyavahriyamāṇa tvam tat vivakṣitam athavā astu sādhāraṇam aprakāśita artha gocara iti viśeṣaṇāt vyabhicāra vyudāsaḥ

original: na dvitīyaḥ, caitanyasya sarvato'pi prasṛtatvena vyavadhānābhāvena ca ābhimukhyasya sadbhāvāt| na cākāśādyātmanā pariṇāme pratibimbāpāyāpattiḥ, pratibimbaprayojakarūpāvirodhipariṇāmasya pratibimbāvirodhitvena pratibimbānapāyāt|
analyzed: na dvitīyaḥ caitanyasya sarvatas pi prasṛta tvena vyavadhāna abhāvena ca ābhimukhyasya sadbhāvāt na ca ākāśa ādi ātmanā pariṇāme pratibimba apāya āpattiḥ pratibimba prayojaka rūpa avirodhi pariṇāmasya pratibimba avirodhi tvena pratibimba anapāyāt

original: na ca -- mukhapratimukhānugatamukhatvātiriktamukhamātratvarūpavyaktyantarasyeva jīvabrahmānugatacittvātiriktacinmātratvarūpasyājñānāśrayatvayogyavyaktyantara syābhāvānmukhamātrasambandhyādarśavacchinmātrasambandhyajñānamiti katham iti vācyam, aparāmṛṣṭabhedasya mukhādermātrāparthatvenānugatadharmyatirekasambhavāt|
analyzed: na ca mukha pratimukha anugata mukha tva atirikta mukha mātra tva rūpa vyakti antarasya iva jīva brahma anugata cittva atirikta cinmātra tva rūpasya ajñāna āśraya tva yogya vyakti antara sya abhāvāt mukha mātra sambandhya ādarśa vat chid mātra sambandhya jñānam iti katham iti vācyam aparāmṛṣṭa bhedasya mukha ādeḥ mātra apartha tvena anugata dharmi atireka sambhavāt

original: nanu -- upādhiḥ pratibimbapakṣapātīti sāmānyavyāpterajñānaṃ svāśraya eva bhrāntyādiheturiti viśeṣavyāptyā bādha iti cenna, viśeṣavyāptigrāhakasahacāradarśanasya vivādaviṣayātirikte'sambhavena viśeṣavyāptyasambhavāt| na ca bandhasya cinmātrāśritamokṣasāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiḥ, avacchedyāṃśamādāya sāmānādhikaraṇyasyoktatvāt|
analyzed: nanu upādhiḥ pratibimba pakṣapātī iti sāmānya vyāpteḥ ajñānam sva āśrayaḥ eva bhrānti ādi hetuḥ iti viśeṣa vyāptyā bādhaḥ iti ced na viśeṣa vyāpti grāhaka sahacāra darśanasya vivāda viṣaya atirikta isambhavena viśeṣa vyāpti asambhavāt na ca bandhasya cit mātra āśrita mokṣa sāmānādhikaraṇya anupapattiḥ avacchedya aṃśam ādāya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ukta tvāt

original: nanu -- upādheḥ pratibimbapakṣapātitvaṃ tatra svadharmapratibhāsakatvaṃ vā? svakāryapratibhāsakatvaṃ vā? svakāryaniṣṭhadharmapratibhāsakatvaṃ vā? pratibimbaṃ prati svaviṣayācchādakatvaṃ vā? nādyaḥ, suṣuptyādyanuvṛttasyāvidyārūpasyāvidyāvacchinnatvarūpasya vā, tatpratibimbitatvasya vā,suṣuptyādāvananuvṛttasya kartṛtvapramātṛtvādirūpasya vā
analyzed: nanu upādheḥ pratibimba pakṣapāti tvam tatra sva dharma pratibhāsaka tvam vā sva kārya pratibhāsaka tvam vā sva kārya niṣṭha dharma pratibhāsaka tvam vā pratibimbam prati sva viṣaya ācchādaka tvam vā na ādyaḥ suṣupti ādi anuvṛttasya avidyā rūpasya avidyā avacchinna tva rūpasya vā tad pratibimbita tvasya vā a suṣupti ādau ananuvṛttasya kartṛ tva pramātṛ tva ādi rūpasya vā

original: saṃsārasyājñānaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt| jñānakriyāsaṃskārādīnāṃ tvanmate ajñānaniṣṭhatve'pi nityātīndriyāṇāṃ teṣāmātmani kadāpyapratiteḥ| `avidyāstamayo mokṣaḥ sā ca bandha udāhṛtaḥ|' iti tvanmate'pi avidyā bandhikā bandho vā, na tu baddhā, yena svaniṣṭhabandharūpadharmasaṃkrāmakatvaṃ syāt|
analyzed: saṃsārasya ajñāna niṣṭhatva abhāvāt jñāna kriyā saṃskāra ādīnām tvad mate ajñāna niṣṭhatve pi nitya atīndriyāṇām teṣām ātmani kadāpi apratiteḥ avidyā astamayaḥ mokṣaḥ sā ca bandhaḥ udāhṛtaḥ iti tvad mate pi avidyā bandhikā bandhaḥ vā na tu baddhā yena sva niṣṭha bandha rūpa dharma saṃkrāmaka tvam syāt

original: na dvitīyaḥ, vicchedāderupādhikāryasya bimbe mahākāśe ca darśanāt, mukhasya bimbatvāderbrahmasthasārvajñyādeścānaupādhikatvāpātācca| nāpi tṛtīyacaturthau, darpaṇaghaṭādāvadṛṣṭeḥ| evaṃ buddhirūpopādhirapi na pratibimbapakṣapātīti cenna, atiśayena kāryakaratvameva tatpakṣapātitvam|
analyzed: na dvitīyaḥ viccheda ādeḥ upādhi kāryasya bimbe mahākāśe ca darśanāt mukhasya bimba tva ādeḥ brahma stha sārvajñya ādeḥ ca anaupādhika tva āpātāt ca nā api tṛtīya caturthau darpaṇa ghaṭa ādau adṛṣṭeḥ evam buddhi rūpa upādhiḥ api na pratibimba pakṣapātī iti ced na atiśayena kārya karatvam eva tad pakṣapāti tvam

original: tathā ca vicchedādirūpakāryakaratvasāmye'pi sthaulyādyavabhāsarūpakāryakaratvena darpaṇādeḥ pratibimbapakṣapātitvavat kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādisaṃsārarūpakāryakaratvenāvidyāyāmapi pratibimbapakṣapātitvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca viccheda ādi rūpa kārya karatva sāmye pi sthaulya ādi avabhāsa rūpa kārya karatvena darpaṇa ādeḥ pratibimba pakṣapāti tva vat kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādi saṃsāra rūpa kārya karatvena avidyāyām api pratibimba pakṣapāti tva upapatteḥ

original: yattūktaṃ mukhādigataṃ bimbatvaṃ brahmagataṃ sārvajñyādikaṃ cānaupādhikaṃ syāditi| tanna, upādhau bimbakāryakaratvameva netīti na brūmaḥ kintu pratibimbe atiśayeneti| yadapi buddhirūpopādherapi na prabimbapakṣapātitvam, tasya pratibimbāpakṣapātijapākusumasthānīyatvena tatpakṣapātyādarśasthānoyatvābhāvāditi|
analyzed: yat tu uktam mukha ādi gatam bimba tvam brahma gatam sārvajñya ādikam ca anaupādhikam syāt iti tat na upādhau bimba kārya karatvam eva na iti iti na brūmaḥ kintu pratibimbe atiśayena iti yat api buddhi rūpa upādheḥ api na prabimba pakṣapāti tvam tasya pratibimba a pakṣapāti japā kusuma sthānīya tvena tad pakṣapāti ādarśa sthānoya tva abhāvāt iti

original: tanna, svaniṣṭhasthaulyāvabhāsakatvenādarśasyevāsyāpi svaniṣṭhadharmāvabhāsakatvena tadvat pakṣa pātitvasambhavāt| tasmādavidyākṛtavicchedena brahmaṇyeva nityamuktatvasaṃsāritvasarvajñatvakiñcijjñatvādivyavasthopapattiḥ|
analyzed: tat na sva niṣṭha sthaulya avabhāsaka tvena ādarśasya iva asya api sva niṣṭha dharma avabhāsaka tvena tadvat pakṣa pāti tva sambhavāt tasmāt avidyā kṛta vicchedena brahmaṇi eva nitya mukta tva saṃsāri tva sarvajña tva kiñcijjña tva ādi vyavasthā upapattiḥ

original: etena asarvajñatvādinānubhavasiddhājjīvāt anyasya cetanasyābhāvena sārvajñyādiśrutirniviṣayā syāt, ekajīvavāde saṃsāryasaṃsārivyavasthā'yogād `dvā suparṇā' `ya ātmani tiṣṭhan ityādiśrutibhiḥ `anyaśca paramo rājan tathā'nyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ|' `tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha paraṃtapa' ityādismṛtibhiḥ `śārīraścobhaye'pi hi bhedenainamadhīyate'
analyzed: etena asarvajña tva ādinā anubhava siddhāt jīvāt anyasya cetanasya abhāvena sārvajñya ādi śrutiḥ niviṣayā syāt eka jīva vāde saṃsārya saṃsāri vyavasthā yogāt dvā suparṇā ye ātmani tiṣṭhan ityādi śrutibhiḥ anyaḥ ca paramaḥ rājan tathā anyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ tāni aham veda sarvāṇi na tvam vettha paraṃtapaḥ ityādi smṛtibhiḥ śārīraḥ ca ubhaye api hi bhedena enam adhīyate

original: `bhedavyapadeśācca' ityādisūtraiḥ `tasmācchārīrādanya eveśvaraḥ| ātmānau tāvetau cetanau, ekaḥ kartā bhoktā anyastadviparīto'pahatapāpmatvādiguṇa' ityādibhāṣyaiḥ `tattvajñānasaṃsaraṇe cāvadātatvaśyāmatvādivat netaretaratrāvatiṣṭhete' ityādivivaraṇagranthaiśca virodha iti nirastam|
analyzed: bheda vyapadeśāt ca ityādi sūtraiḥ tasmāt śārīrāt anyaḥ eva īśvaraḥ ātmānau tau etau cetanau ekaḥ kartā bhoktā anyaḥ tad viparīta upahata pāpma tva ādi guṇaḥ ityādi bhāṣyaiḥ tattva jñāna saṃsaraṇe ca avadāta tva śyāma tva ādi vat na itara itaratra avatiṣṭhete ityādi vivaraṇa granthaiḥ ca virodhaḥ iti nirastam

original: nanu cinmātrasyājñānaṃ svābhāvikam? aupādhikaṃ vā? nādyaḥ, ātmavadanivṛttiprasaṅgāt| nāntyaḥ, svasyaivopādhitve ātmāśrayād, etadapekṣyānyāpekṣatve anyonyāśrayāt, tadanyānyāpekṣatve cānavasthānāditi -- cenna, svasyaivāśrayatvopādhitvāt|
analyzed: nanu cit mātrasya ajñānam svābhāvikam aupādhikam vā nā ādyaḥ ātma vat anivṛtti prasaṅgāt nā antyaḥ svasya eva upādhi tve ātma āśrayāt etat apekṣya anya apekṣa tve anyonya āśrayāt tad anya anya apekṣa tve ca anavasthānāt iti ced na svasya eva āśraya tva upādhi tvāt

original: na cātmāśrayaḥ, bhedasya svabhedakatvavadupapatteḥ, svābhāvikasyāpi ghaṭarūpasya tatpragabhāvasya ca nivṛttidarśanāt|
analyzed: na ca ātma āśrayaḥ bhedasya sva bhedaka tva vat upapatteḥ svābhāvikasya api ghaṭa rūpasya tad pragabhāvasya ca nivṛtti darśanāt

original: ityadvaitasiddhau ajñānasya cinmātrāśrayatvopapattiḥ|
analyzed: iti advaitasiddhau ajñānasya cit mātra āśraya tva upapattiḥ

original: nanu -- śuddhabrahmaṇaḥ cinmātrasyājñānāśrayatve sārvajñyavirodhaḥ| na ca viśiṣṭa eva sārvajñyam, `turīyaṃ sarvadṛksadā' iti śuddhasyaiva sarvajñatvokteriti cenna, sarvadṛkpadena sarveṣāṃ dṛgbhūtaṃ caitanyamityucyate, na tu sarvajñaṃ turīyam, tasmādviśiṣṭa eva sārvajñyam| taccāvidyāṃ vinā na sambhavatītyavidyāsiddhiḥ|
analyzed: nanu śuddhabrahmaṇaḥ cit mātrasya ajñāna āśraya tve sārvajñya virodhaḥ na ca viśiṣṭe eva sārvajñyam turīyam sarva dṛś sadā iti śuddhasya eva sarvajñatva ukteḥ iti ced na sarva dṛś padena sarveṣām dṛś bhūtam caitanyam iti ucyate na tu sarvajñam turīyam tasmāt viśiṣṭe eva sārvajñyam tat ca avidyām vinā na sambhavati iti avidyā siddhiḥ

original: tathā hi -- sarvajño hi pramāṇataḥ, svarūpajñaptyā vā| tatra pramāṇasya bhrānteścāvidyāmūlatvād, asaṅgasvarūpajñapteścāvidyāṃ vinā viṣayāsaṅgateḥ| taduktam --
analyzed: tathā hi sarvajñaḥ hi pramāṇataḥ sva rūpa jñaptyā vā tatra pramāṇasya bhrānteḥ ca avidyā mūla tvāt asaṅga sva rūpa jñapteḥ ca avidyām vinā viṣaya asaṅgateḥ tat uktam

original: svarūpataḥ pramāṇairvā sarvajñatvaṃ dvidhā sthitam|
analyzed: svarūpataḥ pramāṇaiḥ vā sarvajña tvam dvidhā sthitam

original: taccobhayaṃ vinā'vidyāsambhandhaṃ naiva sidhyati|| iti|
analyzed: tat ca ubhayam vinā avidyā sambhandham nā eva sidhyati iti

original: na ca -- svarūpajñapteḥ svataḥ kālādyasambandhe'sattvāpātena svataḥ sambandhābhāve'sarvagatatvāpātena cāvidyayeva svata evānyena sambandho vaktavya iti vācyam, avidyāsambandhasyāpyāvidyakatvenāvidyayeveti dṛṣṭāntānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca svarūpa jñapteḥ svatas kāla ādi asambandhe sattva āpātena svatas sambandha abhāve sarvagata tva āpātena ca avidyayā iva svatas eva anyena sambandhaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti vācyam avidyā sambandhasya api āvidyaka tvena avidyayā iva iti dṛṣṭānta anupapatteḥ

original: svataḥ parato vā kālādisambandhena sarvasambandhena cāsadvailakṣaṇyasarvagatatvayorupapatterna tayorarthe svataḥ kālasambandhasarvasambandhāpekṣā| asaṅgatvaśrutirapi svataḥ saṅgābhāvaviṣayatvenopapadyate| ata eva `ajñatā'khilasaṃvetturghaṭate na kutaścane'ti -- nirastam| tasmāccinmātrāśritaivāvidyā| ityajñānavāde sarvajñasyāvidyāśrayatvopapattiḥ|
analyzed: svatas paratas vā kāla ādi sambandhena sarva sambandhena ca asat vailakṣaṇya sarvagata tvayoḥ upapatteḥ na tayoḥ arthe svatas kāla sambandha sarva sambandha apekṣā asaṅga tva śrutiḥ api svatas saṅga abhāva viṣaya tvena upapadyate atas eva ajña tā akhila saṃvettuḥ ghaṭate na kutaścana iti nirastam tasmāt cit mātra āśritā eva avidyā iti ajñāna vāde sarvajñasya avidyā āśraya tva upapattiḥ

original: vācaspatimiśraistu jīvāśritaivā'vidyā nigadyate| nanu -- jīvāśritā'vidyā tatpratibimbatacaitanyaṃ vā, tadavacchinnacaitanyaṃ vā, tatkalpitabhedaṃ jīvaḥ, tathā cānyonyāśrayaiti cenna, kimayamanyo'nyāśraya utpattau? jñaptau? sthitau vā? nādyaḥ, anāditvādubhayoḥ| na dvitīyaḥ, ajñānasya cidbhāsyatve'pi citeḥ svaprakāśatvena tadabhāsyatvāt| na tṛtīyaḥ|
analyzed: vācaspati miśraiḥ tu jīva āśritā eva avidyā nigadyate nanu jīva āśritā avidyā vā tad avacchinna caitanyam vā tad kalpita bhedam jīvaḥ tathā ca anyonya āśrayā eti ced na kim ayam anyonya āśrayaḥ utpattau jñaptau sthitau vā na ādyaḥ anādi tvāt ubhayoḥ na dvitīyaḥ ajñānasya cit bhāsya tve pi citeḥ sva prakāśa tvena tad abhāsya tvāt na tṛtīyaḥ

original: sa kiṃ parasparāśritatvena vā, parasparasāpekṣasthitikatvena vā syāt| tanna, ubhayasyāpyasiddheḥ, ajñānasya cidāśrayatve cidadhīnasthitikatve'pi citi avidyāśritatvatadadhīnasthitikatvayorabhāvāt| na caivamanyonyādhīnatākṣatiḥ, sāmānakālīnayorapyavacchedyāvacchedakabhāvamātreṇa tadupapatteḥ, ghaṭatadavacchinnākāśayoriva pramāṇaprameyayoriva ca|
analyzed: sa kim paraspara āśrita tvena vā paraspara sāpekṣa sthitika tvena vā syāt tat na ubhayasya api asiddheḥ ajñānasya cit āśraya tve cit adhīna sthitika tve pi citi avidyā āśrita tva tad adhīna sthitika tvayoḥ abhāvāt na ca evam anyonya adhīna tā kṣatiḥ sāmāna kālīnayoḥ api avacchedya avacchedaka bhāva mātreṇa tad upapatteḥ ghaṭa tad avacchinna ākāśayoḥ iva pramāṇa prameyayoḥ iva ca

original: taduktam --
analyzed: tat uktam

original: svenaiva kalpite deśe vyomni yadvad ghaṭādikam|
analyzed: svena eva kalpite deśe vyomni yadvat ghaṭa ādikam

original: tathā jīvāśrayāvidyāṃ manyante jñānakovidāḥ|| iti|

original: etena -- yadyutpattijñaptimāṃtrapratibandhakatvenānyo'nyāpekṣatāyā adoṣatvam, tadā caitramaitrāderanyonyārohaṇādyāpattiriti nirastam, parasparamāśrayāśrayibhāvasyānaṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: etena yadi utpatti jñapti māṃtra pratibandhaka tvena anyonya apekṣatāyāḥ adoṣatvam tadā caitra maitra ādeḥ anyonya ārohaṇa ādi āpattiḥ iti nirastam parasparam āśraya āśrayi bhāvasya anaṅgīkārāt

original: na ceśvarajīvayorīśvarajīvakalpitatve ātmāśrayaḥ, jīveśakalpitatve cānyonyāśrayaḥ, na ca śuddhā cit kalpikā, tasyā ajñānābhāvāditi -- vācyam, jīvāśritāyā avidyāyā eva jīveśakalpakatvenaitadvikalpānavakāśāt| tasmājjīvāśrayatve'pyadoṣaḥ| ityadvaitasiddhau ajñānasya jīvāśrayatvopapattiḥ||
analyzed: na ca īśvara jīvayoḥ īśvara jīva kalpita tve ātmā āśrayaḥ jīva īśa kalpita tve ca anyonya āśrayaḥ na ca śuddhā cit kalpikā tasyāḥ ajñāna abhāvāt iti vācyam jīva āśritāyāḥ avidyāyāḥ eva jīva īśa kalpaka tvena etad vikalpa anavakāśāt tasmāt jīva āśraya tve pi adoṣaḥ iti advaita siddhau ajñānasya jīva āśraya tva upapattiḥ

original: avidyāyā viṣayo'pi suvacaḥ| tathā hi -- cinmātramevāvidyāviṣayaḥ, tasyākalpitatvenānyo'nyāśrayādidoṣāprasakteḥ, svaprakāśatvena prasaktaprakāśe tasmin āvaraṇakṛtyasambhavācca, nānyat, tasyājñānakalpitatvād, aprasaktaprakāśatvenāvaraṇakṛtyābhāvācca|

original: na hyadyāpi svaprakāśātmānyatvamahamarthe siddhamasti| ātmānyatvenāprakāśatvasādhane tena ca tadanyatvasādhane anyonyāśrayaḥ| na cāhamarthasyāparāmarśaḥ, sukhamahamasvāpsaṃ na kiñcidavediṣamiti tasyaiva parāmarśāditi -- cenna, ahaṅkārastāvadicchādiviśiṣṭatayaiva gṛhyata ityāvayoḥ samam|

original: na ca -- rūpādirahitānāṃ teṣāmasattvaṃ tatra bījamitivācyam, pūrvarūpanāśāgrimarūpānutpattikṣaṇādyakṣaṇādau tadvināpi sattvāt| evaṃ ca guṇagrahaṇe kathaṃ guṇigrahaṇam? tathā ca nirguṇa evātmā gṛhyata iti svīkartavyam| anubhavābhāve ca na tasya jāgare parāmarśaḥ| tathā cājñānāśrayatvena suṣuptāvanubhayamānādātmano'haṅkāro bhinnaḥ|

original: evamevātmānyatve siddhe asvaprakāśatvasādhane nānyonyāśrayaḥ| na ca tarhi `ahamasvāpsa'mityahamarthasya parāmarśānupraveśānupapattiḥ, tadaṃśe parāmarśatvāsiddheḥ| evaṃ satyapi yathā'jñānāṃśe tasya parāmarśatvaṃ, tathopapāditamadhastāt|
analyzed: evam eva ātma anyatve siddhe asva prakāśa tva sādhane nā anyonya āśrayaḥ na ca tarhi aham asvāpsam iti ahamarthasya parāmarśa anupraveśa anupapattiḥ tad aṃśe parāmarśa tva asiddheḥ evam sati api yathā jñāna aṃśe tasya parāmarśa tvam tathā upapāditam adhastāt

original: yadyapyahamasvāpsamityādijñānānnānya ātmaparāmarśaḥ, tathāpyahamarthasya suṣuptikālānanubhūtatvena tatkāle ajñānāśrayatvena cānubhūtātmanyeva parāmarśatvaparyavasānam| ata eva cidasvapīt svayamasvapīditi parāmarśākāratāpattirnirastā, tatkālānubhūtāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsargeṇa ahamityākāropapatteḥ|

original: yattūktaṃ vivaraṇe -- `antaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭa evātmani pratyabhijñānaṃ brūmaḥ, na niṣkalaṅkacaitanye, tasya mokṣāvasthāyinaḥ śāstraikasamadhigamyatvād'iti| tadatra na virodhāya, mokṣāvasthāyinaḥ śāstraikasamadhigamyatvāditi hetūktyā na niṣkalaṅka iti upādhimātravirahiṇi pratyabhijñānaniṣedhena cāntaḥkaraṇapadasya upādhimātraparatvāt|

original: tathā ca suṣuptāvapyajñānopahita evātmā gṛhyate| kiṃ cāntaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭe pratyabhijñānaniṣedho nābhijñānaṣedho'pīti na virodhaḥ, suṣuptāvabhijñāyā evoktatvāt| na ca yadyahamartho na parāmṛśyeta, tarhi etāvantaṃ kālaṃ supto'hamanyo veti' saṃśayaḥ syāt, na tvahameveti niścaya iti vācyam, suṣuptikālānubhūtātmaikyādhyāsāditi gṛhāṇa|
analyzed: tathā ca suṣuptau api ajñāna upahitaḥ eva ātmā gṛhyate kim ca antaḥkaraṇa viśiṣṭe pratyabhijñāna niṣedhaḥ na abhijñāna ṣedhaḥ api iti na virodhaḥ suṣuptau abhijñāyāḥ eva uktatvāt na ca yadi aham arthaḥ na parāmṛśyeta tarhi etāvantam kālam suptaḥ uham anyaḥ vā iti saṃśayaḥ syāt na tu aham eva iti niścayaḥ iti vācyam suṣupti kāla anubhūta ātma aikya adhyāsāt iti gṛhāṇa

original: yathā pūrvadinānubhūtadevadattādabhinnatayānubhūte caitre so'yaṃ na veti na saṃśayaḥ, kintu sa eveti niścayaḥ| kiñca niścaye sati saṃśayābhāvaniyamaḥ, na tu niścayābhāve saṃśayaniyamaḥ| taduktam -- `ārope sati nimittānusaraṇam, na tu nimittamastītyāropaḥ' iti|

original: na ca -- etāvantaṃ kālamahaṃ svapnaṃ paśyannāsaṃ jāgradāsamityatrevāhamasvāpsamityatrāpi ahamaṃśe parāmarśatvānubhavāt kathaṃ tatrāparāmarśatvamiti -- vācyam, parāmṛśyamānātmaikyāropāttadbhanāṃśe parāmarśatvābhimānāt|

original: ata eva -- ahamarthasyātmānyatve yaḥ pūrvaṃ duḥkhī, so'dhunā sukhī jāta itivad yaḥ pūrvaṃ madanyaḥ suṣuptaḥ so'dhunā ahaṃ jāta iti dhīḥ syāditi -- nirastam, yathā duḥkhitvena prāk jñānaṃ, tathā madanyatvena prāk jñānābhāvāt| suṣuptāvahamarthāprakāśavat tadanyatvasyāpyaprakāśa eva|
analyzed: atas eva ahamarthasya ātma anyatve yaḥ pūrvam duḥkhī saḥ adhunā sukhī jātaḥ iti vat yaḥ pūrvam mad anyaḥ suṣuptaḥ saḥ adhunā aham jātaḥ iti dhīḥ syāt iti nirastam yathā duḥkhi tvena prāk jñānam tathā mad anya tvena prāk jñāna abhāvāt suṣuptau ahamartha aprakāśa vat tad anya tvasya api aprakāśaḥ eva

original: evaṃ ca prāgasattvāgrahaṇāt pūrvakālagṛhītenābhinnatayā gṛhyamāṇatvācca nāhaṅkāre janmapratyayaḥ vivekināṃ caitādṛgbuddhāviṣṭāpatteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca prāk asattva agrahaṇāt pūrva kāla gṛhītena abhinna tayā gṛhyamāṇa tvāt ca na ahaṅkāre janma pratyayaḥ vivekinām ca etādṛś buddhau iṣṭa āpatteḥ

original: na ca -- siddhe ahamarthasyātmānyatve parāmṛśyamānātmaikyāropaḥ, siddhe ca tasmin suptāvaprakāśenāhamarthasyātmānyatvasiddhirityanyonyāśraya iti -- vācyam, ātmānyatvasiddheḥ prāgevāhamarthāparāmarśasya sādhanād, ahamasvāpsamityasyaivātmaparāmarśatvāṅgīkāreṇa na dṛṣṭahānādṛṣṭakalpanāpattiḥ|
analyzed: na ca siddhe ahamarthasya ātma anyatve parāmṛśyamāna ātma aikya āropaḥ siddhe ca tasmin suptau aprakāśena ahamarthasya ātma anya tva siddhiḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ iti vācyam ātma anyatva siddheḥ prāk eva ahamartha aparāmarśasya sādhanāt aham asvāpsam iti asya eva ātma parāmarśa tva aṅgīkāreṇa na dṛṣṭa hāna adṛṣṭa kalpanā āpattiḥ

original: ata eva ca suṣuptāvahamarthaprakāśe hyastana iva smaryetetyatra neṣṭāpattyavakāśaḥ| kiṃ ca `etāvantaṃ kālamahamityabhimanyamāna āsa'miti parāmarśaḥ syāt| na ca -- ahamarthaprakāśe tadabhimānāpādanaṃ karṇasparśe kaṭicālanamiti -- vācyam, tavaiva hi tat|
analyzed: atas eva ca suṣuptau ahamartha prakāśe hyastanaḥ iva smaryeta iti atra na iṣṭa āpatti avakāśaḥ kim ca etāvantam kālam aham iti abhimanyamānaḥ āsam iti parāmarśaḥ syāt na ca ahamartha prakāśe tad abhimāna āpādanam karṇa sparśe kaṭi cālanam iti vācyam tava eva hi tat

original: ahamarthamātrasāpekṣatayā tadabhimānaprakāśayorubhayoḥ samavyāptatayā parasparaprakāśena parasparaparāmarśāpādanasyāvyadhikaraṇatvāt| na ca tavāpi `ātmetyabhimanyamāna āsa'miti parāmarśāpattiḥ, ahaṅkārasya tatra tantratayā tadabhāve tadāpādayitumaśakyatvāt| yattu -- suṣuptāvahamartho bhāsata eva|
analyzed: ahamartha mātra sāpekṣa tayā tad abhimāna prakāśayoḥ ubhayoḥ sama vyāpta tayā paraspara prakāśena paraspara parāmarśa āpādanasya avyadhikaraṇa tvāt na ca tava api ātmā iti abhimanyamānaḥ āsam iti parāmarśa āpattiḥ ahaṅkārasya tatra tantra tayā tad abhāve tad āpādayitum aśakya tvāt yat tu suṣuptau ahamarthaḥ bhāsate eva

original: `na kiñcidahamavediṣa'miti ajñānaparāmarśasyātmādyajñānādanyadivāhamarthājñānādanyadevājñānaṃ viṣayaḥ, anyathā virodhād -- iti| tadajñānavijṛmbhitam, na hi sākṣivedanamajñānavirodhi| suṣuptau ca yathāhamarthānavabhāsaḥ tathoktam| na vijānātyayamahamastīti śrutirapi tadānīṃtanāhamarthājñāne pramāṇam|
analyzed: na kiñcid aham avediṣam iti ajñāna parāmarśasya ātma ādi ajñānāt anyat iva ahamartha ajñānāt anyat eva ajñānam viṣayaḥ anyathā virodhāt iti tat ajñāna vijṛmbhitam na hi sākṣi vedanam ajñāna virodhi suṣuptau ca yathā ahamartha anavabhāsaḥ tathā uktam na vijānāti ayam aham asti iti śrutiḥ api tadānīṃtana ahamartha ajñāne pramāṇam

original: na ceyaṃ śrutirnātmānaṃ na parāṃśceti suṣuptāvātmājñānaśrutivadviśeṣājñānaparā, `aharaharbrahma gacchanti sati saṃpadya na vidu'rityātmavedanabodhakaśrutivirodhena viśeṣājñānaparatvaṃ yuktam| na ca prakṛte tathā, virodhābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca iyam śrutiḥ na ātmānam na parān ca iti suṣuptau ātma ajñāna śruti vat viśeṣa ajñāna parāḥ aharahar brahma gacchanti sati saṃpadya na viduḥ iti ātma vedana bodhaka śruti virodhena viśeṣa ajñāna para tvam yuktam na ca prakṛte tathā virodha abhāvāt

original: yattu -- ahamarthastāvat smartā| sa cāvidyāvacchinnacaitanyaṃ vā? antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnacaitanyaṃ vā? ādye yo'hamakārṣaṃ so'haṃ sauṣuptikājñānādi smarāmītyanubhavavirodhaḥ| antye tvahamarthasyaiva tadanubhavitṛtvaṃ vācyam, smṛtisaṃskārānubhavānāmekāśrayāṇāmeva kāryakāraṇabhāvād, yo'hamanvabhūvaṃ so'haṃ smarāmī'ti pratyabhijñānācca iti|

original: na ca -- adhiṣṭhānātmanā'nadhyastajapākusumasthānīyamupādhiṃ vinā bhīṣaṇatvādiyuktasarpasya rajjvātmaneva kartṛtvādiyuktabuddheścidātmanādhyāse rajjau bhīṣaṇatvāntarasyevātmani kartṛtvāntarasyānadhyāsena sopādhikatvaṃ na syāditi -- vācyam, ātmani kartṛtvāntarasyaivādhyāsāt|

original: na ca tarhi kartṛtvadvayasya vivicya pratītiḥ syāt, ātmāntaḥkaraṇayoraikyādhyāsāt| rajjusarpādau adhyasyamānakrūratvādiviśiṣṭasarpāpekṣayā adhikasattākasya sarpāntarasya sambhavena nāyamupādhiḥ, ato nirupādhikatvam|

original: na ca evamapi mano na sphuraṇam, kintu sphuratīti tayorbhedadhīdaśāyāṃ pratyekaṃ `raktaṃ kusumaṃ' `sphaṭiko raktaḥ' itivat `manaḥ kartṛ' `caitanyaṃ kartri'ti pratītyāpattiriti -- vācyam, tādātmyāropavirodhibhedagrahasyaiva tatprayojakatvāt, prakṛte ca tadabhāvāt|

original: yattvabhedagrahadaśāyāmapi `ayaṃ bhīṣaṇaḥ sarpo bhīṣaṇaḥ, ahaṃ gauraḥ śarīraṃ gaurami'tivat `manaḥ kartṛ' `caitanyaṃ kartri'ti pratītiḥ syāditi, tanna, tādātmyagrahasyaiva pratibandhakasya sattvena dṛṣṭāntasyaivāsampratipatteḥ|

original: yadapi sopādhikatve tantratvenādhiṣṭhānasamasattākatvamupādheḥ taddharmasya vā, adhyasyamānāpekṣayādhikasattākatvaṃ vā tayoriti pakṣadvayamudbhāvya prakṛte taddvayaṃ na sambhavatīti dūṣaṇābhidhānam, tadanuktopālambhanam, yadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā yatpratīyate tadapekṣayā adhikasattākataddharmāśrayāntarābhāvasyaiva sopādhikatve tantratvāt|
analyzed: yat api sopādhikatve tantratvena adhiṣṭhāna sama sattāka tvam upādheḥ tad dharmasya vā adhyasyamāna apekṣayā adhika sattāka tvam vā tayoḥ iti pakṣa dvayam udbhāvya prakṛte tat dvayam na sambhavati iti dūṣaṇa abhidhānam tat anukta upālambhanam yat anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyitayā yat pratīyate tad apekṣayā adhika sattāka tad dharma āśraya antara abhāvasya eva sopādhikatve tantratvāt

original: na caivaṃ kṣīrasampraktanīraikyādhyāsanibandhanakṣīradharmapratītiḥ sopādhikī syāt, tasyāḥ sopādhikatve iṣṭāpatteḥ| nanu -- buddhigataṃ kartṛtvaṃ kimahamarthe, ahamarthagataṃ vātmani adhyasyate|
analyzed: na ca evam kṣīra samprakta nīra aikya adhyāsa nibandhana kṣīra dharma pratītiḥ sopādhikī syāt tasyāḥ sopādhika tve iṣṭa āpatteḥ nanu buddhi gatam kartṛ tvam kim ahamarthe ahamartha gatam vā ātmani adhyasyate

original: ādye āropitasyāpyanarthasyātmanyabhāve tasya bandhamokṣānadhikaraṇatvāpattiḥ, dvitīye anadhyāsenaiva `ahaṃ karte'ti pratīttyupapattau kimadhyāseneti cenna, ahaṅkārastu cidacid‌granthirūpatayā dvyaṃśaḥ| tatrācidaṃśe buddhau kartṛtvasattve'pi tadviśiṣṭāyā buddheścityaikyādhyāsaṃ vinā `ahaṃ karte'ti pratīterayogenādhyāsasyāvaśyakatvāt|
analyzed: ādye āropitasya api anarthasya ātmani abhāve tasya bandha mokṣa anadhikaraṇa tva āpattiḥ dvitīye anadhyāsena eva aham kartā iti pratītti upapattau kim adhyāsena iti ced na ahaṅkāraḥ tu cit acit granthi rūpatayā dvi aṃśaḥ tatra acit aṃśe buddhau kartṛ tva sattve api tad viśiṣṭāyāḥ buddheḥ citi aikya adhyāsam vinā aham kartā iti pratīteḥ ayogena adhyāsasya āvaśyaka tvāt

original: etena -- āropitakartṛtvasyāpyabhāve ātmano bandhamokṣānadhikaraṇatvaṃ syāditi -- nirastam|
analyzed: etena āropita kartṛ tvasya api abhāve ātmanaḥ bandha mokṣa anadhikaraṇa tvam syāt iti nirastam

original: na ca `kartā śāstrārthavattvādi'tyadhikaraṇe tvayā'pi sāṅkhyarītyā buddheḥ kartṛtve prāpte, jīvasyaiveti siddhāntitatvena virodhaḥ|
analyzed: na ca kartā śāstra arthavat tvāt iti adhikaraṇe tvayā api sāṅkhya rītyā buddheḥ kartṛ tve prāpte jīvasya eva iti siddhāntita tvena virodhaḥ

original: na cāvivekanibandhanaṃ jīvaniṣṭhatvam, avivekasya sāṅkhyamate'pi sattvāditi -- vācyam, buddhereva kartṛtvam, bhoktṛtvaṃ caitanyasyeti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā kartṛtvabhoktṛtvayoraikādhikaraṇyaniyamena bhoktṛtvavat kartṛtvamapyaṅgīkartavyamityuktam, na tu buddheḥ akartṛtvaṃ ātmano vā svābhāvikaṃ kartṛtvaṃmiti|
analyzed: na ca aviveka nibandhanam jīva niṣṭhatvam avivekasya sāṅkhya mate pi sattvāt iti vācyam buddheḥ eva kartṛ tvam bhoktṛ tvam caitanyasya iti pūrvapakṣam kṛtvā kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tvayoḥ aika adhikaraṇya niyamena bhoktṛ tva vat kartṛ tvam api aṅgīkartavyam iti uktam na tu buddheḥ akartṛ tvam ātmanaḥ vā svābhāvikam kartṛ tvam iti

original: `yathā ca takṣobhayathā' ityuttarādhikaraṇe pūrvādhikaraṇoktasyātmakartṛtvasya svābhāvikatvapūrvapakṣe aupādhikatvasya sthāpitatvāt| ato na tadadhikaraṇavirodhaḥ|
analyzed: yathā ca takṣā ubhayathā iti uttara adhikaraṇe pūrva adhikaraṇa uktasya ātma kartṛ tvasya svābhāvika tva pūrvapakṣe aupādhika tvasya sthāpita tvāt atas na tad adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ

original: yadapi buddheḥ kartṛtve karaṇatvaṃ kathamiti? tadapyayuktam, anyatra kartryā eva buddherupalabdhiṃ prati karaṇatvopapatteḥ| na ca kartṛtvādyanartharūpabandhasya buddhigatatvena mokṣasyāpi tadanvayāpattiḥ, anarthatannivṛttyoraikādhikaraṇyaniyamāditi -- vācyam, kartṛtvādeścetanagatatayaivānarthatayā buddheranarthānāśrayatvāt|
analyzed: yat api buddheḥ kartṛ tve karaṇa tvam katham iti tat api ayuktam anyatra kartryāḥ eva buddheḥ upalabdhim prati karaṇa tva upapatteḥ na ca kartṛ tva ādi anartha rūpa bandhasya buddhi gata tvena mokṣasya api tad anvaya āpattiḥ anartha tad nivṛttyoḥ aikādhikaraṇya niyamāt iti vācyam kartṛ tva ādeḥ cetana gata tayā eva anartha tayā buddheḥ anartha anāśraya tvāt

original: na ca caitanyagatasyānarthatve caitanyasyāpyanarthakoṭau niveśāpattiḥ, ātmasabandhitvenaivānarthasya heyatvenātmano'pi heyatvaṃ sarvamate'pi syāt| āropitatvapuraskāreṇānarthatvābhāvāt nānyonyāśrayaḥ|
analyzed: na ca caitanya gatasya anartha tve caitanyasya api anartha koṭau niveśa āpattiḥ ātma sabandhi tvena eva anarthasya heya tvena ātmanaḥ api heya tvam sarva mate api syāt āropita tva puraskāreṇa anartha tva abhāvāt na anyonya āśrayaḥ

original: na ca -- śuddhātmanaḥ kadāpi nānarthāśrayatvena pratītiḥ, bhramakāle ahaṃ bhoktā pramākāle buddhirbhoktrīti pratīteriti -- vācyam, śuddhasya bhoktṛtvādyanarthānāśrayatve'pi upahitasya śuddhātsvābhāvikabhedābhāvena bandhamokṣasāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca śuddha ātmanaḥ kadāpi nā anartha āśraya tvena pratītiḥ bhrama kāle aham bhoktā pramā kāle buddhiḥ bhoktrī iti pratīteḥ iti vācyam śuddhasya bhoktṛ tva ādi anartha anāśraya tve pi upahitasya śuddhāt svābhāvika bheda abhāvena bandha mokṣa sāmānādhikaraṇya upapatteḥ

original: etena -- buddhiḥ śravaṇādikartrīti tasyā eva phalaṃ mokṣo'pi syāditi vācyam, `śāstraphalaṃ prayoktarī'ti nyāyād, anyathā'tiprasaṅgāditi -- nirastam,jāteṣṭipitṛyajñayorvyabhicārāt| na ca pūtaputrakatvaṃ svargabhāgipitṛkatvaṃ vā kartṛgatameva phalam, tasya phalatvenāśravaṇāt|
analyzed: etena buddhiḥ śravaṇa ādi kartrī iti tasyāḥ eva phalam mokṣaḥ api syāt iti vācyam śāstra phalam prayoktari iti nyāyāt anyathā atiprasaṅgāt iti nirastam jāta iṣṭi pitṛ yajñayoḥ vyabhicārāt na ca pūta putraka tvam svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam vā kartṛ gatam eva phalam tasya phala tvena aśravaṇāt

original: na ca tādṛkputrakatvaṃ phalena sambandhaḥ, na tu phalamiti -- vācyam, evaṃ hi saṃyuktasamavāyādinā pitranyasyāpi tatphalaṃ syāt, aśāstrīyatvāviśeṣāt|
analyzed: na ca tādṛś putraka tvam phalena sambandhaḥ na tu phalam iti vācyam evam hi saṃyukta samavāya ādinā pitṛ anyasya api tat phalam syāt aśāstrīya tva aviśeṣāt

original: na ca -- pitrarthaputragataṃ pūtatvādikaṃ tadanuṣṭhātuḥ pitureva phalam, tena taduddeśāt, na cehātmā antaḥkaraṇārthaḥ yenātmagato mokṣaḥ tasyoddeśyaḥ syāditi -- vācyam, ātmā yadyapi nāntaḥkaraṇārthaḥ, ahamarthagatatayā tathāpi phalasyoddeśyatvānubhavād ahamarthasya cātmānātmarūpatvenātmanyapi phale uddesyagatatvānapāyāt|
analyzed: na ca pitṛ artha putra gatam pūta tva ādikam tad anuṣṭhātuḥ pituḥ eva phalam tena tad uddeśāt na ca iha ātmā antaḥkaraṇa arthaḥ yena ātma gataḥ mokṣaḥ tasya uddeśyaḥ syāt iti vācyam ātmā yadi api na antaḥkaraṇa arthaḥ ahamartha gata tayā tathā api phalasya uddeśya tva anubhavāt ahamarthasya ca ātma anātma rūpa tvena ātmani api phale uddesya gata tva anapāyāt

original: yadvā -- āropitānāropitasādhāraṇaṃ kartṛtvameva phalabhāktve prayojakam, taccātmanyastyeva| na ca śarīre'pyāropitakartṛtvena phalabhāktvāpattiḥ, phalaparyantamasattvena phalabhāktvāsambhavāt| na hi kartuḥ phalabhāktvaniyamaṃ brūmaḥ kintu phalabhājaḥ kartṛtvaniyamam, ajanitaphalakarmakartari vyabhicārāt, aprayojaketvācca|
analyzed: yat vā āropita anāropita sādhāraṇam kartṛ tvam eva phala bhāktve prayojakam tat ca ātmani asti eva na ca śarīre pi āropita kartṛ tvena phala bhāktva āpattiḥ phala paryantam asattvena phala bhāktva asambhavāt na hi kartuḥ phala bhāktva niyamam brūmaḥ kintu phala bhājaḥ kartṛ tva niyamam ajanita phala karma kartari vyabhicārāt aprayojaka itvāt ca

original: nanu -- manasaḥ kartṛtvaṃ na ghaṭate, kṛtikarmatvasya karaṇatvasya ca tadvirodhinaḥ śrutyādisiddhatvād, buddhyabhāve'pi kartṛtvasya śrūyamāṇatvācca|
analyzed: nanu manasaḥ kartṛ tvam na ghaṭate kṛti karma tvasya karaṇa tvasya ca tad virodhinaḥ śruti ādi siddha tvāt buddhi abhāve pi kartṛ tvasya śrūyamāṇa tvāt ca

original: tathā hi -- `tanmano'kurute'tyādau manasaḥ kṛtikarmatvam, `śṛṇvantaḥ śrotreṇa vidvāṃśo manase'tyādiśrutau `śarīravāṅmanobhiryat karma prārabhate nara' ityādismṛtau ca karaṇatvam, `mana udakrāmanmīlita ivāśnan pibannāstaive'tyādiśrutau manautkramaṇe'pyātmanaḥ kartṛtvam, tathā `paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate sa tatra paryeti
analyzed: tathā hi tat manokuruta ityādau manasaḥ kṛti karma tvam śṛṇvantaḥ śrotreṇa vidvāṃśaḥ manasā ityādi śrutau śarīra vāc manobhiḥ yat karma prārabhate naraḥ ityādi smṛtau ca karaṇa tvam manaḥ udakrāmat mīlitaḥ iva aśnan piban āsta eva ityādi śrutau manaḥ utkramaṇe pyā ātmanaḥ kartṛ tvam tathā param jyotiḥ upasampadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate sa tatra paryeti

original: jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇa' ityādau svarūpāvirbhāvarūpaparamamuktāvapi kartṛtvaṃ `kartā vijñānātmā yo vededaṃ jighrāṇīti sa ātmā' `ānandabhuktyā prājña' ityādiśrutitaśca kartṛtvam, tathā ca buddhirna kartrīti -- cenna, `vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute' ityādiśrutyā manasaḥ kartṛtvena svakṛtikarmatvavirodhe'pi tatreśvarakṛtikarmatvasya upalabdhiṃ prati
analyzed: jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ ityādau svarūpa āvirbhāva rūpa parama muktau api kartṛ tvam kartā vijñāna ātmā yaḥ veda idam jighrāṇi iti saḥ ātmā ānanda bhuktyā prājñaḥ ityādi śrutitaḥ ca kartṛ tvam tathā ca buddhiḥ na kartrī iti ced na vijñānam yajñam tanute ityādi śrutyā manasaḥ kartṛ tvena sva kṛti karma tva virodhe pi tatra īśvara kṛti karma tvasya upalabdhim prati

original: karaṇatvasya cāvirodhād, īśvare avidyāvṛttirūpajñānecchāvat tadrūpakṛtisambhavāt|
analyzed: karaṇa tvasya ca avirodhāt īśvare avidyā vṛtti rūpa jñāna icchā vat tad rūpa kṛti sambhavāt

original: na ca -- vijñānapadaṃ brahmaparam, `vijñānaṃ brahma cedveda, tasmāccenna pramādyati, śarīre pāpmano hitvā sarvān kāmān samaśnute|' ityādivākyaśeṣāditi -- vācyam, vākyaśeṣoktamumukṣujñeyaśuddhabrahmaṇo yajñakartṛtvāsambhavena kartṛtvena pratipādyamāne vijñāne tato'rthāntaratvaniścayād, `annaṃ brahmetyupāsta' ityetadvākyasamānayogakṣematvācca|
analyzed: na ca vijñāna padam brahma param vijñānam brahma ced veda tasmāt ced na pramādyati śarīre pāpmanaḥ hitvā sarvān kāmān samaśnute ityādi vākya śeṣāt iti vācyam vākya śeṣa ukta mumukṣu jñeya śuddha brahmaṇaḥ yajña kartṛ tva asambhavena kartṛ tvena pratipādyamāne vijñāne tatas ṛtha antara tva niścayāt annam brahma iti upāste iti etad vākya samāna yogakṣema tvāt ca

original: `tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ| paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvāt na sa paśyatī'tyādi smṛteḥ `prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇānī'tyādismṛteśca| na cātmani svātantryeṇa kartṛtvaniṣedhabodhakatvamanayoḥ, sāmānyato niṣedhe bādhakābhāvāt| ata eva `dhyāyatīva lelāyatīve'tyādāvivaśabdaḥ|
analyzed: tatra evam sati kartāram ātmānam kevalam tu yaḥ paśyati akṛtabuddhi tvāt na sa paśyati ityādi smṛteḥ prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇāni ityādi smṛteḥ ca na ca ātmani svātantryeṇa kartṛ tva niṣedha bodhaka tvam anayoḥ sāmānyatas niṣedhe bādhaka abhāvāt atas eva dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva ityādau iva śabdaḥ

analyzed: na ca nirdharmaka tva rūpa dharma bhāva abhāvābhyām vyāghātāt jñānatva sākṣi tva ādi vat satyasya asatyasya vā jñātṛ tva ādeḥ api ātmani eva sambhavāt ca nirdharmaka tva śrutiḥ na śrūyamāṇa artha parā iti vācyam nirdharmaka tvasya dharma abhāva rūpasya brahma svarūpa anatirekeṇa dharma tva abhāvena vyāhati abhāvāt

original: yattvasatyasya satyasya vā jñātṛtvasyātmanyapi sambhava ityuktaṃ| tadiṣṭameva| na hyāropitamapi kartṛtvamātmani pratiṣedhāmaḥ|
analyzed: yat tu asatyasya satyasya vā jñātṛ tvasya ātmani api sambhavaḥ iti uktam tat iṣṭam eva na hi āropitam api kartṛ tvam ātmani pratiṣedhāmaḥ

original: na ca -- nirvikāratvaṃ dravyāntararūpatayā pariṇāmābhāvaparam, na tu viśeṣākārābhāvaparam,taccātmanaḥ kartṛtvādisattve'pyaviruddhamiti -- vācyam, dravyāntararūpatayā pariṇāmaniṣedhakamapīdaṃ vākyaṃ nirdharmakaśrutyanusāreṇa viśeṣākāramātrasyaiva niṣedhaparam, sāmānyaniṣedhenaiva viśeṣaniṣedhaprāpteḥ|
analyzed: na ca nirvikāra tvam dravya antara rūpatayā pariṇāma abhāva param na tu viśeṣa ākāra abhāva param tat ca ātmanaḥ kartṛ tva ādi sattve pi aviruddham iti vācyam dravya antara rūpatayā pariṇāma niṣedhakam api idam vākyam nirdharmaka śruti anusāreṇa viśeṣa ākāra mātrasya eva niṣedha param sāmānya niṣedhena eva viśeṣa niṣedha prāpteḥ

original: nāpi -- niṣkriyatve kriyā parispando vā? dhātvartho vā? ādye iṣṭāpattiḥ, dvitīye ātmanyapi astyādidhātvartharūpasattādeḥ sattvenāsiddhiriti vācyam, brahmaṇa eva sadrūpatvena tatra sattāderapyabhāvāt, kriyāpadasya kṛtiparatvācca| ata eva manaso'bhāve suṣuptau kartṛtvādyadarśanam|
analyzed: nā api niṣkriya tve kriyā parispandaḥ vā dhātvarthaḥ vā ādye iṣṭa āpattiḥ dvitīye ātmani api asti ādi dhātvartha rūpa sattā ādeḥ sattvena asiddhiḥ iti vācyam brahmaṇaḥ eva sat rūpa tvena tatra sattā ādeḥ api abhāvāt kriyāpadasya kṛti paratvāt ca atas eva manasaḥ bhāve suṣuptau kartṛ tva ādi adarśanam

original: na ca -- tadāpi śvāsādikartatvaṃ dṛśyata eva, suṣuptau `bhūrbhūrityeva praśvasitī'ti śruteritivācyam, `na tudvitīyamastī'tyādi śrutyā taṃ prati śvāsasyaivābhāvena tatkartṛtvasya sutarāmasambhavāt| yadvā -- kriyāśaktiprādhānyena prāṇātmakasyāntaḥkaraṇasya tadāpi sattvena tadupādhikakartṛtvasya tadāpi sattvāt| tathā ca śrutiranyaparā|
analyzed: na ca tadā api śvāsa ādi karta tvam dṛśyate eva suṣuptau bhūḥ bhūḥ iti eva praśvasiti iti śruteḥ iti vācyam na tu dvitīyam asti ityādi śrutyā tam prati śvāsasya eva abhāvena tad kartṛ tvasya sutarām asambhavāt yat vā kriyāśakti prādhānyena prāṇa ātmakasya antaḥkaraṇasya tadā api sattvena tad upādhika kartṛ tvasya tadā api sattvāt tathā ca śrutiḥ anya parā

analyzed: darśanam ca draṣṭṛ avidyā kalpita śvāsa ādi viṣayam idam ca dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi vāde eva samarthitam kāmaḥ saṃkalpaḥ iti ārabhya hrīḥ dhīḥ bhīḥ iti etat sarvam manaḥ eva ityantā śrutiḥ api manasaḥ kartṛ tva parā na tu manasaḥ nimitta tva parā

original: na ca -- `manasā vā agre saṃkalpayatī'tyādiśrutyā `ātmendriyamanoyuktaṃ bhoktetyāhurmanīṣiṇa' ityādi śrutyā ca manasaḥ karaṇatvamiti vācyam, manovyatiriktasya saṃkalpānāśrayatvena `manasā vā' iti śruterupacaritārthatvāt|
analyzed: na ca manasā vai agre saṃkalpayati ityādi śrutyā ātma indriya manaḥ yuktam bhoktā iti āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ ityādi śrutyā ca manasaḥ karaṇa tvam iti vācyam manaḥ vyatiriktasya saṃkalpa anāśraya tvena manasā vā iti śruteḥ upacarita artha tvāt

original: nāpi ātmā mokṣasādhanaviṣayakṛtimān, tatphalānvayitvāt, sammatavat, ajñānaṃ jñānasamānādhikaraṇam, jñānanivartyatvāt jñānaprāgabhāvavat, dukhādibhogaḥ mokṣasamānādhikaraṇaḥ bandhatvāt, sammatavadityādyanumānairātmanaḥ kartṛtva siddhiriti -- vācyam, ādyānumāne āropitānāropitasādhāraṇakṛtimattvaṃ vā sādhyam? anāropitakṛtimattvaṃ vā? ādye iṣṭāpattiḥ|
analyzed: na api ātmā mokṣa sādhana viṣaya kṛtimān tad phala anvayi tvāt sammata vat ajñānam jñāna samāna adhikaraṇam jñāna nivartya tvāt jñāna prāgabhāvavat dukha ādi bhogaḥ mokṣa samāna adhikaraṇaḥ bandha tvāt sammata vat ityādi anumānaiḥ ātmanaḥ kartṛ tva siddhiḥ iti vācyam ādya anumāne āropita anāropita sādhāraṇa kṛtimat tvam vā sādhyam anāropita kṛtimat tvam vā ādye iṣṭāpattiḥ

analyzed: dvitīye jāta iṣṭi pitṛyajña janya phala anvayini vyabhicāraḥ dvitīya anumāne pi āropita anāropita sādhāraṇa jñāna adhikaraṇa vṛtti tvam vā anāropita jñāna adhikaraṇa vṛtti tvam vā atra api ādye iṣṭāpattiḥ dvitīye anādi bhāva bhinna tvasya upādhi tvam tṛtīya anumāne āropita anāropita sādhāraṇa sambandhena mokṣa sāmānādhikaraṇye iṣṭāpattiḥ

original: anāropitasambandhena sāmānādhikaraṇye sādhyāprasiddhiḥ| tasmāt siddhaṃ manasaḥ kartṛtvamātmanyāropyata iti||

original: nanu -- `ahamarthasyānātmatve brāhmaṇo'haṃ kāṇa' ityādipratyakṣaṃ dehendriyādau ātmaikyādhyāse pramāṇaṃ na syād, aikyabuddhāvātmano'viṣayatvāditi -- cenna, ahamityasya dvyaṃśatvena cidaṃśe kartṛtvādiviśiṣṭāntaḥkaraṇaikyādhyāsavad brāhmaṇatvakāṇatvādiviśiṣṭadehendriyādyaikyādhyāsenātmaikyaviṣayatvasambhavāt|
analyzed: nanu ahamarthasya anātmatve brāhmaṇa uham kāṇaḥ ityādi pratyakṣam deha indriya ādau ātma aikya adhyāse pramāṇam na syāt aikya buddhau ātmanaḥ viṣayatvāt iti ced na aham ityasya dvi aṃśa tvena cit aṃśe kartṛ tva ādi viśiṣṭa antaḥkaraṇa aikya adhyāsa vat brāhmaṇa tva kāṇa tva ādi viśiṣṭa deha indriya ādi aikya adhyāsena ātma aikya viṣayatva sambhavāt

original: tathā cātmani dehendriyādyaikyādhyāso yujyata eva| naca -- evaṃ dehātmaikyasya pratyakṣatve tadvirodhyanumānāgamayoraprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ vahniśaityānumānavat, śrūyamāṇārthe `yajamānaḥ prastara' ityāgamavacca|

original: na ca -- parasparabhinnatvena niścitānāṃ dehendriyādīnāṃ yugapadekātmaikyādhyāsāyogaḥ, na hi bhinnatvena niścitayo rajataraṅgayorekadaikaśuktikāyāmaikyādhyāsa iti -- vācyam, `dehādindriyamanyad, indriyād deho'nya' iti bhedabud‌dhyā `deho'hamindriyamityaikyādhyāsāsambhave'pi brāhmaṇādanya kāṇaḥ kāṇādanyaḥ brāhmaṇa iti bhedabuddhyabhāvena

original: brāhmaṇo'haṃ kāṇa ityekadā aikyādhyāsasambhavāt, samānaprakārakabhedadhiya eva virodhitvāt|

original: abhedaśca bhedātyantābhāva iti kathaṃ bhedamithyātve abhedaḥ satyo na syāt? na ca -- dehasyāpyadhyastatvena tena sahātmano na bhedo nāpyabheda iti -- vācyam, adhyastādapi rūpyācchukteḥ svajñānābādhyabhedadarśanāditicenna, bhedasya mithyātve'pi abhedo na tāttvikaḥ, bhāvābhāvayorubhayorapi mithyātvasya prāgevopapāditatvāt|
analyzed: abhedaḥ ca bheda atyanta abhāvaḥ iti katham bheda mithyātve abhedaḥ satyaḥ na syāt na ca dehasya api adhyasta tvena tena saha ātmanaḥ na bhedaḥ na api abhedaḥ iti vācyam adhyastāt api rūpyāt śukteḥ sva jñāna abādhya bheda darśanāt iti ced na bhedasya mithyātve pi abhedaḥ na tāttvikaḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ ubhayoḥ api mithyātvasya prāk eva upapādita tvāt

original: iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- yadatrābhedo vyavahārakālīnena parīkṣitapramāṇabhāvenānumānādinā bādhyate, bhedastu dehātmanorna tena, kintu caramavṛttyeti| na ca -- evaṃ gehītivad `dehī'ti pratīti'rna syāt, kintu deho'hamiti -- vācyam, dehatvena bhedagrahād brāhmaṇatvādinā bhedāgrahācca brāhmaṇo'haṃ dehyahamityubhayapratītyupapatteḥ|
analyzed: iyān tu viśeṣaḥ yat atra abhedaḥ vyavahāra kālīnena parīkṣita pramāṇa bhāvena anumāna ādinā bādhyate bhedaḥ tu deha ātmanoḥ na tena kintu carama vṛttyā iti na ca evam gehi iti vat dehi iti pratītiḥ na syāt kintu dehaḥ uham iti vācyam deha tvena bheda grahāt brāhmaṇa tva ādinā bheda agrahāt ca brāhmaṇa uham dehi aham iti ubhaya pratīti upapatteḥ

original: devadattād yajñadatto'nya iti bhedabuddhāvapi tattvenopasthitād devadattādyajñadatte `so'ya'mityabhedabhramadarśanāt|

original: dehabhedayuto yasmād brāhmaṇādipadoditaḥ||

original: iti -- cenna, manuṣyatvāderdehaviśiṣṭātmavṛttitve cakṣurādigamyatvaṃ na syād, dehaviśiṣṭātmanaścakṣuragamyatvāt| na ca -- ekadeśasya cakṣurgamyatvād viśiṣṭagatajātiḥ cakṣuṣā gṛhyata iti -- vācyam, vyāsajyavṛtterubhayayogyatāyāmeva yogyatvaniyamāt| anyathā aindriyakānaindriyakavṛttisaṃyogadvitvādeḥ pratyakṣatā syāt|
analyzed: iti ced na manuṣya tva ādeḥ deha viśiṣṭa ātma vṛtti tve cakṣuḥ ādi gamya tvam na syāt deha viśiṣṭa ātmanaḥ cakṣuḥ agamya tvāt na ca eka deśasya cakṣuḥ gamya tvāt viśiṣṭa gata jātiḥ cakṣuṣā gṛhyate iti vācyam vyāsajya vṛtteḥ ubhaya yogyatāyām eva yogya tva niyamāt anyathā aindriyaka anaindriyaka vṛtti saṃyoga dvi tva ādeḥ pratyakṣa tā syāt

original: vyāsajyavṛttitvasya jātāvadṛṣṭacaratvāt pṛthivītvādinā saṅkarāpatteḥ, tava mate ātmano'ṇutvena tad‌vṛttitve'tīndriyatvaprasaṅgāt| na caivaṃ `deho brāhmaṇo manuṣya' ityādipratītyāpattiḥ, ahaṃtvasāmānādhikaraṇyabhramajanakadoṣasyaiva tādṛkpratītipratibandhakatvāt|

original: uktabādhakairdaihavṛttitve ananyagatikatvena tathā kalpanāt, `kṛśo'haṃ sthūlo'ha'mityādau kārśyādiviśiṣṭaikyādhyāsasyāvaśyakatvācca| na ca -- ayamaupacārikaprayogaḥ putre kṛśe ahaṃ kṛśa itivat, taduktaṃ --

original: iti -- vācyam, evaṃ sati dehādibhinnātmāstitvapratipādikāyā `astītyevopalabdhavya' iti śruteranuvādakatāpatteḥ, mama deha ityanaupacārikaḥ, ahaṃ gaura ityādyaupacārika ityatra vinigamakābhāvācca|
analyzed: iti vācyam evam sati deha ādi bhinna ātma astitva pratipādikāyāḥ asti iti eva upalabdhavyaḥ iti śruteḥ anuvādaka tā āpatteḥ mama dehaḥ iti anaupacārikaḥ aham gauraḥ ityādi aupacārikaḥ iti atra vinigamaka abhāvāt ca

original: nanu -- idaṃ vinigamakam, jātamātrasya paśvādeḥ pravṛttyādihetoriṣṭasādhanatādyanumiterheturyatstanyapānam, tadiṣṭasādhanam, yathā pūrvadehīyaṃ stanyapānamityādivyāptismṛtistāvanna dehāntarāsmṛtau yuktā| na ca `mama prāk dehāntaramabhūdi'ti smaratastasyaikyadhīḥ sambhavatī|

original: athāsattvaṃ nirupākhyatvam? niḥsvarūpatvaṃ vā? nādyaḥ, asadādipadenaiva khyāyamānatvāt, na dvitīyaḥ svarūpeṇa niṣedhapakṣe śuktirūpyāderapi niḥsvarūpatvenāsadvailakṣaṇyānupapatteriti -- cenna, parābhimatasattvāsattve eva vivakṣite, na tu pāribhāṣike ato na tādṛksadasadvailakṣaṇyoktāviṣṭāpattiḥ nāpi -- tayoḥ parasparaviruddhatvena
analyzed: atha asattvam nirupākhya tvam niḥsvarūpatvam vā nā ādyaḥ asat ādi padena eva khyāyamāna tvāt na dvitīyaḥ sva rūpeṇa niṣedha pakṣe śukti rūpya ādeḥ api niḥsvarūpa tvena asat vailakṣaṇya anupapatteḥ iti ced na para abhimata sattva asattve eva vivakṣite na tu pāribhāṣike atas na tādṛś sat asat vailakṣaṇya uktau iṣṭāpattiḥ nā api tayoḥ paraspara viruddha tvena

original: ekaniṣedhasyāparavidhiparyavasannatayā ekatrobhayavailakṣaṇyaṃ vyāhatamiti -- vācyam, niṣedhasamuccayasyātāttvikatvāṅgīkārāt na vyāhatiḥ, na hyatāttvikarajatena śuktervirodhaḥ| na ca tarhi sadādivailakṣaṇyoktiḥ katham? tattatpratiyogidurnirūpatāmātraprakaṭanāya| na hi svarūpato durnirūpasya kiñcidapi rūpaṃ vāstavaṃ sambhavati|

original: nanu -- sattvādirāhityasyātāttvikatve'pi sattvāderdurnirūpatvamātreṇānirvācyatve pañcamaprakārāvidyānivṛttau `nānirvācyo'pi tatkṣaya' iti anirvācyatvaniṣedhāyogaḥ, sattvādivattadrāhityasyāpyatāttvikatve sattvādau pramāṇanirāsena tadrāhitye taduktyayogaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sattva ādi rāhityasya atāttvika tve api sattva ādeḥ durnirūpa tva mātreṇa anirvācya tve pañcama prakāra avidyā nivṛttau na anirvācyaḥ api tad kṣayaḥ iti anirvācya tva niṣedha ayogaḥ sattva ādi vat tad rāhityasya api atāttvika tve sattva ādau pramāṇa nirāsena tad rāhitye tad ukti ayogaḥ

original: avirodhāya vidhisamuccayasyaivātāttvikatvasvīkāraśceti -- cenna, pañcamaprakārāvidyānivṛttipakṣe naitattratayavilakṣaṇatvamātramanirvācyatvam, kintu muktikālānavasthāyitvasahitam| tathā ca muktikālāvasthāyinyāmavidyānivṛttau anirvācyatvaniṣedho yujyate| sattvādirāhitye tu abādhitārthaviṣayakapramāṇoktirnāstyeva| jñāpakamātroktistadaṃśe'sādhāraṇī|
analyzed: avirodhāya vidhi samuccayasya eva atāttvika tva svīkāraḥ ca iti ced na pañcama prakāra avidyā nivṛtti pakṣe na etattrataya vilakṣaṇa tva mātram anirvācya tvam kintu mukti kāla anavasthāyi tva sahitam tathā ca mukti kāla avasthāyinyām avidyā nivṛttau anirvācya tva niṣedhaḥ yujyate sattva ādi rāhitye tu abādhita artha viṣayaka pramāṇa uktiḥ na asti eva jñāpaka mātra uktiḥ tad aṃśe sādhāraṇī

original: ato vādivipratipattinirāsārthā| atāttvikavidhisamuccayāpattistviṣṭaiva| na hyatāttvikasattvāsattve niṣedhasamuccaye'pi virudhyete| yattu vidhisamuccayasyātāttvikatvapakṣe bhrāntibādhavyavasthā na syādityuktam, tanna, atāttvikatvādeva bhrānterbādhasya sattvapratiṣedhasyāpratikṣepāt sattvasyātāttvikatvācca tadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: atas vādi vipratipatti nirāsa arthā atāttvika vidhi samuccaya āpattiḥ tu iṣṭā eva na hi atāttvika sattva asattve niṣedha samuccaye api virudhyete yat tu vidhi samuccayasya atāttvika tva pakṣe bhrānti bādha vyavasthā na syāt iti uktam tat na atāttvika tvāt eva bhrānteḥ bādhasya sattva pratiṣedhasya apratikṣepāt sattvasya atāttvika tvāt ca tad upapatteḥ

original: nanu -- niṣedhasamuccayasyātāttvikatvaṃ kimubhayātāttvikatvādvā? ekaikātāttvikatvādvā? nādyaḥ, ubhayatāttvikatvavadubhayātāttvikatvasyāpi viruddhatvāt, vidhisamuccayasya tāttvikatvāpātācca|
analyzed: nanu niṣedha samuccayasya atāttvika tvam kim ubhaya atāttvika tvāt vā ekaika atāttvika tvāt vā na ādyaḥ ubhaya tāttvika tva vat ubhaya atāttvika tvasya api viruddha tvāt vidhi samuccayasya tāttvika tva āpātāt ca

original: ekaikapratiyogitāttvikatvāpattereva na dvitīyo'pi, tāttvikātyantābhāvapratiyogina eva atāttvikatvāditi -- cenna, ubhayātāttvikatvādeva niṣedhasamuccayasyātāttvikatvam| na cobhayatāttvikatvavadubhayātāttvikatvamapyekatra viruddham, valmīkādāvekatra sthāṇutvapuruṣatvayoratāttvikatvadarśanāt|

original: na ca paraspara viraharūpayorekatrobhayoratāttvikatvaṃ viruddham, ekatra tantvādau ghaṭatatprāgabhāvayorubhayorapi atāttvikatvadarśanāt| na ca pratiyogitadatyantābhāvayorevāyaṃ niyamaḥ, niyāmakābhāvādasmākamasampratipatteḥ| vastutastu -- sattvāsattvayorna parasparaviraharūpatvam, kintu parasparavirahavyāpyatāmātram|
analyzed: na ca paraspara viraha rūpayoḥ ekatra ubhayoḥ atāttvika tvam viruddham ekatra tantu ādau ghaṭa tad prāgabhāvayoḥ ubhayoḥ api atāttvika tva darśanāt na ca pratiyogi tad atyanta abhāvayoḥ eva ayam niyamaḥ niyāmaka abhāvāt asmākam asampratipatteḥ vastutas tu sattva asattvayoḥ na paraspara viraha rūpatvam kintu paraspara viraha vyāpya tā mātram

original: na ca -- tādṛśapāribhāṣikasadasadvailakṣaṇyoktau nāsmākamaniṣṭam iti -- vācyam, sattvamabādhyatvam, asattvaṃ sattvena pratītyanarhatvam, tadubhayavailakṣaṇyaṃ ca tava jagatyasampratipannamiti kathamiṣṭāpattyavakāśaḥ? iṣṭāpattau ca kathaṃ na matakṣatiḥ? ata eva dhvaṃsānupalakṣitatadupalakṣitasattāyogitvarūpanityatvānityatvayoḥ sattāhīne
analyzed: na ca tādṛśa pāribhāṣika sat asat vailakṣaṇya uktau na asmākam aniṣṭam iti vācyam sattvam abādhya tvam asattvam sattvena pratīti anarha tvam tad ubhaya vailakṣaṇyam ca tava jagati asampratipannam iti katham iṣṭāpatti avakāśaḥ iṣṭāpattau ca katham na mata kṣatiḥ atas eva dhvaṃsa anupalakṣita tad upalakṣita sattā yogi tva rūpa nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ sattā hīne

original: sāmānyādāvabhāvavaduttarāvadhirāhityaṃ nityatvaṃ, bhāvānyanivṛttimattvaṃ cānityatvam, tadubhayābhāvaḥ prāgabhāva iva kvacidrūpyādau mithyābhūte sattvāsattvayorabhāvaḥ| syādityāhuḥ, uktasattvāsattvayoḥ parasparavirahavyāpyatve'pi parasparavirahānātmakatvāt| uktanityatvānityatvavat|

original: nanu -- idaṃ nityatvānityatvayormilitayorvyatirekaḥ sāmānye prāgabhāve cāstītyuktam, tadayuktam, nityatvasya sāmānyānugatadhvaṃsāpratiyogitvarūpatvād, anityatvasya ca prāgbhāvānugatatatpratiyogitvarūpatvāt prāgabhāvasyāpi pratiyogyeva dhvaṃsaḥ, bhāvasyaivābhāvo nivṛttiḥ, abhāvasya tu bhāva eveti svīkārāt|
analyzed: nanu idam nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ militayoḥ vyatirekaḥ sāmānye prāgabhāve ca asti iti uktam tat ayuktam nitya tvasya sāmānya anugata dhvaṃsa apratiyogi tva rūpa tvāt anitya tvasya ca prāgbhāva anugata tad pratiyogitva rūpa tvāt prāgabhāvasya api pratiyogī eva dhvaṃsaḥ bhāvasya eva abhāvaḥ nivṛttiḥ abhāvasya tu bhāvaḥ eva iti svīkārāt

original: dhvaṃsopalakṣitānupalakṣitasattārāhityarūpanityatvānityatvayoḥ sāmānyādau bhāvavadekatra sattvāsattve syātāmityapi syāditi -- cenna, na hi vayaṃ dṛṣṭāntamātreṇa sattvāsattvavyatirekayorekatra sthitiṃ brūmaḥ yena dhvaṃsopalakṣitānupalakṣitasattārāhityarūpapāribhāṣikanityatvānityatvayorekatra sāmānyādau sadbhāvanidarśanena sattvāsattvayārekatra
analyzed: dhvaṃsa upalakṣita anupalakṣita sattā rāhitya rūpa nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ sāmānya ādau bhāva vat ekatra sattva asattve syātām iti api syāt iti ced na na hi vayam dṛṣṭānta mātreṇa sattva asattva vyatirekayoḥ ekatra sthitim brūmaḥ yena dhvaṃsa upalakṣita anupalakṣita sattā rāhitya rūpa pāribhāṣika nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ ekatra sāmānya ādau sadbhāva nidarśanena sattva asattvayāḥ ekatra anupalakṣita sattā rāhitya rūpa pāribhāṣika nitya tva anity

original: sattvamucyate, kintu pramāṇaiḥ siddhe niṣedhasamuccaye sāmānyādivyāvṛttanityatvānityatvayorniṣedhasamuccayaṃ dṛṣṭāntayāmaḥ| evaṃ ca sāmānyādyanugatatvaduktanityatvā -- nityatvayorniṣedhasamuccayasyādṛṣṭāntatve'pi na kṣatiḥ|
analyzed: sattvam ucyate kintu pramāṇaiḥ siddhe niṣedha samuccaye sāmānya ādi vyāvṛtta nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ niṣedha samuccayam dṛṣṭāntayāmaḥ evam ca sāmānya ādi anugata tvad ukta nitya tva a nitya tvayoḥ niṣedha samuccayasya adṛṣṭānta tve pi na kṣatiḥ

original: ata evoktamadhyaste nityatvānityatvayoriva sattvāsattvayorapyabhāvau na viruddhau, dharmiṇa eva kalpitatvena viruddhayorapi dharmayorabhāvād, iti| na caivaṃ kalpitasyānityatvābhyupagamavirodhaḥ, tāttvikānityatvābhāve'pi dharmisamasattākānityatvasattvenābhyupagame virodhābhāvāt|

original: na ca -- kalpitatvahetorviruddhadharmābhāvarūpasādhyasya ca bhāvābhāvābhyāṃ vyāghāta iti -- vācyam, atāttvikahetusadbhāvena tāttvikadharmābhāvasya sādhanena vyāghātābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca kalpitatva hetoḥ viruddha dharma abhāva rūpa sādhyasya ca bhāva abhāvābhyām vyāghātaḥ iti vācyam atāttvika hetu sadbhāvena tāttvika dharma abhāvasya sādhanena vyāghāta abhāvāt

original: ata eva svarūpato durnirūpasya na kiñcidapi rūpaṃ vāstavaṃ sambhavatīti prācāmuktirapi saṅgacchate, vyāvahārikeṇaiva durnirūpatvena hetunā vyāvahārikavāstavarūpābhāvasya sādhanāt|

original: ata eva -- durnirūpatvarūpahetorvāstavarūpābhāvasādhyasya cātāttvikatve'siddhibādhau tāttvikatve vyāghāta iti -- nirastam, dharmisamasattākahetusādhyādisattvenāsiddhyādyabhāvāt, tāttvikahetvādyabhāvācca na vyāghātaḥ| svarūpato durnirūpatvaṃ ca kalpitatvameva|

original: etena -- kimidaṃ svarūpato durnirūpatvaṃ kenāpi prakāreṇa vā? kenāpi durnirūpatvamityetadanyaprakāreṇa vā? sattvāsattvābhyāṃ vā? kenāpi durnirūpatvamityetadanyaprakāreṇa vā? sattvāsattvābhyāṃ vā? nādyaḥ, kenāpi prakāreṇa durnirūpatvamityanena prakāreṇa durnirūpatvādurnirūpatvābhyāṃ vyāghātāt|
analyzed: etena kim idam svarūpataḥ durnirūpa tvam kena api prakāreṇa vā kena api durnirūpa tvam iti etad anya prakāreṇa vā sattva asattvābhyām vā kena api durnirūpa tvam iti etad anya prakāreṇa vā sattva asattvābhyām vā na ādyaḥ kena api prakāreṇa durnirūpa tvam iti anena prakāreṇa durnirūpa tva a durnirūpa tvābhyām vyāghātāt
