original: vyāvṛtterbrahmābhinnatayā pāramārthikatve'pi vyāvartakaṃ pāramārthikamiti kutaḥ ? na hi yat pāramārthikabodhakaṃ, tat pāramārthikamiti niyamo'sti, bodhyabodhakayoḥ samasattākatvasya padatadarthādau vyabhicāreṇa prāgeva nirastatvāt, doṣāprayuktabhānatvasya sattvaprayojakatvāt|
analyzed: vyāvṛtteḥ brahma abhinna tayā pāramārthika tve pi vyāvartakam pāramārthikam iti kutas na hi yat pāramārthika bodhakam tat pāramārthikam iti niyamaḥ usti bodhya bodhakayoḥ sama sattāka tvasya pada tad artha ādau vyabhicāreṇa prāk eva nirasta tvāt doṣa aprayukta bhāna tvasya sattva prayojaka tvāt

original: nāpi vyāvṛttibodhakaṃ vyāvṛttisamasattākamiti niyamaḥ, svāpnāṅganāderapi svajanyasukhāpekṣayā sukhāntaravyāvṛttibuddhijanakatvāt, kāraṇasya kāryavyāvartakatvāt| sā ca vyāvṛttiḥ tava mate pāramārthikyeva| mama tu mate vyāvahārikī| sarvathāpi prātibhāsikavyāvartakāpekṣayādhikasattākaiva|
analyzed: nā api vyāvṛtti bodhakam vyāvṛtti sama sattākam iti niyamaḥ svāpna aṅganā ādeḥ api sva janya sukha apekṣayā sukha antara vyāvṛtti buddhi janaka tvāt kāraṇasya kārya vyāvartaka tvāt sā ca vyāvṛttiḥ tava mate pāramārthikī eva mama tu mate vyāvahārikī sarvathā api prātibhāsika vyāvartaka apekṣayā adhika sattākā eva

original: na ca vyāvṛtte brahmābhinnatve brahmapadenaiva tallābhāditarapadavaiyarthyam, sāmānyatastatsiddhāvapyanṛtādivyāvṛttyākāreṇa tatsiddhau sāphalyāt| evamajñānādi vyāvṛttīnāmanyonyābhede satyapadenaiva cāritārthyamiti apāstaṃ, tattadākāreṇa siddhestattatpadaṃ vinānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca vyāvṛtte brahma abhinnatve brahma padena eva tad lābhāt itara pada vaiyarthyam sāmānyatas tad siddhau api anṛta ādi vyāvṛtti ākāreṇa tad siddhau sāphalyāt evam ajñāna ādi vyāvṛttīnām anyonya abhede satya padena eva cāritārthyam iti apāstam tad tad ākāreṇa siddheḥ tat tat padam vinā anupapatteḥ

original: na ca -- evaṃ satyatvajñānatvādidharmāṇāmapi vyāvṛttivad brahmābhinnatayā pāramārthikatvamastviti vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ| tadevaṃ vyāvṛtteḥ satyatve na ko'pi doṣaḥ|
analyzed: na ca evam satya tva jñāna tva ādi dharmāṇām api vyāvṛtti vat brahma abhinnatayā pāramārthika tvam astu iti vācyam iṣṭa āpatteḥ tat evam vyāvṛtteḥ satya tve na kaḥ api doṣaḥ

original: vyāvṛttermithyātvapakṣe'pi nānṛtatvasya brahmasamasattākatvāpattiḥ, ekabādhakabādhyatvasyobhayatrāpi tulyatvād, vyāvṛttibādhakabādhyasyaiva pratiyogino vyāvṛttyadhikasattākatvam, na tvekabādhakabādhyasyāpi, kalpitarajatavyāvṛtteḥ kalpitarajate mithyātve'pi tadapekṣayā tasyādhikasattākatvābhāvād, adhikaṃ mithyātvamithyātvopapādane draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: vyāvṛtteḥ mithyātva pakṣe api nā anṛta tvasya brahma sama sattāka tva āpattiḥ eka bādhaka bādhya tvasya ubhayatra api tulya tvāt vyāvṛtti bādhaka bādhyasya eva pratiyoginaḥ vyāvṛtti adhika sattāka tvam na tu eka bādhaka bādhyasya api kalpita rajata vyāvṛtteḥ kalpita rajate mithyātve pi tad apekṣayā tasya adhika sattāka tva abhāvāt adhikam mithyātva mithyātva upapādane draṣṭavyam

original: nanu -- tattvajijñāsuṃ mumukṣuṃ prati mithyābodhanāyogaḥ, na cānṛtatvādibhrāntinivṛttyarthaṃ tad, adhiṣṭhānabrahmatattvasākṣātkāreṇaiva tannivṛttisaṃbhave bhrāntyantarotpādanāyogāt, na hi valmīke sthāṇurayamiti bhrāmyataḥ puruṣo'yamityupadiśyata iti -- cenna, nivartakādhiṣṭhānatattvasākṣātkāra eva tasyopāyatvāt, sthūlārundhatīnyāyena
analyzed: nanu tattva jijñāsum mumukṣum prati mithyā bodhana ayogaḥ na ca anṛta tva ādi bhrānti nivṛtti artham tat adhiṣṭhāna brahma tattva sākṣātkāreṇa eva tad nivṛtti saṃbhave bhrānti antara utpādana ayogāt na hi valmīke sthāṇuḥ ayam iti bhrāmyataḥ puruṣaḥ yam iti upadiśyate iti ced na nivartaka adhiṣṭhāna tattva sākṣātkāraḥ eva tasya upāya tvāt sthūla arundhatī nyāyena

original: pūrvapūrvabhramanivṛttaye kālpanikopadeśasya pañcakośasthale darśanācca| yathā cātmani kalpitena brāhmaṇyenāśaṅkitā brāhmaṇyabhrāntirnivartate tathā vyāvahārikyā vyāvṛttyā prātibhāsikyanṛtādibhrāntirnivartate|
analyzed: pūrva pūrva bhrama nivṛttaye kālpanika upadeśasya pañcakośa sthale darśanāt ca yathā ca ātmani kalpitena brāhmaṇyena āśaṅkitā brāhmaṇya bhrāntiḥ nivartate tathā vyāvahārikyā vyāvṛttyā prātibhāsikī anṛta ādi bhrāntiḥ nivartate

original: na cāsadvyāvṛttervyāvahārikatve'napoditaprāmāṇyena `asadvā idamagra āsī'diti vākyenāsattvasya pāramārthikatvaprasaṅgaḥ, `neha nāne'tyanena tasya niṣedhād, asadvā ityāderanyaparatvasya prāgeva darśitatvācca| tathā ca mīmāṃsakamate anṛtasyāpyarthavādārthasya satye prāśastya iva mithyābhūtānāmapi vyāvṛttīnāṃ satye brahmaṇi dvāratvena bodhanaṃ yuktam|
analyzed: na ca asat vyāvṛtteḥ vyāvahārika tvena apodita prāmāṇyena asat vā idam agre āsīt iti vākyena asattvasya pāramārthika tva prasaṅgaḥ na iha nānā iti anena tasya niṣedhāt asat vā ityādeḥ anya paratvasya prāk eva darśita tvāt ca tathā ca mīmāṃsaka mate anṛtasya api arthavāda arthasya satye prāśastye iva mithyābhūtānām api vyāvṛttīnām satye brahmaṇi dvāra tvena bodhanam yuktam

original: uktaṃ hi -- `satye brahmaṇi satyādiśabdā vyāvṛttidvārā paryavasyantī'ti|
analyzed: uktam hi satye brahmaṇi satya ādi śabdāḥ vyāvṛtti dvārā paryavasyanti iti

original: na ca vyāvṛttijñānasya dharmidhīsādhyatvena vaiparītyāpātaḥ, dharmaviśiṣṭadharmijñānasādhyāyā vyāvṛtteḥ śuddhadharmijñāne dvāratvāṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: na ca vyāvṛtti jñānasya dharmi dhī sādhya tvena vaiparītya āpātaḥ dharma viśiṣṭa dharmi jñāna sādhyāyāḥ vyāvṛtteḥ śuddha dharmi jñāne dvāra tva aṅgīkārāt

original: na ca -- śābde arthe ārthikasya dvāratvamanupapannam, anyathā nīlamutpamityāderanīlavyāvṛttidvārā svarūpamātraparatvaṃ syāditi vācyam, nīlamutpalamityādau svarūpamātrabodhe tātparyābhāvānna śābde'rthe ārthikārthāpekṣā, viśiṣṭārthatātparyāt| atra tu svarūpamātre tātparyam, taccārthikārthasya dvāratvaṃ vinā'nupapannam|
analyzed: na ca śābde arthe ārthikasya dvāra tvam anupapannam anyathā nīlam utpam ityādeḥ anīla vyāvṛtti dvārā svarūpa mātra paratvam syāt iti vācyam nīlam utpalam ityādau svarūpa mātra bodhe tātparya abhāvāt na śābda ṛthe ārthika artha apekṣā viśiṣṭa artha tātparyāt atra tu svarūpa mātre tātparyam tat ca ārthika arthasya dvāra tvam vinā anupapannam

original: na ca viśeṣasya tvanmate'bhāvāt kiṃ prāgajñātaṃ vyāvṛttyā jñāpanīyamiti vācyam, anyāviṣayakasya svarūpajñānasya bhramavirodhinaḥ sādhyatvāt| na caivamanyājñāne dvāratvam, anyajñānapratibandhadvāreṇa śuddhajñāna eva dvāratvasaṃbhavāt| na ca vyāvṛttijñāna eva svarūpajñānaṃ dvāramastu, tasyābhidhābalalabdhaviśiṣṭajñānādevopapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca viśeṣasya tvad mate bhāvāt kim prāk ajñātam vyāvṛttyā jñāpanīyam iti vācyam anya a viṣayakasya svarūpa jñānasya bhrama virodhinaḥ sādhya tvāt na ca evam anya ajñāne dvāra tvam anya jñāna pratibandha dvāreṇa śuddha jñāne eva dvāra tva saṃbhavāt na ca vyāvṛtti jñāne eva svarūpa jñānam dvāram astu tasya abhidhā bala labdha viśiṣṭa jñānāt eva upapatteḥ

original: na ca -- prācīne brahmājñānanivartakabrahmāparokṣajñāne tadajñānakāryasyānyasya bhānāyogaḥ, brahmaprātipadikārthabubhutsāyāmeva etadvākyapravṛttiriti svaprakriyāvirodhaśceti vācyam, brahmāparokṣajñānaṃ hi tatsvarūpaṃ vā ? vṛttirūpaṃ vā ? ādye nānyabhānānupapattiḥ, tasyāvidyānivartakatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca prācīne brahma ajñāna nivartaka brahma aparokṣa jñāne tad ajñāna kāryasya anyasya bhāna ayogaḥ brahma prātipadika artha bubhutsāyām eva etad vākya pravṛttiḥ iti sva prakriyā virodhaḥ ca iti vācyam brahma aparokṣa jñānam hi tat svarūpam vā vṛtti rūpam vā ādye na anya bhāna anupapattiḥ tasya avidyā nivartaka tva abhāvāt

original: vṛttirūpamapyāpātadarśanaṃ nāvidyānivartakam, tasyāsākṣātkāratvādvā, sākṣātkāratve'pi pratibaddhatvādvā| vicārajanyaṃ tu phalībhūtaṃ bhavatyavidyānivartakam, na tu tatprācīnamiti kimanupapannam ?
analyzed: vṛtti rūpam api āpāta darśanam na avidyā nivartakam tasya asākṣātkāra tvāt vā sākṣātkāra tve pi pratibaddha tvāt vā vicāra janyam tu phalībhūtam bhavati avidyā nivartakam na tu tat prācīnam iti kim anupapannam

original: nanu -- satyaśabdenāsadvyāvṛttidvārā yadbodhitam, tadeva jñānādipadairajñānādivyāvṛttidvārā bodhyamiti padāntaravaiphalyam|
analyzed: nanu satya śabdena asat vyāvṛtti dvārā yat bodhitam tat eva jñāna ādi padaiḥ ajñāna ādi vyāvṛtti dvārā bodhyam iti pada antara vaiphalyam

original: na ca dvāravikalpaḥ, satyādipadānāṃ nityavacchravaṇād ekasmin prayoge vrīhiyavayorivaikasmin vākye satyādyanekapadopādānāyogād, anṛtatvādibhrāntinivṛttirūpadṛṣṭakāryāṇāṃ bhinnatvena brīhiyavādivad vikalpaprayojakasyaikakāryatvasyāpyabhāvācceti cenna, samuccitānāṃ dvāratvena saphalatvāt|
analyzed: na ca dvāra vikalpaḥ satya ādi padānām nitya vat śravaṇāt ekasmin prayoge vrīhi yavayoḥ iva ekasmin vākye satya ādi aneka pada upādāna ayogāt anṛta tva ādi bhrānti nivṛtti rūpa dṛṣṭa kāryāṇām bhinna tvena brīhi yava ādi vat vikalpa prayojakasya eka kāryatvasya api abhāvāt ca iti ced na samuccitānām dvāra tvena saphalatvāt

original: pradhānasya brahmaṇaḥ pratipattyupayogināmānandādīnāṃ bhāvarūpāṇāṃ `ānandādayaḥ pradhānasye'tyanenāsthūlatvādīnāmabhāvarūpāṇām `akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavarodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavattadukta'mityanena ca sūtreṇa nirguṇabrahmapratipattāveva sarvaśākhopasaṃhārasya pratipāditatvena dvārasamuccayasyaiveṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: pradhānasya brahmaṇaḥ pratipatti upayoginām ānanda ādīnām bhāva rūpāṇām ānanda ādayaḥ pradhānasya iti anena a sthūla tva ādīnām abhāva rūpāṇām akṣara dhiyām tu avarodhaḥ sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām aupasada vat tat uktam iti anena ca sūtreṇa nirguṇa brahma pratipattau eva sarva śākhā upasaṃhārasya pratipādita tvena dvārasamuccayasya eva iṣṭa tvāt

original: nanu -- saguṇe brahmaṇyupāsanārthaṃ bhavatu śākhāntarīyaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ, nirguṇabrahmapratipattau tu kiṃ śākhāntarīyaguṇopasaṃhāreṇa ? satyādipadānāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣakatvena lakṣyabrahmabodhane pratyekameva samarthatvāt, satyatvādeśca pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇatvāt| na hi prakṛṣṭatvādikamiva satyatvādikamativyāptamiti cet, na|
analyzed: nanu saguṇe brahmaṇi upāsana artham bhavatu śākhā antarīya guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ nirguṇa brahma pratipattau tu kim śākhā antarīya guṇa upasaṃhāreṇa satya ādi padānām pratyekam lakṣaka tvena lakṣya brahma bodhane pratyekam eva samartha tvāt satya tva ādeḥ ca pratyekam lakṣaṇa tvāt na hi prakṛṣṭa tva ādikam iva satya tva ādikam ativyāptam iti ced na

original: prakṛṣṭaprakāśapadayoriva satyādipadānāmapi kumataprāptātivyāptinivṛttyarthaṃ samuccayāpekṣaṇāt| na hyanṛtavyāvṛttibodhanaṃ vinā `vijñānamānandaṃ brahme' tyatra sūnyavādavyāvṛttabrahmasiddhiḥ| evamekaikapadābhāve sarvatrātivyāptirūhanīyā| tathā ca satyatvādikamanṛtādivyāvṛttidvārā śūnyavādādivyāvṛttabrahmasiddherupāyaḥ|
analyzed: prakṛṣṭa prakāśa padayoḥ iva satya ādi padānām api kumata prāpta ativyāpti nivṛtti artham samuccaya apekṣaṇāt na hi anṛta vyāvṛtti bodhanam vinā vijñānam ānandam brahma iti atra sūnyavāda vyāvṛtta brahma siddhiḥ evam ekaika pada abhāve sarvatra ativyāptiḥ ūhanīyā tathā ca satya tva ādikam anṛta ādi vyāvṛtti dvārā śūnyavāda ādi vyāvṛtta brahma siddheḥ upāyaḥ

original: na ca -- vyāvṛttiḥ, kiṃ brahmaviśeṣaṇatvena bodhyā ? svatantrā vā ? ādye sakhaṇḍārthatvam, dvitīye brahmajijñāsuṃ prati tadupadeśo'saṅgata iti vācyam, vyāvṛttiryadyapi viśeṣaṇatayaivārthikabodhe bhāsate, tathāpi na śābdabodhe sakhaṇḍārthatvam| yaścārthādartho na sa codanārtha iti nyāyāt|
analyzed: na ca vyāvṛttiḥ kim brahma viśeṣaṇatvena bodhyā svatantrā vā ādye sakhaṇḍa arthatvam dvitīye brahma jijñāsum prati tad upadeśa usaṅgataḥ iti vācyam vyāvṛttiḥ yadi api viśeṣaṇatayā eva ārthika bodhe bhāsate tathā api na śābda bodhe sakhaṇḍa arthatvam yaḥ ca arthāt arthaḥ na sa codanā arthaḥ iti nyāyāt

original: taduktaṃ vārtikakāraiḥ -- `mānāntarādapohastu na śābdastena sa smṛtaḥ' iti | na cārthikaināpi viśeṣaṇena brahmaṇaḥ sakhaṇḍatvāpattiḥ, nirdharmakatvādiśruterviśeṣaṇasya dharmyasamānasattākatvena sakhaṇḍatvāprayojakatvāt|
analyzed: tat uktam vārtikakāraiḥ māna antarāt apohaḥ tu na śābdaḥ tena sa smṛtaḥ iti na viśeṣaṇena brahmaṇaḥ sakhaṇḍatva āpattiḥ nirdharmaka tva ādi śruteḥ viśeṣaṇasya dharmya samāna sattāka tvena sakhaṇḍatva aprayojaka tvāt

original: na ca -- anantaśabdenāntavadvyāvṛttessākṣādeva bodhanānna tasya ārthikatvam, tathā cānantapadasya sakhaṇḍārthatvaṃ syāditi -- vācyam, yadyapi --
analyzed: na ca ananta śabdena anta vat vyāvṛtteḥ sākṣāt eva bodhanāt na tasya ārthika tvam tathā ca ananta padasya sakhaṇḍa artha tvam syāt iti vācyam yadi api

original: tatrānanto'ntavadvastuvyāvṛttyaiva viśeṣaṇam|
svārthārpaṇaprāṇāḍyā tu pariśiṣṭau viśeṣaṇam|| iti |
analyzed: sva artha arpaṇa prāṇāḍyā tu pariśiṣṭau viśeṣaṇam iti

original: taittirīyavārtikoktadiśā vidhipadānāṃ svārthārpaṇapraṇāḍikayā arthāditaranivṛtti bodhakatvam, niṣedhapadānāṃ tu sākṣāditi sthitam, tathāpi dvārabhūte jñāne sakhaṇḍārthatve'pi paramatātparyaviṣayajñānenākhaṇḍārthatvavyāghāta ityasakṛduktam| etadevoktamānandabodhācāryaiḥ --
analyzed: taittirīya vārtika ukta diśā vidhi padānām svārtha arpaṇa praṇāḍikayā arthāt itara nivṛtti bodhaka tvam niṣedha padānām tu sākṣāt iti sthitam tathā api dvāra bhūte jñāne sakhaṇḍa artha tve pi parama tātparya viṣaya jñānena akhaṇḍa artha tva vyāghātaḥ iti asakṛt uktam etat eva uktam ānandabodha ācāryaiḥ

original: lakṣyārthabhedābhāve'pi vyavacchedyavibhedataḥ|
analyzed: lakṣya artha bheda abhāve pi vyavacchedya vibhedataḥ

original: vijñānānandapadayoḥ paryāyavyarthate na hi|| iti |
analyzed: vijñāna ānanda padayoḥ na hi iti

original: evaṃ pade lakṣaṇeti pakṣe samāhitam|
analyzed: evam pade lakṣaṇā iti pakṣe samāhitam

original: kecittvatra vākye lakṣaṇāmāhuḥ, na pade| tathā hi -- yathā `gambhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa' ityatra gambhīranadyoḥ parasparamanvayabodhānantaraṃ viśiṣṭārthasaṃbandhi tīraṃ lakṣyate, tathā prakṛte parasparaviśiṣṭārthabodhānantaraṃ tatsambandhyakhaṇḍaṃ lakṣyate| tathā ca na padavaiyarthyam|
analyzed: kecid tu atra vākye lakṣaṇām āhuḥ na pade tathā hi yathā gambhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra gambhīra nadyoḥ parasparam anvaya bodha anantaram viśiṣṭa artha saṃbandhi tīram lakṣyate tathā prakṛte paraspara viśiṣṭa artha bodha anantaram tad sambandhya khaṇḍam lakṣyate tathā ca na pada vaiyarthyam

original: na ca tatrāpi pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇā, tathā sati gambhīranadītīrādilābhena viśiṣṭatīrabuddhirna syāt| na caṃ tatra gambhīranadīpadayoriva iha satyādipadānāṃ parasparamanvayabodhakatvaṃ tvanmate nāstīti -- vācyam, ekasmin brahmaṇi dvārībhūtasya parasparārthānvayabodhasya satyādipadaiḥ militvā jananād, uttarakāla eva lakṣaṇayā akhaṇḍabodhasyābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: na ca tatra api pratyekam lakṣaṇā tathā sati gambhīra nadī tīra ādi lābhena viśiṣṭa tīra buddhiḥ na syāt na tatra gambhīra nadī padayoḥ iva iha satya ādi padānām parasparam anvaya bodhaka tvam tvad mate na asti iti vācyam ekasmin brahmaṇi dvārībhūtasya paraspara artha anvaya bodhasya satya ādi padaiḥ militvā jananāt uttara kāle eva lakṣaṇayā akhaṇḍa bodhasya abhyupagamāt

original: na ca -- `satyaṃ jñānaṃ' `vijñānamānanda'mityādau anyonyānapekṣāṇāṃ satyādipadānāṃ brahmalakṣakatvādarśanāt kathaṃ gambhīrāyāmityāditulyanyāyateti vācyam, yatra vastugatyā gambhīranadyabhiprāyeṇaiva nadyāṃ ghoṣa ityuktam, tatra parasparanirapekṣalakṣakatvasya gambhīrāyāmityuktau ca militalakṣakatvasya darśanād, guṇopasaṃhāranyāyena
analyzed: na ca satyam jñānam vijñānam ānandam ityādau anyonya anapekṣāṇām satya ādi padānām brahma lakṣaka tva adarśanāt katham gambhīrāyām ityādi tulya nyāyatā iti vācyam yatra vastugatyā gambhīra nadī abhiprāyeṇa eva nadyām ghoṣaḥ iti uktam tatra paraspara nirapekṣa lakṣaka tvasya gambhīrāyām iti uktau ca milita lakṣaka tvasya darśanāt guṇa upasaṃhāra nyāyena

original: dvārasamuccayasya sthāpitatvācca| na ca -- parasparapadasāhityena tatra gambhīranadīsaṃbandhi tīraṃ lakṣyate, anyathā tvekaikasaṃbandhi, prakṛte tvadhikalābho na padāntareṇāpīti vācyam, tatrāpi yugapad‌vṛttidvayavirodhāpattyā gambhīranadītīratvena lakṣaṇānabhyupagamād, vastugatyā viśiṣṭasaṃbandhinaḥ pratyekapadādapi lābhāt|
analyzed: dvāra samuccayasya sthāpita tvāt ca na ca paraspara pada sāhityena tatra gambhīra nadī saṃbandhi tīram lakṣyate anyathā tu ekaika saṃbandhi prakṛte tu adhika lābhaḥ na pada antareṇa api iti vācyam tatra api yugapad vṛtti dvaya virodha āpattyā gambhīra nadī tīra tvena lakṣaṇa anabhyupagamāt vastugatyā viśiṣṭa saṃbandhinaḥ pratyeka padāt api lābhāt

original: atha viśiṣṭabuddhidvāratvādvāratvābhyāṃ viśeṣaḥ, prakṛte'pi sa tulya eva|
analyzed: atha viśiṣṭa buddhi dvāra tva advāra tvābhyām viśeṣaḥ prakṛte api sa tulyaḥ eva

original: nanu -- gambhīrāyāmityatrāpi na milite lakṣaṇā, kintu nadīpada eva, paraspara sāhityena viśiṣṭabodhānantaraṃ svajñāpyaviśiṣṭasaṃbandhini lakṣaṇāsaṃbhavāt, svajñāpyasaṃbandha eva hi lakṣaṇā, lāghavāt, na tu tadviśeṣaḥ śakyasaṃbandhaḥ, gauravāt| tathā ca padadvaye lakṣaṇā, lakṣaṇādvayaṃ vā na yuktam|
analyzed: nanu gambhīrāyām iti atra api na milite lakṣaṇā kintu nadī pade eva paraspara sāhityena viśiṣṭa bodha anantaram sva jñāpya viśiṣṭa saṃbandhini lakṣaṇā asaṃbhavāt sva jñāpya saṃbandhaḥ eva hi lakṣaṇā lāghavāt na tu tad viśeṣaḥ śakya saṃbandhaḥ gauravāt tathā ca pada dvaye lakṣaṇā lakṣaṇā dvayam vā na yuktam

original: evaṃ ca vṛtteḥ padavṛttitvaniyamo'pi saṅgacchata iti cet, naitatsāram, svajñāpyasaṃbandho hi lakṣaṇeti tvayocyate, tacca jñāpyaṃ prakṛte viśiṣṭam, tajjñāpakatvaṃ cobhayoḥ sādhāraṇamiti kathaṃ nadīpada eva lakṣaṇā ? na gambhīrapade, vinigamakābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca vṛtteḥ pada vṛtti tva niyamaḥ api saṅgacchate iti ced na etat sāram sva jñāpya saṃbandhaḥ hi lakṣaṇā iti tvayā ucyate tat ca jñāpyam prakṛte viśiṣṭam tad jñāpaka tvam ca ubhayoḥ sādhāraṇam iti katham nadī pade eva lakṣaṇā na gambhīra pade vinigamaka abhāvāt

original: na ca gāmbhīryeṇa saha tīrasya paramparayā saṃbandhaḥ nadyāḥ sākṣātsaṃbandha eva vinigamaka iti vācyam, `nimnaṃ gabhīraṃ gambhīra'miti kośād gambhīrapadasya nimnarūpanadīdravyavācitvena sākṣātsaṃbandhasyāpi sādhāraṇatvāt|
analyzed: na ca gāmbhīryeṇa saha tīrasya paramparayā saṃbandhaḥ nadyāḥ sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ eva vinigamakaḥ iti vācyam nimnam gabhīram gambhīram iti kośāt gambhīra padasya nimna rūpa nadī dravya vāci tvena sākṣāt saṃbandhasya api sādhāraṇa tvāt

original: na ca viśeṣaṇavibhakteḥ sādhutvārthakatvād gambhīrapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ vibhaktyarthānanvaya iti -- vācyam, viśiṣṭabodhasamaye gambhīrapadasya viśeṣaṇapadatve'pi viśiṣṭasaṃbandhilakṣaṇāsamaye viśeṣyapadatvāt|
analyzed: na ca viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ sādhutva arthaka tvāt gambhīra pada lakṣaṇāyām vibhakti artha ananvayaḥ iti vācyam viśiṣṭa bodha samaye gambhīra padasya viśeṣaṇa pada tve pi viśiṣṭa saṃbandhi lakṣaṇā samaye viśeṣya pada tvāt

original: viśeṣaṇavibhakteḥ sādhutvārthakatvamityapyasaṃbaddham, abhedārthakatvasya naiyāyikaiḥ pratyekamanvayasya ca mīmāṃsakairaruṇādhikaraṇasiddhasya cābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ sādhutva arthaka tvam iti api asaṃbaddham abheda arthaka tvasya naiyāyikaiḥ pratyekam anvayasya ca mīmāṃsakaiḥ aruṇa adhikaraṇa siddhasya ca abhyupagamāt

original: evamanyadapi vākyalakṣaṇodāharaṇamanusandheyam -- `gaccha gacchasi cet kānta' ityādi, viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣvetyādi ca|
analyzed: evam anyat api vākya lakṣaṇa udāharaṇam anusandheyam gaccha gacchasi ced kānta ityādi viṣam bhuṅkṣva ityādi ca

original: nanu -- atra janmanā maraṇānumānam, tena ca tatsādhanībhūtāyāḥ gaterakartavyatānumānamityanumānaparamparaiva, na lakṣaṇā, ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāt, na hi dhūmo'stīti vākyaṃ vahnilakṣakam| viṣamityādāvapi viṣabhojanasyeṣṭasādhanatoktyā śatrugṛhānnabhojanasyāniṣṭasādhanatvamākṣipyate|
analyzed: nanu atra janmanā maraṇa anumānam tena ca tad sādhanībhūtāyāḥ gateḥ akartavya tā anumānam iti anumāna paramparā eva na lakṣaṇā ananya labhyasya eva śabda artha tvāt na hi dhūmaḥ usti iti vākyam vahni lakṣakam viṣam ityādau api viṣa bhojanasya iṣṭasādhanatā uktyā śatru gṛha anna bhojanasya aniṣṭa sādhanatvam ākṣipyate

original: yadvā -- āptasya pramāṇaviruddhopadeṣṭṛtvena kopo'numīyate| tatra ca pralasaktaśatrugṛhānnabhojanasya hetutvaṃ kalpayitvā tatrākartavyatānumānam, na lakṣaṇeti cet, naitatsādhu, janmanā maraṇākṣepe'pi tanmaraṇe gamanasya hetutvānākṣepāt, śatavarṣānantaraṃ jarādināpi tadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: yat vā āptasya pramāṇa viruddha upadeṣṭṛ tvena kopaḥ anumīyate tatra ca hetu tvam kalpayitvā tatra akartavya tā anumānam na lakṣaṇā iti ced na etat sādhu janmanā maraṇa ākṣepe api tad maraṇe gamanasya hetu tva anākṣepāt śata varṣa anantaram jarā ādinā api tad upapatteḥ

original: tathā ca priyāmaraṇe hetutvaṃ gamanasya na lakṣaṇāṃ vinā'vagantuṃ śakyam| nāpi priyāmaraṇahetutvena gamanasyākartavyatvānumānam, priyāmaraṇahetorapi tattvenājñānadaśāyāṃ gurunideśādvā ātmatrāṇārthaṃ vā kulāpakīrtiparihārārthaṃ vā kartavyatvadarśanena vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: tathā ca priyā maraṇe hetu tvam gamanasya na lakṣaṇām vinā avagantum śakyam nā api priyā maraṇa hetu tvena gamanasya akartavya tva anumānam priyā maraṇa hetoḥ api tattvena ajñāna daśāyām guru nideśāt vā ātma trāṇa artham vā kula apakīrti parihāra artham vā kartavya tva darśanena vyabhicārāt

original: tathā ca gamanasya priyāmaraṇahetutvaṃ tādṛśasya cākartavyatvamityubhayamapi lakṣaṇādhīnam, janmanirdeśasya ca prakṛte'nupayogāt tena prakṛtopayoginyagamane tātparyaṃ jñāpyate samudāyasya| tathā ca samudāya eva lakṣaṇā| na pratyekapade, pratyekaṃ tātparyajñāpakābhāvāt| tathā ca nātrānumiti paramparā, na vā pratyekapade, lakṣaṇā|
analyzed: tathā ca gamanasya priya āmaraṇa hetu tvam tādṛśasya ca akartavya tvam iti ubhayam api lakṣaṇa adhīnam janma nirdeśasya ca prakṛtena upayogāt tena prakṛta upayogini agamane tātparyam jñāpyate samudāyasya tathā ca samudāye eva lakṣaṇā na pratyeka pade pratyekam tātparya jñāpaka abhāvāt tathā ca na atra anumiti paramparā na vā pratyeka pade lakṣaṇā

original: evaṃ `viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣve'tyatrāpi viṣabhojaneṣṭasādhanatvena śatrugṛhānnabhojanāniṣṭasādhanatvaṃ nākṣeptuṃ śakyate, vyadhikaraṇatvāt| tena vināpyubhayorapīṣṭasādhanatayopapattisaṃbhavācca| na hi yena kenacidyatkiñcidākṣipyate, kiṃtvanupapadyamānenopapādakam|
analyzed: evam viṣam bhuṅkṣva iti atra api viṣa bhojana iṣṭasādhanatvena śatru gṛha anna bhojana aniṣṭa sādhanatvam na ākṣeptum śakyate vyadhikaraṇa tvāt tena vinā api ubhayoḥ api iṣṭa sādhanatayā upapatti saṃbhavāt ca na hi yena kenacid yat kiñcid ākṣipyate kiṃtu anupapadyamānena upapādakam

original: nāpyāptatve sati pramāṇaviruddhopadeṣṭṛtvena kopānumānaṃ kopena ca taddhetau śatrugṛhānnabhojane akartavyatānumānam, āptasyāpi pitrāderbhramādinā vināpi kopaṃ pramāṇaviruddhopadeṣṭṛtvadarśanena vyabhicārādāptakopahetorapi bhramādinā priyāmaraṇahetoriva kartavyatvadarśanena tatrāpi vyabhicārācca|
analyzed: na api āpta tve sati pramāṇa viruddha upadeṣṭṛ tvena kopa anumānam kopena ca tad hetau śatru gṛha anna bhojane akartavya tā anumānam āptasya api pitṛ ādeḥ bhrama ādinā vinā api kopam pramāṇa viruddha upadeṣṭṛ tva darśanena vyabhicārāt āpta kopa hetoḥ api bhrama ādinā priyā maraṇa hetoḥ iva kartavya tva darśanena tatra api vyabhicārāt ca

original: tathā cāprasaktapratipādanena prasaktavāraṇe tātparyaṃ jñātvā tenākalpitapadavibhāge samudāya eva lakṣaṇāṃ kalpayati, na tu pratyekapade, tatra tatra viśiṣya tātparyajñāpakābhāvāt| tathā ca padārthetātparyānvayānupapattibhyāṃ lakṣaṇā pade| vākyārthe tad‌dbayānupapattyā lakṣaṇā vākye|
analyzed: tathā ca aprasakta pratipādanena prasakta vāraṇe tātparyam jñātvā tena akalpita pada vibhāge samudāye eva lakṣaṇām kalpayati na tu pratyeka pade tatra tatra viśiṣya tātparya jñāpaka abhāvāt tathā ca padārtha itātparya anvaya anupapattibhyām lakṣaṇā pade vākya arthe tad dbaya anupapattyā lakṣaṇā vākye

original: vākyārthānupapattyanibandhanatvaṃ ca lakṣaṇāyā padavṛttitvasādhane upādhirityavadheyam|
analyzed: vākya artha anupapatti anibandhana tvam ca lakṣaṇāyā pada vṛtti tva sādhane upādhiḥ iti avadheyam

original: evamevārdhamantarardhaṃ bahirityādau loke ardhamantarvedyardhaṃ bahirvedīti vede'pi vākya eva lakṣaṇā| na ca -- tatrāpyardhasyāntastve satyardhasya bahiṣṭ‌venāntarālānumānam, na lakṣaṇeti vācyam, chinne gṛhe antarālarāhitye'pi tad‌dvayadarśanena vyabhicārād yathākathaṃcidanumānasaṃbhave vā sarvatra śabdapramāṇocchedāpātācca|
analyzed: evam eva ardham antar ardham bahis ityādau loke ardham antarvedi ardham bahirvedi iti vede pi vākye eva lakṣaṇā na ca tatra api ardhasya antar tve sati ardhasya bahiṣṭvena antarāla anumānam na lakṣaṇā iti vācyam chinne gṛhe antarāla rāhitye api tad dvaya darśanena vyabhicārāt yathā kathaṃcid anumāna saṃbhave vā sarvatra śabda pramāṇa uccheda āpātāt ca

original: evaṃ ca brahmajijñāsāpadena vicāro lakṣyata iti vivaraṇakāroktaṃ yajñāyudhipadena yajamāno lakṣyata iti saṃkṣepaśārīrakoktaṃ ca vākyalakṣaṇayopapannam, brahmajijñāsā yajñāyudhiśabdayoḥ subantatvalakṣaṇapadatve'pi śaktatvalakṣaṇapadatvābhāvena śakyasaṃbandharūpāyā lakṣaṇāyā ayogāt, svajñāpyasaṃbandharūpā tu lakṣaṇā yaugikapadasamudāye'pi
analyzed: evam ca brahma jijñāsā padena vicāraḥ lakṣyate iti vivaraṇa kāra uktam yajñāyudhi padena yajamānaḥ lakṣyate iti saṃkṣepaśārīraka uktam ca vākya lakṣaṇayā upapannam brahma jijñāsā yajñāyudhi śabdayoḥ sup anta tva lakṣaṇa pada tve pi śakta tva lakṣaṇa pada tva abhāvena śakya saṃbandha rūpāyāḥ lakṣaṇāyāḥ ayogāt sva jñāpya saṃbandha rūpā tu lakṣaṇā yaugika pada samudāye pi

original: vākyasthānīye nānupapannā|
analyzed: vākya sthānīye na anupapannā

original: evaṃ `vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devate' tyādau arthavāde'pi prāśastyapratipattaye vākya eva laṇaṇā'ṅgīkāryā, pratyekapadāttadanupapatteḥ|
analyzed: evam vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhāḥ devate tyādau arthavāde pi prāśastya pratipattaye vākye eva laṇaṇā aṅgīkāryā pratyeka padāt tad anupapatteḥ

original: na ca -- tatra karmaṇi kṣipradevatāprasādahetutvarūpatatpadārthasaṃbandhabodhakatvameva, na tu tadanyaprāśastyalakṣakatvamiti vācyam, padārthamātrasaṃsargabodhe vāyuḥ śīghratama ityeva dhīḥ syāt, na karmaprāśastyaviṣayā sā syāt|
analyzed: na ca tatra karmaṇi kṣipra devatā prasāda hetutva rūpa tad padārtha saṃbandha bodhakatvam eva na tu tad anya prāśastya lakṣakatvam iti vācyam padārtha mātra saṃsarga bodhe vāyuḥ śīghratamaḥ iti eva dhīḥ syāt na karma prāśastya viṣayā sā syāt

original: na ca -- liṅgādyabhidheyakāryasyānvayānupapattistatra lakṣaṇābījamasti, prakṛte ca sarvapadānāṃ lakṣakatvādabhidheyānvayānupapattirnāstīti vācyam, kena tubhyamabhāṇyabhidheyānupapattyā lakṣaṇeti ? kintu tātparyānupapattyā| tacca tātparyamabhidheyānvayaviṣayamanvayasāmānyaviṣayaṃ svarūpamātraviṣayaṃ veti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: na ca liṅga ādi abhidheya kāryasya anvaya anupapattiḥ tatra lakṣaṇā bījam asti prakṛte ca sarva padānām lakṣaka tvāt abhidheya anvaya anupapattiḥ na asti iti vācyam kena tubhyam abhāṇi abhidheya anupapattyā lakṣaṇā iti kintu tātparya anupapattyā tat ca tātparyam abhidheya anvaya viṣayam anvaya sāmānya viṣayam svarūpa mātra viṣayam vā iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ

original: anyathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyatra lakṣaṇā na syāt| na ca -- bhojanaprayojanakapraveśanasya yaṣṭiṣvanvayānupapattirevāstīti vācyam, evamapi praveśanaviśeṣe tātparyagraha evopajīvya iti tadanupapattireva lakṣaṇābījamastu| vinigamanāviraheṇa dvayorapi vyavasthitavikalpe'pyasmākaṃ na kṣatirityavadheyam|
analyzed: anyathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya iti atra lakṣaṇā na syāt na ca bhojana prayojanaka praveśanasya yaṣṭiṣu anvaya anupapattiḥ eva asti iti vācyam evam api praveśana viśeṣe tātparya grahaḥ eva upajīvyaḥ iti tad anupapattiḥ eva lakṣaṇā bījam astu vinigamanā viraheṇa dvayoḥ api vyavasthita vikalpe pi asmākam na kṣatiḥ iti avadheyam

original: nanu -- sarvapadānāṃ lākṣaṇikatve vākyārthānubhavo na syāt, lākṣaṇikasyānanu bhāvakatvāditi cenna, lākṣaṇikatve'pyanubhāvakatvopapatteḥ| śaktatvena hyanubhāvakatvam, na tu tacchaktatvena, gauravāt| lākṣaṇikamapi kvacicchaktameva, bhaṭṭācāryairvākyārthasya sarvapadalakṣyatvābhyupagamācca|
analyzed: nanu sarva padānām lākṣaṇika tve vākya artha anubhavaḥ na syāt lākṣaṇikasya ananu bhāvaka tvāt iti ced na lākṣaṇika tve pi anubhāvaka tva upapatteḥ śakta tvena hi anubhāvaka tvam na tu tad śakta tvena gauravāt lākṣaṇikam api kvacid śaktam eva bhaṭṭa ācāryaiḥ vākya arthasya sarva pada lakṣya tva abhyupagamāt ca

original: tathā hi -- abhihitānvayavāde padaiḥ svaśaktivaśāt padārthā abhidhīyante; na tu smāryante, smāryasmārakasaṃbandhātiriktamūlasaṃbandhakalpanāpatteḥ| ekasaṃbandhijñānaṃ hyaparasaṃbandhismārakam, na tu smārakatvameva saṃbandhaḥ, hastipakādiṣu tathā darśanāt| ata evoktaṃ -- `padamabhyadhikābhāvāt smārakānna viśiṣyate|| iti |

original: ajñātajñāpakatvābhāvānnānubhāvakam, saṃbandhāntarābhāvācca na smārakam, kintu śaktyā jñātajñāpakamiti smārakasadṛśamityarthaḥ smṛtyanubhavātiriktaṃ ca jñānaṃ pramāṇabalādāyātamaṅgīkāryameva, padārthajñāne tattānullekhācca, tattollekhaniyamabhaṅgenātra tatpramoṣakalpane cātigauravāt|

original: yadyapi padābhihitapadārthasmāryatvaṃ tīrādau lakṣyatvam, vākyārthe tu tadanubhāvyatvamiti viśeṣaḥ, tathāpi padārthabodhyatvamādāya lakṣyatvavyapadeśaḥ| ata eva padārthena padārthalakṣaṇāyāṃ pūrvasaṃbandhajñānāpekṣā, tasya smāryatvād, vākyarthalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu na tadapekṣā, tasyānubhāvyatvena pūrvasaṃbandhajñānānapekṣatvāt|
analyzed: yadi api pada abhihita padārtha smārya tvam tīra ādau lakṣya tvam vākya arthe tu tad anubhāvya tvam iti viśeṣaḥ tathā api padārtha bodhya tvam ādāya lakṣya tva vyapadeśaḥ atas eva padārthena padārtha lakṣaṇāyām pūrva saṃbandha jñāna apekṣā tasya smārya tvāt vākya artha lakṣaṇāyām tu na tad apekṣā tasya anubhāvya tvena pūrva saṃbandha jñāna anapekṣa tvāt

original: evaṃ ca padaśakteḥ padārthopasthitāvevopakṣayādupasthitānāṃ ca padārthānāmanvayānubhāvakatvāt sarvapadalakṣaṇikatve'pi na vedāntavākyānāmanvayānubhāvakatvānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: evam ca pada śakteḥ padārtha upasthitau eva upakṣayāt upasthitānām ca padārthānām anvaya anubhāvaka tvāt sarva pada lakṣaṇika tve pi na vedānta vākyānām anvaya anubhāvaka tva anupapattiḥ

original: syādetat -- abhihitānvayavāde mā bhūdanupapattiḥ, anvitābhidhāne tu bhavati, tathā hi padānāmanvayānubhavajananasāmarthyameva śaktirityucyate, ekaikapadārthopasthitistu smṛtirūpā, na śaktisādhyā, ekasaṃbandhijñānādaparasaṃbandhismaraṇasya hastipakādisādhāraṇatvād, anvayānubhavajananasāmarthyarūpasya ca mūlasaṃbandhasya vidyamānatvāt|
analyzed: syāt etat abhihita anvaya vāde mā bhūt anupapattiḥ anvita abhidhāne tu bhavati tathā hi padānām anvaya anubhava janana sāmarthyam eva śaktiḥ iti ucyate ekaika padārtha upasthitiḥ tu smṛti rūpā na śakti sādhyā eka saṃbandhi jñānāt apara saṃbandhi smaraṇasya hastipaka ādi sādhāraṇa tvāt anvaya anubhava janana sāmarthya rūpasya ca mūla saṃbandhasya vidyamāna tvāt

original: ata eva padaśaktyasādhyatvāt padārthopasthiteḥ smṛtyantarasādhāraṇāyāstadvaijātyakalpane ca mānābhāvādarthādhyāhāra evāsati bādhake, na padādhyāhāraḥ, puṣpebhya ityatra sādhutvārthaṃ spṛhayatipadasya `viśvajitā yajetetyatra niyojyalābhārthaṃ svargakāmapadasya' saurye carāvatideśaprāpte `agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmī'ti mantre prakṛtau vācakapadavattayā
analyzed: atas eva pada śakti asādhya tvāt padārtha upasthiteḥ smṛti antara sādhāraṇāyāḥ tad vaijātya kalpane ca māna abhāvāt artha adhyāhāraḥ eva asati bādhake na pada adhyāhāraḥ puṣpebhyaḥ iti atra sādhu tva artham spṛhayati padasya viśvajitā yajeta iti atra niyojya lābha artham svarga kāma padasya saurye carau atideśa prāpte agnaye juṣṭam nirvapāmi iti mantre prakṛtau vācaka padavat tayā

original: klṛptopakāre agnipadabādhena vācakapadalābhāya sūryapadasya cādhyāhāre'pi padārthasmaraṇāya vākyārthānubhavāya vā tadanapekṣaṇāt| śābdatvaṃ ca padajanyānvayānubhavatvenaiva, na padajanyopasthitijanyānvayānubhavatvena, gauravāt|

original: ata eva yogyatāvacchedakasya chidretaratvādeḥ padādanupasthitasyāpi padajanyānvayānubhavaviṣayatvācchābdatvam, anyairapyanukūlatvapratiyogitvādīnāṃ tathātvābhyupagamāt|

original: evaṃ ca caitro'yamityādau loke `udbhidā yajeta paśukāma' ityādau ca vede pratyakṣopasthitānāmeva caitrodbhidādipadānāṃ nāmatvenānvayaḥ, anyathā caitrapadavācyo'yam udbhitpadavācyena yāgenetyādikalpane lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt, agṛhītasaṅgatike pade tadayogāt|
analyzed: evam ca caitraḥ yam ityādau loke udbhidā yajeta paśu kāmaḥ ityādau ca vede pratyakṣa upasthitānām eva caitra udbhida ādi padānām nāmatvena anvayaḥ anyathā caitra pada vācyaḥ yam udbhid pada vācyena yāgena ityādi kalpane lakṣaṇā prasaṅgāt agṛhīta saṅgatike pade tad ayogāt

original: `ghaṭaḥ paṭo ne'tyatra nañanvaya iva caitro'yamityādināmadheyānvaye'pi vibhaktyarthadvāratvānapekṣaṇena vyutpattyantarakalpanāt nañanvaye vibhaktyarthāpekṣāyāṃ jitamadvaitavādibhiḥ nīlaṃ sugandhimahadutpalamitivat ghaṭapaṭanañarthānāmabhedānvayopapatteḥ| nāmadheye vibhaktyarthāpekṣāyāṃ vede nāmadheyatvaṃ na sidhyediti jitaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na iti atra nañ anvaye iva caitraḥ yam ityādi nāmadheya anvaye pi vibhakti artha dvāratva anapekṣaṇena vyutpatti antara kalpanāt nañ anvaye vibhakti artha apekṣāyām jitam advaita vādibhiḥ nīlam sugandhi mahat utpalam iti vat ghaṭa paṭa nañ arthānām abheda anvaya upapatteḥ nāmadheye vibhakti artha apekṣāyām vede nāmadheya tvam na sidhyet iti jitam pūrvapakṣiṇā

original: `somena yajete'tyatreva matvarthalakṣaṇayodbhidā yajetetyādāvapi viśiṣṭavidhitvopapatteḥ, ubhayatra lakṣaṇāyāstulyatve'pi pravṛttiviśeṣakaratvena vidhitvasyaivocitatvāt| vārtikakārāṇāṃ tu padārthopasthiteḥ padaśaktisādhyatvāttadarthaṃ sarvatra padādhyāhārāṅgīkāre'pi nāmadheyānvaye vyutpattyantarāśrayaṇamastyeva|
analyzed: somena yajeta ityatra iva matvartha lakṣaṇayā udbhidā yajeta ityādau api viśiṣṭa vidhi tva upapatteḥ ubhayatra lakṣaṇāyāḥ tulya tve pi pravṛtti viśeṣa karatvena vidhi tvasya eva ucitatvāt vārtikakārāṇām tu padārtha upasthiteḥ pada śakti sādhyatvāt tad artham sarvatra pada adhyāhāra aṅgīkāre api nāmadheya anvaye vyutpatti antara āśrayaṇam asti eva

original: tathā ca svayameva vyutpāditaṃ nāmadeyādhikaraṇa ityalaṃ prasaktānuprasaktyā|
analyzed: tathā ca svayam eva vyutpāditam nāma deya adhikaraṇe iti alam prasakta anuprasaktyā

original: prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ -- evaṃ sthite lākṣaṇikamapyanvayānubhāvakaṃ cedanvayānubhavajananasāmarthyameva śaktiriti lākṣaṇikasyāpi tadvattvānmukhyajaghanyavibhāgo na syāt| tathā ca liṅgādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ|
analyzed: prakṛtam anusarāmaḥ evam sthite lākṣaṇikam api anvaya anubhāvakam ced anvaya anubhava janana sāmarthyam eva śaktiḥ iti lākṣaṇikasya api tadvat tvāt mukhya jaghanya vibhāgaḥ na syāt tathā ca liṅga adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ

original: tatra hi `barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmī'tyādimantrāṇāṃ mukhye jaghanye cārthe liṅgādviniyogaḥ uta mukhya eveti saṃśayya ubhayorapi śābdatvādubhayatrāpi viniyoga iti prāpte, mukhya eveti siddhāntitam| `arthābhidhānasaṃyogānmantreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāttasmādutpattisaṃbandho'rthena nityasaṃyogā'diti|

original: arthābhidhānasāmarthyarūpālliṅgāt śrutyaviniyukteṣu barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmītyādimantreṣu śeṣabhāvo viniyogaḥ syāt| tacca sāmarthyaṃ mukhye, na jaghanye śabdasāmarthyādupasthito hyartho mukhamivāvyavahito bhavatīti mukhya ucyate| mukhyārthasaṃbandhādupasthitastu jaghanamiva vyavahito bhavatīti jaghanya ucyate|
analyzed: artha abhidhāna sāmarthya rūpāt liṅgāt śrutya viniyukteṣu barhiḥ deva sadanam dāmi ityādi mantreṣu śeṣa bhāvaḥ viniyogaḥ syāt tat ca sāmarthyam mukhye na jaghanye śabda sāmarthyāt upasthitaḥ hi arthaḥ mukham iva avyavahitaḥ bhavati iti mukhyaḥ ucyate mukhya artha saṃbandhāt upasthitaḥ tu jaghanam iva vyavahitaḥ bhavati iti jaghanyaḥ ucyate

original: tathā ca jaghanye'rthe viniyogaṃ bruvatāpi tadupasthitaye mukhyopasthitirvaktavyā| tathā cotpattisaṃbandhaḥ svabāvasaṃbandho'rthābhidhānasaṃbandha eva viniyojakaḥ syāt, tasyārthaniyatatvāt, tāvataivasvādhyāyavidheścaritārthatvāt| mukhyasaṃbandhastu na liṅgam, anekeṣāṃ mukhyasaṃbandhitvenārthāniyamāccaramatvācceti sūtrārthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca jaghanya arthe viniyogam bruvatā api tad upasthitaye mukhya upasthitiḥ vaktavyā tathā ca utpatti saṃbandhaḥ svabāva saṃbandha ūrtha abhidhāna saṃbandhaḥ eva viniyojakaḥ syāt tasya artha niyata tvāt tāvatā eva svādhyāya vidheḥ caritārtha tvāt mukhya saṃbandhaḥ tu na liṅgam anekeṣām mukhya saṃbandhi tvena artha aniyamāt carama tvāt ca iti sūtra arthaḥ

original: ata eva mukhyasaṃbhave lakṣaṇā nopādeyeti sarvatantrasiddhāntaḥ| padavṛttirhi śaktiḥ padārthavṛttiśca lakṣaṇā| sā ca bahuprakāretyanyat| lākṣaṇikapadenānvayapratiyogyupasthitau kṛtāyāṃ yadavaśiṣṭaṃ śaktaṃ, tadevānvayānubhāvakam|
analyzed: atas eva mukhya saṃbhave lakṣaṇā na upādeyā iti sarva tantra siddhāntaḥ pada vṛttiḥ hi śaktiḥ padārtha vṛttiḥ ca lakṣaṇā sā ca bahu prakārā iti anyat lākṣaṇika padena anvaya pratiyogi upasthitau kṛtāyām yat avaśiṣṭam śaktam tat eva anvaya anubhāvakam

original: arthavādapadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ lākṣaṇikatve'pi tadekavākyatāpannaṃ vidhipadamevānubhāvakam, vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syu'riti nyāyāt|
analyzed: arthavāda padānām sarveṣām lākṣaṇika tve pi tad ekavākya tā āpannam vidhi padam eva anubhāvakam vidhinā tu ekavākya tvāt stuti arthena vidhīnām syuḥ iti nyāyāt

original: tathā ca satyādipadānāṃ sarveṣāmapi lākṣaṇikatve kathamanvayānubhavopapattiriti cet, naiṣa doṣaḥ, śakyasyaivānvayānubhavābhyupagamāt, lakṣaṇātvekadeśatyāgamātrasya, na tvaśakyārthopasthitaye gaurnitya ityādivat| ata eva vācakānāmeva svārthe lakṣaṇeyamityuktaṃ prāk| nanu jahallakṣaṇābhyupagame kathamanvayānubhavaḥ ? śakyaikadeśasyāpi tatrābhāvāt|
analyzed: tathā ca satya ādi padānām sarveṣām api lākṣaṇika tve katham anvaya anubhava upapattiḥ iti ced nā eṣa doṣaḥ śakyasya eva anvaya anubhava abhyupagamāt lakṣaṇā tu eka deśa tyāga mātrasya na tu aśakya artha upasthitaye gauḥ nityaḥ ityādi vat atas eva vācakānām eva svārthe lakṣaṇā iyam iti uktam prāk nanu jahat lakṣaṇa abhyupagame katham anvaya anubhavaḥ śakya eka deśasya api tatra abhāvāt

original: tattvapradīpikākṛdādayastu abhihitānvayapakṣamevorarīcakruḥ, sarvathāpi siddhāntānukūlatvāditi na kiṃcidavadyam| tārkikamatasyobhayapakṣabahirbhāvādikaṃ ca vedāntakalpatāyāṃ vyutpāditamityuparamyate| ityadvaitasiddhau satyādyavāntaravākyākhaṇḍārthatopattiḥ|| 2 ||

analyzed: na ca dvaita ādeḥ aprāmāṇika tve tad virahasya aprāmāṇika tva āpattiḥ atireka pakṣe iṣṭa āpatteḥ anatireka pakṣe tu adhikaraṇa prāmāṇika tvasya eva prāmāṇika tve tantra tayā pratiyogi aprāmāṇika tve api prāmāṇika tva upapatteḥ na ca anyonya abhāve api tad pakṣe tathā aṅgīkriyatām iti vācyam tasya adhikaraṇa rūpa tāyām śūnyavāda ādi āpattyāḥ ukta tvāt

original: śabdajanyābhāvabuddhau vyabhicāreṇāropasyābhāvabuddhāvahetutvācca| kiñca bhede svetarabhedasya vaktavyatayā svavṛttivirodho'navasthā vā| na ca -- brahmābhede'pi svābhedasya vaktavyatayā svavṛttitvaṃ samānamiti -- vācyam, abhedasya svanirvāhakatvādityavehi|

original: na ca bhede tathā, bhedādhikaraṇakabhedavyavahārasya svarūpeṇa nirvāhe ghaṭe'pi tathātve dharmapakṣakabhedānupapatteḥ| kiñca bhede bhedatvamupādhirūpaṃ jātirūpaṃ vā vācyam, tatra punarbhedo vācyaḥ, anyathā bhedatvasyānyasmād bhedo na syāt| tathā cānyonyavṛttyā svavṛttyāpatteḥ svavṛttitvavattasyāpi viruddhatvāt|
analyzed: na ca bhede tathā bheda adhikaraṇaka bheda vyavahārasya svarūpeṇa nirvāhe ghaṭe api tathātve dharma pakṣaka bheda anupapatteḥ kiñca bhede bheda tvam upādhi rūpam jāti rūpam vā vācyam tatra punar bhedaḥ vācyaḥ anyathā bheda tvasya anyasmāt bhedaḥ na syāt tathā ca anyonya vṛttyā svavṛtti āpatteḥ svavṛtti tva vat tasya api viruddha tvāt

original: na ca -- abhede'pyabhedatvaṃ vācyam, tatra punarabhedo vācyaḥ, anyathā tasya svābhedo na syāditi tatrāpi tathātvāpattiḥ, prameyatvābhidheyatvādivadanyonyavṛttitvasyābhede adoṣatve bhede'pi sāmyamiti vācyam, asmākamabhedamātrasyābhedatvasya ca brahmābhedābhinnatayā anyonyamityasyaivābhāvenānyonyavṛttitvasyaivāpādayitumaśakyatvāt|
analyzed: na ca abhede pi abheda tvam vācyam tatra punar abhedaḥ vācyaḥ anyathā tasya sva abhedaḥ na syāt iti tatra api tathātva āpattiḥ prameya tva abhidheya tva ādi vat anyonya vṛtti tvasya abhede adoṣa tve bhede api sāmyam iti vācyam asmākam abheda mātrasya abheda tvasya ca brahma abheda abhinnatayā anyonyam ityasya eva abhāvena anyonya vṛtti tvasya eva āpādayitum aśakya tvāt

original: na ca tarhi ghaṭe ghaṭābhedasya jīve jīvābhedasya vā jīvabrahmābhedatve vedāntavaiyarthyam, bhedabhramanivartakavṛttermahāvākyaṃ vinānupapatteruktatvāt| yattu prameyatvādau pramitatvādanyonyavṛttiradoṣa iti, tanna, ātmāśrayāditvadoṣeṇa tatrāpi pramitatvāsiddheḥ| ata eva na kaścit kevalānvayī|
analyzed: na ca tarhi ghaṭe ghaṭa abhedasya jīve jīva abhedasya vā jīva brahma abheda tve vedānta vaiyarthyam bheda bhrama nivartaka vṛtteḥ mahāvākyam vinā anupapatteḥ uktatvāt yat tu prameya tva ādau pramita tvāt anyonya vṛttiḥ adoṣaḥ iti tat na ātma āśraya ādi tva doṣeṇa tatra api pramita tva asiddheḥ atas eva na kaścid kevala anvayī

original: kiñca bhedaḥ kiṃ bhinne niviśate ? abhinne vā ? ādye ātmāśrayo'nyonyāśrayo vā| dvitīye virodhaḥ| na ca -- abhedānirvācyatvādikaṃ kiṃ tadvati tadabhāvavati cetyādivikalpasyātrāpi sāmyamiti -- vācyam, abhedasya svarūpatvena tatra tadvikalpānavakāśāt, anirvācyādāvasya vikalpasyānirvācyatva -- prayojakasyāsmākamanukūlatvāt|
analyzed: kiñca bhedaḥ kim bhinne niviśate abhinne vā ādye ātma āśrayaḥ anyonya āśrayaḥ vā dvitīye virodhaḥ na ca abheda anirvācya tva ādikam kim tadvati tad abhāvavati ca ityādi vikalpasya atra api sāmyam iti vācyam abhedasya svarūpa tvena tatra tad vikalpa anavakāśāt anirvācya ādau asya vikalpasya anirvācya tva prayojakasya asmākam anukūla tvāt

original: na ca bhedo'pi svarūpam, prāgeva nirāsāt| na ca -- bhedaḥ svāśrayatvayogye vartate, yogyatā ca pramārūpaphalaikonneyā iti -- vācyam, yogyatāyā bhedaṃ vinā vaktumaśakyatvāt|

original: na hyabhinne kadāpi tadyogyatā, dharmāntarasyāpi bhedamapuraskṛtya yogyatvāprayojakatvāt, bhedābhedāvajñātvā bhramapramārūpaphalabhedasyaivājñānena bhedayogyatāyāḥ pramārūpaphalabhedānunneyatvācca|

original: asvavyāghātakaireva jātibhinnaiḥ saduttaraiḥ|

original: nirastaṃ bhedamādāya svātmābhedo niṣīdati||

original: bhedapratinidherviśeṣasya vidyamānatvānna paryāyatvādikam, viśeṣaśca bhedahīne'pi ekatarapariśeṣābhāvādinirvāhaka iti -- cenna, paryāyatvādipramājanakasya svarūpātiriktasya viśeṣasyāṅgīkāre tasyaiva bhedatvena bhedasya dharmabhedoktyayogād, viśeṣasyāpi bhedaḥ saviśeṣābhinna eva vācyaḥ| tathā cānavasthātādavasthyam|
analyzed: bheda pratinidheḥ viśeṣasya vidyamāna tvāt na paryāya tva ādikam viśeṣaḥ ca bheda hīne pi ekatara pariśeṣa abhāva ādi nirvāhakaḥ iti ced na paryāya tva ādi pramā janakasya svarūpa atiriktasya viśeṣasya aṅgīkāre tasya eva bheda tvena bhedasya dharma bheda ukti ayogāt viśeṣasya api bhedaḥ sa viśeṣa abhinnaḥ eva vācyaḥ tathā ca anavasthā tādavasthyam

original: na ca vaiśeṣikābhimataviśeṣavattasya svaparanirvāhakatvam, etādṛśaviśeṣe mānābhāvāt| nanu -- `vijñānamānandaṃ brahme'tyādivākyabodhyavijñānānandādīnāṃ tvanmate'pi bhedasya bhedābhedayorvā'khaṇḍārthakatvena `ekadhaivānudraṣṭavya'mityādi śrutivirodhena cāṅgīkartumaśakyatayā bhedapratinidherviśeṣasyāparyāyatvādyarthamavaśyaṃ svīkāra iti

original: kiñca tavāpi jñānānandatvādinimittabhedādevāparyāyatvamastu, kiṃ viśeṣeṇa ? na ca -- `evaṃ dharmā'niti śrutyā tayorapi bhedaniṣedhāt naivamiti -- vācyam, tarhi viśeṣasyāpyāśritatvena dharmatayā'syāpi bhedaniṣedhāttenāpyanupapattiḥ|

original: na ca -- ākāśaśabdāśrayaśabdayoḥ pravṛttinimittābhedena paryāyatvāpattiḥ, tatparihārāya viśeṣo vācya iti -- vācyam, paryāyatve'pi sahaprayogasya vyākhyānavyākhyeyabhāvādināpyupapatteḥ| na ca -- evaṃ jñānānandayorekatarapariśeṣeṇa mokṣe ānandaprakāśo na syāditi -- vācyam, tayorbhedābhāvena ekataratvasyaivābhāvāt, dvayorvacane tarabvidhānāt|
analyzed: na ca ākāśa śabda āśraya śabdayoḥ pravṛtti nimitta abhedena paryāya tva āpattiḥ tad parihārāya viśeṣaḥ vācyaḥ iti vācyam paryāya tve pi sahaprayogasya vyākhyāna vyākhyeya bhāva ādinā api upapatteḥ na ca evam jñāna ānandayoḥ ekatara pariśeṣeṇa mokṣe ānanda prakāśaḥ na syāt iti vācyam tayoḥ bheda abhāvena ekatara tvasya eva abhāvāt dvayoḥ vacane tarap vidhānāt

original: na ca -- ekasyā eva śukterāvṛtānāvṛtatve śuktyaṃśabheda eva syāditi -- vācyam, tadaṃśakalpakasya phalasyābhāvāt|

analyzed: nanu evam dharmān iti śrutiḥ astu mānam atra hi brahma dharmān uktvā bhedaḥ niṣidhyate na ca bheda pratinidheḥ abhāve dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ dharmāṇām anekatvam ca yuktam iti ced na dharmān ityasya niṣedha anuvāda tvena dharma tva anekatva ādau tātparya abhāvāt na ca śrutitaḥ nyatas brahma dharmāḥ prāptāḥ āvidyaka mātrasya sākṣi siddha tayā prāpteḥ

original: nanu -- guṇaguṇinorabhedapakṣe ghaṭopalambhe śuklādyanupalambhārthaṃ bhedābhedapakṣe tayoravirodhārtham atyantabhedapakṣe'pi samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ, sattā satī, antyaviśeṣo vyāvṛttaḥ, kālaḥ sadāsti, deśaḥ sarvatrāstītyabādhitavyavahārārthaṃ viśeṣo'ṅgīkāryaḥ abhāvādāvapyastitvādirnābhāvādito bhinnaḥ, guṇādiṣvanantarbhāvena ṣaḍeva padārthā iti

analyzed: na ca evam chāndogye yaḥ eṣaḥ āditye puruṣaḥ dṛśyate saḥ ham asmi iti atra saḥ eva enān brahma gamayati iti atra bheda para uttara vākya virodhaḥ tasya upāsanā prakaraṇa stha tvena aham graha upāsana para tayā virodha abhāvāt na ca upāsanā prakaraṇa sthita vākya balāt aikya asiddhau api an upāsanā prakaraṇa sthitāt api tad asiddhiḥ śaṅkyā anya śeṣa tvasya tasya tad prayojakasya abhāvāt

original: ātmaśabdena jīvacaitanyamanūdya bṛṃhitatvādyupalakṣitabrahmacaitanyābhedavidhiparatvena sārthakatvāt| tathā ca smṛtiḥ `ahaṃ hariḥ sarvamidaṃ janārdana' ityādikāpi saṅgacchate|

original: yattu kaiścidupāsta iti śravaṇāt prayatnasādhyajñānavijātīyavṛttyantararūpapopāsanāyā eva niṣedhaḥ, na tu jñānasyetyuktam, tanna| `tadyo yo devānāṃ pratyabudhyate'ti pūrvavākye na sa vedeti nindāvākye ca vedanasyaiva nirdeśāt madhyasthitopāsterapi jñānaparatvāt|

original: evaṃ muṇḍake `sa yo ha vaitatparamaṃ brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati' ityetadapi vākyamabhedaparameva| na ca -- dvitīyabrahmaśabdo jīvapara eva, tasya jātijīvakamalāsanādyanekārthatvāt, dve brahmaṇī ityādau jīve brahmaśabdaprayogasambhavācca, yaḥ paramaṃ brahma veda sa jīva eva bhavati, na tu paramaṃ brahmetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam muṇḍake sa yaḥ ha vā etat paramam brahma veda brahmā eva bhavati iti etat api vākyam abheda param eva na ca dvitīya brahma śabdaḥ jīva paraḥ eva tasya jāti jīva kamala āsana ādi aneka artha tvāt dve brahmaṇī ityādau jīve brahma śabda prayoga sambhavāt ca yaḥ paramam brahma veda sa jīvaḥ eva bhavati na tu paramam brahma iti arthaḥ

original: ata eva ādyo brahmaśabdaḥ paramatvena viśeṣita iti -- vācyam, jīve brahmapadaprayogasambhave'pi prakṛte parabrahmopadānamevocitam, jīvabhāvasyābrahmabhāvasya ca prāgeva siddhatayā brahmajñānasādhyatvābhāvāt| evaṃ ca arthād dvitīyabrahmabhavanamapi paramatvaviśeṣitameva|
analyzed: atas eva ādyaḥ brahma śabdaḥ parama tvena viśeṣitaḥ iti vācyam jīve brahma pada prayoga sambhave pi prakṛte para brahma upadānam eva ucitam jīva bhāvasya abrahma bhāvasya ca prāk eva siddhatayā brahma jñāna sādhya tva abhāvāt evam ca arthāt dvitīya brahma bhavanam api parama tva viśeṣitam eva

original: yacca brahma bhavatītyasya bṛṃhitatvarūpabrahmatvākrānto bhavatī'tyarthaḥ, sampūjya brāhmaṇaṃ bhaktyā śūdro'pi brāhmaṇo bhaved itivat| na hi śūdro'pi pūjitabrāhmaṇavyaktirbhavati, kintu brāhmaṇatvajātyākrānta iti, tanna, pūrvoktayuktyā prakṛte vyaktyabhedasyaiva sambhavena dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyāt|

original: na ca -- `asya mahimāna'miti vākyaśeṣāttadīyamahattvaprāptireva, na tu tadbhāva iti yuktam, dehendriyādiprapañcavilakṣaṇaṃ yo veda, prapañca tadvibhūtiṃ ca yo veda, sa vītaśoko bhavatītyevaṃ paratvāt| na ca `yathā nadyaḥ syandamānā' iti bhinnanadīsamudradṛṣṭāntoktirayukteti vācyam, spaṣṭabhedavilayanamātraparatvena dṛṣṭāntopapatteruktatvāt|
analyzed: na ca asya mahimānam iti vākyaśeṣāt tadīya mahat tva prāptiḥ eva na tu tad bhāvaḥ iti yuktam deha indriya ādi prapañca vilakṣaṇam yaḥ veda tad vibhūtim ca yaḥ veda sa vīta śokaḥ bhavati iti evam paratvāt na ca yathā nadyaḥ syandamānāḥ iti bhinna nadī samudra dṛṣṭānta uktiḥ ayuktā iti vācyam spaṣṭa bheda vilayana mātra paratvena dṛṣṭānta upapatteḥ ukta tvāt

original: parāt paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyamiti na deśāntarasthabrahmaprāptyuktiparā, tasyāḥ saguṇopāsanāphalatvena brahmavidyāphalatvāsambhavena svarūpabhūtabrahmaprāptiparatvāt|
analyzed: parāt param puruṣam upaiti divyam iti na deśa antara stha brahma prāpti ukti parā tasyāḥ saguṇa upāsanā phalatvena brahmavidyā phalatva asambhavena svarūpa bhūta brahma prāpti paratvāt

original: na cāta ityenena prastutaṃ sarvaniyantāraṃ parāmṛśyānyo draṣṭā nāstītyukteḥ svaniyāmakadraṣṭrantaraniṣedha āyāti, na tu draṣṭṛsāmānyaniṣedhaḥ, asmin grāme ayameva sarvaniyāmako nānyaḥ puruṣo'stītyadāvanyaśabdasya prastutasadṛśānyaparatayā vyutpannatvāt samānamitaracchyenenetyatra itaraśabdasya pūrvanirdiṣṭasadṛśaparatvokteśceti -- vācyam, anena

original: na cātrāpyantaryāmivākye `ya ātmano'ntaraḥ yamātmā na veda yasyātmā śarīraṃ ya ātmānamantaro yamayatī'ti pūrvakyena `eṣa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamṛtaḥ ato'nyadārtami'tyuttaravākyena ca virodhaḥ| tatra paramātmano'nyaṃ cetanamaṅgīkṛtya tasyārtiyuktatvenāsvātantryasyaivoktiriti vācyam, pūrvavākyasyaupādhikabhedamātreṇopapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca atra api antaryāmi vākye yaḥ ātmanaḥ ntaraḥ yam ātmā na veda yasya ātmā śarīram yaḥ ātmānam antaraḥ yamayati iti pūrvakyena eṣa te ātmā antaryāmī amṛtaḥ atonyat ārtam iti uttara vākyena ca virodhaḥ tatra paramātmanaḥ nyam cetanam aṅgīkṛtya tasya ārti yukta tvena asvātantryasya eva uktiḥ iti vācyam pūrva vākyasya aupādhika bheda mātreṇa upapatteḥ

original: uttaravākyena na cetanāntarasyārtiyogo vidhīyate, kintu `eṣo'ntaryāmī te ātme'ti jīvasvarūpabhūtādantaryāmiṇo vyatiriktaṃ sarvam ārtaṃ vinaśvaramiti vā mithyeti vā bodhanānna virodhaśaṅkā| ata eva akṣaravākye'pi `etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ' ityādipūrvavākyena virodha ityapāstam|
analyzed: uttara vākyena na cetanā antarasya ārti yogaḥ vidhīyate kintu eṣaḥ ntaryāmī te ātmā iti jīva svarūpa bhūtāt antaryāmiṇaḥ vyatiriktam sarvam ārtam vinaśvaram iti vā mithyā iti vā bodhanāt na virodha śaṅkā atas eva akṣara vākye api etasya vai akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ ityādi pūrva vākyena virodhaḥ iti apāstam

original: kiñca dvitīyādvai bhayaṃ bhavatīti bhedasya bhayahetutvena ninditatvādapyabheda evopaniṣadgamyaḥ| na ca -- asya virodhinaḥ samānād bhayaṃ bhavatītyevārthaḥ, loke tādṛśādeva bhayaṃ bhavatīti lokasiddhanuvāditvāt pūrvatra `tasmādekākī bibheti' uttaratra `tasmādekākī na ramata' iti śravaṇācceti vācyam, yanmadanyannāsti kasmānna bibhemīti tata evāsya

original: bhayaṃ vīyāyeti śruteḥ| sāmānyato dvitīyamātradarśanasyaiva bhayahetutvād viśeṣakalpanāyogāt| ekākī bibhetīti pūrvavākye paramārthadarśanarahitasya tannimittabhayasambhavād ekākī bibhetītyuktam| uttaravākye tasmādekākī na ramata ityatra iṣṭasaṃyogajanyaraterekākinyabhāvād ekākino ratirnāstītyuktam|
analyzed: bhayam vīyāya iti śruteḥ sāmānyatas dvitīya mātra darśanasya eva bhaya hetu tvāt viśeṣa kalpanā ayogāt ekākī bibheti iti pūrva vākye paramārtha darśana rahitasya tad nimitta bhaya sambhavāt ekākī bibheti iti uktam uttara vākye tasmāt ekākī na ramate iti atra iṣṭa saṃyoga janya rateḥ ekākini abhāvāt ekākinaḥ ratiḥ na asti iti uktam

original: tataścātattvajñaviṣayoktavākyānusāreṇa tattvajñaviṣayamadhyavākyasya svārthasamarpaṇenāpyupayuktatvāt tadvirodhyarthaparatvāyogāt| `etasminnudaramantaraṃ kurute atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavatī'ti bhedanindayāpyabhedasiddhiḥ|

original: na ca vahnerauṣṇyaṃ bahirnopalabhyeta, samīpavṛttyanudbhūtarūpatejasastadityucyamāne vahnerauṣṇyaṃ na sidhyediti vācyam| bādhake sati savidhe tejo'ntarakalpane'pi dṛśyamānavahnāvanubhūyamānauṣṇasparśe bādhakābhāvena tasmiṃstejo'ntaratvakalpanasyāśakyatvāt| etena ketakyādau parito gandhānubhavād guṇānāṃ guṇinairapekṣyam|
analyzed: na ca vahneḥ auṣṇyam bahis nā upalabhyeta samīpa vṛtti anudbhūta rūpa tejasaḥ tat iti ucyamāne vahneḥ auṣṇyam na sidhyet iti vācyam bādhake sati savidhe tejaḥ ntara kalpanā api dṛśyamāna vahnau anubhūyamāna oṣṇa sparśe bādhaka abhāvena tasmin tejaḥ ntara tva kalpanasya aśakya tvāt etena ketakī ādau paritas gandha anubhavāt guṇānām guṇi nairapekṣyam

analyzed: na ca tatra ketakī avayavānām paritas prasahatām te gandhāḥ tarhi dravya kṣaya prasaṅgāt na ca avayava antara praveśāt tad akṣayaḥ sphaṭika karaṇḍikā stha kastūrī ādau avayava antara praveśa kalpate māna abhāvāt iti nirastam samavāyi nairapekṣya ikāryasya nirāśraya tva āpattau tad pratyāsatti nibandhana kāraṇa antarasya api ucchede kāryatva hāneḥ eva tatra kalpanāyām māna tvāt

original: yattu nityaḥ sarvagatasthāṇurityatra `nitye sarvagate viṣṇāvaṇurjīvo vyavasthitaḥ' iti smṛtyantarānusārāt sarvagatasthaḥ aṇuśceti vigrahaḥ iti tanna| `ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ' `sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātme'ti śrutyanusāryarthasyaivocitatvād aṇuriti padacchede tadvirodhāpatteḥ|
analyzed: yat tu nityaḥ sarvagata sthāṇuḥ iti atra nitye sarvagate viṣṇau aṇuḥ jīvaḥ vyavasthitaḥ iti smṛti antara anusārāt sarvagata sthaḥ aṇuḥ ca iti vigrahaḥ iti tat na ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca nityaḥ sa vai eṣa mahān ajaḥ ātmā iti śruti anusāri arthasya eva ucitatvāt aṇuḥ iti padacchede tad virodha āpatteḥ

original: yattu krameṇa nānādehasambandhādaṇoreva sarvagatatvoktiḥ iti, tanna, aśeṣavācisarvaśabdasaṅkoce mānābhāvāt| yadapi pratyakṣatvādinaivāvyāpakatvaṃ sādhanīyamityuktam, tanna, pratikūlatarkasyoktatvād vyāpakatvasādhane tasyaivānukūlatvenāprayojakatvābhāvācca|
analyzed: yat tu krameṇa nānā deha sambandhāt aṇoḥ eva sarvagata tva uktiḥ iti tat na aśeṣa vāci sarva śabda saṅkoce māna abhāvāt yat api pratyakṣa tva ādinā eva avyāpakatvam sādhanīyam iti uktam tat na pratikūla tarkasya ukta tvāt vyāpaka tva sādhane tasya eva anukūla tvena aprayojaka tva abhāvāt ca

original: nanu ātmano vyāpakatve `sarvāṇi śarīrāṇi sarvasyaiva bhogāyatanāni syuḥ, sarvaśarīrendriyādīnāṃ sarvadā sarvātmasaṃyuktatvāt, karmaṇāmapi sādhāraṇadehādikṛtatvenāsādhāraṇyāyogād, ahantvāropāderapi niyāmakamūlasambandhāderabhāvena naiyatyāyogāditi cenna, tavāpīśvarasya vyāpakatvena sarvaśarīrāṇāṃ tadbhogajanakatvāpatteḥ samānatvāt|
analyzed: nanu ātmanaḥ vyāpaka tve sarvāṇi śarīrāṇi sarvasya eva bhoga āyatanāni syuḥ sarva śarīra indriya ādīnām sarvadā sarva ātma saṃyukta tvāt karmaṇām api sādhāraṇa deha ādi kṛta tvena asādhāraṇya ayogāt ahantva āropa ādeḥ api niyāmaka mūla sambandha ādeḥ abhāvena naiyatya ayogāt iti ced na tava api īśvarasya vyāpaka tvena sarva śarīrāṇām tad bhoga janakatva āpatteḥ samānatvāt

original: na ca tadadṛṣṭājanyatvāttatsaṃyuktatve'pi na tatra bhogajananam tarhīhāpi samam| na ca karmaṇāmeva kathamasādhāraṇyam ? pūrvatatkarmajanyatvād, evamanāditaiva| anyathā īśātmani tavāpyagateḥ caitrabhogajanakāṅkurādeḥ tadadṛṣṭajanyatvāda ātmasamavetasyādṛṣṭasya sākṣādaṅkurāsaṃbandhād ātmadvārakasambandhasya vācyatāyāmātmano vibhutvam|
analyzed: na ca tad adṛṣṭa ajanya tvāt tad saṃyukta tve pi na tatra bhoga jananam tarhi iha api samam na ca karmaṇām eva katham asādhāraṇyam pūrva tad karma janya tvāt evam anādi tā eva anyathā īśa ātmani tava api agateḥ caitra bhoga janaka aṅkura ādeḥ tad adṛṣṭa janya tva ādeḥ ātma samavetasya adṛṣṭasya sākṣāt aṅkura asaṃbandhāt ātma dvāraka sambandhasya vācyatāyām ātmanaḥ vibhu tvam

original: na ca caitrabhogāhetorapyāṅkurāderātmadvārā'dṛṣṭāsaṃbandhe'pi tadajanyatvena tasyātantratvamiti vācyam, janakādṛṣṭanirūpitātmadvārakasannikarṣasyātiprasaṅgābhāvena tantratvāt| janakatā tu adṛṣṭasya phalaikonneyā| evamevopapattau pratiyogyabhāvavācyavācakajñānajñeyādāvivādṛṣṭakāryayorapi saṃbandhāntarasvīkāre mānābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: na ca caitra bhoga ahetoḥ api āṅkura ādeḥ ātma dvārā adṛṣṭa asaṃbandhe pi tad ajanya tvena tasya atantra tvam iti vācyam janaka adṛṣṭa nirūpita ātma dvāraka sannikarṣasya atiprasaṅga abhāvena tantra tvāt janaka tā tu adṛṣṭasya phala eka unneyā evam eva upapattau pratiyogi abhāva vācya vācaka jñāna jñeya ādau iva adṛṣṭa kāryayoḥ api saṃbandha antara svīkāre māna abhāvaḥ

original: yattu kārīryadṛṣṭasya vṛṣṭyā saha taduddaśena vihitakriyājanyatvādirūpaḥ saṃbandho'stītyuktam, tanna tatrāpi yajamānātmadvārakasaṃyuktasamavāyasyaiva jalakṣaraṇādiprayojakatvāt| etacca sarvaṃ pararītyoktam| svamate ca vyavasthā prāguktaiva|
analyzed: yat tu kārīrya dṛṣṭasya vṛṣṭyā saha tad uddaśena vihita kriyā janya tva ādi rūpaḥ saṃbandhaḥ usti iti uktam tat na tatra api yajamāna ātma dvāraka saṃyukta samavāyasya eva jala kṣaraṇa ādi prayojaka tvāt etat ca sarvam para rītyā uktam sva mate ca vyavasthā prāk uktā eva

original: tathā ca `buddherguṇenātmaguṇena caiva hyārāgramātro hyavaro'pi dṛṣṭa' iti śrutau buddhiguṇenārāgramātratvokteḥ svābhāvikameva vibhutvam| na cātrātmaguṇenārāgramātratvaṃ buddherguṇena cāvaratvamiti vyutkramayojanā, "tadyathāṇunaścakṣuṣaḥ prakāśo vyāptaḥ, evamevāsya puruṣasya prakāśo vyāptaḥ aṇurhyevaiṣapuruṣa" iti śrutyanusārāditi vācyam|
analyzed: tathā ca buddheḥ guṇena ātma guṇena ca eva hi ārā agra mātraḥ hi avaraḥ api dṛṣṭaḥ iti śrutau buddhi guṇena ārā agra mātra tva ukteḥ svābhāvikam eva vibhu tvam na ca atra ātma guṇena ārā agra mātra tvam buddheḥ guṇena ca avara tvam iti vyutkrama yojanā tat yathā aṇunaḥ cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśaḥ vyāptaḥ evam eva asya puruṣasya prakāśaḥ vyāptaḥ aṇuḥ hi eva eṣa puruṣaḥ iti śruti anusārāt iti vācyam

original: vyāpakatvabodhakānekaśrutivirodhena buddherguṇenetyetadanusāreṇa cāsyā eva aupādhikāṇutvaparatvāt, puruṣasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā rāhoḥ śira ityādivadupacaritārthatvācca| tathā ca na vyutkrameṇānvayaḥ, tasmādaṇutvaṃ nātmabhedakam|| iti advaitasiddhau ātmano'ṇutvabhaṅgaḥ|| 33 ||
analyzed: vyāpaka tva bodhaka aneka śruti virodhena buddheḥ guṇena iti etad anusāreṇa ca asyāḥ eva aupādhika aṇu tva paratvāt puruṣasya iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ rāhoḥ śiraḥ ityādi vat upacarita artha tvāt ca tathā ca na vyutkrameṇa anvayaḥ tasmāt aṇu tvam na ātma bhedakam iti advaita siddhau ātmanā uṇu tva bhaṅgaḥ

original: tadevamaikātmye vyavasthite tatsākṣātkārāya śravaṇamaṅgi, manananididhyāsane tadaṅgatayā mumukṣubhiranuṣṭheye| taduktaṃ viraṇe -- `śravaṇamaṅgi, pramāṇasya prameyāvagamaṃ pratyavyavadhānāt, manananididhyāsane tu cittasya pratyagātmapravaṇasaṃskārapariniṣpannatadekāgravṛttikāryadvāreṇa brahmānubhavahetutāṃ pratipadyete' iti phalopakāryaṅge|
analyzed: tat evam aikātmye vyavasthite tad sākṣātkārāya śravaṇam aṅgi manana nididhyāsane tad aṅga tayā mumukṣubhiḥ anuṣṭheye tat uktam viraṇe śravaṇam aṅgi pramāṇasya prameya avagamam prati avyavadhānāt manana nididhyāsane tu cittasya pratyagātma pravaṇa saṃskāra pariniṣpanna tad ekāgra vṛtti kārya dvāreṇa brahma anubhava hetutām pratipadyete iti phala upakāri aṅge

original: nanu śravaṇaṃ tāvadvicārarūpaṃ śābdajñāne na karaṇam, vedena dharma iva brahmaṇi pramīyamāṇe vicārasyānumānādau tarkasyeva śabdarūpe tajjñānarūpe vā karaṇe itikartavyamātratvāditi cenna, śabdaśaktitātparyāvadhāraṇaṃ tāvad vicāraḥ| avadhṛtatātparyakaśca śabdaḥ karaṇamiti vicārasya karaṇakoṭipraveśenetikartavyatātvābhāvād aṅgitvanirṇayāt|
analyzed: nanu śravaṇam tāvat vicāra rūpam śābda jñāne na karaṇam vedena dharme iva brahmaṇi pramīyamāṇe vicārasya anumāna ādau tarkasya iva śabda rūpe tad jñāna rūpe vā karaṇe iti kartavya mātra tvāt iti ced na śabda śakti tātparya avadhāraṇam tāvat vicāraḥ avadhṛta tātparyakaḥ ca śabdaḥ karaṇam iti vicārasya karaṇa koṭi praveśena iti kartavya tā tva abhāvāt aṅgi tva nirṇayāt

original: taduktaṃ vidyāsāgareṇa anumitau liṅgajñānavattātparyaviśiṣṭaśabdajñānaṃ karaṇam, atastātparyāvadhāraṇarūpavicārasyāṅgitvam|

original: na ca ākāṅkṣādisahitaśabdajñānasyaiva karaṇatvasambhave tātparyabhramanirāsopakṣīṇatayoktatātparyajñānasya karaṇakoṭipraveśe mananāderapi tatkoṭipraveśaḥ syāditi yuktam, evaṃ sākāṅkṣādidhiyo'pi nirākāṅkṣatvādibhramanirāsakatvamātreṇopayogāpattau ākāṅkṣādikamapi karaṇakoṭipraviṣṭaṃ na syāt|
analyzed: na ca ākāṅkṣā ādi sahita śabda jñānasya eva karaṇatva sambhave tātparya bhrama nirāsa upakṣīṇa tayā ukta tātparya jñānasya karaṇa koṭi praveśe manana ādeḥ api tad koṭi praveśaḥ syāt iti yuktam evam sākāṅkṣā ādi dhiyaḥ api nirākāṅkṣa tva ādi bhrama nirāsaka tva mātreṇa upayoga āpattau ākāṅkṣā ādikam api karaṇa koṭi praviṣṭam na syāt

original: na cānyonyāśrayaḥ, sāmānyato'rthāvagamanena tātparyagrahasambhavāt| anyathā nānārthādau vinigamanādikaṃ ca na syāt| tathā ca sarvatra tātparyajñānasyājanakatve'pi yatra tātparyasaṃśayaviparyayottaraṃ śābdadhīḥ, tatra tātparyajñānasya hetutā grāhyā saṃśayaviparyayottarapratyakṣe viśeṣadarśanasyeva| ata eva na vivaraṇavirodho'pi|
analyzed: na ca anyonya āśrayaḥ sāmānyatas ṛtha avagamanena tātparya graha sambhavāt anyathā nānārtha ādau vinigamana ādikam ca na syāt tathā ca sarvatra tātparya jñānasya ajanaka tve pi yatra tātparya saṃśaya viparyaya uttaram śābda dhīḥ tatra tātparya jñānasya hetutā grāhyā saṃśaya viparyaya uttara pratyakṣe viśeṣa darśanasya iva atas eva na vivaraṇa virodhaḥ api

original: nanu tātparyajñānasya karaṇakoṭipraveśe vede'pi tātparyabhramasambhavāt vāhyāgame'pi tātparyapramāsambhavāt śābdajñānakaraṇasya duṣṭatvāduṣṭatvavyavasthā na syād iti cenna, vede kadācit kasyacit kutracittātparyabhrame'pi nirduṣṭatvena yathārthatātparyamastyeva, parāgame tu pauruṣeyatayā pratāraṇādimatpuruṣapraṇītatayā duṣṭatvena na tatheti
analyzed: nanu tātparya jñānasya karaṇa koṭi praveśe vede api tātparya bhrama sambhavāt vāhya āgame api tātparya pramā sambhavāt śābda jñāna karaṇasya duṣṭatva aduṣṭatva vyavasthā na syāt iti ced na vede kadācid kasyacid kutracid tātparya bhrame api nirduṣṭatvena yathārtha tātparyam asti eva para āgame tu pauruṣeya tayā pratāraṇa ādimat puruṣa praṇīta tayā duṣṭatvena na tathā iti

original: duṣṭatvāduṣṭatva nyavasthāsaṃbhavāt| tātparyāṃśasyāvaghātāderiva yoge śabde sannipatyopakārakatayā karaṇakoṭipraviṣṭatvenāṅgitvam| na ca dṛṣṭānte karaṇadravyaśeṣatvāt tathā, sarvasāmyasya dṛṣṭāntatvāprayojakatvāt|
analyzed: duṣṭatva aduṣṭatva nyavasthā asaṃbhavāt tātparya aṃśasya avaghāta ādeḥ iva yoge śabde sannipatya upakāraka tayā karaṇa koṭi praviṣṭa tvena aṅgi tvam na ca dṛṣṭānte karaṇa dravya śeṣa tvāt tathā sarva sāmyasya dṛṣṭānta tva aprayojaka tvāt

original: nanu sannipatyopakārakatve'pi na phalopakārakamanananididhyāsanarūpāṅgaṃ prati śeṣitā, anyathā prayājādikaṃ pratyavaghātādiḥ śeṣī syāditi cenna, viśiṣṭayāgapraviṣṭatayā śeṣitve iṣṭāpatteḥ asādhāraṇyena śeṣitā tu asādhāraṇaphalopakārakatve syāt, asambhāvanāviśeṣanivṛttirūpāsādhāraṇopakārajanakatvāt sāpi śravaṇasya sambhāvitaiva|
analyzed: nanu sannipatya upakāraka tve api na phala upakāraka manana nididhyāsana rūpa aṅgam prati śeṣi tā anyathā prayāja ādikam prati avaghāta ādiḥ śeṣī syāt iti ced na viśiṣṭa yāga praviṣṭatayā śeṣi tve iṣṭa āpatteḥ asādhāraṇyena śeṣi tā tu asādhāraṇa phala upakāraka tve syāt asambhāvanā viśeṣa nivṛtti rūpa asādhāraṇa upakāra janakatvāt sā api śravaṇasya sambhāvitā eva

original: ata evoktaṃ citsukhācāryaiḥ -- `karaṇībhūtaśabdagatāśayahetutvāt śravaṇasya karaṇatvenāṅgitvam, manananididhyāsanayostu sahakāri bhūtacitagatātiśayahetutvāt phalopakāryaṅgate'ti| na ca evaṃ somayāgasahakāribhūtadīkṣaṇīyādyaṅgasya tadgatātiśayahetvabhiṣavagrahaṇādikaṃ pratyaṅgatvaprasaṅga iti vācyam, pūrvavaduktottaratvāt|
analyzed: atas eva uktam citsukha ācāryaiḥ karaṇībhūta śabda gata āśaya hetu tvāt śravaṇasya karaṇa tvena aṅgitvam manana nididhyāsanayoḥ tu sahakāri bhūta cita gata atiśaya hetu tvāt phala upakāri aṅgatā iti na ca evam soma yāga sahakāri bhūta dīkṣaṇīya ādi aṅgasya tad gata atiśaya hetu abhiṣava grahaṇa ādikam prati aṅgatva prasaṅgaḥ iti vācyam pūrvavat ukta uttaratvāt

original: `tasmāt na brāhmaṇo'vaidikamadhīyīta' iti śruteḥ `śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhya' ityādismṛteśceti āhuḥ| na ca `itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛmhaye'dityādismṛtivirodhaḥ, avicāritena upabṛmhaṇāyogāditi vācyam, vedāntatātparyanirṇayāya tadvicārāpekṣāyāmapi brahmajñāne tadvicārāpekṣāvirahāt|
analyzed: tasmāt na brāhmaṇaḥ vaidikam adhīyīta iti śruteḥ śrotavyaḥ śruti vākyebhyaḥ ityādi smṛteḥ ca iti āhuḥ na ca itihāsa purāṇābhyām vedam samupabṛmhayet ityādi smṛti virodhaḥ avicāritena upabṛmhaṇā yogāt iti vācyam vedānta tātparya nirṇayāya tad vicāra apekṣāyām api brahma jñāne tad vicāra apekṣā virahāt

original: na ca karmaviṣayakasmṛtibhiḥ karmajñānasyeva brahmaviṣayāt bhāratāderitihāsādapi sākṣāt brahmajñānasyodayāt brahmajñāne'pi tadapekṣeti vācyam, ubhayatrapi smṛtyādeḥ svātantryeṇāpramāṇatayā śrutitātparyanirṇāyakatvāt| ata evoktaṃ -- `vedaṃ samupabṛmhaye'diti, na tu vedārthaṃ jānīyāditi|
analyzed: na ca karma viṣayaka smṛtibhiḥ karma jñānasya iva brahma viṣayāt bhārata ādeḥ itihāsāt api sākṣāt brahma jñānasya udayāt brahma jñāne api tad apekṣā iti vācyam ubhayatra api smṛti ādeḥ svātantryeṇa apramāṇa tayā śruti tātparya nirṇāyaka tvāt atas eva uktam vedam samupabṛmhayet iti na tu veda artham jānīyāt iti

original: yattu -- `śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhya' ityādikaṃ śrutimūlapramāṇābhiprāyakam iti tanna, pañcamīpratītahetutvasya sākṣāt sambhave pāramparyakalpanāyogāt|
analyzed: yat tu śrotavyaḥ śruti vākyebhyaḥ iti ādikam śruti mūlapramāṇa abhiprāyakam iti tat na pañcamī pratīta hetutvasya sākṣāt sambhave pāramparya kalpanā ayogāt

original: na ca viprakīrṇanānāśākhārthasaṅgrahādirūpeṇetihāsādinā tattvaniścayadarśanāt sati ca tasmin vividiṣādvārā tadarthāyā antakaraṇaśuddheranapekṣitatvāt āparokṣasya viṣayabhāvādeva siddhyā vedajanyabrahmajñāne itihāsajanyādadhikasyāparokṣyasyānanubhavena tasya niyamādṛṣṭāsādhyatvāt jñānasya ca svaprāgabhāvanivartana ivi ajñānanivartane
analyzed: na ca viprakīrṇa nānā śākhā artha saṅgraha ādi rūpeṇa itihāsa ādinā tattva niścaya darśanāt sati ca tasmin vividiṣā dvārā tad arthāyāḥ anta karaṇa śuddheḥ anapekṣita tvāt āparokṣasya viṣaya bhāvāt eva siddhyā veda janya brahma jñāne itihāsa janyāt adhikasya āparokṣyasya ananubhavena tasya niyama adṛṣṭa asādhya tvāt jñānasya ca sva prāgabhāva nivartane ajñāna nivartane

analyzed: adṛṣṭa nirapekṣa tvāt anyasya ca niyama adṛṣṭa sādhyasya abhāvāt na niyama vidhiḥ iti vācyam tam etam veda anuvacanena ityādi śruti balāt yajña ādi janya adṛṣṭasya niyama adṛṣṭasya ca vividiṣā dvārakā antaḥkaraṇa śuddheḥ eva sarva adṛṣṭa sādhyāyāḥ sambhavena jñāna svarūpa upakāri tayā tad sādhya ajñāna nivṛttau tad apekṣa tvāt ca

original: vidyāyuktatadayuktakarmajanyaphalagatacirācirasvarūpātiśayavat niyamādṛṣṭajanyasākṣātkāre tadajanyatattvaniścayāpekṣayātiśayakalpanasyāvaśyakatvācca niyamavidhitvasambhavāt| tasmāt --

original: niyamādṛṣṭasādhyasya vyāvartyasyāpi sambhavāt|

original: śravaṇāderniyamanaṃ sarvathaivopapadyate|| iti |

original: nanu kimidaṃ śravaṇaṃ nāma ? śaktitātparyāvadhāraṇaṃ vā ? tadviśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇaṃ vā ? tātparyapramāpakaliṅgāvadhāraṇaṃ vā ? āgamācāryopadeśajajñānaṃ vā ? nādyaḥ, avācye brahmaṇi śaktyasambhavāt|
analyzed: nanu kim idam śravaṇam nāma śakti tātparya avadhāraṇam vā tad viśiṣṭa śabda avadhāraṇam vā tātparya pramāpaka liṅga avadhāraṇam vā āgama ācārya upadeśa ja jñānam vā na ādyaḥ avācye brahmaṇi śakti asambhavāt

original: tātparyamapi na tāvadāpātadhījanyasya vicāranivartyasya saṃśayasya dharmiṇi, tasya prāgeva niścitatvena tanniścayārthaṃ tātparyaniścayasādhanasya vicārasya vaiyarthyāt, anyathā vicārānantaramapi saṃśayādiprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: tātparyam api na tāvat āpāta dhī janyasya vicāra nivartyasya saṃśayasya dharmiṇi tasya prāk eva niścita tvena tad niścaya artham tātparya niścaya sādhanasya vicārasya vaiyarthyāt anyathā vicāra anantaram api saṃśaya ādi prasaṅgāt

original: nāpi saṃśayadharmigataprakāraviśeṣe tadviśiṣṭe tadupalakṣite vā, akhaṇḍārthatāhāneḥ, avadhāraṇasya jñānatve vidheyatvasya tvayānaṅgīkārāt| ata eva na dvitīyādi| nāpi gurumukhādvedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi samyojanaṃ śravaṇam, tasyādyapakṣānatirekāt| nāpi vākyaviśeṣaprayogarūpavādakathā śravaṇam, tatra śravaṇapadāprayogāt|
analyzed: nā api saṃśaya dharmi gata prakāra viśeṣe tad viśiṣṭe tad upalakṣite vā akhaṇḍa artha tā hāneḥ avadhāraṇasya jñāna tve vidheya tvasya tvayā anaṅgīkārāt atas eva na dvitīya ādi nā api guru mukhāt vedāntānām brahmaṇi samyojanam śravaṇam tasya ādya pakṣa anatirekāt nā api vākya viśeṣa prayoga rūpa vāda kathā śravaṇam tatra śravaṇa pada aprayogāt

original: ata eva manananididhyāsanayorapi na vidhiḥ, tayorapi jñānānatirekāditi cenna, ādyapakṣasyaiva kṣodakṣamatvāt| na ca tatra śabdaśaktyasambhavo doṣaḥ, śuddheśaktyasambhave'pi viśiṣṭaśaktestadvodhopayoginyā avadhāraṇīyāyāḥ sambhavāt, tātparyasyāpi saṃśayadharmiṇo niścitatvena tatrāsambhave'pi saṃśayakoṭyupalakṣite nirviśeṣe sambhavena
analyzed: atas eva manana nididhyāsanayoḥ api na vidhiḥ tayoḥ api jñāna anatirekāt iti ced na ādya pakṣasya eva kṣoda kṣama tvāt na ca tatra śabda śakti asambhavaḥ doṣaḥ śuddheḥ śakti asambhave api viśiṣṭa śakteḥ tad vodha upayoginyāḥ avadhāraṇīyāyāḥ sambhavāt tātparyasya api saṃśaya dharmiṇaḥ niścita tvena tatra asambhave api saṃśaya koṭi upalakṣite nirviśeṣe sambhavena

original: vicāravaiyarthyāt| na cākhaṇḍārthatāhāniḥ, svarūpamātropalakṣakatayā akhaṇḍārthatāyā upapāditatvāt| na cāvadhāraṇasya jñānarūpatayā avidheyatā, tasya tarkatvena jñānavijātīyacetovṛttyantaratvāt, sureśvarācāryaiḥ `śravaṇādikriyā tāvat kartavyeha prayatnata' iti śravaṇādau kriyāpadaprayogāt| evameva manananididhyāsanayorapi vidheyāvamukṣeyam|
analyzed: vicāra vaiyarthyāt na ca akhaṇḍa artha tā hāniḥ svarūpa mātra upalakṣaka tayā akhaṇḍa artha tāyāḥ upapādita tvāt na ca avadhāraṇasya jñāna rūpa tayā avidheya tā tasya tarka tvena jñāna vijātīya cetaḥ vṛtti antara tvāt sura īśvara ācāryaiḥ śravaṇa ādi kriyā tāvat kartavyā iha prayatnataḥ iti śravaṇa ādau kriyā pada prayogāt evam eva manana nididhyāsanayoḥ api vidheyā avamukṣā iyam

original: na ca tāptaryarupe viṣaye upakramādirūpe ca pramāṇe sati jāyamānasya tasya jñānabahirbhāvānupapattiḥ tadbahirbhūtavāgdhenūpāsanādau pramāṇavastuparatantratvādarśanāditi vācyam, manmate liṅgasya prāmāṇyānabhyupagamena sati pramāṇa ityasyaivābhāvād, upakramādeḥ pramāṇatvapakṣe tatpūrvakālīnatvenāsya pramāṇe satītyetadaṃśāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: na ca tāptarya rupe viṣaye upakrama ādi rūpe ca pramāṇe sati jāyamānasya tasya jñāna bahirbhāva anupapattiḥ tad bahis bhūta vāgdhenu upāsana ādau pramāṇa vastu paratantra tva adarśanāt iti vācyam mad mate liṅgasya prāmāṇya anabhyupagamena sati pramāṇe iti asya eva abhāvāt upakrama ādeḥ pramāṇa tva pakṣe tad pūrva kālīna tvena asya pramāṇe sati iti etad aṃśa asiddheḥ

original: tasmāt śravaṇāderadhīrūpatayā manovyāpāratvena vidheyatvopapattiḥ| siddhāntabindukalpalatikayorvistaraḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt śravaṇa ādeḥ adhī rūpa tayā manaḥ vyāpāra tvena vidheya tva upapattiḥ siddhānta bindu kalpa latikayoḥ vistaraḥ

original: yaccānuvāditvādivarṇanaṃ vācaspatye, tat prasthānāntaratvānna vidhitvoktivirodhi|| ityadvaitasiddhau śravaṇādervidheyatvopapattiḥ|| 3 ||
analyzed: yat ca anuvādi tva ādi varṇanam vācaspatye tat prasthāna antara tvāt na vidhi tva ukti virodhi iti advaita siddhau śravaṇa ādeḥ vidheya tva upapattiḥ

original: evaṃ vicāravidhāyakaśravaṇavidhireva jijñāsāsūtramūlam| na ca vicāravidhau śravaṇasādhyāparokṣajñānādhīnāyā aparokṣajñānakāmanāyā adhikāriviśeṣaṇatvāṅgīkāreṇa anyonyāśrayāpāta iti vācyam| adhītavedasya viditapadapadārthasaṅgatikasyāpātato jāyamānaparokṣajñānādhīnāparokṣajñānakāmanāyā adhikāriviśeṣaṇatvenoktānyonyāśrayānavatārāt|
analyzed: evam vicāra vidhāyaka śravaṇa vidhiḥ eva jijñāsā sūtra mūlam na ca vicāra vidhau śravaṇa sādhya aparokṣa jñāna adhīnāyāḥ aparokṣa jñāna kāmanāyāḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tva aṅgīkāreṇa anyonya āśraya āpātaḥ iti vācyam adhīta vedasya vidita pada padārtha saṅgatikasya āpātataḥ jāyamāna parokṣa jñāna adhīna aparokṣa jñāna kāmanāyāḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tvena ukta anyonya āśraya anavatārāt

original: na ca jijñāsāsūtrokto vicārastattvanirṇāyakanyāyānusandhānarūpaḥ, anyathā nyāyagrathanātmakaśāstrārambhasiddhaye tatkartavyatoktyayukteḥ, itarasya vedetikartavyatātvānupapatteśca| śravaṇaṃ ca noktanyāyānusandhānarūpaṃ mananābhedaprasaṅgāt| ato na śravaṇavidhijijñāsāsūtrayormūlamūlibhāva iti vācyam|

original: jijñāsāsūtrasya śravaṇavidhisamānaviṣayakatayā mūlamūlibhāvābhāve'pi śravaṇavidhiviṣayaśaktitātparyāvadhāraṇātmakaśravaṇākṣiptopakramopasaṃhārāditātparyaliṅgavicāramādāya samānaviṣayatvasambhavena tadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: jijñāsā sūtrasya śravaṇa vidhi samāna viṣayaka tayā mūla mūli bhāva abhāve pi śravaṇa vidhi viṣaya śakti tātparya avadhāraṇa ātmaka śravaṇa ākṣipta upakrama upasaṃhāra ādi tātparya liṅga vicāram ādāya samāna viṣaya tva sambhavena tad upapatteḥ

original: mananaṃ tu śrutasyārthasya yuktibhiścintanamiti na tadabhedo'pi, arthākṣiptavicārasyetikartavyatātve'pi tātparyāvadhāraṇarūpe śravaṇe uktasyāṅgitvasyānapāyāt|
analyzed: mananam tu śrutasya arthasya yuktibhiḥ cintanam iti na tad abhedaḥ api artha ākṣipta vicārasya itikartavya tā tve api tātparya avadhāraṇa rūpe śravaṇe uktasya aṅgi tvasya anapāyāt

original: yattu yuktibhiranucintanaṃ nāma yadi śravaṇaniścitasya tātparyasya tadviṣayaśabdasya vā smaraṇam, pratyabhijñānaṃ vā, saṃskāradārḍhyaphalakaṃ śravaṇasamānākāramabhijñāntaraṃ vā, tarhi tasyāvaśyakaśravaṇāvṛttyaiva siddheḥ mananavidhivaiyarthyam, trividhasyāpi tasya śravaṇānantargatayuktyanapekṣatvena śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhyo
analyzed: yat tu yuktibhiḥ anucintanam nāma yadi śravaṇa niścitasya tātparyasya tad viṣaya śabdasya vā smaraṇam pratyabhijñānam vā saṃskāra dārḍhya phalakam śravaṇa samāna ākāram abhijñā antaram vā tarhi tasya āvaśyaka śravaṇa āvṛttyā eva siddheḥ manana vidhi vaiyarthyam trividhasya api tasya śravaṇa an antargata yukti anapekṣa tvena śrotavyaḥ śruti vākyebhyaḥ

original: mantavyaścopapattibhiritismṛtivirodhaśca, `śravaṇaṃ yāvadajñānaṃ matiryāvadayuktatā' iti mananasya śravaṇānivartitāyuktatvaśaṅkānivartakatvapratipādakasmṛtivirodhaśca iti| tanna, anucintanasya śrutārthaviṣayakayuktāyuktatvādisaṃśayanivartakayuktyanusandhānarūpatvena vivakṣitatayā tvaduktadoṣānavakāśāt|
analyzed: mantavyaḥ ca upapattibhiḥ iti smṛti virodhaḥ ca śravaṇam yāvat ajñānam matiḥ yāvat ayukta tā iti mananasya śravaṇa anivarti tā ayukta tva śaṅkā nivartaka tva pratipādaka smṛti virodhaḥ ca iti tat na anucintanasya śruta artha viṣayaka yukta ayukta tva ādi saṃśaya nivartaka yukti anusandhāna rūpa tvena vivakṣita tayā tvad ukta doṣa anavakāśāt

original: na ca evaṃ yuktāyuktatvasaṃśayādeḥ saṃśayapūrvapakṣasiddhāntāt mīmāṃsāśāstrārambhopayuktavicārakartavyatāṃ pratipādayadādyasūtraṃ mananavidhimūlamevasyāt, na tu śravaṇavidhimūlamiti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca evam yukta ayukta tva saṃśaya ādeḥ saṃśaya pūrvapakṣa siddhāntāt mīmāṃsā śāstra ārambha upayukta vicāra kartavyatām pratipādayat ādya sūtram manana vidhi mūlam eva syāt na tu śravaṇa vidhi mūlam iti vācyam

original: tātparyaviṣayayuktāyuktatvādisaṃśayādinivartakavicārāpekṣayā tātparyanirṇāyakaśravaṇākṣiptaliṅgavicārasyābhyarhitatayā tadākṣepakaśravaṇavidhimūlatvasyaiva vaktuṃ śakyatvāt, yuktāyuktatvavicārasyānuṣaṅgikatvācca|
analyzed: tātparya viṣaya yukta ayukta tva ādi saṃśaya ādi nivartaka vicāra apekṣayā tātparya nirṇāyaka śravaṇa ākṣipta liṅga vicārasya abhyarhita tayā tad ākṣepaka śravaṇa vidhi mūla tvasya eva vaktum śakya tvāt yukta ayukta tva vicārasya ānuṣaṅgika tvāt ca

original: yadvā samanvayādhyāyoktatātparyaniścāyakopakramādiyuktyanusandhānaṃ śravaṇaṃ dvitīyādhyāyoktārthāsattvaśaṅkānivartakayuktyanusandhānaṃ mananam|

original: nanu evaṃ vivaraṇoktivirodhaḥ, yauktikāsambhāvanāviparītabhāvanānirāsitarkāṇāṃ prathamajñānāntarbhūtatvād ityādinā arthāpattīnāmapi śravaṇāntargatimuktvā "brahmātmatvaviparītabhāvanāpracayanimittatadekāgravṛttyayogyatvamasambhāvanā viparītabhāvanā tu śarīrādhyāsasaṃskārapracayaḥ" ityādinā asambhāvanānivartakasya

original: na ca evaṃ nāmādiṣu brahmopāsanāyāṃ tvayā vidheyatvenāṅgīkṛtāyāṃ puṃtantratvaṃ na sidhyet, tatrāpi manodhāraṇādereva puṃtantratvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi vācyam, jñānavidhyuktānupapattestatrābhāvena nirodhādīnāmanyaparatvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt|

original: na ca tvayāpi nididhyāsanasya parokṣajñānasantānarūpasya vidheyatvaṃ vadatā santānināṃ jñānānāmapi vidheyatvamaṅgīkartavyameva tadavidhāne santatividhānānupapatteriti vācyam, āvṛttiguṇayogasyaiva vidheyatvād upaniṣadamāvartayedityatreva |

original: na ca śravaṇādeḥ jñānānātmakatve śravaṇaṃ yāvadajñānamityajñānavirodhitvasmṛteḥ śravaṇenājñānaṃ nivṛttamityanubhavasya cānupapattiriti vācyam, āvṛttiguṇayogavākyārthapramityupayuktatātparyanirṇayadvārā upakramādiliṅgavicārātmakaśravaṇāderajñānādivirodhitayā smṛtyanubhavayorupapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca śravaṇa ādeḥ jñāna anātmaka tve śravaṇam yāvat ajñānam iti ajñāna virodhi tva smṛteḥ śravaṇena ajñānam nivṛttam iti anubhavasya ca anupapattiḥ iti vācyam āvṛtti guṇa yoga vākya artha pramiti upayukta tātparya nirṇaya dvārā upakrama ādi liṅga vicāra ātmaka śravaṇa ādeḥ ajñāna ādi virodhi tayā smṛti anubhavayoḥ upapatteḥ

original: `vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīte'tyādau jñānavidhāvuktānupapattyā prajñāśabdasya vicāralākṣaṇikatvopapatteḥ| na ca tvayā vidheyatvenāṅgīkṛtasya dhyānasya jñānabhinnatve tasya svaviṣaye vyavahārajanakatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, tadanyajñānenaiva tatkāraṇatayā''vaśyakena tadviṣaye vyavahāropapatteḥ pramāṇavato'sya gauravasyādoṣatvāt|

original: ata eva dhyānaviṣaye jānāmītyanubhavasmaraṇe tadbhinnajñānaprayuktatayā vyākhyāte| tasyābhidhyānāditi śrutau dhyānasya māyākhyāvidyānivartakatve'pi taduktiḥ dhyānānantarabhāvisākṣātkāradvārābhiprāyeti na tayā virodhaḥ|

original: yattūpāsītetyupakramya `ya evaṃ vede'tyupasamhāreṇa tvayāpi vidheyatvenāṅgīkṛtāyāmupāsanāyāṃ vididhātuprayogeṇa upāsanāyāḥ jñānatvāvagamād anyatrāpi jñānatvaṃ na vidheyatvavirodhīti, tanna, uktānupapattyā videstatrāmukhyatvenaiva jñānatvāgamakatvād dhātvanekārthatvena vā|

original: na ca mānatantratāmātreṇa kathamapuṃtantratā pratigrahītrāditantrasyāpi dānādestaddarśanāditi vācyam; na hyanyatantratāmātreṇāvidheyatvaṃ brūmaḥ kintu pumicchābhiryatkāraṇe sati anyathā kartumaśakyatvam| jñānasya puruṣatantratābhaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: na ca māna tantra tā mātreṇa katham apuṃtantra tā pratigrahītṛ ādi tantrasya api dāna ādeḥ tad darśanāt iti vācyam na hi anya tantra tā mātreṇa avidheya tvam brūmaḥ kintu pum icchābhiḥ yat kāraṇe sati anyathā kartum aśakya tvam jñānasya puruṣa tantra tā bhaṅgaḥ

original: kiṃ ca vidhīyamānaṃ jñānaṃ kiṃ śābdam ? kiṃ vā tadabhyāsaḥ ? yadvā tattvamanapekṣyāropitaviṣayatayā dhyānam ? kiṃ vāparokṣyaphalakaṃ jñānāntaram ? nādyaḥ, karmakāṇḍa iva gṛhītasaṅgateḥ svataḥ siddhatvena kṛtyasādhyatayā vidhyaviṣayatvāt|

original: na dvitīyaḥ, sa kiṃ mokṣāya vidhīyate ? sākṣātkārāya vā ? nādyaḥ, tasya naiyogikatvena svargādivadanityatvāpātāt| na ca bandhadhvaṃsasya naiyogikatve'pi dhvaṃsatvāt śrutyādibalācca nityatvopapattiriti vācyam, na hi mannaya iva tvannaye'pi bandhadhvaṃsamātraṃ muktiḥ kintu lokāntaraprāptiḥ, tasyāmuktadoṣatādavasthyāpattiḥ|

original: na cānāvṛttiśrutyā nityatvam, `tadyathehakarmacito lokaḥ kṣīyate evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate' iti śrutyā naiyogikasyānityatvāvagamāt| na caitacchrativirodhena tasyānityatvābodhakatvam, `yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam' iti yuktyupodvalitatayā prābalyāt|

original: na dvitīyaḥ, tat kiṃ dṛṣṭaphalakam ? adṛṣṭaphalakaṃ vā ? nādyaḥ, parokṣajñānābhyāsena tattvasākṣātkārādarśanāt| na dvitīyaḥ, pramāṇāyattatvāttasya| ata eva na tṛtīyaḥ, dhyānasya jñānarūpatvābhāvācca| na caturthaḥ śabdasyāpi prāmāṇyābhāvāpātād brahmaṇi pramāṇībhūtajñānakartavyatāyāmeva prāmāṇyāt|
analyzed: na dvitīyaḥ tat kim dṛṣṭa phalakam adṛṣṭa phalakam vā na ādyaḥ parokṣa jñāna abhyāsena tattva sākṣātkāra adarśanāt na dvitīyaḥ pramāṇa āyatta tvāt tasya atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ dhyānasya jñāna rūpa tva abhāvāt ca na caturthaḥ śabdasya api prāmāṇya abhāva āpātāt brahmaṇi pramāṇībhūta jñāna kartavya tāyām eva prāmāṇyāt
