analyzed: yat tu sākṣātkāre api svakīya tayā puruṣa artha tā pakṣe muktasya sukha sākṣātkāra rūpa tayā tam prati api tasya a puruṣa artha tā āpattiḥ sva itara asambandhi tvena svasya puruṣa artha tve mukta sva rūpeṇa sukhena saṃsāri itara asaṃbandhena saṃsāriṇaḥ puruṣa artha prasaṅgaḥ iti tat na sākṣātkriyamāṇa tvena eva hi pumartha tā

original: muktasukhasākṣātkārasya taṃ prati pumarthatve'pi na saṃsāriṇastathā, taṃ pratyabhāsamānatvād, bhāne vā'saṃsāritveneṣṭāpattiḥ| yattu pratyakprakāśamānatvena sukhaṃ pumarthaḥ iti, padapyetena vyākhyātam| pratyak‌prakāśamānatvena sākṣātkriyamāṇatāyā evokteḥ|
analyzed: mukta sukha sākṣātkārasya tam prati pumartha tve api na saṃsāriṇaḥ tathā tam prati abhāsamāna tvāt bhāne vā asaṃsāri tvena iṣṭa āpattiḥ yat tu pratyak prakāśamāna tvena sukham pumarthaḥ iti pad api etena vyākhyātam pratyak prakāśamāna tvena sākṣātkriyamāṇa tāyāḥ eva ukteḥ

original: yattu sukhatvena prakāśamānaṃ sukhaṃ pumarthaḥ, na ca tatparamate mokṣe'sti iti, tanna, sākṣātkriyamāṇatvenaivātiprasaṅgānirāse adhikoktergauravakaratvāt||
analyzed: yat tu sukha tvena prakāśamānam sukham pumarthaḥ na ca tat para mate mokṣe sti iti tat na sākṣātkriyamāṇa tvena eva atiprasaṅga anirāse adhika ukteḥ gaurava kara tvāt

original: nanu kasyāyaṃ mokṣaḥ pumarthaḥ ? kimahamarthasya ? āhosviccinmātrasya ? nādyaḥ, tvanmate'hamarthasya muktyananvayāt| nāntyaḥ, `ahaṃ muktaḥ syā'mitivaccinmātraṃ syāditīcchāyā ananubhavāditi cenna ahamarthagataṃ cidaṃśaṃ muktikālānvayinaṃ prati pumarthasya mokṣe saṃbhava ityuktaprāyatvāt|
analyzed: nanu kasya ayam mokṣaḥ pumarthaḥ kim ahamarthasya āhosvit cit mātrasya na ādyaḥ tvanmata ihamarthasya mukti ananvayāt na antyaḥ aham muktaḥ syām iti vat cit mātram syāt iti icchāyāḥ ananubhavāt iti ced na ahamartha gatam cit aṃśam mukti kāla anvayinam prati pumarthasya mokṣe saṃbhavaḥ iti ukta prāya tvāt

original: na ca sukhasya duḥkhābhāvamātratve vaiśeṣikamokṣavadapumarthatā, atireke sadvitīyatvamiti vācyam, duḥkhābhāvātireke'pyātmānatirekāt| na ca ātmanaḥ sukhamātratve prakāśamātratve vā sukhaprakāśābhāvenāpumarthatvam, ubhayātmakatve cākhaṇḍārthatvahāniriti vācyam, sukhaprakāśayorekātmarūpatayā ubhayatvasyaivābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca sukhasya duḥkha abhāva mātra tve vaiśeṣika mokṣa vat apumartha tā atireke sadvitīya tvam iti vācyam duḥkha abhāva atireke pi ātma anatirekāt na ca ātmanaḥ sukha mātra tve prakāśa mātra tve vā sukha prakāśa abhāvena apumartha tvam ubhaya ātmaka tve ca akhaṇḍa artha tva hāniḥ iti vācyam sukha prakāśayoḥ eka ātma rūpa tayā ubhaya tvasya eva abhāvāt

original: na cārthabhedābhāve sukhaprakāśa iti sahaprayogāyogaḥ, avidyākalpitaduḥkhajaḍātmakatvarūpavyāvartyabhedena tadupapatteḥ| yattu duḥkhābhāvasya sukhasya ca tattvato duḥkhādbhede apasiddhāntaḥ, abhede tvapumarthatā iti, tanna, duḥkhasya kalpitatvena tadbhedasya tatsamānayogakṣematayā tāttvikatvābhāvenāpasiddhāntābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca artha bheda abhāve sukha prakāśaḥ iti saha prayoga ayogaḥ avidyā kalpita duḥkha jaḍa ātmaka tva rūpa vyāvartya bhedena tad upapatteḥ yat tu duḥkha abhāvasya sukhasya ca tattvataḥ duḥkhāt bhede apasiddhāntaḥ abhede tu apumartha tā iti tat na duḥkhasya kalpita tvena tad bhedasya tad samāna yogakṣema tayā tāttvika tva abhāvena apasiddhānta abhāvāt

original: yattu svaprakāśasya sukhasya svataḥ sphuraṇe'pi duḥkhābhāvasyāsphuraṇādapumarthatā iti, tanna, duḥkhābhāvasyātmānatirekeṇātmābhinne sukhe sphurati tasyāpi sphuraṇāt, tattvenāsphuraṇasyāprayojakatāyā uktatvāt| tasmātsvaprakāśacidabhinnaṃ sukhaṃ pumarthaḥ|| iti cinmātrasya mokṣabhāgitvopapattiḥ||
analyzed: yat tu sva prakāśasya sukhasya svatas sphuraṇe api duḥkha abhāvasya asphuraṇāt apumartha tā iti tat na duḥkha abhāvasya ātma anatirekeṇa ātma abhinne sukhe sphurati tasya api sphuraṇāt tattvena asphuraṇasya aprayojaka tāyāḥ ukta tvāt tasmāt sva prakāśa cit abhinnam sukham pumarthaḥ iti cit mātrasya mokṣa bhāgi tva upapattiḥ

original: ityadvaitasiddhau mukterānandarūpatvena puruṣārthatvam|| 3 ||
analyzed: iti advaitasiddhau mukteḥ ānanda rūpa tvena puruṣa artha tvam

original: tacca jīvanmuktānāṃ svānubhavasiddham| jīvanmuktaśca tattvajñānena nivṛttāvidyo'pyanuvṛttadehādipratibhāsaḥ| na ca tattvajñānādavidyānāśe sadyaḥśarīrapātāpattiḥ, nivṛttasarpabhramasyāpi saṃskārād bhayakampānuvṛttivat, daṇḍasaṃyoganāśe'pi cakrabhramaṇavacca saṃskārānuvṛtteravidyānivṛttāvapi tatkāryānuvṛttisaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: tat ca jīvanmuktānām sva anubhava siddham jīvanmuktaḥ ca tattva jñānena nivṛtta avidyā upi anuvṛtta deha ādi pratibhāsaḥ na ca tattva jñānāt avidyā nāśe sadyas śarīrapāta āpattiḥ nivṛtta sarpa bhramasya api saṃskārāt bhaya kampa anuvṛtti vat daṇḍa saṃyoga nāśe pi cakra bhramaṇa vat ca saṃskāra anuvṛtteḥ avidyā nivṛttau api tad kārya anuvṛtti saṃbhavāt

original: na ca kriyājñānayoreva saṃskāra, nānyasyeti vācyam, niḥsāritapuṣpāyāṃ sampuṭikāyāṃ puṣpavāsanādarśanāt, vimato nāśaḥ saṃskāravyāptaḥ, saṃskāranāśānyatve sati nāśatvāt, jñānanāśavat ityanumānācca, saṃskāraḥ kāryo'pi dhvaṃsa iva nirupādānakaḥ avidyeva ca śuddhātmāśrita iti nāvidyāsāpekṣaḥ|
analyzed: na ca kriyā jñānayoḥ eva saṃskāra na anyasya iti vācyam niḥsārita puṣpāyām sampuṭikāyām puṣpa vāsanā darśanāt vimataḥ nāśaḥ saṃskāra vyāptaḥ saṃskāra nāśa anya tve sati nāśa tvāt jñāna nāśa vat iti anumānāt ca saṃskāraḥ kāryaḥ api dhvaṃsaḥ iva nirupādānakaḥ avidyā iva ca śuddha ātma āśritaḥ iti na avidyā sāpekṣaḥ

original: na ca bhāvakāryasyādhyastasya saṃskāradehāditaddhetuprārabdhakarmādeḥ sthityarthaḥ tadupādānājñānānuvṛttyāpāta iti vācyam, vinaśyadavasthasya samavāyikāraṇaṃ vinā sthitidarśanāt| na ca kṣaṇamātrasthitāvapi kathaṃ bahukṣaṇasthitiriti vācyam, satyupapādake kṣaṇagaṇakalpanāyā aprayojakatvāt|
analyzed: na ca bhāva kāryasya adhyastasya saṃskāra deha ādi tad hetu prārabdha karma ādeḥ sthiti arthaḥ tad upādāna ajñāna anuvṛtti āpātaḥ iti vācyam vinaśyat avasthasya samavāyikāraṇam vinā sthiti darśanāt na ca kṣaṇa mātra sthitau api katham bahu kṣaṇa sthitiḥ iti vācyam sati upapādake kṣaṇa gaṇa kalpanāyāḥ aprayojaka tvāt

original: tatra kṣaṇamātraṃ sthitiḥ, samasamayasyājanakatvāt, atra tu pratibandhakābhāvasahakṛtahetostāvatkālamabhāvāt| ata eva pūrvajñānānivṛttasyādhyastasya tadanadhikaviṣayeṇa kathaṃ nivṛttiriti nirastam, pratibandhakābhāvasahakārāsakārābhyāṃ viśeṣāt|
analyzed: tatra kṣaṇa mātram sthitiḥ sama samayasya ajanaka tvāt atra tu pratibandhaka abhāva sahakṛta hetoḥ tāvatkālam abhāvāt atas eva pūrva jñāna anivṛttasya adhyastasya tad anadhika viṣayeṇa katham nivṛttiḥ iti nirastam pratibandhaka abhāva sahakāra asakārābhyām viśeṣāt

original: jīvanmuktidaśāyāmānandasphūrtyāpādanamiṣṭameva, tattve jñāte dvicandrādivaddoṣādbādhitānuvṛttisaṃbhavācca| na ca tatrevātra jñānānivartyadoṣābhāvena vaiṣamyam, yāvatpratibandhakasattvaṃ jñānānivartyasya doṣasyātrāpi saṃbhavāt, sarvajñānānivartyasya tasya kutrāpyasaṃpratipatteḥ| taduktaṃ -- `na hi jātyaiva kaścid doṣo'stī'ti|
analyzed: jīvanmukti daśāyām ānanda sphūrti āpādanam iṣṭam eva tattve jñāte dvi candra ādi vat doṣāt bādhita anuvṛtti saṃbhavāt ca na ca tatra iva atra jñāna anivartya doṣa abhāvena vaiṣamyam yāvat pratibandhaka sattvam jñāna anivartyasya doṣasya atra api saṃbhavāt sarva jñāna anivartyasya tasya kutra api asaṃpratipatteḥ tat uktam na hi jātyā eva kaścid doṣaḥ asti iti

original: yadvā avidyāleśānuvṛttyā dehādyanuvṛttiḥ| nanu leśo nāvayavaḥ, ajñānasya niravayavatvād, ata evāvidyā dagdhapaṭanyāyena tāvattiṣṭhatītyapi nirastam, niravayave etannyāyāsaṃbhavāditi cenna, ākārasyaiva leśaśabdārthatvād, `indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyata' ityādiśrutyā avidyāyā anekākāratvāvagamāt|
analyzed: yat vā avidyā leśa anuvṛttyā deha ādi anuvṛttiḥ nanu leśaḥ na avayavaḥ ajñānasya niravayava tvāt atas eva avidyā dagdha paṭa nyāyena tāvat tiṣṭhati iti api nirastam niravayave etad nyāya asaṃbhavāt iti ced na ākārasya eva leśa śabda artha tvāt indraḥ māyābhiḥ puru rūpaḥ īyate ityādi śrutyā avidyāyāḥ aneka ākāra tva avagamāt

original: ākārinivṛttāvapyākārasyānuvṛttirvyaktinivṛttāvapi jāteriva| nanu ko'yamākāro nāma jātirvā ? śaktyādirūpo dharmo vā ? suvarṇakuṇḍalādivadavasthāviśeṣo vā ? nādyau, tayordehādibhramopādānatve avidyātvāpātāt, anupādānatve ca upādānāntarābhāvena dehādibhramotpattyayogāt ātmānyatvena jñānanivartyatvena cāvidyātatkāryānyataratvāvaśyaṃbhāvenājñāne
analyzed: ākāri nivṛttau api ākārasya anuvṛttiḥ vyakti nivṛttau api jāteḥ iva nanu kaḥ yam ākāraḥ nāma jātiḥ vā śakti ādi rūpaḥ dharmaḥ vā suvarṇa kuṇḍala ādi vat avasthā viśeṣaḥ vā na ādyau tayoḥ deha ādi bhrama upādāna tve avidyā tva āpātāt anupādāna tve ca upādāna antara abhāvena deha ādi bhrama utpatti ayogāt ātma anya tvena jñāna nivartya tvena ca avidyā tad kārya anyatara tva avaśyaṃbhāvena ajñāne

original: nivatte sthityayogācca| ata eva na tṛtīyaḥ| avasthāvantaṃ vinā avasthāyāḥ sthityayogāditi cenna, anekaśaktimadavidyāyāḥ prapañce pāramārthikatvādibhramahetuśakteḥ prapañce arthakriyāsamarthatvasampādakaśakteśca prārabdhakarmasamakālīnatattvasākṣātkāreṇa nivṛttāvapi aparokṣapratibhāsayogyārthabhāsajanikāyāḥ śakteranuvṛtteḥ tadvatī avidyāpi
analyzed: nivatte sthiti ayogāt ca atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ avasthāvantam vinā avasthāyāḥ sthiti ayogāt iti ced na aneka śaktimat avidyāyāḥ prapañce pāramārthika tva ādi bhrama hetu śakteḥ prapañce arthakriyā samartha tva sampādaka śakteḥ ca prārabdha karma sama kālīna tattva sākṣātkāreṇa nivṛttau api aparokṣa pratibhāsa yogya artha bhāsa janikāyāḥ śakteḥ anuvṛtteḥ tadvatī avidyā api

original: tiṣṭhatyeveti noktadoṣāvakāśaḥ| na cāvidyāyāṃ satyāṃ kathaṃ mukta iti vyapadeśaḥ ? śaktināśamātrāt| ata eva samaye sarvaśaktimadajñānanāśaḥ tajjātīyenāpratiruddhena pratyayena| tathā ca śrutiḥ -- `tasyābhidhyānādyojanāttattvabhāvād bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛtti'riti|
analyzed: tiṣṭhati eva iti na ukta doṣa avakāśaḥ na ca avidyāyām satyām katham muktaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ śakti nāśa mātrāt atas eva samaye sarva śaktimat ajñāna nāśaḥ tad jātīyena apratiruddhena pratyayena tathā ca śrutiḥ tasya abhidhyānāt yojanāt tattva bhāvāt bhūyas ca ante viśva māyā nivṛttiḥ iti

original: na ca bhūya ityasya yojanādityanenānvayāt na leśānuvṛttāvasyāḥ śrutermānateti vācyam, viśeṣaṇānvayāpekṣayā viśeṣyānvayasyābhyarhitatvāt tattvabhāvādityanena vyavadhānād anta iti padavaiyarthyācca viparītayojanasyāsaṅgateḥ|
analyzed: na ca bhūyas ityasya yojanāt iti anena anvayāt na leśa anuvṛttau asyāḥ śruteḥ māna tā iti vācyam viśeṣaṇa anvaya apekṣayā viśeṣya anvayasya abhyarhita tvāt tattva bhāvāt iti anena vyavadhānāt ante iti pada vaiyarthyāt ca viparīta yojanasya asaṅgateḥ

original: na ca leśasthitau karmānuvṛttiḥ tadanuvṛttau ca jñānapratibandhena leśasthitirityanyonyāśraya iti vācyam, na tāvat jñaptau `bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛtti' rityādiśrutereva leśānuvṛtteravagatatvāt, nāpi sthitau ekakālīnatvena doṣābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca leśa sthitau karma anuvṛttiḥ tad anuvṛttau ca jñāna pratibandhena leśa sthitiḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ iti vācyam na tāvat jñaptau bhūyas ca ante viśva māyā nivṛttiḥ rityādi śruteḥ eva leśa anuvṛtteḥ avagata tvāt nā api sthitau eka kālīna tvena doṣa abhāvāt

original: yadvā ajñānasya sūkṣmāvasthā leśaḥ| yathā `tasmāt phale pravṛttasya yāgādeḥ śaktimātrakam| utpattāvapi paśvāderapūrvaṃ na tataḥ pṛthak||' iti vārtikena yāge gate'pi yāgasūkṣmāvasthārūpamapūrvaṃ yāge sādhanatānirvāhakamaṅgīkriyate, tathā ajñāne gate'pi tatsūkṣmāvasthārūpo leśo dehādipratītyanukūlaḥ svīkriyate, svargajanakatāgrāhaśruterivātrāpi
analyzed: yat vā ajñānasya sūkṣma avasthā leśaḥ yathā tasmāt phale pravṛttasya yāga ādeḥ śakti mātrakam utpattau api paśu ādeḥ apūrvam na tatas pṛthak iti vārtikena yāge gate api yāga sūkṣma avasthā rūpam apūrvam yāge sādhanatā nirvāhakam aṅgīkriyate tathā ajñāne gate api tad sūkṣma avasthā rūpaḥ leśaḥ deha ādi pratīti anukūlaḥ svīkriyate svarga janakatā grāha śruteḥ iva atra api

original: jīvanmuktiśrutestādṛgarthasvīkārāt| tasmādavidyāleśānuvṛttyā jīvanmuktirupapannatarā|| ityadvaitasiddhau jīvanmuktyupapattiḥ|| 4 ||
analyzed: jīvanmukti śruteḥ tādṛś artha svīkārāt tasmāt avidyā leśa anuvṛttyā jīvanmuktiḥ upapannatarā iti advaita siddhau jīvanmukti upapattiḥ

original: yattu paramate'parokṣajñānino'pi svayogyaparamānandahetuparamakāṣṭhāpannabhaktyabhāve tatsādhyasya mocakasya īśvaraprasādasyābhāvena prārabdhakarmaṇā saṃsārānuvṛttau jīvanmuktiḥ tadbhāve tu prasādasyāpi bhāvena niḥśśeṣaduḥkhanivṛttiviśiṣṭasvatonīcoccabhāvāpannasvarūpānandāvirbhāvarūpā muktiriti tanna, `tāvadevāsya cira'mityādiśrutyā
analyzed: yat tu paramate parokṣa jñāninaḥ api sva yogya paramānanda hetu parama kāṣṭhā āpanna bhakti abhāve tad sādhyasya mocakasya īśvara prasādasya abhāvena prārabdha karmaṇā saṃsāra anuvṛttau jīvanmuktiḥ tad bhāve tu prasādasya api bhāvena niḥśśeṣa duḥkha nivṛtti viśiṣṭa svatas nīca ucca bhāva āpanna svarūpa ānanda āvirbhāva rūpā muktiḥ iti tat na tāvat eva asya ciram ityādi śrutyā

original: asyotpannatattvasākṣātkārasya prārabdhakarmakṣayamātramapekṣaṇīyaṃ kaivalyasaṃpattyarthamiti pratipādanena īśvaraprasādāpekṣāyā vaktumaśakyatvāt| smṛtipurāṇādīnāṃ śrutivirodhena stutiparatvāt|
analyzed: asya utpanna tattva sākṣātkārasya prārabdha karma kṣaya mātram apekṣaṇīyam kaivalya saṃpatti artham iti pratipādanena īśvara prasāda apekṣāyāḥ vaktum aśakya tvāt smṛti purāṇa ādīnām śruti virodhena stuti paratvāt

original: `yamevaiva vṛṇute tena labhyaḥ tasmaiṣa ātmā vivṛṇute tanūṃ svā'miti bhaktijanyeśvaraprasādasyāpi tatsākṣātkārasvarūpa evopayogasya bodhitatvena smṛtyādīnāmapi tadanusāritvāt vaiparītyena sādhyasādhanabhāve mānābhāvāt| na ca prārabdhakarmakṣaye prasādaviniyogaḥ, prasādanirapekṣabhogādeva tatsiddheḥ|
